<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;

  var CURRENT_TAB = 'companies';

  function initAdmin() {
    if (!SESSION_TOKEN) { window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login'; return; }
    renderHub();
  }

  function renderHub() {
    var homeHref = scriptUrl + '?action=ERPDashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN;
    var logo = '<a class="app-logo app-logo-main" href="' + homeHref + '" title="الرئيسية" onclick="UIC.navTo(event, this.getAttribute(\'href\'))"><img src="' + (UIC.SYSTEM_LOGO_URL || '') + '" alt="الرئيسية" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a>';
    var html =
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">' + logo + '<h2 style="margin:0;font-size:clamp(18px,4vw,24px);">إدارة النظام</h2></div>' +
      '<p style="color:var(--text-muted);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:24px;">اختر القسم الذي تريد الإدارة عليه.</p>' +
       '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,200px),1fr));gap:16px;margin-bottom:32px;">' +
        UIC.moduleTile({ icon: '&#127970;', title: 'الشركات', subtitle: 'إدارة شركات النظام', onOpen: 'loadTab(\'companies\')' }) +
        UIC.moduleTile({ icon: '&#128101;', title: 'المستخدمون', subtitle: 'إدارة حسابات المستخدمين', onOpen: 'loadTab(\'users\')' }) +
        UIC.moduleTile({ icon: '&#128272;', title: 'صلاحيات الأدوار', subtitle: 'ضبط صلاحيات الوصول', onOpen: 'loadTab(\'matrix\')' }) +
        UIC.moduleTile({ icon: '&#128196;', title: 'صفحات النظام', subtitle: 'إدارة صفحات النظام', onOpen: 'loadTab(\'pages\')' }) +
        UIC.moduleTile({ icon: '&#128176;', title: 'العملات', subtitle: 'إدارة أسعار الصرف', onOpen: 'loadTab(\'currency\')' }) +
        UIC.moduleTile({ icon: '&#128179;', title: 'فواتير الاشتراكات', subtitle: 'إصدار وطباعة فواتير النظام (ERP Invoices)', onOpen: 'loadTab(\'invoices\')' }) +
        (IS_SUPER_ADMIN ? UIC.moduleTile({ icon: '&#9888;', title: 'مفتاح إيقاف النظام', subtitle: 'إيقاف/تشغيل النظام بالكامل', onOpen: 'loadTab(\'killswitch\')' }) : '') +
       '</div>' +
      '<div id="admin-tab-area" style="display:none;">' +
      renderTabsHtml() +
      '<div class="empty-state" id="tab-body" style="display:none;"></div>' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('admin-root').innerHTML = html;
  }

  function renderTabsHtml() {
    var tabs = [
      { id: 'companies', label: 'الشركات' },
      { id: 'users', label: 'المستخدمون' },
      { id: 'matrix', label: 'صلاحيات الأدوار' },
      { id: 'pages', label: 'صفحات النظام' },
      { id: 'currency', label: 'العملات' },
      { id: 'invoices', label: 'فواتير الاشتراكات' }
    ];
    if (IS_SUPER_ADMIN) tabs.push({ id: 'killswitch', label: 'مفتاح إيقاف النظام' });
    return '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="renderHub()">← العودة</button>' +
      tabs.map(function (t) {
        return '<button class="btn ' + (CURRENT_TAB === t.id ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline') + '" onclick="loadTab(\'' + t.id + '\')">' + t.label + '</button>';
      }).join('') + '</div>';
  }

  function loadTab(tab) {
    CURRENT_TAB = tab;
    var area = document.getElementById('admin-tab-area');
    area.style.display = '';
    var tabsContainer = area.querySelector('div');
    if (tabsContainer) tabsContainer.outerHTML = renderTabsHtml();
    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    body.style.display = '';
    if (tab === 'companies') loadCompanies();
    else if (tab === 'users') loadUsers();
    else if (tab === 'matrix') loadMatrix();
    else if (tab === 'pages') loadPages();
    else if (tab === 'currency') loadCurrency();
    else if (tab === 'invoices') loadInvoices();
    else if (tab === 'killswitch') loadKillSwitch();
  }

  /* ---------- COMPANIES ---------- */
  function loadCompanies() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    API.call('admin_list_companies', {}, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        renderCompanies(r.companies || []);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderCompanies(list) {
    window.__companies = list;
    var rows = list.map(function (c) {
      return {
        id: c.company_unique_id,
        name_ar: c.company_name_ar,
        name_en: c.company_name_en,
        enabled: UIC.statusPill(String(c.enabled).toLowerCase() === 'true' ? 'مفعّل' : 'معطّل', String(c.enabled).toLowerCase() === 'true' ? 'success' : 'neutral'),
        main_page: c.company_main_page || '-',
        actions: '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="editCompany(\'' + FMT.escape(c.company_unique_id) + '\')">تعديل</button>'
      };
    });
    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    body.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="editCompany(\'\')">+ إضافة شركة</button></div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('companies-table', {
        title: 'الشركات',
        headers: [
          { key: 'id', label: 'المعرف' },
          { key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم العربي' },
          { key: 'name_en', label: 'الاسم الإنجليزي' },
          { key: 'enabled', label: 'الحالة' },
          { key: 'main_page', label: 'الصفحة الرئيسية' },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد شركات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('companies-table');
  }

  function editCompany(uid) {
    var existing = null;
    if (uid) {
      existing = (window.__companies || []).find(function (c) { return c.company_unique_id === uid; });
    }
    openCompanyModal(existing);
  }

  function openCompanyModal(company) {
    var c = company || {};
    window.__editingCompanyUid = c.company_unique_id || '';
    var formId = 'company-form';
    var body =
      '<form id="' + formId + '">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'company_name_ar', label: 'الاسم العربي', value: c.company_name_ar, required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'company_name_en', label: 'الاسم الإنجليزي', value: c.company_name_en }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'company_sheet_link', label: 'رابط جدول البيانات', value: c.company_sheet_link }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'company_colors', label: 'الألوان (مثال: yellow, black)', value: c.company_colors }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'company_logo', label: 'معرّف الشعار', value: c.company_logo }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'company_main_page', label: 'الصفحة الرئيسية', value: c.company_main_page }) +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">مفعّل</label><select id="enabled" class="input">' +
      '<option value="TRUE" ' + (String(c.enabled).toLowerCase() === 'true' ? 'selected' : '') + '>مفعّل</option>' +
      '<option value="FALSE" ' + (String(c.enabled).toLowerCase() !== 'true' ? 'selected' : '') + '>معطّل</option>' +
      '</select></div>' +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('company-modal', {
      title: c.company_unique_id ? 'تعديل شركة' : 'إضافة شركة',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveCompany()'
    });
  }

  function saveCompany() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('company-form');
    data.enabled = document.getElementById('enabled').value;
    if (window.__editingCompanyUid) data.company_unique_id = window.__editingCompanyUid;
    if (!UIC.validateForm('company-form')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    API.call('admin_save_company', data, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('company-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        loadCompanies();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  /* ---------- USERS ---------- */
  function loadUsers() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    API.call('admin_list_users', {}, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__roleOptions = r.role_options || [];
        window.__companyOptions = r.company_options || [];
        renderUsers(r.users || []);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderUsers(list) {
    window.__users = list;
    var rows = list.map(function (u) {
      var active = String(u.status).toLowerCase() === 'active';
      return {
        name: u.name,
        email: u.email,
        role: u.role,
        company: u.company || '-',
        status: UIC.statusPill(active ? 'نشط' : 'معطّل', active ? 'success' : 'danger'),
        actions: '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openUserModal(\'' + FMT.escape(u.email) + '\')">تعديل</button>'
      };
    });
    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    body.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openUserModal(\'\')">+ إضافة مستخدم</button></div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('users-table', {
        title: 'المستخدمون',
        headers: [
          { key: 'name', label: 'الاسم' },
          { key: 'email', label: 'البريد الإلكتروني' },
          { key: 'role', label: 'الدور' },
          { key: 'company', label: 'الشركة' },
          { key: 'status', label: 'الحالة' },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا يوجد مستخدمون'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('users-table');
  }

  function openUserModal(email) {
    var u = (window.__users || []).find(function (x) { return x.email === email; });
    var companyOptions = (window.__companyOptions || []).map(function (c) {
      return { value: c.value, label: c.label };
    });
    var formId = 'user-form';
    var body =
      '<form id="' + formId + '">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'name', label: 'الاسم', value: u ? u.name : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'email', label: 'البريد الإلكتروني', value: u ? u.email : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'role', label: 'الدور', value: u ? u.role : '', options: window.__roleOptions || [], required: true, placeholder: 'اختر الدور...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'company', label: 'الشركة', type: 'select', required: true, options: companyOptions, placeholder: 'اختر الشركة...', value: u ? u.company : '' }) +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">الحالة</label><select id="user-status" class="input">' +
      '<option value="Active" ' + (u && String(u.status).toLowerCase() === 'active' ? 'selected' : '') + '>نشط</option>' +
      '<option value="InActive" ' + (u && String(u.status).toLowerCase() !== 'active' ? 'selected' : '') + '>معطّل</option>' +
      '</select></div>' +
      (u ? UIC.field({ key: 'resetPassword', label: 'كلمة مرور جديدة (اختياري)', type: 'password', placeholder: 'اتركه فارغاً لعدم التغيير' }) : '') +
      '</form>' +
      (!u ? '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">المستخدم الجديد يبدأ بدون كلمة مرور وسيقوم بتعيينها عند أول تسجيل دخول.</p>' : '');
    UIC.openModal('user-modal', {
      title: u ? 'تعديل مستخدم' : 'إضافة مستخدم',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveUser()'
    });
  }
  function saveUser() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('user-form');
    data.status = document.getElementById('user-status').value;
    if (!UIC.validateForm('user-form')) return;
    ['role'].forEach(function (k) {
      if (data[k] === '__new__') data[k] = data[k + '_custom'] || '';
      delete data[k + '_custom'];
    });
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    API.call('admin_save_user', data, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('user-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        loadUsers();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  /* ---------- ROLES MATRIX ---------- */
  function loadMatrix() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    API.call('admin_list_matrix', {}, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__matrixData = r.matrix || [];
        window.__matrixPages = r.pages || [];
        window.__matrixRoles = r.roles || [];
        window.__matrixCompanies = r.company_options || [];
        window.__selRole = '';
        window.__selCompany = '';
        renderMatrix();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderMatrix() {
    var roleOpts = '<option value="">اختر الدور...</option>' + (window.__matrixRoles || []).map(function (r) { return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(r) + '">' + FMT.escape(r) + '</option>'; }).join('');
    var companyOpts = '<option value="">كل الشركات</option>' + (window.__matrixCompanies || []).map(function (c) { return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(c.value) + '">' + FMT.escape(c.label) + '</option>'; }).join('');
    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label">الدور</label>' +
      '<select id="mx-role" class="input" onchange="onMatrixRoleChange(this.value)">' + roleOpts + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label">الشركة (فلتر الصفحات)</label>' +
      '<select id="mx-company" class="input" onchange="onMatrixCompanyChange(this.value)">' + companyOpts + '</select></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div id="mx-grid"></div>';
    renderMatrixGrid();
  }

  function onMatrixRoleChange(v) { window.__selRole = v; renderMatrixGrid(); }
  function onMatrixCompanyChange(v) { window.__selCompany = v; renderMatrixGrid(); }

  function renderMatrixGrid() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('mx-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    var role = window.__selRole || '';
    if (!role) { grid.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>اختر دوراً لعرض الصفحات</span></div>'; return; }
    var company = window.__selCompany || '';

    var existing = {};
    (window.__matrixData || []).forEach(function (m) {
      if (String(m.role).toLowerCase() === role.toLowerCase()) existing[String(m.page_id)] = m;
    });

    var pages = (window.__matrixPages || []).filter(function (p) {
      if (!company) return true;
      return String(p.page_company || '') === String(company);
    });
    if (!pages.length) { grid.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>لا توجد صفحات لهذه الشركة</span></div>'; return; }

    var rows = pages.map(function (p) {
      var m = existing[String(p.page_id)] || {};
      var acc = m.access_type || 'Read';
      var st = m.status || 'Active';
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(p.page_id) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(p.page_name || p.page_id) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(p.page_module || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td><select class="input" data-page="' + FMT.escape(p.page_id) + '" data-field="access_type">' +
        '<option value="Read"' + (acc === 'Read' ? ' selected' : '') + '>Read</option>' +
        '<option value="Write"' + (acc === 'Write' ? ' selected' : '') + '>Write</option>' +
        '</select></td>' +
        '<td><select class="input" data-page="' + FMT.escape(p.page_id) + '" data-field="status">' +
        '<option value="Active"' + (st === 'Active' ? ' selected' : '') + '>Active</option>' +
        '<option value="InActive"' + (st === 'InActive' ? ' selected' : '') + '>InActive</option>' +
        '</select></td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    grid.innerHTML =
      '<div style="margin-bottom:8px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveMatrix()">حفظ الصلاحيات</button></div>' +
      '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>الصفحة</th><th>الاسم</th><th>الوحدة</th><th>نوع الوصول</th><th>الحالة</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }

  function saveMatrix() {
    var role = window.__selRole || '';
    if (!role) { UIC.toast('اختر الدور', 'error'); return; }
    var map = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('#mx-grid select[data-page]').forEach(function (sel) {
      var page = sel.getAttribute('data-page');
      var field = sel.getAttribute('data-field');
      if (!map[page]) map[page] = { page_id: page, access_type: 'Read', status: 'Active' };
      map[page][field] = sel.value;
    });
    var assignments = Object.keys(map).map(function (k) { return map[k]; });
    if (!assignments.length) { UIC.toast('لا توجد صفحات', 'error'); return; }
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    API.call('admin_save_matrix', { role: role, assignments: assignments }, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); loadMatrix(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  /* ---------- SYSTEM PAGES ---------- */
  function loadPages() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    API.call('admin_list_pages', {}, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__systemPages = r.system_pages || [];
        window.__allPages = r.all_pages || [];
        window.__pageCompanies = r.company_options || [];
        window.__pageModules = r.module_options || [];
        renderPages();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderPages() {
    var list = window.__systemPages || [];
    var rows = list.map(function (p) {
      return {
        page_id: p.page_id,
        page_name: p.page_name || '-',
        page_module: p.page_module || '-',
        page_company: pageCompanyLabel(p.page_company)
      };
    });
    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    body.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openPagesMatrix()">عرض جميع الصفحات</button></div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('pages-table', {
        title: 'صفحات النظام',
        headers: [
          { key: 'page_id', label: 'معرف الصفحة' },
          { key: 'page_name', label: 'اسم الصفحة' },
          { key: 'page_module', label: 'الوحدة' },
          { key: 'page_company', label: 'الشركة' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد صفحات مسجلة'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('pages-table');
  }

  function pageCompanyLabel(uid) {
    var found = (window.__pageCompanies || []).find(function (c) { return String(c.value) === String(uid); });
    return found ? found.label : (uid || '-');
  }

  function cssId(s) { return String(s).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, '_'); }

  function buildSelect(id, options, selected) {
    var html = '<select id="' + id + '" class="input">';
    options.forEach(function (o) {
      var v = (o && o.value !== undefined) ? o.value : o;
      var l = (o && o.label !== undefined) ? o.label : o;
      html += '<option value="' + FMT.escape(v) + '"' + (String(v) === String(selected || '') ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(l) + '</option>';
    });
    html += '</select>';
    return html;
  }

  function openPagesMatrix() {
    var allPages = window.__allPages || [];
    var sysMap = {};
    (window.__systemPages || []).forEach(function (s) { sysMap[String(s.page_id)] = s; });

    var moduleOpts = (window.__pageModules || []).map(function (m) { return { value: m, label: m }; });
    var companyOpts = [{ value: '', label: '-' }].concat((window.__pageCompanies || []).map(function (c) { return { value: c.value, label: c.label }; }));

    var rows = allPages.map(function (p) {
      var s = sysMap[String(p.page_id)] || {};
      var id = cssId(p.page_id);
      var name = s.page_name || p.title || p.label || p.page_id;
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(p.page_id) + '</td>' +
        '<td><input id="pn_' + id + '" class="input" value="' + FMT.escape(name) + '"></td>' +
        '<td>' + buildSelect('pm_' + id, moduleOpts, s.page_module) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + buildSelect('pc_' + id, companyOpts, s.page_company) + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    var body = '<div style="overflow-x:auto;max-height:65vh;overflow-y:auto;">' +
      '<table class="table" style="min-width:700px;"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>معرف الصفحة</th><th>اسم الصفحة</th><th>الوحدة</th><th>الشركة</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table></div>';

    UIC.openModal('pages-matrix-modal', { title: 'جميع صفحات النظام', body: body, onSave: 'savePagesMatrix()' });
  }

  function savePagesMatrix() {
    var pages = (window.__allPages || []).map(function (p) {
      var id = cssId(p.page_id);
      return {
        page_id: p.page_id,
        page_name: document.getElementById('pn_' + id) ? document.getElementById('pn_' + id).value : '',
        page_module: document.getElementById('pm_' + id) ? document.getElementById('pm_' + id).value : '',
        page_company: document.getElementById('pc_' + id) ? document.getElementById('pc_' + id).value : ''
      };
    });
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    API.call('admin_save_pages', { pages: pages }, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) { UIC.closeModal('pages-matrix-modal'); UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); loadPages(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  /* ---------- CURRENCY ---------- */
  var CURRENCY_CODES = ['EGP','USD','EUR','GBP','SAR','AED','KWD','QAR','BHD','OMR','JOD','CNY','JPY','INR','TRY','CAD','AUD','CHF'];

  function loadCurrency() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    API.call('admin_list_currency', {}, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__currencies = r.currencies || [];
        renderCurrency();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderCurrency() {
    var list = window.__currencies || [];
    var rows = list.map(function (c) {
      return {
        id: c.id,
        currency: c.currency,
        rate: FMT.number(c.rate),
        actions: '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="deleteCurrency(' + c.id + ')">حذف</button>'
      };
    });
    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    body.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openCurrencyModal(\'\')">+ إضافة عملة</button></div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('currency-table', {
        title: 'العملات',
        headers: [
          { key: 'id', label: 'المعرف', numeric: true },
          { key: 'currency', label: 'العملة' },
          { key: 'rate', label: 'السعر (EGP)', numeric: true },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد عملات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('currency-table');
  }

  function openCurrencyModal() {
    var opts = CURRENCY_CODES.map(function (c) { return '<option value="' + c + '">' + c + '</option>'; }).join('');
    var body = '<form id="currency-form">' +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="cur">العملة</label>' +
      '<select id="cur" class="input">' + opts + '</select></div>' +
      '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">يتم حساب السعر تلقائياً من Google Finance.</p>' +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('currency-modal', { title: 'إضافة عملة', body: body, onSave: 'saveCurrency()' });
  }

  function saveCurrency() {
    var currency = document.getElementById('cur') ? document.getElementById('cur').value : '';
    if (!currency) { UIC.toast('اختر العملة', 'error'); return; }
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    API.call('admin_save_currency', { currency: currency }, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) { UIC.closeModal('currency-modal'); UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); loadCurrency(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function deleteCurrency(id) {
    if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذه العملة؟')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحذف...');
    API.call('admin_delete_currency', { id: Number(id) }, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); loadCurrency(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  /* ---------- SYSTEM INVOICES ---------- */
  function loadInvoices() {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري جلب فواتير الاشتراكات...');
    API.call('admin_list_invoices', {}, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__invoices = r.invoices || [];
        window.__invoiceCompanies = r.company_options || [];
        renderInvoices(window.__invoices, window.__invoiceCompanies);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderInvoices(list, companies) {
    var compMap = {};
    (companies || []).forEach(function (c) {
      compMap[c.value] = c.name_en || c.name_ar || c.value;
    });

    var rows = list.map(function (inv) {
      var uid = String(inv.unique_id || '').trim();
      var noOfUsers = Number(inv.no_of_user) || 0;
      var costPerUserUsd = Number(inv.cost_per_user_usd) || 0;
      var maintCostUsd = Number(inv.maintenance_cost_usd) || 0;
      var totalUsd = (noOfUsers * costPerUserUsd) + maintCostUsd;

      var printBtn = '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="printInvoiceDoc(\'' + FMT.escape(uid) + '\')">🖨️ طباعة</button>';
      var editBtn = '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;" onclick="openInvoiceModal(\'' + FMT.escape(uid) + '\')">✏️ تعديل</button>';
      var delBtn = '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;color:#dc2626;border-color:#fca5a5;" onclick="deleteInvoiceDoc(\'' + FMT.escape(uid) + '\')">🗑️</button>';

      return {
        id: inv.id || '-',
        invoice_number: '<strong>' + FMT.escape(inv.invoice_number || '-') + '</strong>',
        invoice_date: FMT.escape(formatDateShort(inv.invoice_date)),
        company: FMT.escape(compMap[inv.company] || inv.company || '-'),
        no_of_user: noOfUsers,
        cost_usd: '$' + costPerUserUsd.toFixed(2),
        rate: (Number(inv.current_exchange_rate) || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ج.م',
        cost_egp: (Number(inv.cost_per_user_egp) || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ج.م',
        maint_usd: '$' + maintCostUsd.toFixed(2),
        maint_egp: (Number(inv.maintenance_cost_per_user_egp) || 0).toFixed(2) + ' ج.م',
        total_usd: '<strong style="color:var(--brand-primary);">' + '$' + totalUsd.toFixed(2) + '</strong>',
        actions: '<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;justify-content:center;">' + printBtn + editBtn + delBtn + '</div>'
      };
    });

    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;">' +
        '<div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);">إجمالي الفواتير الصادرة: <strong>' + list.length + '</strong></div>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openInvoiceModal(\'\')">+ إصدار فاتورة جديدة</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('invoices-table', {
        title: 'فواتير اشتراكات النظام (ERP System Invoices)',
        headers: [
          { key: 'id', label: '#', numeric: true },
          { key: 'invoice_number', label: 'رقم الفاتورة' },
          { key: 'invoice_date', label: 'التاريخ' },
          { key: 'company', label: 'الشركة (Bill To)' },
          { key: 'no_of_user', label: 'المستخدمين', numeric: true },
          { key: 'cost_usd', label: 'تكلفة المستخدم ($)', numeric: true },
          { key: 'rate', label: 'سعر الصرف', numeric: true },
          { key: 'cost_egp', label: 'تكلفة المستخدم (ج.م)', numeric: true },
          { key: 'maint_usd', label: 'الصيانة ($)', numeric: true },
          { key: 'maint_egp', label: 'الصيانة (ج.م)', numeric: true },
          { key: 'total_usd', label: 'الإجمالي ($)', numeric: true },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'الإجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد فواتير صادرة حتى الآن'
      });

    UIC.initTableSort('invoices-table');
  }

  function openInvoiceModal(uniqueId) {
    var inv = null;
    if (uniqueId) {
      inv = (window.__invoices || []).find(function (i) { return String(i.unique_id) === String(uniqueId); });
    }

    var isEdit = !!inv;
    var title = isEdit ? ('تعديل الفاتورة: ' + (inv.invoice_number || '')) : 'إصدار فاتورة اشتراك جديدة';

    var todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    var invoiceNumber = inv ? (inv.invoice_number || '') : ('INV-' + new Date().getFullYear() + '-' + String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 900) + 100));
    var invoiceDate = inv ? formatDateShort(inv.invoice_date) : todayStr;
    var selectedCompany = inv ? (inv.company || '') : '';
    var noOfUsers = inv ? (inv.no_of_user != null ? inv.no_of_user : 1) : 1;
    var costPerUserUsd = inv ? (inv.cost_per_user_usd != null ? inv.cost_per_user_usd : 10) : 10;
    var currentExchangeRate = inv ? (inv.current_exchange_rate != null ? inv.current_exchange_rate : 50) : 50;
    var maintenanceCostUsd = inv ? (inv.maintenance_cost_usd != null ? inv.maintenance_cost_usd : 14) : 14;

    var compOptions = (window.__invoiceCompanies || []).map(function (c) {
      var isSel = String(c.value) === String(selectedCompany) ? ' selected' : '';
      return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(c.value) + '"' + isSel + '>' + FMT.escape(c.name_en ? (c.name_en + ' (' + c.name_ar + ')') : c.name_ar) + '</option>';
    }).join('');

    var modalHtml =
      '<form id="erp-invoice-form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault();">' +
        '<input type="hidden" id="inv-uid" value="' + (isEdit ? FMT.escape(uniqueId) : '') + '">' +
        
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;">' +
          '<div class="form-field">' +
            '<label class="form-label" for="inv-num">رقم الفاتورة (Invoice Number) *</label>' +
            '<input type="text" id="inv-num" class="input" value="' + FMT.escape(invoiceNumber) + '" required placeholder="مثال: INV-2026-001">' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="form-field">' +
            '<label class="form-label" for="inv-date">تاريخ الفاتورة (Date) *</label>' +
            '<input type="date" id="inv-date" class="input" value="' + FMT.escape(invoiceDate) + '" required>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +

        '<div class="form-field">' +
          '<label class="form-label" for="inv-company">الشركة (Company - Bill to) *</label>' +
          '<select id="inv-company" class="input" required>' +
            '<option value="">-- اختر الشركة --</option>' +
            compOptions +
          '</select>' +
        '</div>' +

        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;">' +
          '<div class="form-field">' +
            '<label class="form-label" for="inv-users">عدد المستخدمين (No. of Users) *</label>' +
            '<input type="number" id="inv-users" class="input" min="1" step="1" value="' + noOfUsers + '" required oninput="calcInvoiceModal()">' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="form-field">' +
            '<label class="form-label" for="inv-rate">سعر الصرف (EGP Exchange Rate) *</label>' +
            '<input type="number" id="inv-rate" class="input" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="' + currentExchangeRate + '" required oninput="calcInvoiceModal()">' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +

        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;">' +
          '<div class="form-field">' +
            '<label class="form-label" for="inv-cost-usd">تكلفة المستخدم ($ USD) *</label>' +
            '<input type="number" id="inv-cost-usd" class="input" min="0" step="0.01" value="' + costPerUserUsd + '" required oninput="calcInvoiceModal()">' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="form-field">' +
            '<label class="form-label" for="inv-maint-usd">تكلفة الصيانة ($ USD) *</label>' +
            '<input type="number" id="inv-maint-usd" class="input" min="0" step="0.01" value="' + maintenanceCostUsd + '" required oninput="calcInvoiceModal()">' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +

        // Live calculation summary box
        '<div style="background:var(--bg-muted);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:14px;margin-top:12px;">' +
          '<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--text-main);">📊 الحسابات التلقائية المعتمدة:</div>' +
          '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;">' +
            '<div>تكلفة المستخدم بالجنيه (+4%): <strong id="calc-cost-egp">0.00 ج.م</strong></div>' +
            '<div>تكلفة الصيانة بالجنيه: <strong id="calc-maint-egp">0.00 ج.م</strong></div>' +
            '<div>إجمالي الترخيص بالدولار: <strong id="calc-license-subtotal">$0.00</strong></div>' +
            '<div>الإجمالي العام بالدولار: <strong id="calc-total-usd" style="color:var(--brand-primary);">$0.00</strong></div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</form>';

    UIC.openModal('erp-invoice-modal', {
      title: title,
      body: modalHtml,
      onSave: 'saveInvoiceDoc()'
    });

    // Run initial calculation
    setTimeout(calcInvoiceModal, 50);
  }

  function calcInvoiceModal() {
    var users = parseInt(document.getElementById('inv-users') ? document.getElementById('inv-users').value : 0, 10) || 0;
    var rate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inv-rate') ? document.getElementById('inv-rate').value : 0) || 0;
    var costUsd = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inv-cost-usd') ? document.getElementById('inv-cost-usd').value : 0) || 0;
    var maintUsd = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inv-maint-usd') ? document.getElementById('inv-maint-usd').value : 0) || 0;

    // Formulas:
    // cost_per_user_egp = cost_per_user_usd * current_exchange_rate * 1.04
    // maintenance_cost_per_user_egp = maintenance_cost_usd * current_exchange_rate
    var costEgp = costUsd * rate * 1.04;
    var maintEgp = maintUsd * rate;
    var licenseSubtotal = users * costUsd;
    var totalUsd = licenseSubtotal + maintUsd;

    var elCostEgp = document.getElementById('calc-cost-egp');
    var elMaintEgp = document.getElementById('calc-maint-egp');
    var elLicenseSub = document.getElementById('calc-license-subtotal');
    var elTotalUsd = document.getElementById('calc-total-usd');

    if (elCostEgp) elCostEgp.textContent = costEgp.toFixed(2) + ' ج.م';
    if (elMaintEgp) elMaintEgp.textContent = maintEgp.toFixed(2) + ' ج.م';
    if (elLicenseSub) elLicenseSub.textContent = '$' + licenseSubtotal.toFixed(2);
    if (elTotalUsd) elTotalUsd.textContent = '$' + totalUsd.toFixed(2);
  }

  function saveInvoiceDoc() {
    var uid = document.getElementById('inv-uid') ? document.getElementById('inv-uid').value.trim() : '';
    var invNum = document.getElementById('inv-num') ? document.getElementById('inv-num').value.trim() : '';
    var invDate = document.getElementById('inv-date') ? document.getElementById('inv-date').value.trim() : '';
    var company = document.getElementById('inv-company') ? document.getElementById('inv-company').value.trim() : '';
    var users = document.getElementById('inv-users') ? parseInt(document.getElementById('inv-users').value, 10) : 0;
    var rate = document.getElementById('inv-rate') ? parseFloat(document.getElementById('inv-rate').value) : 0;
    var costUsd = document.getElementById('inv-cost-usd') ? parseFloat(document.getElementById('inv-cost-usd').value) : 0;
    var maintUsd = document.getElementById('inv-maint-usd') ? parseFloat(document.getElementById('inv-maint-usd').value) : 0;

    if (!invNum) { UIC.toast('رقم الفاتورة مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (!invDate) { UIC.toast('تاريخ الفاتورة مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (!company) { UIC.toast('اختر الشركة', 'error'); return; }
    if (isNaN(users) || users < 1) { UIC.toast('عدد المستخدمين يجب أن يكون 1 على الأقل', 'error'); return; }
    if (isNaN(rate) || rate <= 0) { UIC.toast('سعر الصرف غير صحيح', 'error'); return; }
    if (isNaN(costUsd) || costUsd < 0) { UIC.toast('تكلفة المستخدم غير صحيحة', 'error'); return; }
    if (isNaN(maintUsd) || maintUsd < 0) { UIC.toast('تكلفة الصيانة غير صحيحة', 'error'); return; }

    UI.showSpinner('جاري حفظ الفاتورة...');
    API.call('admin_save_invoice', {
      unique_id: uid,
      invoice_number: invNum,
      invoice_date: invDate,
      company: company,
      no_of_user: users,
      cost_per_user_usd: costUsd,
      current_exchange_rate: rate,
      maintenance_cost_usd: maintUsd
    }, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('erp-invoice-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم حفظ الفاتورة بنجاح', 'success');
        loadInvoices();
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل حفظ الفاتورة', 'error');
      })
      .finally(function () {
        UI.hideSpinner();
      });
  }

  function deleteInvoiceDoc(uniqueId) {
    if (!uniqueId) return;
    if (!confirm('هل أنت متأكد من رغبتك في حذف هذه الفاتورة؟')) return;

    UI.showSpinner('جاري حذف الفاتورة...');
    API.call('admin_delete_invoice', { unique_id: uniqueId }, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحذف بنجاح', 'success');
        loadInvoices();
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل حذف الفاتورة', 'error');
      })
      .finally(function () {
        UI.hideSpinner();
      });
  }

  function printInvoiceDoc(uniqueId) {
    if (!uniqueId) return;
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?download=erp_invoice&unique_id=' + encodeURIComponent(uniqueId) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function formatDateShort(val) {
    if (!val) return '';
    if (val instanceof Date && !isNaN(val.getTime())) {
      var y = val.getFullYear();
      var m = String(val.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      var d = String(val.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      return y + '-' + m + '-' + d;
    }
    var s = String(val).trim();
    if (s.indexOf('T') !== -1) s = s.split('T')[0];
    return s;
  }

  /* ---------- KILL SWITCH (super admin only) ---------- */
  function loadKillSwitch() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    API.call('toggle_kill_switch', {}, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        renderKillSwitch(!!r.enabled);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderKillSwitch(enabled) {
    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    if (!body) return;
    var pill = UIC.statusPill(enabled ? 'النظام يعمل' : 'النظام متوقف', enabled ? 'success' : 'neutral');
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div style="max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--border,#e5e7eb);border-radius:12px;">' +
        '<h3 style="margin-top:0;">مفتاح إيقاف النظام</h3>' +
        '<p style="color:var(--text-muted,#666);font-size:13px;">إيقاف النظام يمنع جميع الصفحات وكل العمليات فوراً لكل المستخدمين — بما في ذلك مدير النظام — ويظهر لهم رسالة «عطل في السيستم». لإعادة التشغيل بعد الإيقاف: عدّل قيمة الخلية B2 في جدول <b>ERP_system_work</b> مباشرة من Google Sheets (1 = يعمل، 0 = متوقف).</p>' +
        '<div style="margin:16px 0;">الحالة الحالية: ' + pill + '</div>' +
        '<button class="btn ' + (enabled ? 'btn-outline' : 'btn-primary') + '" id="killswitch-btn" onclick="toggleKillSwitch(' + (!enabled) + ')">' +
          (enabled ? '⛔ إيقاف النظام' : '✅ تشغيل النظام') +
        '</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function toggleKillSwitch(on) {
    if (!on && !confirm('سيتم إيقاف النظام بالكامل لجميع المستخدمين فوراً. متأكد؟')) return;
    UI.showSpinner();
    var btn = document.getElementById('killswitch-btn');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    API.call('toggle_kill_switch', { on: on }, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم التنفيذ', 'success');
        renderKillSwitch(!!r.enabled);
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        showError(e);
        loadKillSwitch();
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('tab-body');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  initAdmin();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<body>
<div id="dash-shell" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  // Read sessionToken from URL (set by login redirect) and stash it.
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';

  function loadDashboard() {
    var content = document.getElementById('dash-content');
    UI.showSpinner();
    API.call('get_dashboard_data', {}, SESSION_TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        var user = r.user;
        var companies = r.companies || [];
        renderDashboard(user, companies);
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        if (e.code === 'SESSION_EXPIRED') {
          window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
          return;
        }
        content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'تعذر تحميل البيانات') + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderDashboard(user, companies) {
    var content = document.getElementById('dash-content');

    var nav = [];
    var isManager = !!(user.isSuperAdmin || String(user.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'admin');
    if (isManager) {
      nav.push({ label: 'لوحة التحكم', active: true, href: '#' });
      nav.push({ label: 'إدارة النظام', href: scriptUrl + '?action=ERP_Management&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN });
    }

    var shellContent = 'dash-inner';
    UIC.appShell('dash-shell', {
      nav: nav,
      userName: user.name || user.email,
      breadcrumb: 'الرئيسية / لوحة التحكم',

    });

      '<p style="color:var(--text-muted);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:24px;">اختر النظام الذي تريد العمل عليه.</p>';

    var tiles = companies.map(function (c) {
      return UIC.companyTile({
        unique_id: c.unique_id,
        name_ar: c.name_ar,
        name_en: c.name_en,
        logo_url: c.logo_url,
        onOpen: c.is_ready ? 'openCompany(\'' + FMT.escape(c.main_page) + '\')' : 'showUnderConstruction()'
      });
    }).join('');

    var empty = '<div class="empty-state"><span>لا توجد أنظمة متاحة حالياً. يرجى مراجعة الإدارة.</span></div>';

    inner.innerHTML = welcome +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,220px),1fr));gap:clamp(12px,3vw,16px);">' +
      (companies.length ? tiles : empty) +
      '</div>';
  }

    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=' + pageUrl + '&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN;
  }

  function getDeviceInfo() {

  function doLogin() {

 * RESPONSIBILITY: registerCompany_(key, config) — the ONE function that populates
 * COMPANY_REGISTRY, plus getAllPages_() used by the router.
 * No business logic. Loaded second.

let _companiesInitialized_ = false;

function ensureCompaniesRegistered_() {
  if (_companiesInitialized_) return;
  _companiesInitialized_ = true;
  // MANUAL STEP: every new company (Company_*_Registry.js) MUST be added here.
  // registerValleyFoods_(), etc. as they are built —
  // forgetting this is the classic "registered company missing" bug.
  registerTopLight_();
  registerTopChemical_();
  registerValleyFoods_();
}

function registerCompany_(key, config) {
  if (COMPANY_REGISTRY[key]) throw new Error('Duplicate company registration: ' + key);
  if (!config.dispatch || typeof config.dispatch !== 'function') {
    throw new Error('Company "' + key + '" must provide a dispatch function');
  }
  COMPANY_REGISTRY[key] = config;
}

function getAllPages_() {
  const base = [
    { action: 'login', template: '0_ERPlogin', title: 'Login', public: true },
    { action: 'setup', template: '0_ERPsetup', title: 'Setup Password', public: true },
    { action: 'ERPDashboard', template: '0_ERPDashboard', title: 'Dashboard' },
    { action: 'ERP_Management', template: '0_ERP_Management', title: 'System Admin' },
    { action: 'user_sessions', template: 'User_Sessions', title: 'جلساتي' },
    { action: 'user_views', template: 'User_Views', title: 'العروض المحفوظة' },
    { action: 'record_history', template: 'Record_History_Panel', title: 'السجل' }
  ];
  return base.concat(Object.values(COMPANY_REGISTRY).flatMap(c => c.pages));
}

// ==== 02_DataAccess.js ====
// ============================================================

/**
 * 02_DataAccess.js
 * RESPONSIBILITY: Generic sheet CRUD: getSheet_, getHeaders_, getAllRecords_,
 * addRecord_, updateRowByCriteria_, getNextId_ (lock-protected via executeWithLock_),
 * plus versioned-cache invalidation (bumpVersion_ / onEdit).
 * getNextId_ is the ONLY ID-assignment function in the project.
 * No business logic. Loaded third.
 */

// Execution-scoped memoization so SpreadsheetApp.openById is called once per execution.
const _ssCache_ = {};

// Batch 1: request-scoped memoization for getAllRecords_(). Lives only for the
// duration of a single apiRouter_()/doGet execution (reset at entry) and is
// disabled entirely for mutating actions so a write can never be served stale
// data. Stores the raw getValues() 2D array; record objects are rebuilt on each
// read so callers may mutate them freely (identical behavior to before).
const _recordCache_ = {};
let _recordCacheDisabled_ = false;

// Batch 8: request-scoped memo of sheets already ensured this execution, so
// repeated ensureSheet_/settingsEnsureSheet_ calls (getSheetByName round trips)
// are paid at most once per sheet per request.
const _ensuredSheets_ = {};

function resetRecordCache_() {
  for (const k in _recordCache_) delete _recordCache_[k];
  for (const k in _ensuredSheets_) delete _ensuredSheets_[k];
  _recordCacheDisabled_ = false;
}

function disableRecordCache_() {
  _recordCacheDisabled_ = true;
  for (const k in _recordCache_) delete _recordCache_[k];
}

function buildRecordsFromRaw_(data, headers) {
  const records = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    const record = {};
    headers.forEach((h, colIdx) => {
      record[String(h).trim()] = data[i][colIdx] !== undefined ? data[i][colIdx] : '';
    });
    if (Object.values(record).some(v => String(v).trim() !== '')) records.push(record);
  }
  return records;
}

function getSpreadsheet_(ssId) {
  if (!_ssCache_[ssId]) _ssCache_[ssId] = SpreadsheetApp.openById(ssId);
  return _ssCache_[ssId];
}

function getSheet_(sheetName, ssId) {
  const sheet = getSpreadsheet_(ssId).getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sheet) throw new Error('Database Error: Missing tab "' + sheetName + '" in spreadsheet ' + ssId + '.');
  return sheet;
}

const _headerCache_ = {};

function getHeaders_(sheet) {
  const key = sheet.getParent().getId() + '_' + sheet.getSheetId();
  if (!_headerCache_[key]) {
    const lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();
    _headerCache_[key] = lastCol > 0 ? sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0] : [];
  }
  return _headerCache_[key];
}

// Reentrant-safe script lock: a nested executeWithLock_ (e.g. an audit helper
// called from inside a company action that already holds the lock) runs its fn
// directly instead of re-acquiring, while still blocking other executions.
let _scriptLockHeld_ = false;

function executeWithLock_(fn, timeoutMs) {
  if (_scriptLockHeld_) return fn();
  _scriptLockHeld_ = true;
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  try {
    lock.waitLock(timeoutMs || 5000);
    return fn();
  } finally {
    _scriptLockHeld_ = false;
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (e) {}
  }
}

/**
 * Retry wrapper for appending rows to handle concurrent writes.
 */
function appendRowWithRetry_(sheet, values, maxRetries = 3, delayMs = 1000) {
  let attempt = 0;
  while (attempt <= maxRetries) {
    try {
      sheet.appendRow(values);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      attempt++;
      if (attempt > maxRetries) {
        throw new Error('Failed to append row after ' + maxRetries + ' attempts: ' + e.message);
      }
      Utilities.sleep(delayMs);
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Internal counter logic — MUST be called while already holding the script lock
 * (i.e. from getNextId_ or addRecord_, never standalone).
 * Defensively creates the ID_Counter sheet if it does not exist yet.
 */
function getNextIdUnderLock_(dbId, tableName, idColumnName = 'id') {
  const ss = getSpreadsheet_(dbId);
  let sheet = ss.getSheetByName('ID_Counter');
  if (!sheet) {
    sheet = ss.insertSheet('ID_Counter');
    sheet.appendRow(['sheet_name', 'next_id']);
  }
  const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const nameIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'sheet_name');
  const nextIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'next_id');
  if (nameIdx === -1 || nextIdx === -1) {
    throw new Error('ID_Counter sheet missing required columns (sheet_name, next_id)');
  }
  let tableMax = 0;
  const tableSheet = ss.getSheetByName(tableName);
  if (tableSheet) {
    const tHeaders = getHeaders_(tableSheet);
    const idIdx = tHeaders.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === idColumnName.toLowerCase());
    if (idIdx !== -1) {
      const tData = tableSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
      for (let i = 1; i < tData.length; i++) {
        const v = Number(tData[i][idIdx]);
        if (Number.isInteger(v) && v > tableMax) tableMax = v;
      }
    }
  }
  const safeNext = tableMax + 1;
  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (String(data[i][nameIdx]).toLowerCase() === tableName.toLowerCase()) {
      const current = Number(data[i][nextIdx]);
      if (current <= tableMax) {
        sheet.getRange(i + 1, nextIdx + 1).setValue(safeNext + 1);
        return safeNext;
      }
      sheet.getRange(i + 1, nextIdx + 1).setValue(current + 1);
      return current;
    }
  }
  sheet.appendRow([tableName, safeNext + 1]);
  return safeNext;
}

/**
 * Canonical ID assignment. The ONLY public function that computes a new ID.
 * Lock-protected. Returns the current counter value and increments it.
 */
function getNextId_(dbId, tableName, idColumnName = 'id') {
  return executeWithLock_(function () {
    return getNextIdUnderLock_(dbId, tableName, idColumnName);
  });
}

/**
 * Read-only peek at the next ID for a table without incrementing it.
 * Used for UI display of "next ID" only — never for writes.
 */
function peekNextId_(dbId, tableName) {
  const sheet = getSheet_('ID_Counter', dbId);
  const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const nameIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'sheet_name');
  const nextIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'next_id');
  if (nameIdx === -1 || nextIdx === -1) return 1;
  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (String(data[i][nameIdx]).toLowerCase() === tableName.toLowerCase()) return data[i][nextIdx];
  }
  return 1;
}

/**
 * Batch ID assignment. Lock-protected. Returns the starting ID for `count`
 * consecutive IDs (caller uses startId, startId+1, ..., startId+count-1).
 */
function getNextIdBatch_(dbId, tableName, count, idColumnName = 'id') {
  if (!Number.isInteger(count) || count <= 0) {
    throw new Error('Count must be a positive integer');
  }
  
  return executeWithLock_(function () {
    const ss = getSpreadsheet_(dbId);
    let sheet = ss.getSheetByName('ID_Counter');
    if (!sheet) {
      sheet = ss.insertSheet('ID_Counter');
      sheet.appendRow(['sheet_name', 'next_id']);
    }
    const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
    const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    const nameIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'sheet_name');
    const nextIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'next_id');
    if (nameIdx === -1 || nextIdx === -1) {
      throw new Error('ID_Counter sheet missing required columns (sheet_name, next_id)');
    }
    
    // Find current max in the table
    let tableMax = 0;
    const tableSheet = ss.getSheetByName(tableName);
    if (tableSheet) {
      const tHeaders = getHeaders_(tableSheet);
      const idIdx = tHeaders.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === idColumnName.toLowerCase());
      if (idIdx !== -1) {
        const tData = tableSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
        for (let i = 1; i < tData.length; i++) {
          const v = Number(tData[i][idIdx]);
          if (Number.isInteger(v) && v > tableMax) tableMax = v;
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Calculate starting ID and next counter value
    const startId = tableMax + 1;
    const nextCounter = startId + count;
    
    // Update or create counter in ID_Counter sheet
    let found = false;
    for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
      if (String(data[i][nameIdx]).toLowerCase() === tableName.toLowerCase()) {
        sheet.getRange(i + 1, nextIdx + 1).setValue(nextCounter);
        found = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!found) {
      sheet.appendRow([tableName, nextCounter]);
    }
    
    return startId;
  });
}

/**
 * Get all records from a sheet as an array of objects with lowercase keys.
 * Empty rows are filtered out. Does not touch any counter.
 */
function getAllRecords_(dbId, sheetName) {
  const sheet = getSheet_(sheetName, dbId);
  const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
  if (!_recordCacheDisabled_) {
    const key = dbId + '|' + sheetName;
    const cached = _recordCache_[key];
    if (cached) return buildRecordsFromRaw_(cached.data, cached.headers);
    const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    _recordCache_[key] = { data: data, headers: headers };
    return buildRecordsFromRaw_(data, headers);
  }
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  return buildRecordsFromRaw_(data, headers);
}

/**
 * Add a record to a sheet. Assigns the ID via getNextIdUnderLock_ (the canonical
 * counter logic) inside a single lock acquisition — no nested locking.
 * All sheet writes must go through this or getNextId_.
 */
function addRecord_(dbId, sheetName, dataMap, requiredFields) {
  const missing = (requiredFields || []).filter(f => dataMap[f] === undefined || dataMap[f] === null || String(dataMap[f]).trim() === '');
  if (missing.length) throw new Error('Missing required fields: ' + missing.join(', '));

  return executeWithLock_(function () {
    const id = getNextIdUnderLock_(dbId, sheetName);
    const sheet = getSheet_(sheetName, dbId);
    const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
    const rowValues = headers.map(h => {
      const key = String(h).trim().toLowerCase();
      if (key === 'id') return id;
      return dataMap[key] !== undefined ? dataMap[key] : '';
    });
    const newRowNumber = sheet.getLastRow() + 1;
    sheet.appendRow(rowValues);

    const savedRecord = {};
    headers.forEach((h, colIdx) => {
      savedRecord[String(h).trim().toLowerCase()] = rowValues[colIdx];
    });

    return {
      status: 'success',
      message: 'Record added successfully (row ' + newRowNumber + ')',
      data: { record: savedRecord, newRowNumber: newRowNumber, assignedId: id }
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Update a row by matching criteriaHeader == criteriaValue.
 * Uses a single batched setValues() write.
 */
function updateRowByCriteria_(sheet, criteriaHeader, criteriaValue, updatesObject) {
  const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const critIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === String(criteriaHeader).trim().toLowerCase());
  if (critIdx === -1) throw new Error('Criteria header "' + criteriaHeader + '" not found.');

  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (String(data[i][critIdx]).trim().toLowerCase() === String(criteriaValue).trim().toLowerCase()) {
      const newRow = data[i].map((originalVal, colIdx) => {
        const header = headers[colIdx];
        const updateKey = Object.keys(updatesObject).find(k => k.trim().toLowerCase() === String(header).trim().toLowerCase());
        return updateKey !== undefined ? updatesObject[updateKey] : originalVal;
      });
      sheet.getRange(i + 1, 1, 1, newRow.length).setValues([newRow]);
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Delete all rows where criteriaHeader == criteriaValue.
 * Deletes bottom-up so earlier row indices stay valid. Returns count deleted.
 */
function deleteRowsByCriteria_(sheet, criteriaHeader, criteriaValue) {
  const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const critIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === String(criteriaHeader).trim().toLowerCase());
  if (critIdx === -1) return 0;
  let deleted = 0;
  for (let i = data.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
    if (String(data[i][critIdx]).trim() === String(criteriaValue).trim()) {
      sheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
      deleted++;
    }
  }
  return deleted;
}

// ==========================================
// Versioned cache invalidation
// ==========================================
function onEdit(e) {
  try {
    const sheet = e.range.getSheet();
    if (sheet.getParent().getId() !== CONFIG.AUTH_SPREADSHEET_ID) return;
    const sheetName = sheet.getName();
    if (sheetName === 'ERP_Users') bumpVersion_('ERP_Users');
    else if (sheetName === 'ERP_Companies') bumpVersion_('ERP_Companies');
    else if (sheetName === 'ERP_Pages_Matrix') bumpVersion_('ERP_Pages_Matrix');
    else if (sheetName === 'ERP_Information') bumpVersion_('ERP_Information');
    else if (sheetName === 'ERP_system_work') bumpVersion_('ERP_system_work');
  } catch (err) { console.error('onEdit version update failed: ' + err.message); }
}

function bumpVersion_(sheetName) {
  try {
    const cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
    const now = String(new Date().getTime());
    if (sheetName === 'ERP_Users') cache.put('version_users', now);
    else if (sheetName === 'ERP_Companies') cache.put('version_companies', now);
    else if (sheetName === 'ERP_Pages_Matrix') cache.put('version_matrix', now);
    else if (sheetName === 'ERP_Information') cache.put('version_killswitch', now);
    else if (sheetName === 'ERP_system_work') cache.put('version_killswitch', now);
  } catch (e) {}
}

// ==========================================
// Audit trail helpers (B5) — multi-device sessions + Odoo-style history
// ==========================================
const AUDIT_COLUMNS = ['record_uid', 'created_by', 'created_at', 'updated_by', 'updated_at', 'approved_by', 'approved_at'];

function safeStr_(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  if (v instanceof Date) return v.toISOString();
  if (typeof v === 'object') { try { return JSON.stringify(v); } catch (e) { return String(v); } }
  return String(v);
}

/**
 * Append one ERP_Record_History row per CHANGED business column.
 * `dbId` is the business sheet's spreadsheet; history is ALWAYS stored in the
 * AUTH spreadsheet's ERP_Record_History tab (created by batch1_createSystemSheets).
 * For 'create' logs every business column's new value; for update/approve/delete
 * logs only columns whose old/new differ.
 */
function logHistory_(dbId, sheetName, recordUid, recordId, user, action, newValues, oldValues) {
  const histSheet = getSheet_('ERP_Record_History', CONFIG.AUTH_SPREADSHEET_ID);
  const targetSheet = getSheet_(sheetName, dbId);
  const allHeaders = getHeaders_(targetSheet).map(function (h) { return String(h).trim(); });
  const businessHeaders = allHeaders.filter(function (h) {
    const lc = h.toLowerCase();
    return AUDIT_COLUMNS.indexOf(lc) === -1 && lc !== 'id';
  });
  const rows = [];
  businessHeaders.forEach(function (col) {
    const nVal = newValues ? (newValues[col] !== undefined ? newValues[col] : '') : null;
    const oVal = oldValues ? (oldValues[col] !== undefined ? oldValues[col] : '') : null;
    if (action !== 'create' && safeStr_(nVal) === safeStr_(oVal)) return;
    rows.push({
      sheet_name: sheetName,
      record_uid: recordUid,
      record_id: recordId,
      action: action,
      column_name: col,
      old_value: safeStr_(oVal),
      new_value: safeStr_(nVal),
      changed_by: user || '',
      changed_at: new Date(),
      created_at: new Date()
    });
  });
  rows.forEach(function (hr) {
    addRecord_(CONFIG.AUTH_SPREADSHEET_ID, 'ERP_Record_History', hr,
      ['sheet_name', 'record_uid', 'action', 'column_name', 'changed_by']);
  });
}

/**
 * Stamps audit fields onto a data map ONLY for columns that already exist in the
 * sheet. This prevents the audit trail from creating new columns in business
 * tables. Supported fields: user, created_by, created_at, updated_by,
 * updated_at, approved_by, approved_at, record_uid.
 */
function _stampExistingAuditCols_(sheet, target, stamps) {
  const headers = getHeaders_(sheet).map(function (h) { return String(h).trim().toLowerCase(); });
  function setIf(col, val) {
    if (val !== undefined && headers.indexOf(col.toLowerCase()) !== -1) target[col] = val;
  }
  setIf('user', stamps.user);
  setIf('created_by', stamps.created_by);
  setIf('created_at', stamps.created_at);
  setIf('updated_by', stamps.updated_by);
  setIf('updated_at', stamps.updated_at);
  setIf('approved_by', stamps.approved_by);
  setIf('approved_at', stamps.approved_at);
  setIf('record_uid', stamps.record_uid);
}

/**
 * Create or update a business row AND write its audit history.
 * existingRowId null => create (id assigned by addRecord_). Otherwise update by pkColumn.
 * oldRowByUid (optional) maps pkColumn value -> full record object, used to recover
 * record_uid and old values without an extra read.
 */
function saveRecordWithAudit_(sheetDbId, sheetName, existingRowId, dataMap, action, currentUser, auditCols, requiredFields, oldRowByUid, pkColumn) {
  const dbId = sheetDbId || CONFIG.AUTH_SPREADSHEET_ID;
  const pk = pkColumn || 'id';
  const sheet = getSheet_(sheetName, dbId);
  if (existingRowId == null) {
    const merged = Object.assign({}, dataMap);
    const uid = 'rec_' + Utilities.getUuid();
    _stampExistingAuditCols_(sheet, merged, {
      user: currentUser || '',
      created_by: currentUser || '',
      created_at: new Date(),
      updated_by: currentUser || '',
      updated_at: new Date(),
      approved_by: '',
      approved_at: '',
      record_uid: uid
    });
    const res = addRecord_(dbId, sheetName, merged, requiredFields);
    if (res.status !== 'success') return res;
    logHistory_(dbId, sheetName, uid, null, currentUser, action || 'create', merged, null);
    return res;
  }
  let old = oldRowByUid ? (oldRowByUid[String(existingRowId)] || null) : null;
  if (!old) {
    const rows = getAllRecords_(dbId, sheetName);
    old = rows.find(function (r) { return String(r[pk]) === String(existingRowId); }) || null;
  }
  const oldUid = old ? (old.record_uid || ('upd_' + sheetName + '_' + existingRowId)) : ('upd_' + sheetName + '_' + existingRowId);
  const newValues = Object.assign({}, old || {}, dataMap);
  _stampExistingAuditCols_(sheet, newValues, {
    user: currentUser || '',
    updated_by: currentUser || '',
    updated_at: new Date(),
    record_uid: oldUid
  });
  if (pk !== 'id') newValues[pk] = existingRowId;
  const ok = updateRowByCriteria_(sheet, pk, existingRowId, newValues);
  if (!ok) return { status: 'error', message: 'Row not found for update: ' + existingRowId };
  logHistory_(dbId, sheetName, oldUid, existingRowId, currentUser, action || 'update', newValues, old);
  return { status: 'success', data: { record: newValues, rowId: existingRowId } };
}

function approveRecordWithAudit_(sheetDbId, sheetName, rowId, approveMap, currentUser, auditCols, requiredFields, oldRowByUid, pkColumn) {
  const dbId = sheetDbId || CONFIG.AUTH_SPREADSHEET_ID;
  const pk = pkColumn || 'id';
  const sheet = getSheet_(sheetName, dbId);
  let old = oldRowByUid ? (oldRowByUid[String(rowId)] || null) : null;
  if (!old) {
    const rows = getAllRecords_(dbId, sheetName);
    old = rows.find(function (r) { return String(r[pk]) === String(rowId); }) || null;
  }
  const oldUid = old ? (old.record_uid || ('upd_' + sheetName + '_' + rowId)) : ('upd_' + sheetName + '_' + rowId);
  const merged = Object.assign({}, old || {}, approveMap);
  _stampExistingAuditCols_(sheet, merged, {
    approved_by: currentUser || '',
    approved_at: new Date(),
    updated_by: currentUser || '',
    updated_at: new Date(),
    record_uid: oldUid
  });
  if (pk !== 'id') merged[pk] = rowId;
  const ok = updateRowByCriteria_(sheet, pk, rowId, merged);
  if (!ok) return { status: 'error', message: 'Row not found for approve: ' + rowId };
  logHistory_(dbId, sheetName, oldUid, rowId, currentUser, 'approve', merged, old);
  return { status: 'success', data: { record: merged, rowId: rowId } };
}

function deleteRecordWithAudit_(sheetDbId, sheetName, rowId, currentUser, auditCols, oldRowByUid, pkColumn) {
  const dbId = sheetDbId || CONFIG.AUTH_SPREADSHEET_ID;
  const pk = pkColumn || 'id';
  const sheet = getSheet_(sheetName, dbId);
  let old = oldRowByUid ? (oldRowByUid[String(rowId)] || null) : null;
  if (!old) {
    const rows = getAllRecords_(dbId, sheetName);
    old = rows.find(function (r) { return String(r[pk]) === String(rowId); }) || null;
  }
  const oldUid = old ? (old.record_uid || ('del_' + sheetName + '_' + rowId)) : ('del_' + sheetName + '_' + rowId);
  logHistory_(dbId, sheetName, oldUid, rowId, currentUser, 'delete', null, old);
  const removed = deleteRowsByCriteria_(sheet, pk, rowId);
  return { status: 'success', removed: removed };
}
