<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>رصيد أصناف الميزانية</title>

<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);
  var FILTER = { target: '', search: '', view: 'all' };

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / حسابات الميزانية / رصيد أصناف الميزانية',
      contentId: 'stock-balance-content',
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchBalance();
  }

  function fetchBalance() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_legal_current_products')
      .then(function (r) { renderBalance(r.items || []); })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderBalance(list) {
    window.__balance = list;
    var targets = [];
    list.forEach(function (r) { var t = String(r.product_target || '').trim(); if (t && targets.indexOf(t) === -1) targets.push(t); });
    targets.sort();
    var targetOpts = targets.map(function (t) {
      return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(t) + '"' + (FILTER.target === t ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(t) + '</option>';
    }).join('');

    var rows = list.filter(function (r) {
      if (FILTER.target && String(r.product_target || '').trim() !== FILTER.target) return false;
      if ((FILTER.view === 'blank' || FILTER.view === 'both') && !String(r.product || '').trim()) return false;
      if ((FILTER.view === 'zero' || FILTER.view === 'both') && !(Number(r.current_qty) || 0)) return false;
      if (FILTER.search) {
        var q = FILTER.search.toLowerCase();
        return String(r.product || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ||
          String(r.transaction_code || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ||
          String(r.code || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
      }
      return true;
    }).map(function (r) {
      return {
        transaction_code: FMT.escape(r.transaction_code || '-'),
        product: FMT.escape(r.product || '-'),
        unit: FMT.escape(r.unit || '-'),
        current_qty: Number(r.current_qty) || 0,
        total_cost_sign: Number(r.total_cost_sign) || 0,
        total_sales_value: Number(r.total_sales_value) || 0,
        sales_per_qty: Number(r.sales_per_qty) || 0,
        product_target: FMT.escape(r.product_target || '-')
      };
    });

    var headers = [
      { key: 'transaction_code', label: 'كود المعاملة' },
      { key: 'product', label: 'الصنف' },
      { key: 'unit', label: 'الوحدة' },
      { key: 'current_qty', label: 'الكمية الحالية', numeric: true },
      { key: 'total_cost_sign', label: 'قيمة التكلفة', money: true },
      { key: 'total_sales_value', label: 'قيمة المبيعات', money: true },
      { key: 'sales_per_qty', label: 'سعر البيع/الوحدة', money: true },
      { key: 'product_target', label: 'التصنيف' }
    ];
    document.getElementById('stock-balance-content').innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
        '<select id="bal-target" class="input" style="width:auto;min-width:170px;" onchange="setTarget(this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">كل التصنيفات</option>' + targetOpts + '</select>' +
        '<input id="bal-search" class="input" style="width:auto;min-width:200px;" type="search" placeholder="بحث عن صنف..." onkeyup="setSearch(this.value)">' +
        '<select id="bal-view" class="input" style="width:auto;min-width:190px;" onchange="setView(this.value)">' +
          '<option value="all"' + (FILTER.view === 'all' ? ' selected' : '') + '>كل الأصناف</option>' +
          '<option value="blank"' + (FILTER.view === 'blank' ? ' selected' : '') + '>إخفاء الأصناف الفارغة</option>' +
          '<option value="zero"' + (FILTER.view === 'zero' ? ' selected' : '') + '>إخفاء الصفرية</option>' +
          '<option value="both"' + (FILTER.view === 'both' ? ' selected' : '') + '>الاثنان معاً</option>' +
        '</select>' +
        '<span style="font-size:13px;color:#374151;">عدد الأصناف المعروضة: <b>' + FMT.number(rows.length) + '</b></span>' +
      '</div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('stock-balance-table', { title: 'رصيد أصناف الميزانية', headers: headers, rows: rows, emptyText: 'لا توجد بيانات' });
    UIC.initTableSort('stock-balance-table');
  }

  function setTarget(v) { FILTER.target = v; renderBalance(window.__balance || []); }
  function setSearch(v) { FILTER.search = v.trim(); renderBalance(window.__balance || []); }
  function setView(v) { FILTER.view = v; renderBalance(window.__balance || []); }

  function showError(e) {
    UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ غير متوقع', 'error');
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>

  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);
  var MONTHS = ['', 'يناير', 'فبراير', 'مارس', 'أبريل', 'مايو', 'يونيو', 'يوليو', 'أغسطس', 'سبتمبر', 'أكتوبر', 'نوفمبر', 'ديسمبر'];
  var FILTER = { month: '', year: '', type: '', product: '', search: '', offset: 0, limit: 200 };
  var LAST = { total: 0, items: [] };
  var REFS = null;

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / حسابات الميزانية / حركة الأصناف',
      contentId: 'stock-movement-content',
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    UI.showSpinner('جاري تحميل البيانات...');
    companyCall('get_budget_refs')
      .then(function (r) { REFS = r.refs || {}; fetchMovement(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); showError(e); });
  }

  function fetchMovement() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    var year = new Date().getFullYear();
    companyCall('get_legal_products_movement', {
      month: FILTER.month ? Number(FILTER.month) : '',
      year: FILTER.year ? Number(FILTER.year) : year,
      type: FILTER.type,
      product: FILTER.product,
      search: FILTER.search,
      offset: FILTER.offset,
      limit: FILTER.limit
    })
      .then(function (r) {
        LAST.total = r.total || 0;
        LAST.items = r.items || [];
        renderMovement(r.items || [], r.total || 0);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderMovement(items, total) {
    var typeOpts = ['اصول غير متداولة', 'رصيد افتتاحي', 'مشتريات', 'التصنيع الداخلي', 'مبيعات', 'تسوية'].map(function (t) {
      return '<option value="' + t + '"' + (FILTER.type === t ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + t + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    var mOpts = MONTHS.map(function (m, i) {
      if (!i) return '<option value="">كل الشهور</option>';
      return '<option value="' + i + '"' + (String(FILTER.month) === String(i) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + m + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    var yOpts = [2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026].map(function (y) {
      return '<option value="' + y + '"' + (String(FILTER.year) === String(y) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + y + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    var productOpts = ((REFS && REFS.current_products) || []).map(function (c) {
      var val = String(c.product || '').trim();
      if (!val) return '';
      return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(val) + '"' + (FILTER.product === val ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(val) + '</option>';
    }).join('');

    var rows = items.map(function (r) {
      var prod = String(r.product || '').trim();
      var printBtn = '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="printMovement(\'' + FMT.escape(prod) + '\')">طباعة</button>';
      return {
        transaction_code: FMT.escape(r.transaction_code || '-'),
        product: FMT.escape(r.product || '-'),
        transaction_name: FMT.escape(r.transaction_name || '-'),
        transaction_type: FMT.escape(r.transaction_type || '-'),
        transaction_date: FMT.escape(r.transaction_date || '-'),
        qty: Number(r.qty) || 0,
        total_sales_value: Number(r.total_sales_value) || 0,
        cost_per_qty: Number(r.cost_per_qty) || 0,
        sales_per_qty: Number(r.sales_per_qty) || 0,
        total_cost_sign: Number(r.total_cost_sign) || 0,
        tax_type: FMT.escape(r.tax_type || '-'),
        month: FMT.escape(MONTHS[Number(r.month)] || r.month || '-'),
        year: FMT.escape(r.year || '-'),
        print: printBtn
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'transaction_code', label: 'كود المعاملة' },
      { key: 'product', label: 'الصنف' },
      { key: 'transaction_name', label: 'المعاملة' },
      { key: 'transaction_type', label: 'النوع' },
      { key: 'transaction_date', label: 'التاريخ' },
      { key: 'qty', label: 'الكمية', numeric: true },
      { key: 'total_sales_value', label: 'قيمة المبيعات', money: true },
      { key: 'cost_per_qty', label: 'تكلفة/الوحدة', money: true },
      { key: 'sales_per_qty', label: 'بيع/الوحدة', money: true },
      { key: 'total_cost_sign', label: 'إجمالي التكلفة', money: true },
      { key: 'tax_type', label: 'الضريبة' },
      { key: 'month', label: 'الشهر' },
      { key: 'year', label: 'السنة' },
      { key: 'print', label: '' }
    ];
    var page = Math.floor(FILTER.offset / FILTER.limit) + 1;
    var pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / FILTER.limit));
    document.getElementById('stock-movement-content').innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
        '<select id="mv-month" class="input" style="width:auto;" onchange="setFilter(\'month\', this.value)">' + mOpts + '</select>' +
        '<select id="mv-year" class="input" style="width:auto;" onchange="setFilter(\'year\', this.value)">' + yOpts + '</select>' +
        '<select id="mv-type" class="input" style="width:auto;min-width:150px;" onchange="setFilter(\'type\', this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">كل الأنواع</option>' + typeOpts + '</select>' +
        '<select id="mv-product" class="input" style="width:auto;min-width:200px;" onchange="setFilter(\'product\', this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">كل المنتجات</option>' + productOpts + '</select>' +
        '<input id="mv-search" class="input" style="width:auto;min-width:200px;" type="search" placeholder="بحث عن صنف/كود..." onkeyup="setFilter(\'search\', this.value)">' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div id="movement-table-area"></div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:10px;">' +
        '<button class="btn btn-outline" ' + (FILTER.offset === 0 ? 'disabled' : '') + ' onclick="gotoPage(' + (page - 1) + ')">السابق</button>' +
        '<span style="font-size:13px;color:#374151;">صفحة ' + page + ' من ' + pages + ' (' + FMT.number(total) + ' حركة)</span>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-outline" ' + (page >= pages ? 'disabled' : '') + ' onclick="gotoPage(' + (page + 1) + ')">التالي</button>' +
      '</div>';
    document.getElementById('movement-table-area').innerHTML =
      UIC.dataTable('stock-movement-table', { title: 'حركة الأصناف (دفتر الجرد)', headers: headers, rows: rows, emptyText: 'لا توجد حركة' });
    UIC.initTableSort('stock-movement-table');
  }

  function printMovement(product) {
    if (!product) return;
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?download=budget_print&type=movement&id=' + encodeURIComponent(product) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function setFilter(k, v) {
    FILTER[k] = k === 'search' ? v.trim() : v;
    FILTER.offset = 0;
    fetchMovement();
  }

  function gotoPage(p) {
    if (p < 1) return;
    FILTER.offset = (p - 1) * FILTER.limit;
    fetchMovement();
  }

  function showError(e) {
    UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ غير متوقع', 'error');
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>




// ============================================================
// ==== Company_TopChemical_CartonSizes.html ====

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>مقاسات الكراتين والعبوات</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= include('Company_TopChemical_Nav'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);
  var NEW_TYPE_OPTION = '__new__';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'carton-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / الاستيراد والمشتريات / مقاسات الكراتين والعبوات',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchSizes();
  }

  function fetchSizes() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_carton_sizes')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__sizes = r.sizes || [];
        window.__productOptions = r.product_options || [];
        window.__vendorOptions = r.vendor_options || [];
        window.__typeOptions = r.type_options || [];
        renderSizes();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderSizes() {
    var list = window.__sizes;
    var rows = list.map(function (s) {
      return {
        id: s.id,
        product: esc(s.product_name || ('#' + s.product)),
        vendor: esc(s.vendor_name || ('#' + s.common_vendor)),
        type: esc(s.type || '-'),
        length: s.length,
        width: s.width,
        height: s.height,
        other_details: esc(s.other_details || '-'),
        document: fileLinkCell(s.document),
        actions: '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openDetail(' + window.__sizes.indexOf(s) + ')">عرض</button>'
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'id', label: '#', numeric: true },
      { key: 'product', label: 'المنتج' },
      { key: 'vendor', label: 'المورد المشترك' },
      { key: 'type', label: 'النوع' },
      { key: 'length', label: 'الطول', numeric: true },
      { key: 'width', label: 'العرض', numeric: true },
      { key: 'height', label: 'الارتفاع', numeric: true },
      { key: 'other_details', label: 'تفاصيل أخرى' },
      { key: 'document', label: 'المستند' },
      { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('carton-content');
    body.innerHTML = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ إضافة مقاس</button></div>'
      : '') +
      UIC.dataTable('carton-table', {
        title: 'مقاسات الكراتين والعبوات',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد مقاسات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('carton-table');
  }

  function typeFieldHTML() {
    var opts = (window.__typeOptions || []).map(function (t) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(t.value) + '">' + esc(t.label) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    return '<div class="form-field" data-field="type"><label class="form-label" for="size-type">النوع <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<select id="size-type" class="input" data-field-name="type">' +
      '<option value="">اختر النوع...</option>' + opts +
      '<option value="' + NEW_TYPE_OPTION + '">+ إضافة نوع جديد</option>' +
      '</select>' +
      '<div class="field-error" id="err-type"></div></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="new_type" id="new-type-row" style="display:none;">' +
      '<label class="form-label" for="size-new-type">النوع الجديد <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<input id="size-new-type" class="input" type="text" placeholder="اكتب النوع الجديد...">' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function openAddModal() {
    var body =
      '<form id="carton-size-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'product', label: 'المنتج', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__productOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر المنتج...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'common_vendor', label: 'المورد المشترك', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__vendorOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر المورد...' }) +
      typeFieldHTML() +
      UIC.field({ key: 'length', label: 'الطول', type: 'number', step: '0.01', min: '0', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 40.5' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'width', label: 'العرض', type: 'number', step: '0.01', min: '0', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 30' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'height', label: 'الارتفاع', type: 'number', step: '0.01', min: '0', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 20' }) +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="other_details"><label class="form-label" for="size-other-details">تفاصيل أخرى <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<textarea id="size-other-details" class="input" data-field-name="other_details" rows="3" placeholder="تفاصيل إضافية..."></textarea>' +
      '<div class="field-error" id="err-other_details"></div></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="document"><label class="form-label" for="size-document">المستند (pdf, word, صورة)</label>' +
      '<input id="size-document" data-field-name="document" class="input" type="file" accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg">' +
      '<div class="field-error" id="err-document"></div></div>' +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('carton-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة مقاس كرتون/عبوة',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveCartonSize()'
    });
    var sel = document.getElementById('size-type');
    if (sel) {
      sel.addEventListener('change', function () {
        document.getElementById('new-type-row').style.display = (sel.value === NEW_TYPE_OPTION) ? '' : 'none';
      });
    }
  }

  function saveCartonSize() {
    var formEl = document.getElementById('carton-size-form');
    var data = UIC.collectForm('carton-size-form');
    if (data.type === NEW_TYPE_OPTION) {
      var newType = (document.getElementById('size-new-type') || {}).value || '';
      newType = String(newType).trim();
      if (!newType) { UIC.toast('اكتب النوع الجديد', 'error'); return; }
      data.type = newType;
    }
    if (!UIC.validateForm('carton-size-form')) return;
    if (String(data.type).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('النوع مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_carton_size', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        var id = (r && r.data) ? r.data.assignedId : null;
        return uploadDocument(formEl, id).then(function (docRef) {
          if (docRef) {
            return companyCall('add_carton_size_files', { id: id, document: docRef }).then(function () { return r; });
          }
          return r;
        });
      })
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('carton-modal');
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchSizes();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function uploadDocument(formEl, id) {
    var input = formEl.querySelector('input[data-field-name="document"]');
    if (!input || !input.files || !input.files[0]) return Promise.resolve(null);
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('خطأ في قراءة الملف')); };
      reader.onload = function () {
        var b64 = String(reader.result || '').split(',')[1] || '';
        companyCall('add_upload_file', {
          sheet: 'purchasing_support_data',
          field: 'document',
          id: id,
          filename: input.files[0].name,
          base64: b64
        }).then(function (res) {
          if (res && res.status === 'success') resolve(res.reference);
          else reject(new Error((res && res.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
        }).catch(function (e) {
          reject(new Error((e && e.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
        });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
    });
  }

  function downloadRef(ref) {
    if (!ref) return;
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?download=doc_file&company=3fe1b5cb67b7223e&ref=' +
      encodeURIComponent(ref) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function fileLinkCell(ref) {
    return ref
      ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="downloadRef(\'' + esc(ref) + '\')">تحميل</button>'
      : '-';
  }

  function openDetail(idx) {
    var s = window.__sizes[idx];
    if (!s) return;
    var rows = [
      ['#', s.id],
      ['المنتج', s.product_name || ('#' + s.product)],
      ['المورد المشترك', s.vendor_name || ('#' + s.common_vendor)],
      ['النوع', s.type || '-'],
      ['الطول', s.length],
      ['العرض', s.width],
      ['الارتفاع', s.height],
      ['تفاصيل أخرى', s.other_details || '-'],
      ['المستند', fileLinkCell(s.document)],
      ['أضيف بواسطة', s.user || '-'],
      ['وقت الإضافة', s.created_at ? fmtDate(s.created_at) : '-']
    ];
    var body = rows.map(function (r) {
      return '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">' + esc(r[0]) + '</label>' +
        '<div style="padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:13px;">' + r[1] + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
    UIC.openModal('carton-detail-modal', {
      title: 'تفاصيل المقاس #' + s.id,
      body: body,
      footer: false
    });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('carton-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>





// ============================================================
// ==== Company_TopChemical_Clients.html ====

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>عملاء وموردين</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= include('Company_TopChemical_Nav'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'clients-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / الحسابات / عملاء وموردين',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchClients();
  }

  function fetchClients() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_clients_vendors')
      .then(function (r) { renderClients(r.clients || []); })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderClients(list) {
    window.__clients = list;
    var rows = list.map(function (c) {
      var maps = c.google_maps
        ? '<a href="' + FMT.escape(c.google_maps) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">خريطة</a>'
        : '-';
      return {
        id: c.id,
        name_ar: c.name_ar || '-',
        cell_phone: c.cell_phone || '-',
        address: c.address || '-',
        google_maps: maps,
        notes: c.notes || '-',
        tax_id: c.tax_id || '-',
        actions: IS_SUPER_ADMIN
          ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openClientModal(\'' + FMT.escape(c.id) + '\')">تعديل</button>'
          : ''
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'id', label: '#' },
      { key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم' },
      { key: 'cell_phone', label: 'الموبايل' },
      { key: 'address', label: 'العنوان' },
      { key: 'google_maps', label: 'الموقع' },
      { key: 'notes', label: 'ملاحظات' },
      { key: 'tax_id', label: 'الرقم الضريبي' },
      { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('clients-content');
    body.innerHTML = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openClientModal(\'\')">+ إضافة عميل / مورد</button></div>'
      : '') +
      UIC.dataTable('clients-table', {
        title: 'العملاء والموردون',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد بيانات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('clients-table');
  }

  function openClientModal(id) {
    var c = (window.__clients || []).find(function (x) { return String(x.id) === String(id); });
    var body =
      '<form id="client-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'id', label: '#', type: 'number', value: c ? c.id : '', required: true, placeholder: 'رقم صحيح' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم', value: c ? c.name_ar : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'cell_phone', label: 'الموبايل', value: c ? c.cell_phone : '' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'address', label: 'العنوان', value: c ? c.address : '' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'google_maps', label: 'رابط الموقع (Google Maps)', value: c ? c.google_maps : '' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'notes', label: 'ملاحظات', type: 'textarea', value: c ? c.notes : '' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'tax_id', label: 'الرقم الضريبي', type: 'number', value: c ? c.tax_id : '' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('client-modal', {
      title: c ? 'تعديل عميل / مورد' : 'إضافة عميل / مورد',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveClient(\'' + (c ? c.id : '') + '\')'
    });
    if (c) {
      var idField = document.getElementById('id');
      if (idField) idField.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
    }
  }

  function saveClient(id) {
    if (!id && !CAN_WRITE) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    if (id && !IS_SUPER_ADMIN) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    var data = UIC.collectForm('client-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('client-form')) return;
    if (id) data.id = id;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall(id ? 'edit_client_vendor' : 'add_client_vendor', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('client-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchClients();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('clients-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  <style>
    .co-wrap { padding: 16px 20px 32px; }

<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function todayStr() {
    var d = new Date();
    var m = ('0' + (d.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2);
    var day = ('0' + d.getDate()).slice(-2);
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + m + '-' + day;
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function fmt2(n) {
    var v = Number(n) || 0;
    return v.toLocaleString('ar-EG', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  }

  function fileLink(ref) {
    if (!ref) return '—';
    if (String(ref).indexOf('/') === -1) return esc(ref); // plain text, not a file ref
    var href = scriptUrl + '?download=doc_file&ref=' + encodeURIComponent(ref) +
      '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN);
    var name = String(ref).split('/').pop();
    return '<a class="file-link" href="' + href + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + esc(name) + ' ↗</a>';
  }

  // ---- Upload helper (mirrors BudgetInputs.uploadFileInput) ----
  function uploadFileInput(inputEl, field, sheet) {
    if (!inputEl || !inputEl.files || !inputEl.files[0]) return Promise.resolve('');
    var file = inputEl.files[0];
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('خطأ في قراءة الملف')); };
      reader.onload = function () {
        var b64 = String(reader.result || '').split(',')[1] || '';
        companyCall('add_upload_file', { sheet: sheet, field: field, filename: file.name, base64: b64 })
          .then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.status === 'success') resolve(res.reference);
            else reject(new Error((res && res.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
          })
          .catch(function (err) { reject(new Error((err && err.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف')); });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  }

  var ALL_ROWS = [];
  var TABLE_STATE = { search: '', sortKey: 'id', sortAsc: false, page: 1, perPage: 10 };

  function load() {
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / مكتب الجمارك',
      contentId: 'tc-content',
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    renderShell();
    fetchData();
  }

  function renderShell() {
    var inner = document.getElementById('tc-content');
    if (!inner) return;
    inner.innerHTML =
      '<div class="co-wrap">' +
        '<div class="co-cards">' +
          '<div class="co-card egp">' +
            '<div class="co-icon">💷</div>' +
            '<div><div class="co-value" id="egp-total">0.00</div>' +
            '<div class="co-label">إجمالي المعاملات بالجنيه</div></div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="co-card usd">' +
            '<div class="co-icon">💵</div>' +
            '<div><div class="co-value" id="usd-total">0.00</div>' +
            '<div class="co-label">إجمالي المعاملات بالدولار</div></div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +

        '<div class="co-toolbar">' +
          '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openFormModal(\'egp\')">➕ إضافة معاملة (بالجنيه)</button>' +
          '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="openFormModal(\'usd\')">➕ إضافة معاملة (بالدولار)</button>' +
          '<input id="co-search" class="input co-search" type="search" placeholder="بحث في المعاملات..." onkeyup="onSearch(this.value)">' +
        '</div>' +

        '<div id="customs-table"></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function fetchData() {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري تحميل بيانات مكتب الجمارك...');
    companyCall('get_customs_office', { scriptUrl: scriptUrl, sessionToken: SESSION_TOKEN })
      .then(function (d) {
        var s = d.summary || { egp_total: 0, usd_total: 0 };
        document.getElementById('egp-total').textContent = fmt2(s.egp_total) + ' ج.م';
        document.getElementById('usd-total').textContent = '$ ' + fmt2(s.usd_total);
        ALL_ROWS = d.transactions || [];
        TABLE_STATE.page = 1;
        renderTable();
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        var t = document.getElementById('customs-table');
        if (t) t.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>خطأ في تحميل البيانات: ' + esc((e && e.message) || String(e)) + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function onSearch(v) {
    TABLE_STATE.search = String(v || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    TABLE_STATE.page = 1;
    renderTable();
  }

  function sortBy(key) {
    if (TABLE_STATE.sortKey === key) TABLE_STATE.sortAsc = !TABLE_STATE.sortAsc;
    else { TABLE_STATE.sortKey = key; TABLE_STATE.sortAsc = true; }
    renderTable();
  }

  function renderTable() {
    var container = document.getElementById('customs-table');
    if (!container) return;

    var rows = ALL_ROWS.slice();
    if (TABLE_STATE.search) {
      rows = rows.filter(function (r) {
        return [r.transaction_date, r.transaction_type, r.operation_reason,
          r.transaction_details, r.user_email, r.amount_egp, r.amount_usd]
          .join(' ').toLowerCase().indexOf(TABLE_STATE.search) !== -1;
      });
    }

    var key = TABLE_STATE.sortKey;
    rows.sort(function (a, b) {
      var av = a[key], bv = b[key];
      var na = parseFloat(av), nb = parseFloat(bv);
      var cmp;
      if (!isNaN(na) && !isNaN(nb)) cmp = na - nb;
      else cmp = String(av == null ? '' : av).localeCompare(String(bv == null ? '' : bv), 'ar');
      return TABLE_STATE.sortAsc ? cmp : -cmp;
    });

    if (!rows.length) {
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>لا توجد معاملات مطابقة</span></div>';
      return;
    }

    var totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.length / TABLE_STATE.perPage));
    if (TABLE_STATE.page > totalPages) TABLE_STATE.page = totalPages;
    var start = (TABLE_STATE.page - 1) * TABLE_STATE.perPage;
    var pageRows = rows.slice(start, start + TABLE_STATE.perPage);

    var caret = function (k) { return TABLE_STATE.sortKey === k ? (TABLE_STATE.sortAsc ? ' ▲' : ' ▼') : ''; };

    var head =
      '<thead><tr>' +
        '<th onclick="sortBy(\'id\')"># ' + caret('id') + '</th>' +
        '<th onclick="sortBy(\'transaction_date\')">التاريخ ' + caret('transaction_date') + '</th>' +
        '<th onclick="sortBy(\'transaction_type\')">النوع ' + caret('transaction_type') + '</th>' +
        '<th onclick="sortBy(\'operation_reason\')">سبب العملية ' + caret('operation_reason') + '</th>' +
        '<th onclick="sortBy(\'amount_egp\')">المبلغ (جنيه) ' + caret('amount_egp') + '</th>' +
        '<th onclick="sortBy(\'amount_usd\')">المبلغ (دولار) ' + caret('amount_usd') + '</th>' +
        '<th>تفاصيل المعاملة</th>' +
        '<th>تكليف المطالبة</th>' +
        '<th>تخليص الشحنة</th>' +
        '<th>المستخدم</th>' +
        '<th onclick="sortBy(\'created_at\')">تم الإنشاء ' + caret('created_at') + '</th>' +
      '</tr></thead>';

    var body = '<tbody>' + pageRows.map(function (r) {
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.id) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.transaction_date) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.transaction_type) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.operation_reason) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + fmt2(r.amount_egp) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + fmt2(r.amount_usd) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.transaction_details) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + fileLink(r.claim_assignment) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + fileLink(r.shipment_clearance) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.user_email) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.created_at) + '</td>' +
      '</tr>';
    }).join('') + '</tbody>';

    var from = start + 1, to = start + pageRows.length;
    var pager =
      '<div class="co-pager">' +
        '<span class="co-info">عرض ' + from + ' — ' + to + ' من ' + rows.length + '</span>' +
        '<div class="co-pages">' +
          (TABLE_STATE.page > 1 ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="min-height:34px;padding:4px 12px;" onclick="gotoPage(' + (TABLE_STATE.page - 1) + ')">السابق</button>' : '') +
          '<span class="co-info">صفحة ' + TABLE_STATE.page + ' / ' + totalPages + '</span>' +
          (TABLE_STATE.page < totalPages ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="min-height:34px;padding:4px 12px;" onclick="gotoPage(' + (TABLE_STATE.page + 1) + ')">التالي</button>' : '') +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    container.innerHTML = '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="table">' + head + body + '</table></div>' + pager;
  }

  function gotoPage(p) { TABLE_STATE.page = p; renderTable(); }

  // ---- Modals ----
  function buildFormHtml(mode) {
    var typeOpts = [{ value: 'مدين', label: 'مدين' }, { value: 'دائن', label: 'دائن' }];

    var egpField = (mode === 'usd')
      ? '<input type="hidden" id="amount_egp" value="0">'
      : UIC.field({ key: 'amount_egp', label: 'المبلغ (جنيه)', type: 'number', step: '0.01', min: '0', required: true });

    var usdField = (mode === 'egp')
      ? '<input type="hidden" id="amount_usd" value="0">'
      : UIC.field({ key: 'amount_usd', label: 'المبلغ (دولار)', type: 'number', step: '0.01', min: '0', required: true });

    return '<form id="customs-form" onsubmit="return false;">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'transaction_date', label: 'التاريخ', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
      UIC.combo({ key: 'transaction_type', label: 'نوع المعاملة', options: typeOpts, required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'operation_reason', label: 'سبب العملية', type: 'text', required: true }) +
      egpField +
      usdField +
      UIC.field({ key: 'transaction_details', label: 'تفاصيل المعاملة', type: 'textarea' }) +
      UIC.fileField({ key: 'claim_assignment_file', label: 'تكليف المطالبة (اختياري)', accept: '.pdf,.doc,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg' }) +
      UIC.fileField({ key: 'shipment_clearance_file', label: 'تخليص الشحنة (اختياري)', accept: '.pdf,.doc,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg' }) +
      '</form>';
  }

  function openFormModal(mode) {
    var title = (mode === 'usd') ? 'إضافة معاملة بالدولار' : 'إضافة معاملة بالجنيه';
    UIC.openModal('customs-modal', {
      title: title,
      body: buildFormHtml(mode),
      onSave: 'submitCustoms(\'' + mode + '\')'
    });
  }

  function submitCustoms(mode) {
    if (!UIC.validateForm('customs-form')) {
      UIC.toast('يرجى تعبئة الحقول المطلوبة', 'warning');
      return;
    }
    var claimInput = document.getElementById('claim_assignment_file');
    var shipInput = document.getElementById('shipment_clearance_file');
    var claimFile = (claimInput && claimInput.files && claimInput.files[0]) ? claimInput.files[0] : null;
    var shipFile = (shipInput && shipInput.files && shipInput.files[0]) ? shipInput.files[0] : null;

    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    var p1 = claimFile ? uploadFileInput(claimInput, 'claim_assignment', 'customs_office_transactions') : Promise.resolve('');
    var p2 = shipFile ? uploadFileInput(shipInput, 'shipment_clearance', 'customs_office_transactions') : Promise.resolve('');
    Promise.all([p1, p2])
      .then(function (refs) {
        var data = UIC.collectForm('customs-form');
        data.mode = mode;
        data.claim_assignment = refs[0] || '';
        data.shipment_clearance = refs[1] || '';
        return companyCall('add_customs_office', data);
      })
      .then(function (res) {
        UIC.closeModal('customs-modal');
        UIC.toast((res && res.message) || 'تمت الإضافة بنجاح', 'success');
        fetchData();
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        UIC.toast((err && err.message) || 'خطأ في حفظ المعاملة', 'error');
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';

  // Destroy any existing chart before re-drawing
  var _charts = {};
  function destroyChart(id) {
    if (_charts[id]) { try { _charts[id].destroy(); } catch(e){} delete _charts[id]; }
  }

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function fmtMoney(n) {
    if (!n && n !== 0) return '—';
    return Number(n).toLocaleString('ar-EG', {minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0}) + ' ج.م';
  }

  var selectedYear = new Date().getFullYear();

  function load() {
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',

      contentId: 'tc-content',
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchDashboard(selectedYear);
  }

  function fetchDashboard(year) {
    var inner = document.getElementById('tc-content');
    if (!inner) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري تحميل بيانات لوحة التحكم...');

    companyCall('get_dashboard_data', { year: year })
      .then(function(d) {
        renderDashboard(d, year);
      })
      .catch(function(e) {
        inner.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>خطأ في تحميل البيانات: ' + FMT.escape((e && e.message) || String(e)) + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function() { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderDashboard(d, year) {
    var inner = document.getElementById('tc-content');
    if (!inner) return;

    var kpi = d.kpi || {};
    var monthlyInvoices = d.monthlyInvoices || [];
    var topClients = d.topClients || [];
    var monthlyCosts = d.monthlyCosts || [];

    var years = [2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027];
    var yOpts = years.map(function(y) {
      return '<option value="' + y + '"' + (y === year ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + y + '</option>';
    }).join('');

    inner.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-wrap">' +
        '<div class="dash-toolbar">' +
          '<label>السنة:</label>' +
          '<select onchange="selectedYear=Number(this.value);fetchDashboard(selectedYear)">' + yOpts + '</select>' +
          '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-right:8px;">عرض بيانات سنة ' + year + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +

        // KPI row
        '<div class="kpi-row">' +
          '<div class="kpi-card">' +
            '<div class="kpi-label">إجمالي المبيعات الصافية</div>' +
            '<div class="kpi-value">' + fmtMoney(kpi.totalNet) + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kpi-card green">' +
            '<div class="kpi-label">إجمالي المبيعات شامل الضريبة</div>' +
            '<div class="kpi-value">' + fmtMoney(kpi.totalSales) + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kpi-card orange">' +
            '<div class="kpi-label">إجمالي ضريبة المبيعات</div>' +
            '<div class="kpi-value">' + fmtMoney(kpi.totalTax) + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kpi-card red">' +
            '<div class="kpi-label">إجمالي التكاليف النقدية</div>' +
            '<div class="kpi-value">' + fmtMoney(kpi.totalCosts) + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +

        // Charts grid
        '<div class="charts-grid">' +
          '<div class="chart-card full-width">' +
            '<p class="chart-title">📊 المبيعات الشهرية (الصافي والإجمالي) — ' + year + '</p>' +
            '<div class="chart-canvas-wrap"><canvas id="chart-monthly-invoices"></canvas></div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="chart-card">' +
            '<p class="chart-title">🏆 أعلى العملاء مبيعاً</p>' +
            '<div class="chart-canvas-wrap"><canvas id="chart-top-clients"></canvas></div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="chart-card">' +
            '<p class="chart-title">💸 التكاليف الشهرية — ' + year + '</p>' +
            '<div class="chart-canvas-wrap"><canvas id="chart-monthly-costs"></canvas></div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    // Give browser a tick to paint, then draw charts
    setTimeout(function() {
      drawMonthlyInvoicesChart(monthlyInvoices);
      drawTopClientsChart(topClients);
      drawMonthlyCostsChart(monthlyCosts);
    }, 50);
  }

  var MONTH_LABELS = ['يناير','فبراير','مارس','أبريل','مايو','يونيو','يوليو','أغسطس','سبتمبر','أكتوبر','نوفمبر','ديسمبر'];

  function drawMonthlyInvoicesChart(rows) {
    destroyChart('monthly-invoices');
    var ctx = document.getElementById('chart-monthly-invoices');
    if (!ctx) return;
    _charts['monthly-invoices'] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: rows.map(function(r) { return r.month; }),
        datasets: [
          {
            label: 'المبلغ الصافي',
            data: rows.map(function(r) { return r.net || 0; }),
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(59,130,246,0.75)',
            borderColor: 'rgb(37,99,235)',
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderRadius: 4
          },
          {
            label: 'الإجمالي شامل الضريبة',
            data: rows.map(function(r) { return r.total || 0; }),
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.55)',
            borderColor: 'rgb(5,150,105)',
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderRadius: 4
          }
        ]
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
          legend: { position: 'top', labels: { font: { family: 'inherit' } } },
          tooltip: {
            callbacks: {
              label: function(ctx) {
                return ctx.dataset.label + ': ' + Number(ctx.parsed.y).toLocaleString('ar-EG') + ' ج.م';
              }
            }
          }
        },
        scales: {
          x: { ticks: { font: { size: 11 } } },
          y: {
            ticks: {
              callback: function(v) { return Number(v).toLocaleString('ar-EG'); },
              font: { size: 11 }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function drawTopClientsChart(rows) {
    destroyChart('top-clients');
    var ctx = document.getElementById('chart-top-clients');
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (!rows || !rows.length) {
      ctx.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:13px;">لا توجد بيانات عملاء لهذه السنة</div>';
      return;

    var colors = ['#3b82f6','#10b981','#f59e0b','#ef4444','#8b5cf6','#06b6d4','#f97316','#ec4899'];

      type: 'doughnut',

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>مديونيات</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= include('Company_TopChemical_Nav'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>
  <style>
    .group-header { cursor: pointer; }
    .group-header:hover td { background: var(--brand-subtle-bg); }
    .tx-row td { background: var(--bg-subtle); padding: 12px; }
    .subtotal td { font-weight: 700; background: var(--bg-subtle); }
    .grand-total td { font-weight: 800; background: var(--brand-subtle-bg); }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'debts-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / الحسابات / مديونيات',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchDebts();
  }

  function fetchDebts() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_ar_ap')
      .then(function (r) { renderDebts(r); })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderDebts(r) {
    window.__arap = r;
    var summary = r.summary || [];

    var grandDebit = 0, grandCredit = 0;
    summary.forEach(function (g) { grandDebit += g.debit; grandCredit += g.credit; });
    var grandNet = grandDebit - grandCredit;

    var rows = summary.map(function (g, i) {
      return '<tr class="group-header" onclick="toggleDebt(' + i + ')">' +
        '<td><strong>' + FMT.escape(g.client_name) + '</strong></td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(g.debit) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(g.credit) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(g.net) + '</td>' +
        (CAN_WRITE ? '<td><button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 8px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openDebtModal(\'' + FMT.escape(g.client_id) + '\')">إضافة حركة</button></td>' : '<td></td>') +
        '<td><button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 8px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleDebt(' + i + ')">التفاصيل</button></td>' +
        '</tr>' +
        '<tr class="tx-row" id="tx-' + i + '" style="display:none;" data-cid="' + FMT.escape(g.client_id) + '"><td colspan="6"><div class="tx-loading" style="text-align:center;padding:12px;color:#666;">جاري تحميل التفاصيل...</div></td></tr>';
    }).join('');

    var body = document.getElementById('debts-content');
    body.innerHTML =
      (CAN_WRITE
        ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openDebtModal(\'\')">+ إضافة حركة</button></div>'
        : '') +
      '<div class="table-wrap">' +
      '<table class="table">' +
      '<thead><tr><th>العميل</th><th>مدين</th><th>دائن</th><th>الصافي</th><th>إجراءات</th><th></th></tr></thead>' +
      '<tbody>' + rows +
      '<tr class="grand-total"><td>الإجمالي</td>' +
      '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(grandDebit) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(grandCredit) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(grandNet) + '</td><td colspan="2"></td></tr>' +
      '</tbody></table></div>';
  }

  function toggleDebt(i) {
    var el = document.getElementById('tx-' + i);
    if (!el) return;
    if (el.style.display === 'none' || el.style.display === '') {
      loadClientTxs(el, i);
    } else {
      el.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  function loadClientTxs(el, i) {
    var cid = el.getAttribute('data-cid');
    var loaded = el.getAttribute('data-loaded');
    if (loaded === '1') {
      el.style.display = 'table-row';
      return;
    }
    el.style.display = 'table-row';
    companyCall('get_ar_ap_client', { client_id: cid })
      .then(function (r) {
        var txs = r.transactions || [];
        var debit = 0, credit = 0;
        txs.forEach(function (t) { if (t.transaction_type === 'مدين') debit += t.amount; else credit += t.amount; });
        var txsHtml = txs.map(function (t) {
          return '<tr>' +
            '<td>' + FMT.date(t.date) + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + t.transaction_type + '</td>' +
            '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(t.amount) + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + FMT.escape(t.currency || '') + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + FMT.escape(t.reason || '-') + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + (t.invoice_id === '' || t.invoice_id == null ? '-' : t.invoice_id) + '</td>' +
            '</tr>';
        }).join('');
        el.innerHTML = '<td colspan="6"><table class="table">' +
          '<thead><tr><th>التاريخ</th><th>النوع</th><th>المبلغ</th><th>العملة</th><th>السبب</th><th>رقم الفاتورة</th></tr></thead>' +
          '<tbody>' +
          '<tr class="subtotal"><td colspan="2">إجمالي مدين</td><td class="num">' + FMT.number(debit) + '</td><td colspan="3"></td></tr>' +
          '<tr class="subtotal"><td colspan="2">إجمالي دائن</td><td class="num">' + FMT.number(credit) + '</td><td colspan="3"></td></tr>' +
          txsHtml +
          '</tbody></table></td>';
        el.setAttribute('data-loaded', '1');
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        el.innerHTML = '<td colspan="6"><div style="text-align:center;padding:12px;color:#c0392b;">' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</div></td>';
      });
  }

  function openDebtModal(clientId) {
    var r = window.__arap || {};
    var clients = r.clients || [];
    var reasons = r.reasons || [];
    var currencies = r.currencies || [];
    var today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    var body =
      '<form id="debt-form">' +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">اسم العميل <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<select id="client" class="input" required>' +
      '<option value="">اختر العميل...</option>' +
      clients.map(function (c) { return '<option value="' + c.value + '">' + FMT.escape(c.label) + '</option>'; }).join('') +
      '</select><div class="field-error" id="err-client"></div></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">اسم العميل (تلقائي)</label>' +
      '<input id="name_ar_display" class="input" disabled placeholder="يظهر تلقائياً عند اختيار العميل"></div>' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'date', label: 'التاريخ', type: 'date', value: today, required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'amount', label: 'المبلغ', type: 'number', step: '0.01', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'currency', label: 'العملة', type: 'select', value: 'EGP', required: true,
        options: currencies, placeholder: 'اختر العملة...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'transaction_type', label: 'نوع الحركة', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: [{ value: 'مدين', label: 'مدين' }, { value: 'دائن', label: 'دائن' }], placeholder: 'اختر النوع...' }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'reason', label: 'السبب', options: reasons, required: true, placeholder: 'اختر السبب...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'invoice_id', label: 'رقم الفاتورة', type: 'number' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('debt-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة حركة مديونية',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveDebt()'
    });
    var clientSel = document.getElementById('client');
    if (clientSel) {
      clientSel.addEventListener('change', fillClientName);
      if (clientId !== '') clientSel.value = String(clientId);
      fillClientName();
    }
  }

  function fillClientName() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('client');
    var disp = document.getElementById('name_ar_display');
    if (!sel || !disp) return;
    var opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
    disp.value = (opt && opt.text && opt.text !== 'اختر العميل...') ? opt.text : '';
  }

  function saveDebt() {
    if (!CAN_WRITE) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    var data = UIC.collectForm('debt-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('debt-form')) return;
    if (data.reason === '__new__') { data.reason = data.reason_custom || ''; }
    delete data.reason_custom;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_ar_ap', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('debt-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchDebts();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('debts-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function todayStr() {
    var d = new Date();
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'ded-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / شئون العاملين / الغياب والخصومات',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchDeductions();
  }

  function fetchDeductions() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_emp_deductions')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__rows = r.rows || [];
        window.__empOptions = r.employee_options || [];
        window.__dedOptions = r.deduction_options || [];
        renderDeductions();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderDeductions() {
    var body = document.getElementById('ded-content');
    if (!body) return;
    var groups = {};
    (window.__rows || []).forEach(function (r) {
      var t = r.deduction_type || 'أخرى';
      groups[t] = groups[t] || { dates: {} };
      var d = fmtDate(r.date);
      groups[t].dates[d] = groups[t].dates[d] || [];
      groups[t].dates[d].push(r);
    });
    var typeOrder = ['سلف', 'غياب', 'جزاء'];
    var order = Object.keys(groups).sort(function (a, b) {
      var ia = typeOrder.indexOf(a), ib = typeOrder.indexOf(b);
      if (ia === -1 && ib === -1) return a.localeCompare(b, 'ar');
      if (ia === -1) return 1;
      if (ib === -1) return -1;
      return ia - ib;
    });
    var html = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ تسجيل خصم</button></div>'
      : '');
    if (!order.length) {
      html += '<div class="empty-state"><span>لا توجد خصومات</span></div>';
    } else {
      order.forEach(function (t, gi) {
        var g = groups[t];
        var dates = Object.keys(g.dates).sort(function (a, b) { return b.localeCompare(a); });
        var count = dates.reduce(function (s, d) { return s + g.dates[d].length; }, 0);
        html += '<div style="margin-bottom:14px;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);overflow:hidden;">' +
          '<div class="ded-group-head" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;background:#f2f4f7;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;" ' +
          'onclick="toggleDedGroup(\'ded-body-' + gi + '\')">' +
          '<span style="transition:transform .2s;font-size:11px;" id="ded-arrow-' + gi + '">▼</span>' +
          '<b style="flex:1;">' + esc(t) + '</b>' +
          '<span class="text-muted" style="font-size:12px;">' + count + ' سجل</span>' +
          (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openAddModal({type:\'' + esc(t) + '\'})">+ إضافة</button>' : '') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div id="ded-body-' + gi + '" class="ded-group-body">';
        dates.forEach(function (d) {
          html += '<div style="padding:8px 14px 4px;"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:4px;">' +
            '<b style="flex:1;font-size:13px;">' + esc(d) + '</b>' +
            '<span class="text-muted" style="font-size:12px;">' + g.dates[d].length + ' سجل</span>' +
            (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 8px;font-size:11px;" onclick="openAddModal({type:\'' + esc(t) + '\',date:\'' + esc(d) + '\'})">+ في هذا التاريخ</button>' : '') +
            '</div>' +
            '<table class="table" style="font-size:13px;">' +
            '<thead><tr><th>كود</th><th>الاسم</th><th>الأيام</th><th>الجزاء</th><th>خصم آخر</th><th>تفاصيل</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
          g.dates[d].forEach(function (r) {
            html += '<tr><td>' + r.emp_id + '</td><td>' + esc(r.name_ar || '-') + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + (r.number_of_days != null ? r.number_of_days : '') + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + (r.penalty_value != null ? r.penalty_value : '') + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + (r.deduction_value_other != null ? r.deduction_value_other : '') + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + esc(r.details || '-') + '</td></tr>';
          });
          html += '</tbody></table></div>';
        });
        html += '</div></div>';
      });
    }
    body.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function toggleDedGroup(id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    var arrow = document.getElementById(id.replace('ded-body-', 'ded-arrow-'));
    if (el.style.display === 'none') {
      el.style.display = 'block';
      if (arrow) arrow.textContent = '▼';
    } else {
      el.style.display = 'none';
      if (arrow) arrow.textContent = '▶';
    }
  }

  function openAddModal(prefill) {
    prefill = prefill || {};
    var body =
      '<form id="ded-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__empOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر الموظف...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'deduction_type', label: 'نوع الخصم', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__dedOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر النوع...', value: prefill.type || '' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'date', label: 'التاريخ', type: 'date', required: true, value: prefill.date || todayStr() }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'number_of_days', label: 'عدد الأيام', type: 'number', min: '0', step: '0.5', value: '1' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'deduction_value_other', label: 'قيمة الخصم (سلف وغيرها)', type: 'number', min: '0', step: '0.01' }) +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="details"><label class="form-label" for="details">تفاصيل <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<textarea id="details" class="input" data-field-name="details" rows="2" placeholder="وصف الخصم..." required></textarea>' +
      '<div class="field-error" id="err-details"></div></div>' +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('ded-modal', {
      title: 'تسجيل غياب / خصم',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveDeduction()'
    });
    var sel = document.getElementById('deduction_type');
    if (sel) sel.addEventListener('change', onDedTypeChange);
    onDedTypeChange();
  }

  function clearFieldError(id) {
    var e = document.getElementById(id);
    if (e) e.textContent = '';
  }

  function setFieldError(input, errId, message) {
    var e = document.getElementById(errId);
    if (e) e.textContent = message;
    var field = input.closest ? input.closest('.form-field') : null;
    if (field) field.classList.add('has-error');
  }

  function onDedTypeChange() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('deduction_type');
    var days = document.getElementById('number_of_days');
    var other = document.getElementById('deduction_value_other');
    if (!sel || !days || !other) return;
    var t = sel.value;
    if (t === 'غياب' || t === 'جزاء') {
      days.setAttribute('required', 'required');
      other.removeAttribute('required');
      clearFieldError('err-deduction_value_other');
    } else if (t === 'سلف') {
      days.removeAttribute('required');
      other.setAttribute('required', 'required');
      clearFieldError('err-number_of_days');
    } else {
      days.removeAttribute('required');
      other.removeAttribute('required');
      clearFieldError('err-number_of_days');
      clearFieldError('err-deduction_value_other');
    }
  }

  function saveDeduction() {
    if (!UIC.validateForm('ded-form')) return;
    var t = document.getElementById('deduction_type').value;
    var days = document.getElementById('number_of_days');
    var other = document.getElementById('deduction_value_other');
    if ((t === 'غياب' || t === 'جزاء') && Number(days.value) <= 0) {
      setFieldError(days, 'err-number_of_days', 'عدد الأيام مطلوب لهذا النوع');
      return;
    }
    if (t === 'سلف' && Number(other.value) <= 0) {
      setFieldError(other, 'err-deduction_value_other', 'قيمة الخصم مطلوبة لهذا النوع');
      return;
    }
    var data = UIC.collectForm('ded-form');
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_emp_deduction', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('ded-modal');
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchDeductions();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('ded-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>تسجيل الموظفين</title>

  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>

<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'employee-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / شئون العاملين / تسجيل الموظفين',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchEmployees();
  }

  function fetchEmployees() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_employees')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__employees = r.employees || [];
        window.__titleOptions = r.title_options || [];
        window.__categoryOptions = r.category_options || [];
        renderEmployees();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderEmployees() {
    var list = window.__employees;
    var rows = list.map(function (e) {
      return {
        emp_id: e.emp_id,
        name_ar: esc(e.name_ar || '-'),
        title: esc(e.title || '-'),
        section: esc(e.section || '-'),
        category: esc(e.category || '-'),
        insurance: e.insurance ? 'نعم' : 'لا',
        main_salary: e.main_salary,
        allow: e.allow,
        basic_salary: e.basic_salary,
        status: esc(e.status || '-')
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'emp_id', label: '#', numeric: true },
      { key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم' },
      { key: 'title', label: 'المسمى الوظيفي' },
      { key: 'section', label: 'القسم' },
      { key: 'category', label: 'التصنيف' },
      { key: 'insurance', label: 'التأمين' },
      { key: 'main_salary', label: 'الراتب', numeric: true },
      { key: 'allow', label: 'البدلات', numeric: true },
      { key: 'basic_salary', label: 'الأساسي', numeric: true },
      { key: 'status', label: 'الحالة الوظيفية' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('employee-content');
    body.innerHTML = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ تسجيل موظف</button></div>'
      : '') +
      UIC.dataTable('employee-table', {
        title: 'الموظفون',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا يوجد موظفون'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('employee-table');
  }

  function openAddModal() {
    var titleOpts = (window.__titleOptions || []).map(function (t) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(t.value) + '">' + esc(t.label) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    var catOpts = (window.__categoryOptions || []).map(function (c) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(c.value) + '">' + esc(c.label) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    var body =
      '<form id="employee-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'name_ar', label: 'اسم الموظف', type: 'text', required: true, placeholder: 'الاسم بالكامل' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'national_id', label: 'الرقم القومي', type: 'number', min: '20000000000000', required: true, placeholder: '14 رقم' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'hiring_date', label: 'تاريخ التعيين', type: 'date', required: true }) +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="title"><label class="form-label" for="title">المسمى الوظيفي <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<select id="title" class="input" data-field-name="title"><option value="">اختر المسمى...</option>' + titleOpts + '</select>' +
      '<div class="field-error" id="err-title"></div></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="section"><label class="form-label">القسم (يُحسب تلقائياً)</label>' +
      '<div style="padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:13px;" id="section-preview">—</div></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="category"><label class="form-label" for="category">التصنيف <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<select id="category" class="input" data-field-name="category"><option value="">اختر التصنيف...</option>' + catOpts + '</select>' +
      '<div class="field-error" id="err-category"></div></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="insurance"><label class="form-label">التأمين</label>' +
      '<label class="input" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><input type="checkbox" id="insurance" style="width:auto;"> <span>مؤمن عليه</span></label></div>' +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('employee-modal', {
      title: 'تسجيل موظف جديد',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveEmployee()'
    });
    var sel = document.getElementById('title');
    if (sel) {
      sel.addEventListener('change', function () {
        var t = window.__titleOptions.find(function (x) { return String(x.value) === sel.value; });
        document.getElementById('section-preview').textContent = (t && t.section) ? t.section : '—';
      });
    }
  }

  function saveEmployee() {
    var formEl = document.getElementById('employee-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('employee-form')) return;
    var data = UIC.collectForm('employee-form');
    data.insurance = !!document.getElementById('insurance').checked;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_employee', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('employee-modal');
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchEmployees();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('employee-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'status-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,

  function fetchStatus() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_employee_status')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__rows = r.rows || [];
        window.__empOptions = r.employee_options || [];
        window.__statusOptions = r.status_options || [];
        renderStatus();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderStatus() {
    var rows = window.__rows.map(function (r) {
      return {
        employee_code: r.employee_code,
        employee_name: esc(r.employee_name || '-'),
        status_type: esc(r.status_type || '-'),
        status_date: fmtDate(r.status_date)
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'employee_code', label: 'كود الموظف', numeric: true },
      { key: 'employee_name', label: 'الاسم' },
      { key: 'status_type', label: 'الحالة' },
      { key: 'status_date', label: 'تاريخ الحالة' }
    ];

      UIC.dataTable('status-table', {
        title: 'حالات الموظفين',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد حالات'

      '<form id="status-form">' +

  function saveStatus() {
    if (!UIC.validateForm('status-form')) return;
    var data = UIC.collectForm('status-form');
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_employee_status', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('status-modal');
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');

<!DOCTYPE html>
