  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function fmtTime(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    if (v instanceof Date) {
      var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
      return p(v.getHours()) + ':' + p(v.getMinutes());
    }
    var s = String(v);
    if (s.indexOf('T') !== -1) { var dt = new Date(s); if (!isNaN(dt.getTime())) return fmtTime(dt); }
    return s;
  }

  function todayStr() {
    var d = new Date();
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'ot-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / شئون العاملين / العمل الإضافي',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchOvertime();
  }

  function fetchOvertime() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_emp_overtime')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__rows = r.rows || [];
        window.__empOptions = r.employee_options || [];
        window.__otOptions = r.overtime_options || [];
        renderOvertime();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderOvertime() {
    var rows = window.__rows.map(function (r) {
      return {
        emp_id: r.emp_id,
        name_ar: esc(r.name_ar || '-'),
        date: fmtDate(r.date),
        start_time: fmtTime(r.start_time),
        end_time: fmtTime(r.end_time),
        total_time: r.total_time,
        approved: r.approved ? 'نعم' : 'لا',
        overtime_type: esc(r.overtime_type || '-'),
        amount: r.amount,
        approved_amount: r.approved_amount
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'emp_id', label: 'كود الموظف', numeric: true },
      { key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم' },
      { key: 'date', label: 'التاريخ' },
      { key: 'start_time', label: 'من' },
      { key: 'end_time', label: 'إلى' },
      { key: 'total_time', label: 'الساعات', numeric: true },
      { key: 'approved', label: 'معتمد' },
      { key: 'overtime_type', label: 'النوع' },
      { key: 'amount', label: 'المبلغ', numeric: true },
      { key: 'approved_amount', label: 'المعتمد', numeric: true }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('ot-content');
    body.innerHTML = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ تسجيل عمل إضافي</button></div>'
      : '') +
      UIC.dataTable('ot-table', {
        title: 'العمل الإضافي',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد سجلات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('ot-table');
  }

  function openAddModal() {
    var body =
      '<form id="ot-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__empOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر الموظف...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'date', label: 'التاريخ', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'start_time', label: 'وقت البداية', type: 'time', required: true, value: '17:00' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'end_time', label: 'وقت النهاية', type: 'time', required: true, value: '18:00' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'overtime_type', label: 'النوع', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__otOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر النوع...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'amount', label: 'المبلغ', type: 'number', min: '0', step: '0.01', required: true }) +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="approved"><label class="form-label">اعتماد</label>' +
      '<label class="input" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><input type="checkbox" id="approved" style="width:auto;" checked> <span>معتمد</span></label></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="details"><label class="form-label" for="details">تفاصيل <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<textarea id="details" class="input" data-field-name="details" rows="2" placeholder="وصف العمل..." required></textarea>' +
      '<div class="field-error" id="err-details"></div></div>' +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('ot-modal', {
      title: 'تسجيل عمل إضافي',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveOvertime()'
    });
    var otSel = document.getElementById('overtime_type');
    if (otSel) otSel.addEventListener('change', onOtTypeChange);
    onOtTypeChange();
  }

  function onOtTypeChange() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('overtime_type');
    var amount = document.getElementById('amount');
    if (!sel || !amount) return;
    if (sel.value === 'عمل اضافي') {
      amount.value = '0';
      amount.disabled = true;
      amount.removeAttribute('required');
      var err = document.getElementById('err-amount');
      if (err) err.textContent = '';
    } else {
      amount.disabled = false;
      amount.setAttribute('required', 'required');
    }
  }

  function saveOvertime() {
    if (!UIC.validateForm('ot-form')) return;
    var sel = document.getElementById('overtime_type');
    var amount = document.getElementById('amount');
    if (sel && sel.value !== 'عمل اضافي' && Number(amount.value) <= 0) {
      var err = document.getElementById('err-amount');
      if (err) err.textContent = 'المبلغ مطلوب لهذا النوع';
      var field = amount.closest ? amount.closest('.form-field') : null;
      if (field) field.classList.add('has-error');
      return;
    }
    var data = UIC.collectForm('ot-form');
    data.approved = !!document.getElementById('approved').checked;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_emp_overtime', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('ot-modal');
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchOvertime();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('ot-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'sal-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / شئون العاملين / صرف المرتبات الشهرية',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchSalaries();
  }

  function fetchSalaries(month, year) {
    UI.showSpinner();
    var data = {};
    if (month) data.month = Number(month);
    if (year) data.year = Number(year);
    companyCall('get_emp_salaries', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__salaries = r.salaries || [];
        window.__total = r.total || 0;
        window.__existingIds = r.existing_emp_ids || [];
        window.__months = r.months || [];
        window.__monthOptions = r.month_options || [];
        window.__empOptions = r.employee_options || [];
        renderFilterBar();
        renderSalaries();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderFilterBar() {
    var yearOptions = [];
    window.__months.forEach(function (m) {
      if (yearOptions.indexOf(String(m.year)) === -1) yearOptions.push(String(m.year));
    });
    var years = yearOptions.sort(function (a, b) { return Number(b) - Number(a); });
    var ySel = '<option value="">كل السنوات</option>';
    years.forEach(function (y) {
      ySel += '<option value="' + y + '"' + (String(FILTER_YEAR) === y ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + y + '</option>';
    });
    var mSel = '<option value="">كل الأشهر</option>';
    window.__monthOptions.forEach(function (m) {
      mSel += '<option value="' + m.value + '"' + (String(FILTER_MONTH) === String(m.value) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(m.label) + '</option>';
    });
    var html =
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="min-width:140px;"><label class="form-label">السنة</label>' +
      '<select id="sal-year" class="input">' + ySel + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="min-width:140px;"><label class="form-label">الشهر</label>' +
      '<select id="sal-month" class="input">' + mSel + '</select></div>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="applyFilter()">عرض</button>' +
      (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openGenerate()">+ توليد شهر</button>' : '') +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="printPayrollReport(\'cards\')">🖨️ كشف الكروت (8/ورقة)</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="printPayrollReport(\'sections\')">🖨️ كشف الأقسام</button>' +
      '</div>';
    var body = document.getElementById('sal-content');
    body.innerHTML = html + '<div id="sal-table-wrap"></div>';
  }

  function applyFilter() {
    FILTER_YEAR = document.getElementById('sal-year').value;
    FILTER_MONTH = document.getElementById('sal-month').value;
    fetchSalaries(FILTER_MONTH, FILTER_YEAR);
  }

  function renderSalaries() {
    var rows = window.__salaries.map(function (r) {
      return {
        emp_id: r.emp_id,
        name_ar: esc(r.name_ar || '-'),
        basic_salary: r.basic_salary,
        allow: r.allow,
        section: esc(r.section || '-'),
        working_days: r.working_days,
        deduction_day: r.deduction_day,
        overtime_days: r.overtime_days,
        net_salary: r.net_salary,
        net_salary_nearest: r.net_salary_nearest,
        receipt: r.receipt ? 'نعم' : 'لا'
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'emp_id', label: 'الكود', numeric: true },
      { key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم' },
      { key: 'basic_salary', label: 'الراتب', money: true },
      { key: 'allow', label: 'البدلات', money: true },
      { key: 'section', label: 'التصنيف' },
      { key: 'working_days', label: 'أيام', numeric: true },
      { key: 'deduction_day', label: 'خصم غياب', numeric: true },
      { key: 'overtime_days', label: 'إضافي', numeric: true },
      { key: 'net_salary', label: 'الصافي', money: true },
      { key: 'net_salary_nearest', label: 'التقريب', money: true },
      { key: 'receipt', label: 'إيصال' }
    ];
    var wrap = document.getElementById('sal-table-wrap');
    if (!wrap) return;
    var totalBar = window.__total ? '<div style="text-align:left;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-muted);">إجمالي الصافي: <b>' + FMT.currency(window.__total) + '</b></div>' : '';
    wrap.innerHTML = totalBar + UIC.dataTable('sal-table', {
      title: 'مرتبات الشهر',
      headers: headers,
      rows: rows,
      emptyText: 'لا توجد مرتبات لهذا الشهر'
    });
    UIC.initTableSort('sal-table');
  }

  function openGenerate() {
    var m = document.getElementById('sal-month') ? document.getElementById('sal-month').value : FILTER_MONTH;
    var y = document.getElementById('sal-year') ? document.getElementById('sal-year').value : FILTER_YEAR;
    if (!m || !y) { UIC.toast('اختر الشهر والسنة أولاً', 'error'); return; }
    var existing = {};
    window.__existingIds.forEach(function (id) { existing[id] = true; });
    var pending = window.__empOptions.filter(function (e) { return !existing[e.value]; });
    if (!pending.length) { UIC.toast('كل الموظفين مسجلون في هذا الشهر', 'error'); return; }
    var mSel = '';
    window.__monthOptions.forEach(function (mo) {
      mSel += '<option value="' + mo.value + '"' + (String(mo.value) === String(m) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(mo.label) + '</option>';
    });
    var listRows = pending.map(function (e, i) {
      return '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:6px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle);">' +
        '<div style="flex:1;">' + esc(e.label) + ' <span class="text-muted" style="font-size:12px;">#' + e.value + '</span></div>' +
        '<input type="number" class="input" style="width:80px;" min="0" step="0.5" data-emp="' + e.value + '" value="30">' +
        '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">يوم</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    var body =
      '<form id="generate-form">' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="flex:1;"><label class="form-label" for="gen-month">الشهر <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<select id="gen-month" class="input" required><option value="">اختر الشهر...</option>' + mSel + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="flex:1;"><label class="form-label" for="gen-year">السنة <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
      '<input id="gen-year" class="input" type="number" required value="' + esc(y) + '"></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="max-height:340px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:4px 10px;">' +
      listRows + '</div>' +
      '<p class="text-muted" style="font-size:12px;margin-top:8px;">سيتم توليد ' + pending.length + ' موظفاً مع نسخ معادلات الجدول (قسّم 30 يوم عمل).</p>' +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('generate-modal', {
      title: 'توليد مرتبات شهر',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveGenerate()'
    });
  }

  function saveGenerate() {
    var month = document.getElementById('gen-month').value;
    var year = document.getElementById('gen-year').value;
    if (!month || !year) { UIC.toast('الشهر والسنة مطلوبان', 'error'); return; }
    var entries = [];
    var inputs = document.querySelectorAll('#generate-form input[data-emp]');
    inputs.forEach(function (inp) {
      var wd = inp.value.trim();
      if (wd === '') return;
      entries.push({ emp_id: Number(inp.getAttribute('data-emp')), working_days: Number(wd) });
    });
    if (!entries.length) { UIC.toast('لا توجد أيام عمل مدخلة', 'error'); return; }
    UI.showSpinner('جاري توليد المرتبات...');
    companyCall('add_emp_salaries', { month: Number(month), year: Number(year), entries: entries })
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('generate-modal');
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم التوليد', 'success');
        FILTER_MONTH = month; FILTER_YEAR = year;
        fetchSalaries(month, year);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function printPayrollReport(type) {
    var m = document.getElementById('sal-month') ? document.getElementById('sal-month').value : FILTER_MONTH;
    var y = document.getElementById('sal-year') ? document.getElementById('sal-year').value : FILTER_YEAR;
    if (!m || !y) { UIC.toast('اختر الشهر والسنة أولاً لعرض التقرير', 'error'); return; }
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?download=payroll_report&type=' + type + '&month=' + encodeURIComponent(m) +
      '&year=' + encodeURIComponent(y) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN));
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('sal-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;

  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function monthName(m) {
    var names = ['يناير', 'فبراير', 'مارس', 'أبريل', 'مايو', 'يونيو', 'يوليو', 'أغسطس', 'سبتمبر', 'أكتوبر', 'نوفمبر', 'ديسمبر'];
    return names[Number(m) - 1] || m;
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'close-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / شئون العاملين / غلق المرتبات الشهرية',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchMonths();
  }

  function fetchMonths() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_payroll_months')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__open = r.open || [];
        window.__closed = r.closed || [];
        renderMonths();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderMonths() {
    var body = document.getElementById('close-content');
    var openRows = window.__open.map(function (m) {
      return {
        month: monthName(m.month) + ' ' + m.year,
        actions: CAN_WRITE
          ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="closeMonth(' + m.year + ',' + m.month + ')">غلق الشهر</button>'
          : '-'
      };
    });
    var closedRows = window.__closed.map(function (c) {
      return {
        month: monthName(c.month) + ' ' + c.year,
        amount: c.amount,
        created_at: fmtDate(c.created_at),
        user: esc(c.user || '-')
      };
    });
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div style="margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      UIC.dataTable('open-table', {
        title: 'أشهر مفتوحة',
        headers: [
          { key: 'month', label: 'الشهر' },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: openRows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد أشهر مفتوحة'
      }) + '</div>' +
      '<div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('closed-table', {
        title: 'أشهر مغلقة',
        headers: [
          { key: 'month', label: 'الشهر' },
          { key: 'amount', label: 'الإجمالي', numeric: true },
          { key: 'created_at', label: 'تاريخ الغلق' },
          { key: 'user', label: 'بواسطة' }
        ],
        rows: closedRows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد أشهر مغلقة'
      }) + '</div>';
    UIC.initTableSort('open-table');
    UIC.initTableSort('closed-table');
  }

  function closeMonth(year, month) {
    if (!window.confirm('غلق مرتبات ' + monthName(month) + ' ' + year + '؟ سيتم احتساب الإجمالي من المرتبات المسجلة.')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الغلق...');
    companyCall('close_payroll_month', { year: year, month: month })
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الغلق', 'success');
        fetchMonths();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('close-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  load();
</script>

    });
    var keys = Object.keys(groups).sort(function (a, b) { return String(a).localeCompare(String(b), 'ar'); });
    var headers = [

    });
    names.sort(function (a, b) { return String(a).localeCompare(String(b), 'ar'); });
    var productOptions = names.map(function (n) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(n) + '">' + esc(n) + '</option>';
    }).join('');

    var html =
      '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">' +
      (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ إضافة متابعة</button>' : '') +
      '<label class="form-label" style="margin:0;">المنتج: ' +
      '<select id="import-product-filter" class="input" style="width:auto;display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;">' +
      '<option value="">جميع المنتجات</option>' + productOptions + '</select></label></div>';

    if (!keys.length) {
      html += '<div class="empty-state"><span>لا توجد متابعات</span></div>';
    } else {
      keys.forEach(function (key, gi) {
        var gRows = groups[key].map(function (f) {
          return {
            id: f.id,
            vendor: esc(f.vendor || '-'),
            approval_sent_date: fmtDate(f.approval_sent_date),
            proforma_invoice_code: esc(f.proforma_invoice_code || '-'),
            acid: esc(f.acid || '-'),
            proforma_invoice_date: fmtDate(f.proforma_invoice_date),
            invoice_value: f.invoice_value,
            product_amount: f.product_amount,
            bank: esc(f.bank || '-'),
            approval_number: f.approval_number,
            approval_date: fmtDate(f.approval_date),
            approval_expiry_date: fmtDate(f.approval_expiry_date),
            status: statusBadge(f.status),
            actions: (CAN_WRITE && String(f.status || '').trim() !== 'Received'
              ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="advanceStatus(' + f.id + ')">التالي</button> '
              : '') +
              '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openDetailById(' + f.id + ')">عرض</button>'
          };
        });
        html +=
          '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:18px 0 6px;">' +
          '<h3 style="margin:0;font-size:15px;">' + esc(key) + '</h3>' +
          '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">' + groups[key].length + ' سجل</span></div>' +
          UIC.dataTable('import-table-' + gi, { headers: headers, rows: gRows, emptyText: '' });
        UIC.initTableSort('import-table-' + gi);
      });
    }
    var body = document.getElementById('import-content');
    body.innerHTML = html;
    var pf = document.getElementById('import-product-filter');
    if (pf) {
      pf.value = filter || '';
      pf.addEventListener('change', function () {
        window.__productFilter = pf.value;
        renderFollows();
      });
    }
  }

  function openAddModal() {
    var body =
      '<form id="import-follow-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'vendor', label: 'المورد', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__vendorOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر المورد...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'product', label: 'المنتج', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__productOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر المنتج...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'approval_sent_date', label: 'تاريخ الإرسال للموافقة', type: 'date', value: todayStr(), required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'proforma_invoice_code', label: 'كود الفاتورة المبدئية', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: CRS25K01533' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'acid', label: 'رقم ACID (اختياري)', placeholder: 'رقم طويل (يُحفظ كنص للحفاظ على الدقة)' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'proforma_invoice_date', label: 'تاريخ الفاتورة المبدئية', type: 'date', value: todayStr(), required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'invoice_value', label: 'قيمة الفاتورة', type: 'number', step: '0.01', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 42400' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'product_amount', label: 'كمية المنتج', type: 'number', step: '0.01', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 8000' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'bank', label: 'البنك' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'approval_number', label: 'رقم الموافقة', type: 'number', step: '1', placeholder: 'مثال: 2590' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'approval_date', label: 'تاريخ الموافقة', type: 'date', placeholder: 'اختر التاريخ...' }) +
      FILE_FIELDS.map(function (ff) { return fileFieldCustom(ff.field, ff.label, ff.accept); }).join('') +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('import-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة متابعة موافقة استيراد',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveImportFollow()'
    });
  }

  function saveImportFollow() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('import-follow-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('import-follow-form')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_import_follow', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        var id = (r && r.data) ? r.data.assignedId : null;
        var formEl = document.getElementById('import-follow-form');
        return uploadFollowFiles(formEl, id).then(function (refs) {
          if (Object.keys(refs).length) {
            refs.id = id;
            return companyCall('add_import_follow_files', refs).then(function () { return r; });
          }
          return r;
        });
      })
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('import-modal');
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchFollows();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function uploadFollowFiles(formEl, id) {
    var tasks = [];
    FILE_FIELDS.forEach(function (ff) {
      var input = formEl.querySelector('input[data-field-name="' + ff.field + '"]');
      if (input && input.files && input.files[0]) {
        tasks.push(readAndUpload(input.files[0], ff, id));
      }
    });
    return Promise.all(tasks).then(function (results) {
      var refs = {};
      results.forEach(function (r) { if (r && r.field) refs[r.field] = r.ref; });
      return refs;
    });
  }

  function readAndUpload(file, ff, id) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('خطأ في قراءة الملف')); };
      reader.onload = function () {
        var b64 = String(reader.result || '').split(',')[1] || '';
        companyCall('add_upload_file', {
          sheet: 'legal_importation_follow',
          field: ff.field,
          id: id,
          filename: file.name,
          base64: b64
        }).then(function (res) {
          if (res && res.status === 'success') resolve({ field: ff.field, ref: res.reference });
          else reject(new Error((res && res.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
        }).catch(function (e) {
          reject(new Error((e && e.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
        });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  }

  function downloadRef(ref) {
    if (!ref) return;
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?download=doc_file&company=3fe1b5cb67b7223e&ref=' +
      encodeURIComponent(ref) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function fileLinkCell(ref) {
    return ref
      ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="downloadRef(\'' + esc(ref) + '\')">تحميل</button>'
      : '-';
  }

  function openDetail(idx) {
    var f = window.__follows[idx];
    if (!f) return;
    var rows = [
      ['#', f.id],
      ['المورد', f.vendor || '-'],
      ['المنتج', f.product_name || ('#' + f.product)],
      ['تاريخ الإرسال للموافقة', fmtDate(f.approval_sent_date)],
      ['كود الفاتورة المبدئية', f.proforma_invoice_code || '-'],
      ['رقم ACID', f.acid || '-'],
      ['تاريخ الفاتورة المبدئية', fmtDate(f.proforma_invoice_date)],
      ['قيمة الفاتورة', f.invoice_value],
      ['كمية المنتج', f.product_amount],
      ['البنك', f.bank || '-'],
      ['رقم الموافقة', f.approval_number],
      ['تاريخ الموافقة', fmtDate(f.approval_date)],
      ['تاريخ الانتهاء', fmtDate(f.approval_expiry_date)],
      ['الحالة', statusBadge(f.status)],
      ['ملف الفاتورة المبدئية', fileLinkCell(f.porforma_file)],
      ['ملف SWIFT', fileLinkCell(f.swift_file)],
      ['صورة الموافقة 1', fileLinkCell(f.approval_1)],
      ['صورة الموافقة 2', fileLinkCell(f.approval_2)],
      ['صورة الموافقة 3', fileLinkCell(f.approval_3)],
      ['أضيف بواسطة', f.user || '-'],
      ['وقت الإضافة', f.created_at ? fmtDate(f.created_at) : '-']
    ];
    var body = rows.map(function (r) {
      return '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">' + esc(r[0]) + '</label>' +
        '<div style="padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:13px;">' + r[1] + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
    UIC.openModal('import-detail-modal', {
      title: 'تفاصيل متابعة الموافقة #' + f.id,
      body: body,
      footer: false
    });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('import-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>الأصناف</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= include('Company_TopChemical_Nav'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'products-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / الحسابات / الأصناف',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchProducts();
  }

  function fetchProducts() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_products')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__unitOptions = r.unit_options || [];
        window.__categoryOptions = r.category_options || [];
        renderProducts(r.products || []);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderProducts(list) {
    window.__products = list;
    var rows = list.map(function (p) {
      var printLink = p.print_file
        ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="downloadPrint(\'' + FMT.escape(p.id) + '\')">تحميل</button>'
        : '-';
      return {
        id: p.id,
        code: p.code,
        name_ar: p.name_ar || '-',
        unit: p.unit || '-',
        category: p.category || '-',
        number_of_cartons_bags: p.number_of_cartons_bags,
        print_file: printLink,
        actions: IS_SUPER_ADMIN
          ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openProductModal(\'' + FMT.escape(p.id) + '\')">تعديل</button>'
          : ''
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'id', label: '#' },
      { key: 'code', label: 'الكود' },
      { key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم' },
      { key: 'unit', label: 'الوحدة' },
      { key: 'category', label: 'الفئة' },
      { key: 'number_of_cartons_bags', label: 'عدد الكراتين/الشنط' },
      { key: 'print_file', label: 'ملف الطباعة' },
      { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('products-content');
    body.innerHTML = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openProductModal(\'\')">+ إضافة صنف</button></div>'
      : '') +
      UIC.dataTable('products-table', {
        title: 'الأصناف',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد أصناف'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('products-table');
  }

  function downloadPrint(id) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?download=print_file&id=' + encodeURIComponent(id) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function uploadSelectedFile(formEl, meta) {
    var input = formEl.querySelector('input[type=file]');
    if (!input || !input.files || !input.files[0]) return Promise.resolve('');
    var file = input.files[0];
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('خطأ في قراءة الملف')); };
      reader.onload = function () {
        var b64 = String(reader.result || '').split(',')[1] || '';
        var payload = { sheet: meta.sheet, filename: file.name, base64: b64 };
        if (meta.id) payload.id = meta.id;
        if (meta.name) payload.name = meta.name;
        companyCall('add_upload_file', payload)
          .then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.status === 'success') resolve(res.reference);
            else reject(new Error((res && res.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
          })
          .catch(function (err) {
            reject(new Error((err && err.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
          });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  }

  function openProductModal(id) {
    var p = (window.__products || []).find(function (x) { return String(x.id) === String(id); });
    var body =
      '<form id="product-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'id', label: '#', type: 'number', value: p ? p.id : '', required: true, placeholder: 'رقم صحيح' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'code', label: 'الكود', type: 'number', value: p ? p.code : '', required: true, placeholder: 'رقم صحيح' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم', value: p ? p.name_ar : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'unit', label: 'الوحدة', value: p ? p.unit : '', options: window.__unitOptions || [], required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'category', label: 'الفئة', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__categoryOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر الفئة...', value: p ? p.category : '' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'number_of_cartons_bags', label: 'عدد الكراتين/الشنط', type: 'number', value: p ? p.number_of_cartons_bags : '', required: true }) +
      (p && p.print_file ? '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">ملف الطباعة الحالي</label><input class="input" value="' + FMT.escape(p.print_file) + '" disabled></div>' : '') +
      UIC.fileField({ key: 'file', label: 'ملف الطباعة (pdf, word, png, jpg)', accept: '.pdf,.doc,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('product-modal', {
      title: p ? 'تعديل صنف' : 'إضافة صنف',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveProduct(\'' + (p ? p.id : '') + '\')'
    });
    if (p) {
      var idField = document.getElementById('id');
      if (idField) idField.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
    }
  }

  function saveProduct(id) {
    if (!id && !CAN_WRITE) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    if (id && !IS_SUPER_ADMIN) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    var data = UIC.collectForm('product-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('product-form')) return;
    if (data.unit === '__new__') { data.unit = data.unit_custom || ''; }
    delete data.unit_custom;
    if (id) data.id = id;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    var formEl = document.getElementById('product-form');
    uploadSelectedFile(formEl, { sheet: 'products', id: id || data.id })
      .then(function (ref) {
        if (ref) data.print_file = ref;
        return companyCall(id ? 'edit_product' : 'add_product', data);
      })
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('product-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchProducts();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('products-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function todayStr() {
    var d = new Date();
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function setSelectOptions(selectId, options, selectedValue) {
    var sel = document.getElementById(selectId);
    if (!sel) return;
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر...</option>' + (options || []).map(function (o) {
      var v = typeof o === 'object' ? o.value : o;
      var l = typeof o === 'object' ? o.label : o;
      var s = String(v) === String(selectedValue) ? ' selected' : '';
      return '<option value="' + esc(v) + '"' + s + '>' + esc(l) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'purchasing-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / الاستيراد والمشتريات / توريدات ومشتريات',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchPurchases();
  }

  function fetchPurchases() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_purchase_items')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__purchases = r.purchases || [];
        window.__vendorOptions = r.vendor_options || [];
        window.__itemOptions = r.item_options || [];
        renderPurchases();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderPurchases() {
    var list = window.__purchases;
    var rows = list.map(function (p) {
      return {
        id: p.id,
        vendor_name: esc(p.vendor_name || '-'),
        invoice_no: esc(p.invoice_no || '-'),
        invoice_date: fmtDate(p.invoice_date),
        item_name: esc(p.item_name || '-'),
        item_brand: esc(p.item_brand || '-'),
        qty: p.qty,
        price: p.price,
        receipt_date: fmtDate(p.receipt_date),
        actions: '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openDetail(' + window.__purchases.indexOf(p) + ')">عرض</button>'
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'id', label: '#', numeric: true },
      { key: 'vendor_name', label: 'المورد' },
      { key: 'invoice_no', label: 'رقم الفاتورة' },
      { key: 'invoice_date', label: 'تاريخ الفاتورة', numeric: true },
      { key: 'item_name', label: 'الصنف' },
      { key: 'item_brand', label: 'البراند' },
      { key: 'qty', label: 'الكمية', numeric: true },
      { key: 'price', label: 'سعر الوحدة', numeric: true },
      { key: 'receipt_date', label: 'تاريخ الاستلام', numeric: true },
      { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('purchasing-content');
    body.innerHTML = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ إضافة توريد</button></div>'
      : '') +
      UIC.dataTable('purchasing-table', {
        title: 'توريدات ومشتريات',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد توريدات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('purchasing-table');
  }

  function openAddModal() {
    var body =
      '<form id="purchase-form">' +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="vendor">' +
        '<label class="form-label" for="vendor">المورد <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">' +
          '<select id="vendor" class="input" required style="flex:1;"><option value="">اختر المورد...</option></select>' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" onclick="openVendorPopup()">+ إضافة مورد</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="field-error" id="err-vendor"></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" data-field="item">' +
        '<label class="form-label" for="item">الصنف <span class="req">*</span></label>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">' +
          '<select id="item" class="input" required style="flex:1;"><option value="">اختر الصنف...</option></select>' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" onclick="openItemPopup()">+ إضافة صنف</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="field-error" id="err-item"></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'invoice_no', label: 'رقم الفاتورة', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: INV-1002' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'invoice_date', label: 'تاريخ الفاتورة', type: 'date', value: todayStr(), required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'item_brand', label: 'البراند', required: true, placeholder: 'اسم البراند' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'qty', label: 'الكمية', type: 'number', step: '0.01', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 50' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'price', label: 'سعر الوحدة', type: 'number', step: '0.01', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 125.50' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'receipt_date', label: 'تاريخ الاستلام', type: 'date', value: todayStr(), required: true }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('purchase-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة توريد',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'savePurchase()'
    });
    setSelectOptions('vendor', window.__vendorOptions || []);
    setSelectOptions('item', window.__itemOptions || []);
  }

  function savePurchase() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('purchase-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('purchase-form')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_purchase_item', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('purchase-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchPurchases();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function openVendorPopup() {
    var body =
      '<form id="vendor-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'vendor_name_ar', label: 'اسم المورد (بالعربية)', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'vendor_name_en', label: 'اسم المورد (بالإنجليزية)' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'vendor_address', label: 'العنوان' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'vendor_vat', label: 'الرقم الضريبي' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'vendor_1_percent_status', label: 'حالة خصم 1%' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'contact_person', label: 'الشخص المسؤول' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'contact_number', label: 'رقم الهاتف' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'contact_email', label: 'البريد الإلكتروني' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'vat_1_percent_certificate', label: 'شهادة خصم 1%' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('vendor-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة مورد جديد',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveVendorPopup()'
    });
  }

  function saveVendorPopup() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('vendor-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('vendor-form')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_vendor', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('vendor-modal');
        window.__vendorOptions = (window.__vendorOptions || []).concat([r.vendor]);
        setSelectOptions('vendor', window.__vendorOptions, r.vendor.value);
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تمت إضافة المورد', 'success');
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function openItemPopup() {
    var body =
      '<form id="item-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'item_name_ar', label: 'اسم الصنف (بالعربية)', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'item_name_en', label: 'اسم الصنف (بالإنجليزية)' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'item_technical_details', label: 'المواصفات الفنية' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'category_id', label: 'رقم الفئة' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'unit_type', label: 'الوحدة' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('item-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة صنف جديد',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveItemPopup()'
    });
  }

  function saveItemPopup() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('item-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('item-form')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_item', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('item-modal');
        window.__itemOptions = (window.__itemOptions || []).concat([r.item]);
        setSelectOptions('item', window.__itemOptions, r.item.value);
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تمت إضافة الصنف', 'success');
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function openDetail(idx) {
    var p = window.__purchases[idx];
    if (!p) return;
    var rows = [
      ['#', p.id],
      ['المورد', p.vendor_name || p.vendor || '-'],
      ['رقم الفاتورة', p.invoice_no || '-'],
      ['تاريخ الفاتورة', fmtDate(p.invoice_date)],
      ['الصنف', p.item_name || p.item || '-'],
      ['البراند', p.item_brand || '-'],
      ['الكمية', p.qty],
      ['سعر الوحدة', p.price],
      ['تاريخ الاستلام', fmtDate(p.receipt_date)],
      ['أضيف بواسطة', p.user || '-'],
      ['وقت الإضافة', p.created_at ? fmtDate(p.created_at) : '-']
    ];
    var body = rows.map(function (r) {
      return '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">' + esc(r[0]) + '</label>' +
        '<div style="padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:13px;">' + esc(r[1]) + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
    UIC.openModal('purchase-detail-modal', {
      title: 'تفاصيل التوريد',
      body: body,
      footer: false
    });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('purchasing-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>تصاريح وتراخيص</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= include('Company_TopChemical_Nav'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function pad(n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); }
  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
  }
  function todayStr() {
    var d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
  }

  function uploadSelectedFile(formEl, meta) {
    var input = formEl.querySelector('input[type=file]');
    if (!input || !input.files || !input.files[0]) return Promise.resolve('');
    var file = input.files[0];
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('خطأ في قراءة الملف')); };
      reader.onload = function () {
        var b64 = String(reader.result || '').split(',')[1] || '';
        var payload = { sheet: meta.sheet, filename: file.name, base64: b64 };
        if (meta.id) payload.id = meta.id;
        if (meta.name) payload.name = meta.name;
        companyCall('add_upload_file', payload)
          .then(function (res) {
            if (res && res.status === 'success') resolve(res.reference);
            else reject(new Error((res && res.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
          })
          .catch(function (err) {
            reject(new Error((err && err.message) || 'خطأ في رفع الملف'));
          });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'papers-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / الترخيص / تصاريح وتراخيص',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchPapers();
  }

  function fetchPapers() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_registration_papers')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__docTypes = r.document_types || [];
        window.__productOptions = r.product_options || [];
        renderPapers(r.papers || []);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderPapers(list) {
    window.__papers = list;
    var rows = list.map(function (p) {
      var fileCell = p.document_file
        ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="downloadDoc(\'' + FMT.escape(p.document_file) + '\')">تحميل</button>'
        : '-';
      return {
        document_name_ar: p.document_name_ar || '-',
        document_name_en: p.document_name_en || '-',
        product: p.product_name || (p.product_id ? '#' + p.product_id : '-'),
        document_number: p.document_number,
        document_type: p.document_type || '-',
        document_start_date: fmtDate(p.document_start_date),
        document_end_date: fmtDate(p.document_end_date),
        document_file: fileCell
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'document_name_ar', label: 'اسم المستند (عربي)' },
      { key: 'document_name_en', label: 'اسم المستند (إنجليزي)' },
      { key: 'product', label: 'المنتج' },
      { key: 'document_number', label: 'رقم المستند' },
      { key: 'document_type', label: 'النوع' },
      { key: 'document_start_date', label: 'تاريخ البداية' },
      { key: 'document_end_date', label: 'تاريخ النهاية' },
      { key: 'document_file', label: 'الملف' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('papers-content');
    body.innerHTML = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openPaperModal()">+ إضافة مستند</button></div>'
      : '') +
      UIC.dataTable('papers-table', {
        title: 'تصاريح وتراخيص',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد مستندات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('papers-table');
  }

  function downloadDoc(ref) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?download=doc_file&company=3fe1b5cb67b7223e&ref=' +
      encodeURIComponent(ref) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function openPaperModal() {
    var body =
      '<form id="paper-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'document_name_ar', label: 'اسم المستند بالعربية', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'document_name_en', label: 'اسم المستند بالإنجليزية' }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'product', label: 'المنتج (اختياري)', options: window.__productOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر المنتج...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'document_number', label: 'رقم المستند', type: 'number', required: true, placeholder: 'رقم صحيح' }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'document_type', label: 'نوع المستند', options: window.__docTypes || [], required: true, placeholder: 'اختر النوع...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'document_start_date', label: 'تاريخ البداية', type: 'date', value: todayStr(), required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'document_end_date', label: 'تاريخ النهاية', type: 'date', value: todayStr(), required: true }) +
      UIC.fileField({ key: 'file', label: 'ملف المستند (pdf, word, png, jpg)', accept: '.pdf,.doc,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('paper-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة مستند / تصريح',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'savePaper()'
    });
  }

  function savePaper() {
    if (!CAN_WRITE) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    var data = UIC.collectForm('paper-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('paper-form')) return;
    if (data.document_type === '__new__') { data.document_type = data.document_type_custom || ''; }
    delete data.document_type_custom;
    if (data.product === '__new__') { UIC.toast('اختر منتجاً موجوداً', 'error'); return; }
    delete data.product_custom;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    var formEl = document.getElementById('paper-form');
    uploadSelectedFile(formEl, { sheet: 'registration_papers', name: data.document_name_ar })
      .then(function (ref) {
        if (ref) data.document_file = ref;
        return companyCall('add_registration_paper', data);
      })
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('paper-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchPapers();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('papers-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>جرد المخزون</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= include('Company_TopChemical_Nav'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tc-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);
  var WAREHOUSES = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', 'شبرا'];

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  function todayStr() {
    var d = new Date();
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (v == null || v === '') return '';
    var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    var p = function (n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'stock-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / الحسابات / جرد المخزون',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchStock();
  }

  function fetchStock() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_stock_revision')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__stock = r.stock || [];
        window.__productOptions = r.product_options || [];
        renderStock();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderStock() {
    var list = window.__stock;
    var rows = list.map(function (s) {
      return {
        product: esc(s.product_name || ('#' + s.product)),
        name_ar: esc(s.name_ar || '-'),
        category: esc(s.category || '-'),
        unit: esc(s.unit || '-'),
        date: fmtDate(s.date),
        amount: s.amount,
        warehouse: esc(s.warehouse || '-'),
        available_amount: s.available_amount,
        difference: esc(s.difference || '-'),
        percentage: esc(s.percentage || '-'),
        actions: '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openDetail(' + window.__stock.indexOf(s) + ')">عرض</button>'
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'product', label: 'المنتج' },
      { key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم' },
      { key: 'category', label: 'الفئة' },
      { key: 'unit', label: 'الوحدة' },
      { key: 'date', label: 'التاريخ', numeric: true },
      { key: 'amount', label: 'الكمية', numeric: true },
      { key: 'warehouse', label: 'المخزن', numeric: true },
      { key: 'available_amount', label: 'رصيد السيستم', numeric: true },
      { key: 'difference', label: 'الفرق' },
      { key: 'percentage', label: 'النسبة' },
      { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('stock-content');
    body.innerHTML = (CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ إضافة جرد</button></div>'
      : '') +
      UIC.dataTable('stock-table', {
        title: 'جرد المخزون',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد جرد'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('stock-table');
  }

  function openAddModal() {
    var body =
      '<form id="stock-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'product', label: 'المنتج', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: window.__productOptions || [], placeholder: 'اختر المنتج...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'date', label: 'التاريخ', type: 'date', value: todayStr(), required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'amount', label: 'الكمية', type: 'number', step: '0.01', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 150.50' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'warehouse', label: 'المخزن', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: WAREHOUSES, placeholder: 'اختر المخزن...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'available_amount', label: 'رصيد السيستم', type: 'number', step: '0.01', required: true, placeholder: 'مثال: 160.00' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'notes', label: 'ملاحظات', type: 'textarea' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('stock-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة جرد مخزون',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveStock()'
    });
  }

  function saveStock() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('stock-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('stock-form')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_stock_revision', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('stock-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchStock();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function openDetail(idx) {
    var s = window.__stock[idx];
    if (!s) return;
    var rows = [
      ['المنتج', s.product_name || ('#' + s.product)],
      ['الاسم', s.name_ar || '-'],
      ['الفئة', s.category || '-'],
      ['الوحدة', s.unit || '-'],
      ['التاريخ', fmtDate(s.date)],
      ['الكمية', s.amount],
      ['المخزن', s.warehouse || '-'],
      ['ملاحظات', s.notes || '-'],
      ['رصيد السيستم', s.available_amount],
      ['الفرق', s.difference || '-'],
      ['النسبة', s.percentage || '-'],
      ['أضيف بواسطة', s.user || '-'],
      ['وقت الإضافة', s.created_at ? fmtDate(s.created_at) : '-']
    ];
    var body = rows.map(function (r) {
      return '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">' + esc(r[0]) + '</label>' +
        '<div style="padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:13px;">' + esc(r[1]) + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
    UIC.openModal('stock-detail-modal', {
      title: 'تفاصيل الجرد',
      body: body,
      footer: false
    });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('stock-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>عهد خاصة</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= include('Company_TopChemical_Nav'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>
  <style>
    .trust-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .trust-card { background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s ease; }
    .trust-card:hover, .trust-card.active { border-color: var(--brand-primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-brand); }
    .trust-card .t-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .trust-totals { display: flex; gap: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .trust-totals b { color: var(--text-main); }
  </style>

<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('3fe1b5cb67b7223e') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
  var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

  var SELECTED_ACCOUNT = '';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '3fe1b5cb67b7223e',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function pad(n) { return ('0' + n).slice(-2); }
  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
  }
  function todayStr() {
    var d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
  }
  function fmtNum(v) {
    var n = Number(v) || 0;
    return n.toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'trust-content';
    UIC.appShell('tc-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tc_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'توب كيميكال',
      breadcrumb: 'توب كيميكال / الحسابات / عهد خاصة',
      contentId: contentId,
      menuGroups: (window.TOPCHEMICAL_MENU || [])
    });
    fetchAccounts();
  }

  function fetchAccounts() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_trust_accounts')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__accountOptions = r.account_options || [];
        renderAccounts(r.accounts || []);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderAccounts(accounts) {
    window.__accounts = accounts;
    var body = document.getElementById('trust-content');
    var addBtn = CAN_WRITE
      ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openMovementModal(\'\')">+ إضافة حركة</button></div>'
      : '';
    if (!accounts.length) {
      body.innerHTML = addBtn + '<div class="empty-state"><span>لا توجد عهد بعد</span></div>';
      return;
    }
    var cards = accounts.map(function (a) {
      var active = a.account === SELECTED_ACCOUNT ? ' active' : '';
      var netColor = a.net >= 0 ? 'var(--success-text)' : 'var(--danger-text)';
      return '<div class="trust-card' + active + '" onclick="selectAccount(\'' + FMT.escape(a.account) + '\')">' +
        '<div class="t-name">' + FMT.escape(a.account) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="trust-totals">' +
        '<span>عهدة: <b>' + fmtNum(a.in_total) + '</b></span>' +
        '<span>مصروف: <b>' + fmtNum(a.out_total) + '</b></span>' +
        '<span>الرصيد: <b style="color:' + netColor + ';">' + fmtNum(a.net) + '</b></span>' +
        '<span>حركات: <b>' + a.count + '</b></span>' +
        '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
    body.innerHTML = addBtn +
      '<div class="trust-grid">' + cards + '</div>' +
      '<div id="movement-panel"></div>';
    if (SELECTED_ACCOUNT) selectAccount(SELECTED_ACCOUNT);
  }

  function selectAccount(account) {
    SELECTED_ACCOUNT = account;
    var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.trust-card');
    cards.forEach(function (c) {
      c.classList.toggle('active', c.textContent.indexOf(account) !== -1);
    });
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_trust_movements', { account: account })
      .then(function (r) {
        renderMovements(r.movements || [], r.account);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderMovements(movements, account) {
    var panel = document.getElementById('movement-panel');
    if (!panel) return;
    var addBtn = CAN_WRITE
      ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:6px 14px;" onclick="openMovementModal(\'' + FMT.escape(account) + '\')">+ إضافة حركة لهذا الحساب</button>'
      : '';
    var rows = movements.map(function (m) {
      return {
        id: m.id,
        date: fmtDate(m.date),
        movement_type: m.movement_type === 'عهدة'
          ? '<span class="pill pill-success">عهدة</span>'
          : '<span class="pill pill-danger">مصروف</span>',
        reason: m.reason || '-',
        value: fmtNum(m.value),
        details: m.details || '-',
        user: m.user || '-'
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'id', label: '#' },
      { key: 'date', label: 'التاريخ' },
      { key: 'movement_type', label: 'النوع' },
      { key: 'reason', label: 'السبب' },
      { key: 'value', label: 'القيمة' },
      { key: 'details', label: 'التفاصيل' },
      { key: 'user', label: 'المستخدم' }
    ];
    panel.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<h3 style="margin:0;">حساب: ' + FMT.escape(account) + '</h3>' + addBtn +
      '</div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('movements-table', {
        title: 'حركات الحساب',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد حركات لهذا الحساب'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('movements-table');
  }

  function openMovementModal(account) {
    var body =
      '<form id="movement-form">' +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'account', label: 'الحساب', value: account, options: window.__accountOptions || [], required: true, placeholder: 'اختر الحساب...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'movement_type', label: 'نوع الحركة', type: 'select', required: true, options: ['عهدة', 'مصروف'] }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'reason', label: 'السبب', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'value', label: 'القيمة', type: 'number', step: 'any', min: 0, required: true, placeholder: '0.00' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'details', label: 'التفاصيل', type: 'textarea' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'date', label: 'التاريخ', type: 'date', value: todayStr() }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('movement-modal', {
      title: 'إضافة حركة عهدة',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveMovement()'
    });
  }

  function saveMovement() {
    if (!CAN_WRITE) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    var data = UIC.collectForm('movement-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('movement-form')) return;
    if (data.account === '__new__') { data.account = data.account_custom || ''; }
    delete data.account_custom;
    if (!data.account) { UIC.toast('الحساب مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_trust_movement', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('movement-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        refreshWithAccount(data.account);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function refreshWithAccount(account) {
    SELECTED_ACCOUNT = account;
    fetchAccounts();
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('trust-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>





// ============================================================
// ==== Company_TopLight_Actions.js ====
// ============================================================

/**
 * Company_TopLight_Actions.js
 * RESPONSIBILITY: Top Light business logic, IIFE-namespaced to TopLight.
 * Dashboard + Products + Customers/Vendors (create / list / edit).
 * All writes go through getNextId_ + addRecord_ from 02_DataAccess.js.
 * No functions leak into global scope (the only global is TopLight).
 */

const TopLight = (function () {
  const actions = {};
  function register(name, fn) { actions[name] = fn; }

  const PRODUCTS_SHEET = 'top_light_products';
  const CUSTOMERS_SHEET = 'top_light_customer_vendor';
  const CATEGORIES_SHEET = 'top_light_categories';
  const CHART_SHEET = 'top_light_chart_of_accounts';
  const CURRENT_PRODUCTS_SHEET = 'top_light_current_products';
  const PURCHASING_SHEET = 'top_light_purchasing_costing';
  const PURCHASING_LINES_SHEET = 'top_light_product_purchasing';
  const SALES_SHEET = 'top_light_sales_invoices';
  const SALES_LINES_SHEET = 'top_light_sales_products';
  const SALES_RETURNS_SHEET = 'top_light_sales_returns';
  const OFFER_SHEET = 'top_light_sales_offer';
  const OFFER_LINES_SHEET = 'top_light_sales_offer_products';
  const CASH_SHEET = 'top_light_cash_bank_movement';
  const BOX_SHEET = 'top_light_box_account_codes';
  const CURRENCY_SHEET = 'ERP_currency_exchange';

  function dispatch_(payload, user, dbId) {
    const action = payload.module_action;
    if (!actions[action]) throw new Error('Unknown Top Light action: ' + action);
    return actions[action](payload.data, user, dbId);
  }

  // =========================================
  // Page-level access control + audit mapping.
  // page values MUST match the `action` strings in registerTopLight_'s pages
  // array (Company_TopLight_Registry.js) verbatim — they are what
  // ERP_Pages_Matrix.page_id references and what checkPageAccess_ enforces.
  // get_dashboard_data is intentionally absent: it is shadowed by the global
  // ROUTES['get_dashboard_data'] and never reaches this dispatcher.
  // get_xlsx_export is intentionally unmapped: generic client-data exporter
  // usable from any page (coarse get_/add_ rules still apply).
  // =========================================
  const PAGE_ACCESS = {
    'get_products':            { page: 'tl_products', access: 'read' },
    'add_product':             { page: 'tl_products', access: 'write' },
    'edit_product':            { page: 'tl_products', access: 'write' },

    'get_parties':             { page: 'tl_customers', access: 'read' },
    'add_party':               { page: 'tl_customers', access: 'write' },
    'edit_party':              { page: 'tl_customers', access: 'write' },

    'get_purchasing_headers':  { page: 'tl_purchasing', access: 'read' },
    'get_purchasing_lines':    { page: 'tl_purchasing', access: 'read' },
    'add_purchasing':          { page: 'tl_purchasing', access: 'write' },
    'edit_purchasing':         { page: 'tl_purchasing', access: 'write' },
    'delete_purchasing':       { page: 'tl_purchasing', access: 'write' },
    'approve_purchasing':      { page: 'tl_purchasing', access: 'write' },
    'get_purchase_print':      { page: 'tl_purchase_print', access: 'read' },

    'get_sales_headers':       { page: 'tl_sales', access: 'read' },
    'get_sales_lines':         { page: 'tl_sales', access: 'read' },
    'add_sales':               { page: 'tl_sales', access: 'write' },
    'edit_sales':              { page: 'tl_sales', access: 'write' },
    'delete_sales':            { page: 'tl_sales', access: 'write' },
    'approve_sales':           { page: 'tl_sales', access: 'write' },
    'get_sales_print':         { page: 'tl_sales_print', access: 'read' },

    'get_sales_returns':       { page: 'tl_sales_returns', access: 'read' },
    'add_sales_return':        { page: 'tl_sales_returns', access: 'write' },
    'delete_sales_return':     { page: 'tl_sales_returns', access: 'write' },

    'get_sales_offer_headers': { page: 'tl_sales_offer', access: 'read' },
    'get_sales_offer_lines':   { page: 'tl_sales_offer', access: 'read' },

  /** Page for a module_action, for both page-access enforcement and SystemLog. */
  function pageForAction_(action) {
    const req = PAGE_ACCESS[action];
    return req ? req.page : '';
  }

  /** Sheet/table touched by a module_action, for the SystemLog Table column. */
