    header.customer_name = custNames[String(rec['اسم العميل'])] || '';
    const prodNames = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, PRODUCTS_SHEET).forEach(p => { prodNames[String(p.id)] = p.name_ar; });
    const lines = getAllRecords_(dbId, OFFER_LINES_SHEET)
      .filter(r => String(r['top_lightsales_offer_id']) === uid)
      .map(r => ({
        product_id: r.product_id,
        product_name: prodNames[String(r.product_id)] || '',
        product_tax: r.product_tax,
        product_qty: r.product_qty,
        product_price: r.product_price,
        product_discount: r.product_discount,
        product_net_value: r.product_net_value,
        product_tax_value: r.product_tax_value,
        product_total_value: r.product_total_value
      }));
    return { status: 'success', header: header, lines: lines };
  }

  function addSalesOffer_(data, user, dbId) {
    const header = data && data.header ? data.header : {};
    const lines = (data && data.lines) ? data.lines : [];
    validateSales_(header, lines, dbId);
    const uid = uid16_();
    header.customer_tax_id = lookupCustomerField_(dbId, header.customer_id, 'tax_id');
    header.customer_telephone = lookupCustomerField_(dbId, header.customer_id, 'telephone');
    header.customer_address = lookupCustomerField_(dbId, header.customer_id, 'address');
    header.invoice_number = nextOfferNumber_(dbId);
    computeSalesTotals_(header, lines);
    writeOfferHeaderRow_(dbId, uid, header, user);
    writeOfferLines_(dbId, uid, lines, user);
    return { status: 'success', message: 'تمت إضافة العرض', unique_id: uid };
  }

  function editSalesOffer_(data, user, dbId) {
    const header = data && data.header ? data.header : {};
    const lines = (data && data.lines) ? data.lines : [];
    const uid = String((header.unique_id == null) ? '' : header.unique_id).trim();
    if (!uid) throw new Error('معرف العرض مطلوب');
    validateSales_(header, lines, dbId);

    const sheet = getSheet_(OFFER_SHEET, dbId);
    const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
    const uIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'invoice_unique_id');
    const invIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim() === 'رقم الفاتورة');
    const dataArr = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    let rowNum = -1;
    for (let i = 1; i < dataArr.length; i++) {
      if (String(dataArr[i][uIdx]).trim() === uid) { rowNum = i + 1; break; }
    }
    if (rowNum === -1) throw new Error('العرض غير موجود');

    header.customer_tax_id = lookupCustomerField_(dbId, header.customer_id, 'tax_id');
    header.customer_telephone = lookupCustomerField_(dbId, header.customer_id, 'telephone');
    header.customer_address = lookupCustomerField_(dbId, header.customer_id, 'address');
    header.invoice_number = (invIdx !== -1 && dataArr[rowNum - 1][invIdx] != null && String(dataArr[rowNum - 1][invIdx]).trim() !== '')
      ? dataArr[rowNum - 1][invIdx] : nextOfferNumber_(dbId);
    computeSalesTotals_(header, lines);

    deleteOfferLines_(dbId, uid);
    const rowValues = buildOfferHeaderValues_(headers, uid, header, user);
    sheet.getRange(rowNum, 1, 1, rowValues.length).setValues([rowValues]);
    setSalesHeaderFormulas_(sheet, headers, rowNum);
    writeOfferLines_(dbId, uid, lines, user);

    return { status: 'success', message: 'تم تحديث العرض', unique_id: uid };
  }

  function deleteSalesOffer_(data, user, dbId) {
    const uid = String((data && data.unique_id) || '').trim();
    if (!uid) throw new Error('معرف العرض مطلوب');
    deleteOfferLines_(dbId, uid);
    const sheet = getSheet_(OFFER_SHEET, dbId);
    const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
    const uIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'invoice_unique_id');
    const dataArr = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    for (let i = dataArr.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
      if (String(dataArr[i][uIdx]).trim() === uid) { sheet.deleteRow(i + 1); break; }
    }
    return { status: 'success', message: 'تم حذف العرض' };
  }

  function approveSalesOffer_(data, user, dbId) {
    const uid = String((data && data.unique_id) || '').trim();
    if (!uid) throw new Error('معرف العرض مطلوب');
    const sheet = getSheet_(OFFER_SHEET, dbId);
    const updated = updateRowByCriteria_(sheet, 'invoice_unique_id', uid, {
      approval_status: 'Approved',
      approval: user ? user.email : '',
      approval_time: new Date()
    });
    if (!updated) throw new Error('العرض غير موجود');
    return { status: 'success', message: 'تمت الموافقة على العرض' };
  }

  function nextOfferNumber_(dbId) {
    let maxPrefix = 0;
    getAllRecords_(dbId, OFFER_SHEET).forEach(r => {
      const s = String((r['رقم الفاتورة'] == null) ? '' : r['رقم الفاتورة']).trim();
      const m = s.match(/^(\d+)-/);
      if (m) { const n = Number(m[1]); if (!isNaN(n) && n > maxPrefix) maxPrefix = n; }
    });
    return (maxPrefix + 1) + '-' + new Date().getFullYear();
  }

  function buildOfferHeaderValues_(headers, uid, header, user) {
    const rowValues = headers.map(() => '');
    const put = (key, val) => { const i = salesColIndex_(headers, key); if (i !== -1) rowValues[i] = val; };
    put('invoice_unique_id', uid);
    put('رقم الفاتورة', header.invoice_number);
    put('اسم العميل', numOrKeep_(header.customer_id));
    put('رقم التسجيل الضريبي للعميل', header.customer_tax_id || '');
    put('العنوان', header.customer_address || '');
    put('رقم الموبيل', header.customer_telephone || '');
    put('تاريخ الفاتورة', parseDate_(header.invoice_date));
    put('المبلغ الصافي', num0_(header.net_amount));
    put('نسبة الخصم', num0_(header.discount_percent));
    put('قيمة الخصم', num0_(header.discount_amount));
    put('قيمة الضريبة', num0_(header.tax_amount));
    put('إجمالي', num0_(header.total_amount));
    put('tax_system', header.tax_system === true || header.tax_system === 'true');
    put('user', user ? user.email : '');
    put('created_at', new Date());
    put('approval_status', (header.approval_status != null && header.approval_status !== '') ? header.approval_status : 'Pending');
    return rowValues;
  }

  function writeOfferHeaderRow_(dbId, uid, header, user) {
    const sheet = getSheet_(OFFER_SHEET, dbId);
    const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
    const rowValues = buildOfferHeaderValues_(headers, uid, header, user);
    sheet.appendRow(rowValues);
    const newRow = sheet.getLastRow();
    setSalesHeaderFormulas_(sheet, headers, newRow);
    return newRow;
  }

  function writeOfferLines_(dbId, headerUid, lines, user) {
    const sheet = getSheet_(OFFER_LINES_SHEET, dbId);
    const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
    const idx = {};
    headers.forEach((h, i) => { idx[String(h).trim().toLowerCase()] = i; });
    const L = (name) => colLetter_(idx[name]);

    const baseId = getNextIdBatch_(dbId, OFFER_LINES_SHEET, lines.length, 'id');

    (lines || []).forEach((line, i) => {
      const rowValues = headers.map(() => '');
      const set = (name, val) => { if (idx[name] !== undefined) rowValues[idx[name]] = val; };
      set('unique_id', uid16_());
      set('id', baseId + i);
      set('top_lightsales_offer_id', headerUid);
      set('product_id', numOrKeep_(line.product_id));
      set('product_tax', num0_(line.product_tax));
      set('product_qty', num0_(line.product_qty));
      set('product_price', num0_(line.product_price));
      set('product_discount', num0_(line.product_discount));
      set('user', user ? user.email : '');
      set('created_at', new Date());
      sheet.appendRow(rowValues);

      const r = sheet.getLastRow();
      if (idx['product_net_value'] !== undefined) {
        sheet.getRange(r, idx['product_net_value'] + 1).setFormula('=' + L('product_qty') + r + '*' + L('product_price') + r);
      }
      if (idx['product_tax_value'] !== undefined) {
        sheet.getRange(r, idx['product_tax_value'] + 1).setFormula('=' + L('product_net_value') + r + '*' + L('product_tax') + r);
      }
      if (idx['product_total_value'] !== undefined) {
        sheet.getRange(r, idx['product_total_value'] + 1).setFormula('=' + L('product_net_value') + r + '-' + L('product_discount') + r + '+' + L('product_tax_value') + r);
      }
    });
  }

  function deleteOfferLines_(dbId, headerUid) {
    const sheet = getSheet_(OFFER_LINES_SHEET, dbId);
    const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
    const idx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'top_lightsales_offer_id');
    if (idx === -1) return;
    const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    for (let i = data.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
      if (String(data[i][idx]).trim() === headerUid) sheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
    }
  }

  // =========================================
  // Sales analysis report
  // =========================================
  function getSalesAnalysis_(data, user, dbId) {
    const dateFrom = parseDate_(data && data.date_from);
    const dateTo = parseDate_(data && data.date_to);
    const customerId = String((data && data.customer_id) || '').trim();
    const productId = String((data && data.product_id) || '').trim();

    const custNames = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, CUSTOMERS_SHEET).forEach(c => { custNames[String(c.id)] = c.name; });
    const retNet = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, SALES_RETURNS_SHEET).forEach(r => {
      const inv = String(r.top_lightsales_invoices_id);
      retNet[inv] = (retNet[inv] || 0) + (num0_(r.top_lightreturn_value) - num0_(r.top_lightreturn_discount));
    });

    // invoices containing a product (for product filter)
    let invByProduct = null;
    if (productId) {
      invByProduct = {};
      getAllRecords_(dbId, SALES_LINES_SHEET).forEach(l => {
        if (String(l.product_id) === productId) invByProduct[String(l.top_lightsales_header_id)] = true;
      });
    }

    const rows = getAllRecords_(dbId, SALES_SHEET)
      .filter(inv => {
        if (customerId && String(inv['اسم العميل']) !== customerId) return false;
        if (productId && !invByProduct[String(inv.invoice_unique_id)]) return false;
        if (dateFrom) {
          const d = parseDate_(inv['تاريخ الفاتورة']);
          const t = d instanceof Date ? d.getTime() : 0;
          if (t && dateFrom instanceof Date && t < dateFrom.getTime()) return false;
        }
        if (dateTo) {
          const d = parseDate_(inv['تاريخ الفاتورة']);
          const t = d instanceof Date ? d.getTime() : 0;
          if (t && dateTo instanceof Date && t > dateTo.getTime()) return false;
        }
        return true;
      })
      .map(inv => {
        const netReturn = retNet[String(inv.invoice_unique_id)] || 0;
        const netAmount = num0_(inv['المبلغ الصافي']);
        const discount = num0_(inv['قيمة الخصم']);
        const tax = num0_(inv['قيمة الضريبة']);
        return {
          code: inv['رقم الفاتورة'] || '',
          invoice_unique_id: inv.invoice_unique_id,
          date: parseDate_(inv['تاريخ الفاتورة']),
          customer_name: custNames[String(inv['اسم العميل'])] || '',
          net_return: netReturn,
          net_amount: netAmount,
          discount: discount,
          tax: tax,
          net_collection: netAmount - discount + tax - netReturn
        };
      });
    rows.sort(function (a, b) {
      const na = parseInt(String(a.code).split('-')[0], 10) || 0;
      const nb = parseInt(String(b.code).split('-')[0], 10) || 0;
      return na - nb;
    });
    const totals = rows.reduce(function (t, r) {
      t.net_return += r.net_return;
      t.net_amount += r.net_amount;
      t.discount += r.discount;
      t.tax += r.tax;
      t.net_collection += r.net_collection;
      return t;
    }, { net_return: 0, net_amount: 0, discount: 0, tax: 0, net_collection: 0 });
    return {
      status: 'success',
      rows: rows,
      totals: totals,
      customer_options: customerSalesOptions_(dbId),
      product_options: getAllRecords_(dbId, PRODUCTS_SHEET).map(p => ({ value: p.id, label: p.name_ar }))
    };
  }

  // =========================================
  // Cash movement report
  // =========================================
  function companyArabicName_() {
    try {
      const sheet = getSheet_('ERP_Companies', CONFIG.AUTH_SPREADSHEET_ID);
      const headers = getHeaders_(sheet);
      const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
      const uidIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'company_unique_id');
      const arIdx = headers.findIndex(h => String(h).trim().toLowerCase() === 'company_name_ar');
      const row = data.slice(1).find(r => uidIdx !== -1 && String(r[uidIdx]).trim() === '8df5c89a117fe9a5');
      return (row && arIdx !== -1) ? String(row[arIdx]).trim() : 'شركة القمة لايت';
    } catch (e) { return 'شركة القمة لايت'; }
  }

  function getCashReport_(data, user, dbId) {
    const dateFrom = parseDate_(data && data.date_from);
    const dateTo = parseDate_(data && data.date_to);
    const boxId = String((data && data.box) || '').trim();
    const typeId = String((data && data.type) || '').trim();

    const boxMap = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, BOX_SHEET).forEach(b => {
      boxMap[String(b['المستوى الخامس'])] = [b['اسم المستوى الرابع'], b['المستوى الخامس'], b['اسم المستوى الخامس']].join('-');
    });
    const custNames = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, CUSTOMERS_SHEET).forEach(c => { custNames[String(c.id)] = c.name; });
    const companyName = companyArabicName_();
    const rows = getAllRecords_(dbId, CASH_SHEET)
      .filter(r => {
        if (boxId && String(r.related_box) !== boxId) return false;
        if (typeId && String(r.transaction_type) !== typeId) return false;
        if (dateFrom) {
          const d = parseDate_(r.transaction_date);
          const t = d instanceof Date ? d.getTime() : 0;
          if (t && dateFrom instanceof Date && t < dateFrom.getTime()) return false;
        }
        if (dateTo) {
          const d = parseDate_(r.transaction_date);
          const t = d instanceof Date ? d.getTime() : 0;
          if (t && dateTo instanceof Date && t > dateTo.getTime()) return false;
        }
        return true;
      })
      .map(r => {
        let party = String((r.name_vendor == null) ? '' : r.name_vendor).trim();
        if (!party) party = String((r.name == null) ? '' : r.name).trim() ? (custNames[String(r.name)] || '') : companyName;
        return {
          transaction_id: r.transaction_id,
          date: parseDate_(r.transaction_date),
          party: party,
          details: r.transaction_details || '',
          account: boxMap[String(r.related_box)] || '',
          type: r.transaction_type || '',
          total: num0_(r.total),
          balance: num0_(r.box_balance),
          approved: r.approved === true || r.approved === 'true'
        };
      });
    rows.sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a.transaction_id) - Number(b.transaction_id); });
    return {
      status: 'success',
      rows: rows,
      box_options: boxOptions_(dbId),
      type_options: [{ value: 'Debit', label: 'مدين (Debit)' }, { value: 'Credit', label: 'دائن (Credit)' }]
    };
  }

  // =========================================
  // Generic XLSX export (built via Utilities.zip, no Drive API needed)
  // =========================================
  function getXlsxExport_(data, user, dbId) {
    const headers = (data && data.headers) || [];
    const rows = (data && data.rows) || [];
    const filename = (data && data.filename) || 'report.xlsx';
    if (!headers.length) throw new Error('headers required');
    const blob = buildXlsx_(headers, rows, filename);
    return { status: 'success', base64: Utilities.base64Encode(blob.getBytes()), filename: filename };
  }

  function buildXlsx_(headers, rows, filename) {
    const esc = function (s) {
      return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    };
    let sheetData = '';
    let hrow = '<row r="1">';
    headers.forEach(function (h, i) {
      hrow += '<c r="' + colLetter_(i) + '1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>' + esc(h) + '</t></is></c>';
    });
    hrow += '</row>';
    sheetData += hrow;
    rows.forEach(function (r, ri) {
      const rn = ri + 2;
      let row = '<row r="' + rn + '">';
      headers.forEach(function (h, ci) {
        const v = r[h];
        const ref = colLetter_(ci) + rn;
        if (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v)) {
          row += '<c r="' + ref + '"><v>' + v + '</v></c>';
        } else {
          row += '<c r="' + ref + '" t="inlineStr"><is><t>' + esc(v) + '</t></is></c>';
        }
      });
      row += '</row>';
      sheetData += row;
    });

    const parts = {};
    parts['[Content_Types].xml'] = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/></Types>';
    parts['_rels/.rels'] = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/></Relationships>';
    parts['xl/workbook.xml'] = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><sheets><sheet name="Sheet1" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets></workbook>';
    parts['xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'] = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/></Relationships>';
    parts['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"><sheetData>' + sheetData + '</sheetData></worksheet>';

    const blobs = [];
    Object.keys(parts).forEach(function (k) {
      blobs.push(Utilities.newBlob(parts[k], 'application/xml', k));
    });
    return Utilities.zip(blobs, filename);
  }

  // =========================================
  // Items needed to purchase (current_qty / last purchase qty <= 0.5)
  // =========================================
  function getPurchaseNeeds_(data, user, dbId) {
    const qtyMap = currentQtyMap_(dbId);
    // last purchase qty per product: qty of the purchasing line with max receipt_date
    const latest = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, PURCHASING_LINES_SHEET).forEach(r => {
      const pid = String((r.product == null) ? '' : r.product).trim();
      if (!pid) return;
      const d = parseDate_(r.receipt_date);
      const t = d instanceof Date ? d.getTime() : 0;
      if (!(pid in latest) || t > latest[pid].t) {
        latest[pid] = { t: t, qty: num0_(r.qty) };
      }
    });

    const prodNames = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, PRODUCTS_SHEET).forEach(p => { prodNames[String(p.id)] = p.name_ar; });
    const rows = [];
    Object.keys(latest).forEach(pid => {
      const lastQty = latest[pid].qty;
      if (lastQty <= 0) return;
      const current = qtyMap[pid] != null ? qtyMap[pid] : 0;
      const ratio = current / lastQty;
      rows.push({
        product_id: pid,
        product_name: prodNames[pid] || '',
        current_qty: current,
        last_purchase_qty: lastQty,
        ratio: ratio,
        needs_purchase: ratio <= 0.5
      });
    });
    rows.sort(function (a, b) { return a.ratio - b.ratio; });
    return { status: 'success', rows: rows };
  }

  // =========================================
  // Product movement (purchases in, sales out, returns in)
  // =========================================
  function getProductMovement_(data, user, dbId) {
    const productId = String((data && data.product_id) || '').trim();
    if (!productId) throw new Error('معرف المنتج مطلوب');
    const dateFrom = parseDate_(data && data.date_from);
    const dateTo = parseDate_(data && data.date_to);
    const prodNames = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, PRODUCTS_SHEET).forEach(p => { prodNames[String(p.id)] = p.name_ar; });
    const custNames = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, CUSTOMERS_SHEET).forEach(c => { custNames[String(c.id)] = c.name; });

    const invMap = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, SALES_SHEET).forEach(inv => {
      invMap[String(inv.invoice_unique_id)] = {
        number: inv['رقم الفاتورة'] || '',
        customer: custNames[String(inv['اسم العميل'])] || '',
        date: parseDate_(inv['تاريخ الفاتورة'])
      };
    });

    const movements = [];

    // Purchases (in) — from purchasing lines, reference = header code
    const headerMap = {};
    getAllRecords_(dbId, PURCHASING_SHEET).forEach(h => { headerMap[String(h.unique_id)] = h; });
    getAllRecords_(dbId, PURCHASING_LINES_SHEET).forEach(l => {
      if (String(l.product) !== productId) return;
      const h = headerMap[String(l.top_light_purchasing_costing_id)] || {};
      movements.push({
        date: parseDate_(l.receipt_date),
        type: 'purchase',
        reference: h.code || '',
        customer: custNames[String(l.vendor)] || '',
        qty_in: num0_(l.qty),
        qty_out: 0
      });
    });

    // Sales (out)
    getAllRecords_(dbId, SALES_LINES_SHEET).forEach(l => {
      if (String(l.product_id) !== productId) return;
      const inv = invMap[String(l.top_lightsales_header_id)] || {};
      movements.push({
        date: inv.date || parseDate_(l.created_at),
        type: 'sales',
        reference: inv.number || '',
        customer: inv.customer || '',
        qty_in: 0,
        qty_out: num0_(l.product_qty)
      });
    });

    // Returns (in)
    getAllRecords_(dbId, SALES_RETURNS_SHEET).forEach(r => {
      if (String(r.top_lightsales_products_id) !== productId) return;
      const inv = invMap[String(r.top_lightsales_invoices_id)] || {};
      movements.push({
        date: parseDate_(r.top_lightreturn_date),
        type: 'return',
        reference: inv.number || '',
        customer: custNames[String(r.top_lightsales_invoices_client)] || '',
        qty_in: num0_(r.top_lightreturn_qty),
        qty_out: 0
      });
    });

    movements.sort(function (a, b) {
      const ta = a.date instanceof Date ? a.date.getTime() : 0;
      const tb = b.date instanceof Date ? b.date.getTime() : 0;
      return ta - tb;
    });

    let opening = 0;
    const inRange = [];
    movements.forEach(m => {
      const t = m.date instanceof Date ? m.date.getTime() : 0;
      if (dateFrom instanceof Date && t < dateFrom.getTime()) { opening += m.qty_in - m.qty_out; return; }
      if (dateTo instanceof Date && t > dateTo.getTime()) return;
      inRange.push(m);
    });

    let running = opening;
    const rows = inRange.map(m => {
      running += m.qty_in - m.qty_out;
      return {
        date: m.date,
        type: m.type,
        reference: m.reference,
        customer: m.customer,
        qty_in: m.qty_in,
        qty_out: m.qty_out,
        running: running
      };
    });

    return {
      status: 'success',
      product: { id: productId, name: prodNames[productId] || '' },
      opening_balance: opening,
      rows: rows,
      balance: running
    };
  }

  }

  function renderForm(record, presetBox, readOnly) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    var o = __options;
    var curOpts = o.currency_options || [];
    var defCurrency = record ? record.currency : (curOpts[0] ? curOpts[0].value : 'EGP');
    var defRate = record ? record.exchange_rate : (curOpts[0] ? (curOpts[0].rate || 1) : 1);

    var f = function (key, label, type, opts, value, required, placeholder) {
      return UIC.field({ key: key, label: label, type: type || 'text', options: opts, value: value, required: required, placeholder: placeholder, min: type === 'number' ? 0 : undefined, step: type === 'number' ? 'any' : undefined });
    };

    var title = readOnly ? 'عرض حركة' : (record ? 'تعديل حركة' : 'إضافة حركة');
    var relatedBoxVal = record ? record.related_box : (presetBox || '');

    content.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="renderCash()">← عودة</button>' +
      '<h2 style="margin:0;">' + title + '</h2></div>' +
      '<form id="cash-form">' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:0 16px;padding:16px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:2px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;">' +
      f('name', 'الطرف *', 'select', o.customer_options || [], record ? record.name : '', true, 'اختر الطرف...') +
      f('related_box', 'الصندوق *', 'select', o.box_options || [], relatedBoxVal, true, 'اختر الصندوق...') +
      f('chart_code', 'كود الحساب *', 'select', o.chart_options || [], record ? record.chart_code : '', true, 'اختر كود الحساب...') +
      f('transaction_details', 'البيان *', 'text', null, record ? record.transaction_details : '', true) +
      f('transaction_date', 'التاريخ', 'date', null, record ? formatDate(record.transaction_date) : formatDate(new Date()), false) +
      f('transaction_amount', 'المبلغ *', 'number', null, record ? record.transaction_amount : '', true) +
      f('total_discount', 'الخصم', 'number', null, record ? record.total_discount : 0, false) +
      f('taxes', 'الضرائب', 'number', null, record ? record.taxes : 0, false) +
      f('transaction_type', 'النوع *', 'select', o.type_options || [], record ? record.transaction_type : '', true, 'اختر النوع...') +
      f('transaction_method', 'طريقة الدفع *', 'select', (o.method_options || []).map(function (m) { return { value: m, label: m }; }), record ? record.transaction_method : '', true, 'اختر الطريقة...') +
      f('currency', 'العملة *', 'select', curOpts, defCurrency, true, 'اختر العملة...') +
      f('exchange_rate', 'سعر الصرف', 'number', null, defRate, false) +
      f('invoice_id', 'رقم الفاتورة (اختياري)', 'text', null, record ? record.invoice_id : '', false) +
      f('transaction_purchasing_items', 'الأصناف (CSV)', 'text', null, record ? record.transaction_purchasing_items : '', false) +
      f('tax_system', 'النظام الضريبي', 'select', [{ value: 'false', label: 'لا' }, { value: 'true', label: 'نعم' }], record ? String(record.tax_system) : 'false', false) +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border:2px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-top:12px;">' +
      '<div>الصافي: <strong id="net_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>الإجمالي: <strong id="total_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>الرصيد: <strong id="balance_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '</form>' +
      '<div style="margin:16px 0;">' + (readOnly ? '' : '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveCash()">حفظ</button> ') +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="renderCash()">' + (readOnly ? 'عودة' : 'إلغاء') + '</button></div>';

    if (readOnly) {
      content.querySelectorAll('#cash-form input, #cash-form select, #cash-form textarea').forEach(function (el) { el.disabled = true; });
    }

    var curEl = document.getElementById('currency');
    if (curEl && !readOnly) curEl.addEventListener('change', onCurrencyChange);
    ['transaction_amount', 'total_discount', 'taxes', 'transaction_type', 'exchange_rate'].forEach(function (k) {
      var el = document.getElementById(k);
      if (el) { el.addEventListener('input', recalc); el.addEventListener('change', recalc); }
    });
    var methodEl = document.getElementById('transaction_method');
    if (methodEl && !readOnly) { methodEl.addEventListener('input', recalc); methodEl.addEventListener('change', onMethodChange); }
    recalc();
  }

  function onCurrencyChange() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('currency');
    if (!sel) return;
    var opts = __options.currency_options || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
      if (String(opts[i].value) === String(sel.value)) {
        var rateEl = document.getElementById('exchange_rate');
        if (rateEl) rateEl.value = opts[i].rate;
        recalc();
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  function onMethodChange() {
    var method = getVal('transaction_method');
    if (method === 'فودافون كاش') {
      var td = document.getElementById('total_discount');
      if (td) td.value = num(getVal('transaction_amount')) / 100;
    }
    recalc();
  }

  function recalc() {
    var amount = num(getVal('transaction_amount'));
    var discount = num(getVal('total_discount'));
    var taxes = num(getVal('taxes'));
    var rate = num(getVal('exchange_rate'));
    var method = getVal('transaction_method');
    var type = getVal('transaction_type');
    var base = (method === 'فودافون كاش') ? amount * rate : (amount - discount) * rate;
    var net = base;
    var total = base + taxes * rate;
    var balance = (type === 'Credit') ? -total : total;
    setText('net_display', FMT.number(net));
    setText('total_display', FMT.number(total));
    setText('balance_display', FMT.number(balance));
  }

  function saveCash() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('cash-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('cash-form')) return;

    var rec = {
      name: data.name,
      related_box: data.related_box,
      chart_code: data.chart_code,
      transaction_details: data.transaction_details,
      transaction_date: data.transaction_date,
      transaction_amount: data.transaction_amount,
      total_discount: data.total_discount,
      taxes: data.taxes,
      transaction_type: data.transaction_type,
      transaction_method: data.transaction_method,
      currency: data.currency,
      exchange_rate: data.exchange_rate,
      invoice_id: data.invoice_id,
      transaction_purchasing_items: data.transaction_purchasing_items,
      tax_system: data.tax_system
    };
    if (String(rec.name || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('الطرف مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(rec.related_box || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('الصندوق مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(rec.chart_code || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('كود الحساب مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(rec.transaction_details || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('البيان مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (num(rec.transaction_amount) <= 0) { UIC.toast('المبلغ يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(rec.transaction_method || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('طريقة الدفع مطلوبة', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(rec.currency || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('العملة مطلوبة', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(rec.transaction_type || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('نوع الحركة مطلوب', 'error'); return; }

    var payload = { record: rec };
    var isEdit = __editingId ? true : false;
    if (isEdit) rec.transaction_id = Number(__editingId);

    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall(isEdit ? 'edit_cash' : 'add_cash', payload)
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); renderCash(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function openReport() {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_cash_report&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function openTransfer() {
    var o = __options;    var boxOpts = (o.box_options || []).map(function (b) {
      return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(b.value) + '">' + FMT.escape(b.label) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
    var body = '<form id="transfer-form">' +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="tf_from">من صندوق *</label>' +
      '<select id="tf_from" class="input"><option value="">اختر...</option>' + boxOpts + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="tf_to">إلى صندوق *</label>' +
      '<select id="tf_to" class="input"><option value="">اختر...</option>' + boxOpts + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="tf_amount">المبلغ *</label>' +
      '<input id="tf_amount" class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any"></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="tf_date">التاريخ</label>' +
      '<input id="tf_date" class="input" type="date" value="' + formatDate(new Date()) + '"></div>' +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('transfer-modal', { title: 'تحويل بين الصناديق', body: body, onSave: 'saveTransfer()' });
  }

  function saveTransfer() {
    var from = getVal('tf_from');
    var to = getVal('tf_to');
    var amount = num(getVal('tf_amount'));
    var date = getVal('tf_date');
    if (!from) { UIC.toast('اختر الصندوق المصدر', 'error'); return; }
    if (!to) { UIC.toast('اختر الصندوق الهدف', 'error'); return; }
    if (from === to) { UIC.toast('يجب اختيار صندوقين مختلفين', 'error'); return; }
    if (amount <= 0) { UIC.toast('المبلغ يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر', 'error'); return; }

    UI.showSpinner('جاري التحويل...');
    companyCall('add_transfer', { from_box: from, to_box: to, amount: amount, transfer_date: date })
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم التحويل', 'success');
        UIC.closeModal('transfer-modal');
        renderCash();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function doAction(id, action) {
    if (action === 'approve') approveCash(id);
    else if (action === 'edit') openForm(id, '', false);
    else if (action === 'view') openForm(id, '', true);
    else if (action === 'delete') deleteCash(id);
  }

  function approveCash(id) {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الاعتماد...');
    companyCall('approve_cash', { unique_id: Number(id) })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الاعتماد', 'success'); renderCash(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function deleteCash(id) {
    if (!IS_SUPER_ADMIN) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذه الحركة؟')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحذف...');
    companyCall('delete_cash', { unique_id: Number(id) })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); renderCash(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function formatDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>





// ============================================================
// ==== Company_TopLight_Cash_Report.html ====

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Top Light — تقرير النقدية</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
  <style>
    @media print {
      .topbar, .breadcrumb, .no-print { display: none !important; }
      body { background: #ffffff !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tl-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var __boxOptions = [];
  var __typeOptions = [];
  var __rows = [];
  var __search = '';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    UIC.appShell('tl-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tl_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'القمة لايت',
      breadcrumb: 'القمة لايت / تقرير النقدية',
      contentId: 'tl-content'
    });
    fetchData();
  }

  function filterPayload() {
    return {
      date_from: document.getElementById('f_from') ? document.getElementById('f_from').value : '',
      date_to: document.getElementById('f_to') ? document.getElementById('f_to').value : '',
      box: document.getElementById('f_box') ? document.getElementById('f_box').value : '',
      type: document.getElementById('f_type') ? document.getElementById('f_type').value : ''
    };
  }

  var __filtersBuilt = false;

  function fetchData() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_cash_report', filterPayload())
      .then(function (r) {
        __boxOptions = r.box_options || [];
        __typeOptions = r.type_options || [];
        __rows = r.rows || [];
        var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
        if (!__filtersBuilt) {
          content.innerHTML = renderFilters() + '<div id="results"></div>';
          __filtersBuilt = true;
        }
        renderResults();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function onSearch() {
    var el = document.getElementById('f_search');
    __search = el ? el.value : '';
    renderResults();
  }

  function renderFilters() {
    return '<div class="no-print" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:16px;padding:12px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:2px solid #111111;border-radius:8px;">' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_from">من تاريخ</label><input id="f_from" class="input" type="date" onchange="fetchData()"></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_to">إلى تاريخ</label><input id="f_to" class="input" type="date" onchange="fetchData()"></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_box">الصندوق</label>' +
      '<select id="f_box" class="input" onchange="fetchData()"><option value="">الكل</option>' + (__boxOptions || []).map(function (b) { return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(b.value) + '">' + FMT.escape(b.label) + '</option>'; }).join('') + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_type">النوع</label>' +
      '<select id="f_type" class="input" onchange="fetchData()"><option value="">الكل</option>' + (__typeOptions || []).map(function (t) { return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(t.value) + '">' + FMT.escape(t.label) + '</option>'; }).join('') + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;flex:1;min-width:200px;"><label class="form-label" for="f_search">بحث (رقم / الطرف / البيان)</label>' +
      '<input id="f_search" class="input" type="text" placeholder="اكتب للبحث..." oninput="onSearch()"></div>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="window.print()">طباعة</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function renderResults() {
    var el = document.getElementById('results');
    if (!el) return;

    var q = String(__search || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    var rows = (__rows || []).filter(function (r) {
      if (!q) return true;
      return String(r.transaction_id).indexOf(q) !== -1 ||
             String(r.party || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ||
             String(r.details || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
    });

    var totalDebit = 0, totalCredit = 0, net = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var t = numVal(r.total);
      if (r.type === 'Credit') { totalCredit += t; net -= t; }
      else { totalDebit += t; net += t; }
    });

    var kpis = '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      kpiCard('إجمالي مدين', totalDebit) +
      kpiCard('إجمالي دائن', totalCredit) +
      kpiCard('صافي الحركة', net) +
      '</div>';

    var tbody = rows.map(function (r) {
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + r.transaction_id + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + fmtDate(r.date) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(r.party || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(r.details || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(r.account || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(r.type || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(r.total) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(r.balance) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (r.approved ? 'معتمد' : 'قيد الانتظار') + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    el.innerHTML =
      kpis +
      '<div class="table-wrap" style="border:2px solid #111111;overflow-x:auto;">' +
      '<table class="table" style="min-width:1000px;"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>رقم الحركة</th><th>التاريخ</th><th>الجهة المرتبطة</th><th>البيان</th><th>تبويب الحساب</th><th>النوع</th><th>المبلغ</th><th>الرصيد</th><th>الحالة</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + (tbody || '<tr><td colspan="9" style="text-align:center;padding:16px;">لا توجد حركات</td></tr>') + '</tbody></table>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function kpiCard(label, value) {
    return '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-body"><div class="stat-value num">' + FMT.number(value) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="stat-label">' + FMT.escape(label) + '</div></div></div>';
  }

  function numVal(v) { var n = Number(v); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '-';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB');
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<body>
<div id="stmt-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var customerId = '<?!= purchaseCode ?>';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function typeLabel_(t) {
    if (t === 'sales') return 'مبيعات';
    if (t === 'return') return 'مرتجع';
    if (t === 'collection') return 'تحصيل';
    if (t === 'payment') return 'مدفوعات';
    if (t === 'purchase') return 'شراء';
    return t;
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '-';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  var __filters = { from: '', to: '' };
  var __filtersBuilt = false;

  function load() {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري تحميل كشف الحساب...');
    companyCall('get_customer_statement', { customer_id: customerId, date_from: __filters.from, date_to: __filters.to })
      .then(function (r) {
        var root = document.getElementById('stmt-root');
        if (!__filtersBuilt) {
          root.innerHTML = renderFilters() + '<div id="stmt-results"></div>';
          __filtersBuilt = true;
        }
        renderStatement(r);
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        document.getElementById('stmt-root').innerHTML =
          '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderFilters() {
    return '<div class="no-print" style="max-width:1200px;margin:12px auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end;">' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_from">من تاريخ</label><input id="f_from" class="input" type="date" value="' + __filters.from + '" onchange="onFilter(\'from\', this.value)"></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_to">إلى تاريخ</label><input id="f_to" class="input" type="date" value="' + __filters.to + '" onchange="onFilter(\'to\', this.value)"></div>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function onFilter(k, v) { __filters[k] = v; load(); }

  function toggleGroup(i) {
    var els = document.querySelectorAll('.g-' + i);
    for (var k = 0; k < els.length; k++) {
      els[k].style.display = els[k].style.display === 'none' ? '' : 'none';
    }
  }

  function td(v) { return '<td>' + v + '</td>'; }
  function tdN(v) { return '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(v) + '</td>'; }
  function dash() { return '<td>-</td>'; }

  function renderStatement(r) {
    var root = document.getElementById('stmt-results');
    if (!root) return;
    var cust = r.customer || {};

    var body = '';
    (r.movements || []).forEach(function (m, i) {
      if (m.type === 'sales') body += salesRows(m, i);
      else if (m.type === 'return') body += returnRows(m, i);
      else if (m.type === 'collection') body += cashRows(m, 'collection');
      else if (m.type === 'payment') body += cashRows(m, 'payment');
      else if (m.type === 'purchase') body += purchaseRow(m);
    });

    var openingHtml = (__filters.from || __filters.to)
      ? metaItem('الرصيد الافتتاحي', '<span class="num">' + FMT.number(r.opening_balance) + '</span>')
      : '';

    var html =
      '<div class="no-print" style="max-width:1200px;margin:12px auto;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="window.print()">طباعة</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="try{window.top.close()}catch(e){window.close()}">إغلاق</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="stmt">' +
      '<div class="stmt-head">' +
      '<img src="' + (COMPANY_LOGO_URL || '') + '" style="height:42px;" alt="">' +
      '<div class="stmt-title">كشف حساب عميل</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="stmt-meta">' +
      metaItem('الاسم', cust.name) +
      metaItem('النوع', (String(cust.customer_direction).toLowerCase() === 'vendor' ? 'مورد' : 'عميل')) +
      metaItem('الهاتف', cust.telephone) +
      metaItem('العنوان', cust.address) +
      openingHtml +
      metaItem('الرصيد الحالي', '<span class="num">' + FMT.number(r.balance) + '</span>') +
      '</div>' +
      '<table class="inv-table"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>التاريخ</th><th>النوع</th><th>الكود</th><th>البيان / الصنف</th><th>الكمية</th><th>السعر</th><th>الخصم</th><th>مسحوبات</th><th>العملة</th><th>سعر الصرف</th><th>له</th><th>عليه</th><th>الرصيد</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table>' +
      '</div>';

    root.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function salesRows(m, i) {
    var rows = '<tr class="mov-row" onclick="toggleGroup(' + i + ')" style="cursor:pointer;">' +
      td(fmtDate(m.date)) + td('مبيعات') + td(FMT.escape(m.reference || '-')) +
      td('▶ فاتورة مبيعات (' + (m.item_count || m.lines.length) + ' صنف)') +
      dash() + dash() + dash() + dash() +
      td(FMT.escape(m.currency || 'EGP')) + tdN(m.rate != null ? m.rate : 1) +
      td('') + tdN(m.total) + tdN(m.running_balance) + '</tr>';

    (m.lines || []).forEach(function (l) {
      rows += '<tr class="sub g-' + i + '" style="display:none;">' +
        td('') + td('') + td('') + td(FMT.escape(l.product_name || '-')) +
        tdN(l.qty) + tdN(l.price) + tdN(l.discount) +
        td('') + td('') + td('') +
        td('') + tdN(l.net_value) + td('') + '</tr>';
    });

    rows += '<tr class="sum g-' + i + '" style="display:none;">' +
      td('') + td('') + td('') +
      td('رقم: ' + FMT.escape(m.reference || '') + ' الصافي: ' + FMT.number(m.net) + ' خصم: -' + FMT.number(m.discount) + ' الإجمالي: ' + FMT.number(m.total) + ' ج.م') +
      td('') + td('') + td('') + td('') + td('') + td('') +
      td('') + tdN(m.total) + td('') + '</tr>';

    return rows;
  }

  function returnRows(m, i) {
    var rows = '<tr class="mov-row" onclick="toggleGroup(' + i + ')" style="cursor:pointer;">' +
      td(fmtDate(m.date)) + td('مرتجع') + td(FMT.escape(m.reference || '-')) +
      td('▶ مرتجع فاتورة #' + FMT.escape(m.invoice_number || m.reference || '') + ' (' + (m.item_count || m.lines.length) + ' صنف)') +
      dash() + dash() + dash() + dash() +
      td(FMT.escape(m.currency || 'EGP')) + tdN(m.rate != null ? m.rate : 1) +
      tdN(m.total) + td('') + tdN(m.running_balance) + '</tr>';

    (m.lines || []).forEach(function (l) {
      rows += '<tr class="sub g-' + i + '" style="display:none;">' +
        td('') + td('') + td('') + td(FMT.escape(l.product_name || '-')) +
        tdN(l.qty) + tdN(l.gross) + tdN(l.discount) +
        td('') + td('') + td('') +
        tdN(l.net) + td('') + td('') + '</tr>';
    });

    rows += '<tr class="sum g-' + i + '" style="display:none;">' +
      td('') + td('') + td('') +
      td('مرتجع #: ' + FMT.escape(m.invoice_number || m.reference || '') + ' الكمية: ' + FMT.number(m.total_qty) + ' الإجمالي: ' + FMT.number(m.total) + ' ج.م') +
      td('') + td('') + td('') + td('') + td('') + td('') +
      tdN(m.total) + td('') + td('') + '</tr>';

    return rows;
  }

  function cashRows(m, label) {
    var desc = m.description || '';
    if (m.method) desc = desc ? (desc + ' ' + m.method) : m.method;
    var creditCell = label === 'collection' ? tdN(m.credit) : td('');
    var debitCell = label === 'payment' ? tdN(m.debit) : td('');
    return '<tr class="mov-row">' +
      td(fmtDate(m.date)) + td(label === 'collection' ? 'تحصيل' : 'مدفوعات') + td(FMT.escape(m.reference || '-')) +
      td(FMT.escape(desc || '-')) +
      dash() + dash() + dash() + tdN(m.withdrawal) +
      td(FMT.escape(m.currency || 'EGP')) + tdN(m.rate != null ? m.rate : 1) +
      creditCell + debitCell + tdN(m.running_balance) + '</tr>';
  }

  function purchaseRow(m) {
    return '<tr class="mov-row">' +
      td(fmtDate(m.date)) + td('شراء') + td(FMT.escape(m.reference || '-')) +
      td(FMT.escape(m.description || '-')) +
      dash() + dash() + dash() + dash() +
      td(FMT.escape(m.currency || 'EGP')) + tdN(m.rate != null ? m.rate : 1) +
      tdN(m.credit) + td('') + tdN(m.running_balance) + '</tr>';
  }

  function metaItem(label, value) {
    return '<div class="meta-item"><strong>' + label + ':</strong> ' + (value == null || value === '' ? '-' : value) + '</div>';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Top Light — العملاء والموردون</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
  <style>
    @page { size: A4; }
    @media print {
      .topbar, .breadcrumb, .no-print { display: none !important; }
      .table-toolbar { display: none !important; }
      #parties-table table th:last-child,
      #parties-table table td:last-child { display: none !important; }
      body { background: #ffffff !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tl-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var DIRECTION_FILTER = '';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'parties-content';
    UIC.appShell('tl-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tl_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'القمة لايت',
      breadcrumb: 'القمة لايت / العملاء والموردون',
      contentId: contentId
    });
    fetchParties();
  }

  function fetchParties() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_parties', { direction: DIRECTION_FILTER })
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__typeOptions = r.type_options || [];
        window.__countryOptions = r.country_options || [];
        window.__regionOptions = r.region_options || [];
        renderParties(r.parties || []);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderParties(list) {
    window.__parties = list;
    var rows = list.map(function (p) {
      var dir = String(p.customer_direction).toLowerCase();
      var isCustomer = dir === 'customer' || dir === 'عميل' || dir === 'client';
      return {
        name: p.name,
        direction: UIC.statusPill(isCustomer ? 'عميل' : 'مورد', isCustomer ? 'success' : 'warning'),
        type: p.type || '-',
        country: p.country || '-',
        region: p.region || '-',
        tax_id: p.tax_id || '-',
        telephone: p.telephone || '-',
        address: p.address || '-',
        balance: FMT.number(p.balance),
        actions: '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openStatement(\'' + FMT.escape(p.id) + '\')">كشف حساب</button>' +
          (IS_SUPER_ADMIN ? ' <button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openPartyModal(\'' + FMT.escape(p.id) + '\')">تعديل</button>' : '')
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'name', label: 'الاسم' },
      { key: 'direction', label: 'النوع' },
      { key: 'type', label: 'الصنف' },
      { key: 'country', label: 'الدولة' },
      { key: 'region', label: 'المنطقة' },
      { key: 'tax_id', label: 'الرقم الضريبي' },
      { key: 'telephone', label: 'الهاتف' },
      { key: 'address', label: 'العنوان' },
      { key: 'balance', label: 'الرصيد', numeric: true },
      { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('parties-content');
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;" class="no-print">' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">' +
      '<button class="btn ' + (DIRECTION_FILTER === '' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline') + '" onclick="setFilter(\'\')">الكل</button>' +
      '<button class="btn ' + (DIRECTION_FILTER === 'customer' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline') + '" onclick="setFilter(\'customer\')">العملاء</button>' +
      '<button class="btn ' + (DIRECTION_FILTER === 'vendor' ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline') + '" onclick="setFilter(\'vendor\')">الموردون</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="window.print()">طباعة</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="exportCustomers()">تصدير Excel</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openPartyModal(\'\')">+ إضافة</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('parties-table', {
        title: 'العملاء والموردون',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد بيانات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('parties-table');
  }

  function setFilter(direction) {
    DIRECTION_FILTER = direction;
    fetchParties();
  }

  function openStatement(id) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_customer_statement&purchase_code=' + encodeURIComponent(id) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function exportCustomers() {
    var list = window.__parties || [];
    var headers = ['الاسم', 'النوع', 'الهاتف', 'العنوان', 'الرصيد'];
    var rows = list.map(function (p) {
      var isCustomer = String(p.customer_direction).toLowerCase() === 'customer' || String(p.customer_direction).toLowerCase() === 'عميل' || String(p.customer_direction).toLowerCase() === 'client';
      return {
        'الاسم': p.name || '',
        'النوع': isCustomer ? 'عميل' : 'مورد',
        'الهاتف': p.telephone || '',
        'العنوان': p.address || '',
        'الرصيد': p.balance || 0
      };
    });
    UI.showSpinner('جاري التصدير...');
    companyCall('get_xlsx_export', { headers: headers, rows: rows, filename: 'العملاء.xlsx' })
      .then(function (r) { API.downloadXlsx(r.base64, r.filename); })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function openPartyModal(id) {
    var p = (window.__parties || []).find(function (x) { return String(x.id) === String(id); });
    var body =
      '<form id="party-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'name', label: 'الاسم', value: p ? p.name : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'customer_direction', label: 'النوع', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: [{ value: 'customer', label: 'عميل' }, { value: 'vendor', label: 'مورد' }],
        value: p ? (p.customer_direction || 'customer') : 'customer' }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'type', label: 'الصنف', value: p ? p.type : '', options: window.__typeOptions || [], required: true }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'country', label: 'الدولة', value: p ? p.country : '', options: window.__countryOptions || [], required: true }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'region', label: 'المنطقة', value: p ? p.region : '', options: window.__regionOptions || [], required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'telephone', label: 'الهاتف', value: p ? p.telephone : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'address', label: 'العنوان', value: p ? p.address : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'registration_number', label: 'رقم التسجيل', value: p ? p.registration_number : '' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'tax_id', label: 'الرقم الضريبي', value: p ? p.tax_id : '' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('party-modal', {
      title: p ? 'تعديل' : 'إضافة',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveParty(\'' + (p ? p.id : '') + '\')'
    });
  }

  function saveParty(id) {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('party-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('party-form')) return;
    ['type', 'country', 'region'].forEach(function (k) {
      if (data[k] === '__new__') data[k] = data[k + '_custom'] || '';
      delete data[k + '_custom'];
    });
    if (id) data.id = id;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall(id ? 'edit_party' : 'add_party', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('party-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchParties();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('parties-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>




// ============================================================
// ==== Company_TopLight_Dashboard.html ====
// ============================================================

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Top Light — Dashboard</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    .chart-card { background: var(--bg-surface); border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; }
    .chart-card h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 15px; color: #111111; }
    .chart-wrap { position: relative; height: 300px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tl-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    var root = document.getElementById('tl-root');
    var contentId = 'tl-content';
    UIC.appShell('tl-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tl_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'القمة لايت',
      breadcrumb: 'القمة لايت / لوحة التحكم',
      contentId: contentId
    });

    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_dashboard_data')
      .then(function (r) {
        var inner = document.getElementById(contentId);
        if (!r.kpi_authorized || !r.kpis) {
          inner.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>لا توجد بيانات للعرض</span></div>';
          return;
        }
        var k = r.kpis;
        inner.innerHTML =
          '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px;">' +
          UIC.statCard({ label: 'مبيعات منذ بداية العام', value: FMT.number(k.sales_ytd), icon: '&#128200;', tone: 'success' }) +
          UIC.statCard({ label: 'مبيعات هذا الشهر', value: FMT.number(k.sales_mtd), icon: '&#128200;' }) +
          UIC.statCard({ label: 'رصيد البنك', value: FMT.number(k.bank_balance), icon: '&#127970;', tone: 'warning' }) +
          UIC.statCard({ label: 'رصيد الصناديق', value: FMT.number(k.box_balance), icon: '&#128230;' }) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:20px;">' +
          '<div class="chart-card"><h3>المبيعات الشهرية</h3><div class="chart-wrap"><canvas id="salesChart"></canvas></div></div>' +
          '<div class="chart-card"><h3>المبيعات حسب العميل</h3><div class="chart-wrap"><canvas id="customerChart"></canvas></div></div>' +
          '</div>';
        renderCharts(k);
      })
      .catch(function (e) {
        var inner = document.getElementById(contentId);
        if (inner) inner.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderCharts(k) {
    if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;
    Chart.defaults.color = '#111111';
    Chart.defaults.borderColor = '#111111';

    var monthly = k.monthly_sales || [];
    var salesCtx = document.getElementById('salesChart');
    if (salesCtx) {
      new Chart(salesCtx, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: monthly.map(function (m) { return m.label; }),
          datasets: [{
            label: 'المبيعات',
            data: monthly.map(function (m) { return m.value; }),
            backgroundColor: '#fbbf24',
            borderColor: '#111111',
            borderWidth: 2,
            borderRadius: 4
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
          scales: {
            y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: '#e5e7eb' } },
            x: { grid: { display: false } }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    var pie = k.pie_data || [];
    var palette = ['#fbbf24', '#111111', '#b45309', '#16a34a', '#0369a1', '#c2410c', '#fef08a', '#6b7280', '#b91c1c'];
    var pieCtx = document.getElementById('customerChart');
    if (pieCtx) {
      new Chart(pieCtx, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
          labels: pie.map(function (p) { return p.label; }),
          datasets: [{
            data: pie.map(function (p) { return p.value; }),
            backgroundColor: palette,
            borderColor: '#111111',
            borderWidth: 2
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          cutout: '55%',
          plugins: {
            legend: { position: 'right', rtl: true, labels: { font: { size: 11 } } }
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';

// ==== Company_TopLight_Product_Movement.html ====

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>حركة المنتج</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
  <style>
    @media print {
      .no-print { display: none !important; }
      body { background: #ffffff !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="mov-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var productId = '<?!= purchaseCode ?>';
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function typeLabel_(t) {
    if (t === 'purchase') return 'شراء (وارد)';
    if (t === 'sales') return 'بيع (صادر)';
    if (t === 'return') return 'مرتجع (وارد)';
    return t;
  }

  function filterPayload() {
    return {
      product_id: productId,
      date_from: document.getElementById('f_from') ? document.getElementById('f_from').value : '',
      date_to: document.getElementById('f_to') ? document.getElementById('f_to').value : ''
    };
  }

  function hasDateFilter() {
    var f = document.getElementById('f_from'), t = document.getElementById('f_to');
    return (f && f.value) || (t && t.value);
  }

  function load() {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري تحميل حركة المنتج...');
    companyCall('get_product_movement', filterPayload())
      .then(function (r) { render(r); })
      .catch(function (e) {
        document.getElementById('mov-root').innerHTML =
          '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function render(r) {
    var root = document.getElementById('mov-root');

    var filterBar =
      '<div class="no-print" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;padding:12px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:2px solid #111111;border-radius:8px;">' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_from">من تاريخ</label><input id="f_from" class="input" type="date" onchange="load()"></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_to">إلى تاريخ</label><input id="f_to" class="input" type="date" onchange="load()"></div>' +
      '</div>';

    var openingHtml = '';
    if (hasDateFilter()) {
      openingHtml = '<div style="margin-bottom:12px;padding:10px 14px;background:#fef08a;border:2px solid #111111;border-radius:8px;">' +
        'الرصيد الافتتاحي (قبل التاريخ المحدد): <strong class="num">' + FMT.number(r.opening_balance) + '</strong></div>';
    }

    var rows = (r.rows || []).map(function (m) {
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + fmtDate(m.date) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(typeLabel_(m.type)) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(m.reference || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(m.customer || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + (m.qty_in > 0 ? FMT.number(m.qty_in) : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + (m.qty_out > 0 ? FMT.number(m.qty_out) : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(m.running) + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    var html =
      '<div class="no-print" style="max-width:1100px;margin:12px auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;">' +
      '<h2 style="margin:0;">حركة المنتج: ' + FMT.escape((r.product && r.product.name) || '') + '</h2>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="window.print()">طباعة</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="try{window.top.close()}catch(e){window.close()}">إغلاق</button>' +
      '</div></div>' +
      '<div style="max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;">' +
      filterBar + openingHtml +
      '<div style="margin-bottom:12px;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:2px solid #111111;border-radius:8px;">' +
      'الرصيد الحالي: <strong class="num">' + FMT.number(r.balance) + '</strong></div>' +
      '<div class="table-wrap" style="border:2px solid #111111;">' +
      '<table class="table"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>التاريخ</th><th>النوع</th><th>المرجع</th><th>العميل</th><th style="text-align:left;">وارد</th><th style="text-align:left;">صادر</th><th style="text-align:left;">الرصيد</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>' +
      '</div></div>';

    root.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '-';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB');
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

// ==== Company_TopLight_Products.html ====

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Top Light — المنتجات</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tl-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'products-content';
    UIC.appShell('tl-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tl_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'القمة لايت',
      breadcrumb: 'القمة لايت / المنتجات',
      contentId: contentId
    });
    fetchProducts();
  }

  function fetchProducts() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_products')
      .then(function (r) {
        window.__categoryOptions = r.category_options || [];
        window.__assetCodeOptions = r.asset_code_options || [];
        window.__unitOptions = r.unit_options || [];
        renderProducts(r.products || []);
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderProducts(list) {
    window.__products = list;
    var rows = list.map(function (p) {
      return {
        id: p.id,
        name_ar: p.name_ar,
        name_en: p.name_en || '-',
        category: p.category_name || '-',
        unit: p.unit || '-',
        carton: p.carton || '-',
        current_qty: FMT.number(p.current_qty),
        total_cost_sign: FMT.currency(p.total_cost_sign),
        actions: '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openMovement(\'' + FMT.escape(p.id) + '\')">حركة</button>' +
          (IS_SUPER_ADMIN ? ' <button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openProductModal(\'' + FMT.escape(p.id) + '\')">تعديل</button>' : '')
      };
    });
    var headers = [
      { key: 'id', label: 'المعرف' },
      { key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم العربي' },
      { key: 'name_en', label: 'الاسم الإنجليزي' },
      { key: 'category', label: 'الفئة' },
      { key: 'unit', label: 'الوحدة' },
      { key: 'carton', label: 'الكرتونة' },
      { key: 'current_qty', label: 'الرصيد الحالي', numeric: true },
      { key: 'total_cost_sign', label: 'قيمة الكمية المتاحة', numeric: true },
      { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
    ];
    var body = document.getElementById('products-content');
    body.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;gap:8px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="openPurchaseNeeds()">الاصناف المطلوب شرائها</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openProductModal(\'\')">+ إضافة منتج</button></div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('products-table', {
        title: 'المنتجات',
        headers: headers,
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد منتجات'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('products-table');
  }

  function openMovement(id) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_product_movement&purchase_code=' + encodeURIComponent(id) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function openPurchaseNeeds() {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_purchase_needs&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function openProductModal(id) {
    var p = (window.__products || []).find(function (x) { return String(x.id) === String(id); });
    var categoryOptions = (window.__categoryOptions || []).map(function (c) {
      return { value: c.id, label: c.name_ar };
    });
    var assetCodeOptions = (window.__assetCodeOptions || []).map(function (o) {
      return { value: o.fifth, label: o.code };
    });
    var body =
      '<form id="product-form">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'name_ar', label: 'الاسم العربي', value: p ? p.name_ar : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'name_en', label: 'الاسم الإنجليزي', value: p ? p.name_en : '' }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'unit', label: 'الوحدة', value: p ? p.unit : '', options: window.__unitOptions || [], required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'carton', label: 'الكرتونة', value: p ? p.carton : '', required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'asset_code', label: 'كود الأصل', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: assetCodeOptions, placeholder: 'اختر كود الأصل...', value: p ? p.asset_code : '' }) +
      UIC.enumSelect({ key: 'category', label: 'الفئة', value: p ? p.category : '', options: categoryOptions, required: true, placeholder: 'اختر الفئة...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'sales_tax', label: 'ضريبة المبيعات', type: 'select', required: true,
        options: [{ value: '0.14', label: '14%' }, { value: '0.10', label: '10%' }, { value: '0.05', label: '5%' }],
        value: p ? String(p.sales_tax) : '0.14' }) +
      '</form>';
    UIC.openModal('product-modal', {
      title: p ? 'تعديل منتج' : 'إضافة منتج',
      body: body,
      onSave: 'saveProduct(\'' + (p ? p.id : '') + '\')'
    });
  }

  function saveProduct(id) {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('product-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('product-form')) return;
    ['unit'].forEach(function (k) {
      if (data[k] === '__new__') data[k] = data[k + '_custom'] || '';
      delete data[k + '_custom'];
    });
    if (data.category === '__new__') {
      data.category_new = data.category_custom || '';
      delete data.category;
      delete data.category_custom;
    } else {
      delete data.category_custom;
    }
    if (id) data.id = id;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall(id ? 'edit_product' : 'add_product', data)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('product-modal');
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchProducts();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var body = document.getElementById('products-content');
    if (body) body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  function metaItem(label, value) {

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
