  function num(v) { var n = Number(v); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
  function getVal(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; }
  function setText(id, t) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = t; }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'tl-content';
    UIC.appShell('tl-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tl_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'القمة لايت',
      breadcrumb: 'القمة لايت / المشتريات',
      contentId: contentId
    });
    renderList();
  }

  function renderList() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_purchasing_headers')
      .then(function (r) {
        __options = r.options || {};
        __headers = r.headers || [];
        renderHeadersTable();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderHeadersTable() {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    __headers.sort(function (a, b) {
      return new Date(b['reciept date']) - new Date(a['reciept date']);
    });
    var rows = __headers.map(function (h) {
      var opts = '<option value="">إجراءات...</option>' +
        '<option value="print">طباعة</option>';
      if (String(h.approval_status) !== 'Approved') {
        opts += '<option value="approve">اعتماد</option>';
        if (IS_SUPER_ADMIN) {
          opts += '<option value="edit">تعديل</option><option value="delete">حذف</option>';
        } else {
          opts += '<option value="view">عرض</option>';
        }
      }
      var actions = '<select class="input" style="padding:6px 8px;width:130px;" onchange="doAction(\'' + FMT.escape(h.unique_id) + '\', this.value); this.value=\'\';">' + opts + '</select>';
      return {
        code: h.code || '-',
        supplier_name: h.supplier_name || '-',
        receipt_date: h['reciept date'] ? String(h['reciept date']).slice(0, 10) : '-',
        items: h.items || '-',
        total_costs: FMT.number(h['total costs']),
        approval_status: h.approval_status || '-',
        actions: actions
      };
    });
    content.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openForm(\'\')">+ إضافة عملية شراء</button></div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('purchasing-table', {
        title: 'المشتريات',
        headers: [
          { key: 'code', label: 'الكود' },
          { key: 'supplier_name', label: 'المورد' },
          { key: 'receipt_date', label: 'تاريخ الاستلام' },
          { key: 'items', label: 'الأصناف' },
          { key: 'total_costs', label: 'إجمالي التكاليف', numeric: true },
          { key: 'approval_status', label: 'الحالة' },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد عمليات شراء'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('purchasing-table');
  }

  function openForm(uid) {
    __editingUid = uid || '';
    var record = null;
    if (uid) {
      record = __headers.find(function (h) { return String(h.unique_id) === String(uid); }) || null;
    }
    renderForm(record);
  }

        { key: 'receipt_date', label: 'تاريخ الاستلام *', type: 'date', required: true, default: 'today' },

        { key: 'customs_expenses', label: 'مصاريف جمركية', type: 'number' },

      ]},
      { title: 'الضرائب وأخرى', fields: [
        { key: 'purchase_tax', label: 'ضريبة الشراء', type: 'number' },
        { key: 'income_tax', label: 'ضريبة الدخل', type: 'number' },
        { key: 'minimum_differences', label: 'الحد الأدنى للفروقات', type: 'text' },
        { key: 'approved_this_month', label: 'معتمد هذا الشهر', type: 'text' },
        { key: 'associated_bank', label: 'البنك المرتبط', type: 'text' }
      ]}
    ];
  }

  function fieldValue(s, record) {
    var v = record ? record[RECORD_KEYS[s.key]] : null;
    if (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '') return v;
    if (s.type === 'date' && s.default === 'today') return formatDate(new Date());
    if (s.default !== undefined && s.default !== null) return s.default;
    return s.type === 'number' ? 0 : '';
  }

  function renderField(s, record) {
    var v = fieldValue(s, record);
    if (s.type === 'select') {
      return UIC.field({ key: s.key, label: s.label, type: 'select', options: s.options, value: v });
    }
    if (s.type === 'date') {
      return UIC.field({ key: s.key, label: s.label, type: 'date', value: v, required: !!s.required });
    }
    if (s.key === 'value' && (!v || Number(v) === 0)) v = '';
    return UIC.field({ key: s.key, label: s.label, type: s.type, value: v, required: !!s.required, min: s.type === 'number' ? 0 : undefined, step: s.type === 'number' ? 'any' : undefined });
  }

  function renderForm(record) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    __canEdit = !record || IS_SUPER_ADMIN;

    var sectionsHtml = headerSections().map(function (sec) {
      var grid = '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:0 16px;">' +
        sec.fields.map(function (s) { return renderField(s, record); }).join('') + '</div>';
      return '<details' + (sec.open ? ' open' : '') + ' style="margin-bottom:12px;border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--bg-surface);">' +
        '<summary style="font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:12px;">' + sec.title + '</summary>' + grid + '</details>';
    }).join('');

    content.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="showList()">← عودة</button>' +
      '<h2 style="margin:0;">' + (record ? 'تعديل عملية شراء' : 'إضافة عملية شراء') + '</h2></div>' +
      '<form id="purchasing-form">' +
      '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;padding:16px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<div>قيمة بناءً على الفاتورة: <strong id="value_based_on_invoice_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>إجمالي التكاليف: <strong id="total_costs_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>مجموع تكاليف الأصناف: <strong id="lines_total_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>قيمة البيع: <strong id="sales_value_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>نوع الضريبة: <strong id="tax_type_display">-</strong></div>' +
      '<div>ضريبة المبيعات: <strong id="sales_tax_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>الشهر: <strong id="month_display">-</strong></div>' +
      '<div>السنة: <strong id="year_display">-</strong></div>' +
      '<div id="reconcile_warning" style="flex-basis:100%;color:var(--danger);font-weight:700;display:none;">⚠ مجموع تكاليف الأصناف لا يساوي إجمالي التكاليف</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      sectionsHtml +
      '</form>' +
      '<h3 style="margin-top:20px;">الأصناف</h3>' +
      '<div style="overflow-x:auto;">' +
      '<table class="table" style="min-width:900px;"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>المنتج</th><th>الكمية</th><th>سعر الوحدة</th><th>تكاليف أخرى</th><th>سعر البيع</th><th>نوع الحركة</th><th>الإجمالي</th>' + (__canEdit ? '<th></th>' : '') +
      '</tr></thead><tbody id="lines-tbody"></tbody></table>' +
      '</div>' +
      (__canEdit ? '<div style="margin:12px 0;"><button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="addLine()">+ إضافة صنف</button></div>' : '') +
      '<div style="margin:16px 0;">' + (__canEdit ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="savePurchasing()">حفظ</button> ' : '') +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="showList()">إلغاء</button></div>';

    var curEl = document.getElementById('currency');
    if (curEl) curEl.addEventListener('change', onCurrencyChange);

    attachCalcListeners();

    __lines = [];
    if (record) {
      companyCall('get_purchasing_lines', { parent_id: record.unique_id })
        .then(function (r) {
          __lines = (r.lines || []).map(function (l) {
            return { product: l.product, qty: l.qty, unit_price: l.unit_price, other_cost: l.other_cost, sales_value: l.sales_value, movement_type: l.movement_type };
          });
          renderLines();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
    } else {
      renderLines();
    }
  }

  function attachCalcListeners() {
    ['value','exchange_rate','type','tax_type','receipt_date','administrative_expenses','customs_expenses',
     'unloading_expenses','bank_commission','customs_clearance','additional_fees','clearance_expenses',
     'other_expenses','internal_cost_adjustment'].forEach(function (k) {
      var el = document.getElementById(k);
      if (el) { el.addEventListener('input', recalc); el.addEventListener('change', recalc); }
    });
  }

  function renderLines() {
    var lines = __lines || [];
    var opts = __options || {};
    var html = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      var l = lines[i];
      var avail = availableProducts(i);
      html += '<tr>' +
        '<td><select id="product_' + i + '" class="input" onchange="updateLineSelect(' + i + ', \'product\', this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">اختر...</option>' +
          avail.map(function (p) {
            return '<option value="' + p.value + '"' + (String(p.value) === String(l.product) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(p.label) + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.qty != null ? l.qty : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'qty\', this.value)"></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.unit_price != null ? l.unit_price : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'unit_price\', this.value)"></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.other_cost != null ? l.other_cost : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'other_cost\', this.value)"></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.sales_value != null ? l.sales_value : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'sales_value\', this.value)"></td>' +
        '<td><select id="movement_type_' + i + '" class="input" onchange="updateLineSelect(' + i + ', \'movement_type\', this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">اختر...</option>' +
          (opts.movement_type_options || []).map(function (o) {
            return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(o.fifth) + '"' + (String(o.fifth) === String(l.movement_type) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(o.code) + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
        '<td id="total_cost_' + i + '"></td>' +
        (__canEdit ? '<td><button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="removeLine(' + i + ')">حذف</button></td>' : '') +
        '</tr>';
    }
    var tbody = document.getElementById('lines-tbody');
    if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = html;
    recalc();
  }

  function availableProducts(excludeIndex) {
    var chosen = {};
    (__lines || []).forEach(function (l, i) {
      if (i !== excludeIndex && l.product) chosen[String(l.product)] = true;
    });
    return (__options.product_options || []).filter(function (p) { return !chosen[String(p.value)]; });
  }

  function addLine() {
    __lines.push({ product: '', qty: 0, unit_price: 0, other_cost: 0, sales_value: 0, movement_type: '' });
    renderLines();
  }

  function removeLine(i) {
    __lines.splice(i, 1);
    renderLines();
  }

  function updateLineInput(i, key, value) {
    __lines[i][key] = value;
    recalc();
  }

  function updateLineSelect(i, key, value) {
    __lines[i][key] = value;
    renderLines();
  }

  function recalc() {
    var headerRate = num(getVal('exchange_rate'));

    var lineSum = 0;
    (__lines || []).forEach(function (l, i) {
      var tc = num(l.qty) * num(l.unit_price) * headerRate + num(l.other_cost);
      lineSum += tc;
      setText('total_cost_' + i, FMT.number(tc));
    });
    setText('lines_total_display', FMT.number(lineSum));

    var value = num(getVal('value'));
    var vbi = value * headerRate;
    setText('value_based_on_invoice_display', FMT.number(vbi));

    var expenses = num(getVal('administrative_expenses')) + num(getVal('customs_expenses')) +
      num(getVal('unloading_expenses')) + num(getVal('bank_commission')) + num(getVal('customs_clearance')) +
      num(getVal('additional_fees')) + num(getVal('clearance_expenses')) + num(getVal('other_expenses'));
    var type = getVal('type');
    var totalCosts = vbi + expenses + (type === 'بيع' ? 0 : num(getVal('internal_cost_adjustment')) + num(getVal('purchase_tax')));
    setText('total_costs_display', FMT.number(totalCosts));

    var mismatch = Math.abs(lineSum - totalCosts) > 0.01;
    var lcEl = document.getElementById('lines_total_display');
    var tcEl = document.getElementById('total_costs_display');
    var warnEl = document.getElementById('reconcile_warning');
    if (lcEl) lcEl.style.color = mismatch ? 'var(--danger)' : '';
    if (tcEl) tcEl.style.color = mismatch ? 'var(--danger)' : '';
    if (warnEl) warnEl.style.display = mismatch ? '' : 'none';

    var salesValue = type === 'بيع' ? Math.round((totalCosts * 103 / 100) / 100) * 100 : 0;
    setText('sales_value_display', FMT.number(salesValue));

    var purchaseTax = num(getVal('purchase_tax'));
    var denom = num(getVal('importation_reprice')) + num(getVal('customs_expenses'));
    var taxType = denom > 0 ? (purchaseTax / denom >= 0.08 ? 0.14 : purchaseTax / denom) : '';
    setText('tax_type_display', taxType === '' ? '-' : taxType);
    var salesTax = (taxType === '' || num(taxType) > 0.06) ? salesValue * 14 / 100 : 0;
    setText('sales_tax_display', FMT.number(salesTax));

    var d = new Date(getVal('receipt_date'));
    if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      setText('month_display', d.getMonth() + 1);
      setText('year_display', d.getFullYear());
    } else {
      setText('month_display', '-');
      setText('year_display', '-');
    }
  }

  function onCurrencyChange() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('currency');
    if (!sel) return;
    var cur = sel.value;
    var opts = __options.currency_options || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
      if (String(opts[i].value) === String(cur)) {
        var rateEl = document.getElementById('exchange_rate');
        if (rateEl) rateEl.value = opts[i].rate;
        recalc();
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  function savePurchasing() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('purchasing-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('purchasing-form')) return;
    var header = {};
    HEADER_KEYS.forEach(function (k) { header[k] = data[k] !== undefined ? data[k] : ''; });
    if (String(header.code || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('الكود (Code) مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(header.value || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('قيمة الفاتورة (Value) مطلوبة', 'error'); return; }

    var rate = num(header.exchange_rate);
    var lineSum = 0;
    (__lines || []).forEach(function (l) { lineSum += num(l.qty) * num(l.unit_price) * rate + num(l.other_cost); });
    var vbi = num(header.value) * rate;
    var expenses = num(header.administrative_expenses) + num(header.customs_expenses) + num(header.unloading_expenses) +
      num(header.bank_commission) + num(header.customs_clearance) + num(header.additional_fees) +
      num(header.clearance_expenses) + num(header.other_expenses);
    var headerTotal = vbi + expenses + (header.type === 'بيع' ? 0 : num(header.internal_cost_adjustment) + num(header.purchase_tax));
    if (Math.abs(lineSum - headerTotal) > 0.01) { UIC.toast('مجموع الأصناف لا يساوي إجمالي التكاليف', 'error'); return; }

    var payload = { header: header, lines: __lines || [] };
    var isEdit = __editingUid ? true : false;
    if (isEdit) header.unique_id = __editingUid;

    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall(isEdit ? 'edit_purchasing' : 'add_purchasing', payload)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        showList();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function printPurchasing(uid) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_purchase_print&purchase_code=' + encodeURIComponent(uid) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function doAction(uid, action) {
    if (action === 'print') printPurchasing(uid);
    else if (action === 'approve') approvePurchasing(uid);
    else if (action === 'edit' || action === 'view') openForm(uid);
    else if (action === 'delete') deletePurchasing(uid);
  }

  function approvePurchasing(uid) {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الاعتماد...');
    companyCall('approve_purchasing', { unique_id: uid })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الاعتماد', 'success'); showList(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function deletePurchasing(uid) {
    if (!IS_SUPER_ADMIN) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذه العملية؟')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحذف...');
    companyCall('delete_purchasing', { unique_id: uid })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); showList(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function showList() {
    renderList();
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function formatDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Top Light — المبيعات</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tl-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';

  var __options = {};
  var __headers = [];
  var __lines = [];
  var __editingUid = '';
  var __canEdit = false;

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function num(v) { var n = Number(v); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
  function getVal(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; }
  function setText(id, t) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = t; }

  function load() {
    var contentId = 'tl-content';
    UIC.appShell('tl-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tl_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'القمة لايت',
      breadcrumb: 'القمة لايت / المبيعات',
      contentId: contentId
    });
    renderList();
  }

  function renderList() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_sales_headers')
      .then(function (r) {
        __options = r.options || {};
        __headers = r.headers || [];
        renderHeadersTable();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderHeadersTable() {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    __headers.sort(function (a, b) {
      return new Date(b['تاريخ الفاتورة']) - new Date(a['تاريخ الفاتورة']);
    });
    var rows = __headers.map(function (h) {
      var opts = '<option value="">إجراءات...</option>' +
        '<option value="print">طباعة</option>' +
        '<option value="release">اذن صرف منتج</option>';
      if (!h.fully_returned) {
        opts += '<option value="returns">مرتجعات</option>';
      }
      if (String(h.approval_status) !== 'Approved') {
        opts += '<option value="approve">اعتماد</option>';
        if (IS_SUPER_ADMIN) {
          opts += '<option value="edit">تعديل</option><option value="delete">حذف</option>';
        } else {
          opts += '<option value="view">عرض</option>';
        }
      }
      var actions = '<select class="input" style="padding:6px 8px;width:130px;" onchange="doAction(\'' + FMT.escape(h.invoice_unique_id) + '\', this.value); this.value=\'\';">' + opts + '</select>';
      return {
        invoice_number: h['رقم الفاتورة'] || '-',
        customer_name: h.customer_name || '-',
        invoice_date: h['تاريخ الفاتورة'] ? String(h['تاريخ الفاتورة']).slice(0, 10) : '-',
        net: FMT.number(h['المبلغ الصافي']),
        discount_percent: FMT.percent(h['نسبة الخصم']),
        discount_amount: FMT.number(h['قيمة الخصم']),
        total: FMT.number(h['إجمالي']),
        approval_status: h.approval_status || '-',
        actions: actions
      };
    });
    content.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;gap:8px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="openAnalysis()">تحليل المبيعات</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openForm(\'\')">+ إضافة فاتورة بيع</button></div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('sales-table', {
        title: 'المبيعات',
        headers: [
          { key: 'invoice_number', label: 'رقم الفاتورة' },
          { key: 'customer_name', label: 'العميل' },
          { key: 'invoice_date', label: 'تاريخ الفاتورة' },
          { key: 'net', label: 'المبلغ الصافي', numeric: true },
          { key: 'discount_percent', label: 'نسبة الخصم', numeric: true },
          { key: 'discount_amount', label: 'قيمة الخصم', numeric: true },
          { key: 'total', label: 'الإجمالي', numeric: true },
          { key: 'approval_status', label: 'الحالة' },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد فواتير بيع'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('sales-table');
  }

  function openForm(uid) {
    __editingUid = uid || '';
    var record = null;
    if (uid) {
      record = __headers.find(function (h) { return String(h.invoice_unique_id) === String(uid); }) || null;
    }
    renderForm(record);
  }

  function renderForm(record) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    __canEdit = !record || IS_SUPER_ADMIN;

    var o = __options;
    var custId = record ? String(record['اسم العميل']) : '';
    var invoiceDate = record ? formatDate(record['تاريخ الفاتورة']) : formatDate(new Date());
    var discount = record ? String(record['نسبة الخصم']) : '0';
    var taxSystem = record ? String(record.tax_system) : 'false';

    content.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="showList()">← عودة</button>' +
      '<h2 style="margin:0;">' + (record ? 'تعديل فاتورة بيع' : 'إضافة فاتورة بيع') + '</h2></div>' +
      '<form id="sales-form">' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:0 16px;padding:16px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'customer_id', label: 'اسم العميل *', type: 'select', options: o.customer_options || [], value: custId, required: true, placeholder: 'اختر العميل...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'invoice_date', label: 'تاريخ الفاتورة *', type: 'date', value: invoiceDate, required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'discount_percent', label: 'نسبة الخصم', type: 'select', options: o.discount_options || [], value: discount }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'tax_system', label: 'النظام الضريبي', type: 'select', options: [{ value: 'false', label: 'لا' }, { value: 'true', label: 'نعم' }], value: taxSystem }) +
      '</div>' +
      '<div id="customer_info" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<span>رقم التسجيل الضريبي: <strong id="c_tax_id">-</strong></span>' +
      '<span>رقم الموبيل: <strong id="c_telephone">-</strong></span>' +
      '<span>العنوان: <strong id="c_address">-</strong></span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;padding:16px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<div>المبلغ الصافي: <strong id="net_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>قيمة الخصم: <strong id="discount_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>قيمة الضريبة: <strong id="tax_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>الإجمالي: <strong id="total_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '</form>' +
      '<h3 style="margin-top:20px;">الأصناف</h3>' +
      '<div style="overflow-x:auto;">' +
      '<table class="table" style="min-width:900px;"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>المنتج</th><th>الكمية</th><th>السعر</th><th>نسبة الضريبة</th><th>الخصم</th><th>الإجمالي</th>' + (__canEdit ? '<th></th>' : '') +
      '</tr></thead><tbody id="lines-tbody"></tbody></table>' +
      '</div>' +
      (__canEdit ? '<div style="margin:12px 0;"><button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="addLine()">+ إضافة صنف</button></div>' : '') +
      '<div style="margin:16px 0;">' + (__canEdit ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveSales()">حفظ</button> ' : '') +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="showList()">إلغاء</button></div>';

    var custEl = document.getElementById('customer_id');
    if (custEl) custEl.addEventListener('change', onCustomerChange);
    var discEl = document.getElementById('discount_percent');
    if (discEl) { discEl.addEventListener('change', recalc); discEl.addEventListener('input', recalc); }

    if (custId) onCustomerChange();

    __lines = [];
    if (record) {
      companyCall('get_sales_lines', { parent_id: record.invoice_unique_id })
        .then(function (r) {
          __lines = (r.lines || []).map(function (l) {
            return { product_id: l.product_id, product_qty: l.product_qty, product_price: l.product_price, product_tax: l.product_tax, product_discount: l.product_discount };
          });
          renderLines();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
    } else {
      renderLines();
    }
  }

  function onCustomerChange() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('customer_id');
    if (!sel) return;
    var opts = __options.customer_options || [];
    var found = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
      if (String(opts[i].value) === String(sel.value)) { found = opts[i]; break; }
    }
    setText('c_tax_id', found && found.tax_id ? found.tax_id : '-');
    setText('c_telephone', found && found.telephone ? found.telephone : '-');
    setText('c_address', found && found.address ? found.address : '-');
  }

  function renderLines() {
    var lines = __lines || [];
    var opts = __options || {};
    var html = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      var l = lines[i];
      html += '<tr>' +
        '<td><select id="product_id_' + i + '" class="input" onchange="updateLineSelect(' + i + ', \'product_id\', this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">اختر...</option>' +
          (opts.product_options || []).map(function (p) {
            return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(p.value) + '"' + (String(p.value) === String(l.product_id) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(p.label) + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.product_qty != null ? l.product_qty : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'product_qty\', this.value)">' +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);">متاح: ' + availableQty(i) + '</div></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.product_price != null ? l.product_price : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'product_price\', this.value)"></td>' +
        '<td><select id="product_tax_' + i + '" class="input" onchange="updateLineSelect(' + i + ', \'product_tax\', this.value)">' +
          (opts.product_tax_options || []).map(function (t) {
            return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(t.value) + '"' + (String(t.value) === String(l.product_tax) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(t.label) + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.product_discount != null ? l.product_discount : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'product_discount\', this.value)"></td>' +
        '<td id="line_total_' + i + '"></td>' +
        (__canEdit ? '<td><button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="removeLine(' + i + ')">حذف</button></td>' : '') +
        '</tr>';
    }
    var tbody = document.getElementById('lines-tbody');
    if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = html;
    recalc();
  }

  function addLine() {
    __lines.push({ product_id: '', product_qty: 0, product_price: 0, product_tax: 0, product_discount: 0 });
    renderLines();
  }

  function removeLine(i) {
    __lines.splice(i, 1);
    renderLines();
  }

  function updateLineInput(i, key, value) {
    __lines[i][key] = value;
    recalc();
  }

  function findProductOption(value) {
    var opts = __options.product_options || [];
    for (var k = 0; k < opts.length; k++) {
      if (String(opts[k].value) === String(value)) return opts[k];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function availableQty(i) {
    var opt = findProductOption(__lines[i].product_id);
    return opt && opt.current_qty != null ? opt.current_qty : 0;
  }

  function updateLineSelect(i, key, value) {
    __lines[i][key] = value;
    if (key === 'product_id') {
      var opt = findProductOption(value);
      if (opt) __lines[i].product_price = opt.default_price != null ? opt.default_price : 0;
    }
    renderLines();
  }

  function recalc() {
    var discountPercent = num(getVal('discount_percent'));
    var net = 0, lineDiscount = 0, tax = 0;
    (__lines || []).forEach(function (l, i) {
      var nv = num(l.product_qty) * num(l.product_price);
      net += nv;
      lineDiscount += num(l.product_discount);
      tax += nv * num(l.product_tax);
      setText('line_total_' + i, FMT.number(nv - num(l.product_discount) + nv * num(l.product_tax)));
    });
    var discountAmount = lineDiscount + net * discountPercent;
    var total = net - discountAmount + tax;
    setText('net_display', FMT.number(net));
    setText('discount_display', FMT.number(discountAmount));
    setText('tax_display', FMT.number(tax));
    setText('total_display', FMT.number(total));
  }

  function saveSales() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('sales-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('sales-form')) return;

    var header = {
      customer_id: data.customer_id,
      invoice_date: data.invoice_date,
      discount_percent: data.discount_percent,
      tax_system: data.tax_system
    };
    if (String(header.customer_id || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('اسم العميل مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(header.invoice_date || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('تاريخ الفاتورة مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (!(__lines || []).length) { UIC.toast('يجب إضافة صنف واحد على الأقل', 'error'); return; }

    for (var i = 0; i < __lines.length; i++) {
      var l = __lines[i];
      if (String(l.product_id == null ? '' : l.product_id).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('المنتج مطلوب لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(l.product_tax == null ? '' : l.product_tax).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('نسبة الضريبة مطلوبة لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(l.product_qty == null ? '' : l.product_qty).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('الكمية مطلوبة لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(l.product_price == null ? '' : l.product_price).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('السعر مطلوب لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(l.product_discount == null ? '' : l.product_discount).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('الخصم مطلوب لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (num(l.product_qty) <= 0) { UIC.toast('الكمية يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر', 'error'); return; }
      if (num(l.product_price) <= 0) { UIC.toast('السعر يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر', 'error'); return; }
      var avail = availableQty(i);
      if (num(l.product_qty) > avail) { UIC.toast('الكمية تتجاوز الرصيد المتاح (المتاح: ' + avail + ')', 'error'); return; }
    }

    var payload = { header: header, lines: __lines || [] };
    var isEdit = __editingUid ? true : false;
    if (isEdit) header.unique_id = __editingUid;

    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall(isEdit ? 'edit_sales' : 'add_sales', payload)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        showList();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function printSales(uid) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_sales_print&purchase_code=' + encodeURIComponent(uid) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function openReturns(uid) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_sales_returns&purchase_code=' + encodeURIComponent(uid) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function openRelease(uid) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_sales_release&purchase_code=' + encodeURIComponent(uid) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function openAnalysis() {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_sales_analysis&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function doAction(uid, action) {
    if (action === 'print') printSales(uid);
    else if (action === 'release') openRelease(uid);
    else if (action === 'returns') openReturns(uid);
    else if (action === 'approve') approveSales(uid);
    else if (action === 'edit' || action === 'view') openForm(uid);
    else if (action === 'delete') deleteSales(uid);
  }

  function approveSales(uid) {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الاعتماد...');
    companyCall('approve_sales', { unique_id: uid })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الاعتماد', 'success'); showList(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function deleteSales(uid) {
    if (!IS_SUPER_ADMIN) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذه الفاتورة؟')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحذف...');
    companyCall('delete_sales', { unique_id: uid })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); showList(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function showList() {
    renderList();
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function formatDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

// ==== Company_TopLight_Sales_Analysis.html ====
// ============================================================

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Top Light — تحليل المبيعات</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
  <style>
    @media print {
      .topbar, .breadcrumb, .no-print { display: none !important; }
      body { background: #ffffff !important; }
    }
    .kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .kpi { background: var(--bg-surface); border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; }
    .kpi-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .kpi-value { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; }
    .inv-link { color: #0369a1; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tl-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
  var __options = { customer_options: [], product_options: [] };

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    UIC.appShell('tl-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tl_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'القمة لايت',
      breadcrumb: 'القمة لايت / تحليل المبيعات',
      contentId: 'tl-content'
    });
    fetchData();
  }

  function filterPayload() {
    return {
      date_from: document.getElementById('f_from') ? document.getElementById('f_from').value : '',
      date_to: document.getElementById('f_to') ? document.getElementById('f_to').value : '',
      customer_id: document.getElementById('f_customer') ? document.getElementById('f_customer').value : '',
      product_id: document.getElementById('f_product') ? document.getElementById('f_product').value : ''
    };
  }

  var __filtersBuilt = false;

  function fetchData() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_sales_analysis', filterPayload())
      .then(function (r) {
        __options.customer_options = r.customer_options || [];
        __options.product_options = r.product_options || [];
        var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
        if (!__filtersBuilt) {
          content.innerHTML = renderFilters() + '<div id="results"></div>';
          __filtersBuilt = true;
        }
        renderResults(r.rows || [], r.totals || {});
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderFilters() {
    return '<div class="no-print" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:16px;padding:12px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:2px solid #111111;border-radius:8px;">' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_from">من تاريخ</label><input id="f_from" class="input" type="date" onchange="fetchData()"></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_to">إلى تاريخ</label><input id="f_to" class="input" type="date" onchange="fetchData()"></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_customer">العميل</label>' +
      '<select id="f_customer" class="input" onchange="fetchData()"><option value="">الكل</option>' + (__options.customer_options || []).map(function (c) { return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(c.value) + '">' + FMT.escape(c.label) + '</option>'; }).join('') + '</select></div>' +
      '<div class="form-field" style="margin:0;"><label class="form-label" for="f_product">المنتج</label>' +
      '<select id="f_product" class="input" onchange="fetchData()"><option value="">الكل</option>' + (__options.product_options || []).map(function (p) { return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(p.value) + '">' + FMT.escape(p.label) + '</option>'; }).join('') + '</select></div>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="window.print()">طباعة</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function renderResults(rows, totals) {
    var el = document.getElementById('results');
    if (!el) return;

    var kpis =
      '<div class="kpis">' +
      kpi('المبيعات قبل الخصم والمرتجع', totals.net_amount) +
      kpi('إجمالي الخصومات', totals.discount) +
      kpi('إجمالي المرتجعات', totals.net_return) +
      kpi('إجمالي الضرائب', totals.tax) +
      kpi('صافي قيمة المبيعات المتبقية', totals.net_collection) +
      '</div>';

    var tbody = rows.map(function (r) {
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td><span class="inv-link" onclick="showInvoice(\'' + FMT.escape(r.invoice_unique_id) + '\')">' + FMT.escape(r.code || '-') + '</span></td>' +
        '<td>' + fmtDate(r.date) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(r.customer_name || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(r.net_return) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(r.net_amount) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(r.discount) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(r.tax) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(r.net_collection) + '</td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    var totalRow = '<tr style="font-weight:700;background:#fef08a;">' +
      '<td colspan="3">الإجمالي المالي المجمع</td>' +
      '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(totals.net_return) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(totals.net_amount) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(totals.discount) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(totals.tax) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(totals.net_collection) + '</td>' +
      '</tr>';

    el.innerHTML =
      kpis +
      '<div class="table-wrap" style="border:2px solid #111111;overflow-x:auto;">' +
      '<table class="table" style="min-width:1000px;"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>كود السند</th><th>تاريخ الحركة</th><th>اسم العميل</th><th>صافي المرتجع</th><th>المبلغ الصافي</th><th>الخصومات</th><th>الضرائب</th><th>صافي التحصيل الفعلي</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + tbody + totalRow + '</tbody></table>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function kpi(label, value) {
    return '<div class="kpi"><div class="kpi-label">' + FMT.escape(label) + '</div><div class="kpi-value num">' + FMT.number(value) + '</div></div>';
  }

  function showInvoice(uid) {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري تحميل الفاتورة...');
    companyCall('get_sales_print', { sales_code: uid })
      .then(function (r) {
        var h = r.header;
        var lines = (r.lines || []).map(function (l) {
          return '<tr><td>' + FMT.escape(l.product_name || '-') + '</td><td class="num">' + FMT.number(l.product_qty) + '</td><td class="num">' + FMT.number(l.product_price) + '</td><td class="num">' + FMT.number(l.product_total_value) + '</td></tr>';
        }).join('');
        var body =
          '<div class="invoice-meta" style="margin-bottom:12px;">' +
          '<div><strong>رقم الفاتورة:</strong> ' + FMT.escape(h['رقم الفاتورة'] || '-') + '</div>' +
          '<div><strong>العميل:</strong> ' + FMT.escape(h.customer_name || '-') + '</div>' +
          '<div><strong>المبلغ الصافي:</strong> <span class="num">' + FMT.number(h['المبلغ الصافي']) + '</span></div>' +
          '<div><strong>قيمة الخصم:</strong> <span class="num">' + FMT.number(h['قيمة الخصم']) + '</span></div>' +
          '<div><strong>قيمة الضريبة:</strong> <span class="num">' + FMT.number(h['قيمة الضريبة']) + '</span></div>' +
          '<div><strong>الإجمالي:</strong> <span class="num">' + FMT.number(h['إجمالي']) + '</span></div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<table class="table" style="min-width:400px;"><thead><tr><th>المنتج</th><th>الكمية</th><th>السعر</th><th>الإجمالي</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + lines + '</tbody></table>';
        UIC.openModal('invoice-modal', { title: 'فاتورة بيع', body: body, footer: false });
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function fmtDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '-';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB');
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>





// ============================================================
// ==== Company_TopLight_Sales_Offer.html ====
// ============================================================

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Top Light — عروض الأسعار</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tl-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
  var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';

  var __options = {};
  var __headers = [];
  var __lines = [];
  var __editingUid = '';
  var __canEdit = false;

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function num(v) { var n = Number(v); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
  function getVal(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; }
  function setText(id, t) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = t; }

  function load() {
    UIC.appShell('tl-root', {
      companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
      companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=tl_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
      companyLogoTitle: 'القمة لايت',
      breadcrumb: 'القمة لايت / عروض الأسعار',
      contentId: 'tl-content'
    });
    renderList();
  }

  function renderList() {
    UI.showSpinner();
    companyCall('get_sales_offer_headers')
      .then(function (r) {
        __options = r.options || {};
        __headers = r.headers || [];
        renderHeadersTable();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { showError(e); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function renderHeadersTable() {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    __headers.sort(function (a, b) {
      return new Date(b['تاريخ الفاتورة']) - new Date(a['تاريخ الفاتورة']);
    });
    var rows = __headers.map(function (h) {
      var opts = '<option value="">إجراءات...</option>' +
        '<option value="print">طباعة</option>';
      if (String(h.approval_status) !== 'Approved') {
        opts += '<option value="approve">اعتماد</option>';
        if (IS_SUPER_ADMIN) {
          opts += '<option value="edit">تعديل</option><option value="delete">حذف</option>';
        } else {
          opts += '<option value="view">عرض</option>';
        }
      }
      var actions = '<select class="input" style="padding:6px 8px;width:130px;" onchange="doAction(\'' + FMT.escape(h.invoice_unique_id) + '\', this.value); this.value=\'\';">' + opts + '</select>';
      return {
        invoice_number: h['رقم الفاتورة'] || '-',
        customer_name: h.customer_name || '-',
        invoice_date: h['تاريخ الفاتورة'] ? String(h['تاريخ الفاتورة']).slice(0, 10) : '-',
        net: FMT.number(h['المبلغ الصافي']),
        discount_percent: FMT.percent(h['نسبة الخصم']),
        discount_amount: FMT.number(h['قيمة الخصم']),
        total: FMT.number(h['إجمالي']),
        approval_status: h.approval_status || '-',
        actions: actions
      };
    });
    content.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openForm(\'\')">+ إضافة عرض سعر</button></div>' +
      UIC.dataTable('offer-table', {
        title: 'عروض الأسعار',
        headers: [
          { key: 'invoice_number', label: 'رقم العرض' },
          { key: 'customer_name', label: 'العميل' },
          { key: 'invoice_date', label: 'تاريخ العرض' },
          { key: 'net', label: 'المبلغ الصافي', numeric: true },
          { key: 'discount_percent', label: 'نسبة الخصم', numeric: true },
          { key: 'discount_amount', label: 'قيمة الخصم', numeric: true },
          { key: 'total', label: 'الإجمالي', numeric: true },
          { key: 'approval_status', label: 'الحالة' },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد عروض أسعار'
      });
    UIC.initTableSort('offer-table');
  }

  function openForm(uid) {
    __editingUid = uid || '';
    var record = null;
    if (uid) {
      record = __headers.find(function (h) { return String(h.invoice_unique_id) === String(uid); }) || null;
    }
    renderForm(record);
  }

  function renderForm(record) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    __canEdit = !record || IS_SUPER_ADMIN;

    var o = __options;
    var custId = record ? String(record['اسم العميل']) : '';
    var invoiceDate = record ? formatDate(record['تاريخ الفاتورة']) : formatDate(new Date());
    var discount = record ? String(record['نسبة الخصم']) : '0';
    var taxSystem = record ? String(record.tax_system) : 'false';

    content.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="showList()">← عودة</button>' +
      '<h2 style="margin:0;">' + (record ? 'تعديل عرض سعر' : 'إضافة عرض سعر') + '</h2></div>' +
      '<form id="offer-form">' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:0 16px;padding:16px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:2px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      UIC.field({ key: 'customer_id', label: 'اسم العميل *', type: 'select', options: o.customer_options || [], value: custId, required: true, placeholder: 'اختر العميل...' }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'invoice_date', label: 'تاريخ العرض *', type: 'date', value: invoiceDate, required: true }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'discount_percent', label: 'نسبة الخصم', type: 'select', options: o.discount_options || [], value: discount }) +
      UIC.field({ key: 'tax_system', label: 'النظام الضريبي', type: 'select', options: [{ value: 'false', label: 'لا' }, { value: 'true', label: 'نعم' }], value: taxSystem }) +
      '</div>' +
      '<div id="customer_info" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border:2px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<span>رقم التسجيل الضريبي: <strong id="c_tax_id">-</strong></span>' +
      '<span>رقم الموبيل: <strong id="c_telephone">-</strong></span>' +
      '<span>العنوان: <strong id="c_address">-</strong></span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;padding:16px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:2px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<div>المبلغ الصافي: <strong id="net_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>قيمة الخصم: <strong id="discount_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>قيمة الضريبة: <strong id="tax_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '<div>الإجمالي: <strong id="total_display">0</strong></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '</form>' +
      '<h3 style="margin-top:20px;">الأصناف</h3>' +
      '<div style="overflow-x:auto;">' +
      '<table class="table" style="min-width:900px;"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>المنتج</th><th>الكمية</th><th>السعر</th><th>نسبة الضريبة</th><th>الخصم</th><th>الإجمالي</th>' + (__canEdit ? '<th></th>' : '') +
      '</tr></thead><tbody id="lines-tbody"></tbody></table>' +
      '</div>' +
      (__canEdit ? '<div style="margin:12px 0;"><button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="addLine()">+ إضافة صنف</button></div>' : '') +
      '<div style="margin:16px 0;">' + (__canEdit ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveOffer()">حفظ</button> ' : '') +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="showList()">إلغاء</button></div>';

    var custEl = document.getElementById('customer_id');
    if (custEl) custEl.addEventListener('change', onCustomerChange);
    var discEl = document.getElementById('discount_percent');
    if (discEl) { discEl.addEventListener('change', recalc); discEl.addEventListener('input', recalc); }

    if (custId) onCustomerChange();

    __lines = [];
    if (record) {
      companyCall('get_sales_offer_lines', { parent_id: record.invoice_unique_id })
        .then(function (r) {
          __lines = (r.lines || []).map(function (l) {
            return { product_id: l.product_id, product_qty: l.product_qty, product_price: l.product_price, product_tax: l.product_tax, product_discount: l.product_discount };
          });
          renderLines();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
    } else {
      renderLines();
    }
  }

  function onCustomerChange() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('customer_id');
    if (!sel) return;
    var opts = __options.customer_options || [];
    var found = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
      if (String(opts[i].value) === String(sel.value)) { found = opts[i]; break; }
    }
    setText('c_tax_id', found && found.tax_id ? found.tax_id : '-');
    setText('c_telephone', found && found.telephone ? found.telephone : '-');
    setText('c_address', found && found.address ? found.address : '-');
  }

  function renderLines() {
    var lines = __lines || [];
    var opts = __options || {};
    var html = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      var l = lines[i];
      html += '<tr>' +
        '<td><select id="product_id_' + i + '" class="input" onchange="updateLineSelect(' + i + ', \'product_id\', this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">اختر...</option>' +
          (opts.product_options || []).map(function (p) {
            return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(p.value) + '"' + (String(p.value) === String(l.product_id) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(p.label) + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.product_qty != null ? l.product_qty : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'product_qty\', this.value)">' +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);">متاح: ' + availableQty(i) + '</div></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.product_price != null ? l.product_price : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'product_price\', this.value)"></td>' +
        '<td><select id="product_tax_' + i + '" class="input" onchange="updateLineSelect(' + i + ', \'product_tax\', this.value)">' +
          (opts.product_tax_options || []).map(function (t) {
            return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(t.value) + '"' + (String(t.value) === String(l.product_tax) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + FMT.escape(t.label) + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
        '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.product_discount != null ? l.product_discount : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'product_discount\', this.value)"></td>' +
        '<td id="line_total_' + i + '"></td>' +
        (__canEdit ? '<td><button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="removeLine(' + i + ')">حذف</button></td>' : '') +
        '</tr>';
    }
    var tbody = document.getElementById('lines-tbody');
    if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = html;
    recalc();
  }

  function addLine() {
    __lines.push({ product_id: '', product_qty: 0, product_price: 0, product_tax: 0, product_discount: 0 });
    renderLines();
  }

  function removeLine(i) {
    __lines.splice(i, 1);
    renderLines();
  }

  function updateLineInput(i, key, value) {
    __lines[i][key] = value;
    recalc();
  }

  function findProductOption(value) {
    var opts = __options.product_options || [];
    for (var k = 0; k < opts.length; k++) {
      if (String(opts[k].value) === String(value)) return opts[k];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function availableQty(i) {
    var opt = findProductOption(__lines[i].product_id);
    return opt && opt.current_qty != null ? opt.current_qty : 0;
  }

  function updateLineSelect(i, key, value) {
    __lines[i][key] = value;
    if (key === 'product_id') {
      var opt = findProductOption(value);
      if (opt) __lines[i].product_price = opt.default_price != null ? opt.default_price : 0;
    }
    renderLines();
  }

  function recalc() {
    var discountPercent = num(getVal('discount_percent'));
    var net = 0, lineDiscount = 0, tax = 0;
    (__lines || []).forEach(function (l, i) {
      var nv = num(l.product_qty) * num(l.product_price);
      net += nv;
      lineDiscount += num(l.product_discount);
      tax += nv * num(l.product_tax);
      setText('line_total_' + i, FMT.number(nv - num(l.product_discount) + nv * num(l.product_tax)));
    });
    var discountAmount = lineDiscount + net * discountPercent;
    var total = net - discountAmount + tax;
    setText('net_display', FMT.number(net));
    setText('discount_display', FMT.number(discountAmount));
    setText('tax_display', FMT.number(tax));
    setText('total_display', FMT.number(total));
  }

  function saveOffer() {
    var data = UIC.collectForm('offer-form');
    if (!UIC.validateForm('offer-form')) return;

    var header = {
      customer_id: data.customer_id,
      invoice_date: data.invoice_date,
      discount_percent: data.discount_percent,
      tax_system: data.tax_system
    };
    if (String(header.customer_id || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('اسم العميل مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(header.invoice_date || '').trim() === '') { UIC.toast('تاريخ العرض مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (!(__lines || []).length) { UIC.toast('يجب إضافة صنف واحد على الأقل', 'error'); return; }

    for (var i = 0; i < __lines.length; i++) {
      var l = __lines[i];
      if (String(l.product_id == null ? '' : l.product_id).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('المنتج مطلوب لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(l.product_tax == null ? '' : l.product_tax).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('نسبة الضريبة مطلوبة لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(l.product_qty == null ? '' : l.product_qty).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('الكمية مطلوبة لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(l.product_price == null ? '' : l.product_price).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('السعر مطلوب لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(l.product_discount == null ? '' : l.product_discount).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('الخصم مطلوب لكل صنف', 'error'); return; }
      if (num(l.product_qty) <= 0) { UIC.toast('الكمية يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر', 'error'); return; }
      if (num(l.product_price) <= 0) { UIC.toast('السعر يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر', 'error'); return; }
      var avail = availableQty(i);
      if (num(l.product_qty) > avail) { UIC.toast('الكمية تتجاوز الرصيد المتاح (المتاح: ' + avail + ')', 'error'); return; }
    }

    var payload = { header: header, lines: __lines || [] };
    var isEdit = __editingUid ? true : false;
    if (isEdit) header.unique_id = __editingUid;

    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall(isEdit ? 'edit_sales_offer' : 'add_sales_offer', payload)
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        showList();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function printOffer(uid) {
    window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=tl_sales_offer_print&purchase_code=' + encodeURIComponent(uid) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
  }

  function doAction(uid, action) {
    if (action === 'print') printOffer(uid);
    else if (action === 'approve') approveOffer(uid);
    else if (action === 'edit' || action === 'view') openForm(uid);
    else if (action === 'delete') deleteOffer(uid);
  }

  function approveOffer(uid) {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الاعتماد...');
    companyCall('approve_sales_offer', { unique_id: uid })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الاعتماد', 'success'); showList(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function deleteOffer(uid) {
    if (!IS_SUPER_ADMIN) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذا العرض؟')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحذف...');
    companyCall('delete_sales_offer', { unique_id: uid })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); showList(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function showList() {
    renderList();
  }

  function showError(e) {
    var content = document.getElementById('tl-content');
    if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
  }

  function formatDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  function logout() {
    API.clearSession();
    window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    .invoice-title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brand-primary); }
    .invoice-meta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 8px 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; }

<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var salesCode = '<?!= purchaseCode ?>';
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function load() {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري تحميل فاتورة البيع...');
    companyCall('get_sales_print', { sales_code: salesCode })
      .then(function (r) { renderInvoice(r.header, r.lines, r.returns, r.total_return_value); })
      .catch(function (e) {
        document.getElementById('invoice-root').innerHTML =
          '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function buildReturnMap(returns) {
    var map = {};
    (returns || []).forEach(function (r) {
      var k = String(r.product_id);
      if (!map[k]) map[k] = { qty: 0, value: 0 };
      map[k].qty += Number(r.return_qty) || 0;
      map[k].value += Number(r.return_value) || 0;
    });
    return map;
  }

  function releaseNumber(invNo) {
    var m = String(invNo == null ? '' : invNo).trim().match(/^(\d+)-(\d+)$/);
    if (m) return String(parseInt(m[1] + m[2], 10) + 10000);
    return invNo == null ? '' : invNo;
  }

  function renderInvoice(h, lines, returns, totalReturnValue) {
    var root = document.getElementById('invoice-root');
    var retMap = buildReturnMap(returns);
    var rows = (lines || []).map(function (l) {
      var rt = retMap[String(l.product_id)] || { qty: 0, value: 0 };
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td>' + FMT.escape(l.product_name || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="num">' + FMT.number(l.product_qty) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><span class="num">' + (rt.qty > 0 ? '-' + FMT.number(rt.qty) : '-') + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><span class="num">' + FMT.number(l.product_price) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><span class="num">' + FMT.percent(l.product_tax) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><span class="num">' + FMT.number(l.product_discount) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><span class="num">' + FMT.number(l.product_total_value) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><span class="num">' + (rt.value > 0 ? '-' + FMT.number(rt.value) : '-') + '</span></td>' +
        '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    var total = Number(h['إجمالي']) || 0;
    var retTotal = Number(totalReturnValue) || 0;
    var returnRows = '';
    if (retTotal > 0) {
      returnRows =
        '<div class="row" style="color:var(--danger);"><span>قيمة المرتجعات</span><span class="num">-' + FMT.number(retTotal) + '</span></div>' +
        '<div class="row total"><span>الصافي بعد المرتجعات</span><span class="num">' + FMT.number(total - retTotal) + '</span></div>';
    }

    var html =
      '<div class="no-print" style="max-width:900px;margin:12px auto;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;">' +
      '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="window.print()">طباعة</button>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="try{window.top.close()}catch(e){window.close()}">إغلاق</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="invoice">' +
      '<div class="invoice-head">' +
      '<img src="' + (COMPANY_LOGO_URL || '') + '" style="height:42px;" alt="">' +
      '<div class="invoice-title">فاتورة بيع</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="invoice-meta">' +
      metaItem('رقم الفاتورة', releaseNumber(h['رقم الفاتورة'])) +
      metaItem('تاريخ الفاتورة', h['تاريخ الفاتورة'] ? String(h['تاريخ الفاتورة']).slice(0, 10) : '-') +
      metaItem('العميل', h.customer_name) +
      metaItem('رقم التسجيل الضريبي للعميل', h['رقم التسجيل الضريبي للعميل']) +
      metaItem('رقم الموبيل', h['رقم الموبيل']) +
      metaItem('العنوان', h['العنوان']) +
      metaItem('نسبة الخصم', FMT.percent(h['نسبة الخصم'])) +
      '</div>' +
      '<table class="inv-table"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>المنتج</th><th>الكمية</th><th>كمية المرتجع</th><th>السعر</th><th>الضريبة</th><th>الخصم</th><th>الإجمالي</th><th>قيمة المرتجع</th>' +
      '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>' +
      '<div class="inv-totals">' +
      '<div class="row"><span>المبلغ الصافي</span><span class="num">' + FMT.number(h['المبلغ الصافي']) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="row"><span>قيمة الخصم</span><span class="num">' + FMT.number(h['قيمة الخصم']) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="row"><span>قيمة الضريبة</span><span class="num">' + FMT.number(h['قيمة الضريبة']) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="row"><span>الإجمالي</span><span class="num">' + FMT.number(h['إجمالي']) + '</span></div>' +
      returnRows +
      '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    root.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function metaItem(label, value) {
    return '<div class="meta-item"><strong>' + label + ':</strong> ' + FMT.escape(value == null || value === '' ? '-' : value) + '</div>';
  }

  load();
</script>

    return invNo == null ? '' : invNo;

  function load() {

          '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });

  function render(h, lines) {

    }).join('');

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>مرتجعات المبيعات</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>
</head>
<body>
<div id="returns-root" dir="rtl"></div>
<script>
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
  var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
  var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
  var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('8df5c89a117fe9a5') ?>';
  var invoiceId = '<?!= purchaseCode ?>';

  var __data = { invoice: null, products: [], returns: [] };

  function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
    return API.call('company_action', {
      target_system: '8df5c89a117fe9a5',
      module_action: moduleAction,
      data: data || {}
    }, SESSION_TOKEN);
  }

  function num(v) { var n = Number(v); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
  function getVal(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; }

  function load() {
    UI.showSpinner('جاري تحميل المرتجعات...');
    companyCall('get_sales_returns', { invoice_id: invoiceId })
      .then(function (r) { __data = r; render(); })
      .catch(function (e) {
        document.getElementById('returns-root').innerHTML =
          '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + FMT.escape(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
      })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function render() {
    var root = document.getElementById('returns-root');
    var inv = __data.invoice || {};

    var availProducts = (__data.products || []).filter(function (p) { return p.available_qty > 0; });

    var returnsRows = (__data.returns || []).map(function (r) {
      var del = IS_SUPER_ADMIN ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="deleteReturn(\'' + FMT.escape(r.unique_id) + '\')">حذف</button>' : '';
      return {
        product_name: r.product_name || '-',
        return_qty: FMT.number(r.return_qty),
        return_price: FMT.number(r.return_price),
        return_discount: FMT.number(r.return_discount),
        return_value: FMT.number(r.return_value),
        return_date: r.return_date ? String(r.return_date).slice(0, 10) : '-',
        actions: del
      };
    });

    var addForm = '';
    if (availProducts.length) {
      var prodOptions = availProducts.map(function (p) {
        return '<option value="' + FMT.escape(p.product_id) + '">' + FMT.escape(p.product_name) + '</option>';
      }).join('');
      addForm =
        '<div style="background:var(--bg-surface);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
        '<h3 style="margin:0 0 12px;">إضافة مرتجع</h3>' +
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:0 16px;">' +
        '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="ret_product">المنتج *</label>' +
        '<select id="ret_product" class="input" onchange="onProductChange()"><option value="">اختر...</option>' + prodOptions + '</select></div>' +
        '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="ret_qty">كمية المرتجع *</label>' +
        '<input id="ret_qty" class="input" type="number" min="1" step="any" oninput="onProductChange()"></div>' +
        '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label" for="ret_date">تاريخ المرتجع *</label>' +
        '<input id="ret_date" class="input" type="date" value="' + formatDate(new Date()) + '"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="ret_avail" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:8px;">المتاح: 0</div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addReturn()">حفظ المرتجع</button></div>' +
        '</div>';
    }

    var html =
      '<div style="max-width:960px;margin:12px auto;padding:0 16px;">' +
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<img src="' + (COMPANY_LOGO_URL || '') + '" style="height:34px;" alt="">' +
      '<h2 style="margin:0;flex:1;">مرتجعات المبيعات</h2>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="try{window.top.close()}catch(e){window.close()}">إغلاق</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--bg-subtle);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
      '<span>رقم الفاتورة: <strong>' + FMT.escape(inv.invoice_number || '-') + '</strong></span>' +
      '<span>العميل: <strong>' + FMT.escape(inv.customer_name || '-') + '</strong></span>' +
      '<span>تاريخ الفاتورة: <strong>' + (inv.invoice_date ? String(inv.invoice_date).slice(0, 10) : '-') + '</strong></span>' +
      '<span>المبلغ الصافي: <strong>' + FMT.number(inv.net) + '</strong></span>' +
      '<span>قيمة الخصم: <strong>' + FMT.number(inv.discount_value) + '</strong></span>' +
      '</div>' +
      addForm +
      UIC.dataTable('returns-table', {
        title: 'المرتجعات المسجلة',
        headers: [
          { key: 'product_name', label: 'المنتج' },
          { key: 'return_qty', label: 'الكمية', numeric: true },
          { key: 'return_price', label: 'السعر', numeric: true },
          { key: 'return_discount', label: 'الخصم', numeric: true },
          { key: 'return_value', label: 'القيمة', numeric: true },
          { key: 'return_date', label: 'التاريخ' },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: returnsRows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد مرتجعات مسجلة'
      }) +
      '</div>';

    root.innerHTML = html;
    UIC.initTableSort('returns-table');
  }

  function onProductChange() {
    var pid = getVal('ret_product');
    var qty = num(getVal('ret_qty'));
    var avail = availableQty(pid);
    var el = document.getElementById('ret_avail');
    if (el) el.textContent = 'المتاح: ' + avail;
    if (qty > avail && avail > 0) {
      if (el) { el.style.color = 'var(--danger)'; el.textContent = 'المتاح: ' + avail + ' — الكمية تتجاوز المتاح'; }
    } else if (el) {
      el.style.color = '';
    }
  }

  function availableQty(pid) {
    var p = (__data.products || []).find(function (x) { return String(x.product_id) === String(pid); });
    return p ? p.available_qty : 0;
  }

  function addReturn() {
    var product_id = getVal('ret_product');
    var return_qty = num(getVal('ret_qty'));
    var return_date = getVal('ret_date');
    if (!product_id) { UIC.toast('اختر المنتج', 'error'); return; }
    if (String(return_date).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('تاريخ المرتجع مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
    if (return_qty <= 0) { UIC.toast('كمية المرتجع يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر', 'error'); return; }
    var avail = availableQty(product_id);
    if (return_qty > avail) { UIC.toast('الكمية تتجاوز المتاح (المتاح: ' + avail + ')', 'error'); return; }

    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
    companyCall('add_sales_return', { invoice_id: invoiceId, product_id: product_id, return_qty: return_qty, return_date: return_date })
      .then(function (r) {
        UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        load();
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function deleteReturn(uid) {
    if (!IS_SUPER_ADMIN) { UIC.toast('غير مصرح', 'error'); return; }
    if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذا المرتجع؟')) return;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري الحذف...');
    companyCall('delete_sales_return', { unique_id: uid })
      .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); load(); })
      .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast(e.message || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
  }

  function formatDate(v) {
    if (!v) return '';
    var d = new Date(v);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

 * `PAGE_ACCESS` table feeding `guard_` (page-level access control), and
 * `pageForAction_`/`tableForAction_` for SystemLog enrichment.
 *
 * Action logic stays inside the IIFE namespace (the only global is ValleyFoods).
 * Every module action is registered as a TODO stub so the file loads and routes
 * cleanly — replace each stub with real logic as pages are built.
 */

/* Global cross-module reference micro-cache (Batch 2). Defined at file top
 * level so it is reachable from every IIFE namespace (HREmp, HRModules, Finance).
 * 60s TTL; save handlers bust the touched kinds instantly. */
var FIN_REF_TTL_G = 60;
function vfRefsCached_(dbId, kind, builder) {
  var cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  var key = 'vfref_' + String(dbId) + '_' + kind;
  try {
    var cached = cache.get(key);
    if (cached) return JSON.parse(cached);
  } catch (e) {}
  var val = builder();
  try { cache.put(key, JSON.stringify(val), FIN_REF_TTL_G); } catch (e2) {}
  return val;
}

    'save_overtime_role': 'valley_employee_overtime_roles', 'toggle_overtime_role': 'valley_employee_overtime_roles',

    'get_deduction_roles_settings': 'valley_employee_deduction_roles',
    'save_deduction_role': 'valley_employee_deduction_roles', 'toggle_deduction_role': 'valley_employee_deduction_roles',

    'get_vacations_index_settings': 'valley_employee_vacations_index',

    'transfer_valley_cash': 'valley_cash_bank_movement',

    'get_valley_sales_bootstrap': 'valley_sales_invoices',
    'get_valley_product_batches': 'valley_current_products',

    'get_valley_mfg_recipes': 'valley_product_recipe',
    'save_valley_mfg_recipe': 'valley_product_recipe',

    'get_valley_mfg_orders': 'valley_manufacture_header',
    'get_valley_recipe_consumption': 'valley_product_recipe_footer',
    'save_valley_mfg_order': 'valley_manufacture_header',
    'approve_valley_mfg_order': 'valley_manufacture_header',
    'delete_valley_mfg_order': 'valley_manufacture_header',

    'get_valley_mfg_byproducts': 'valley_manufacture_by_product',
    'add_valley_mfg_byproduct': 'valley_manufacture_by_product',
    'get_valley_mfg_workops': 'valley_manufacture_work_center',
    'save_valley_mfg_workop': 'valley_manufacture_work_center',
    'control_valley_mfg_workop': 'valley_manufacture_work_center',
    'change_valley_mfg_status': 'valley_manufacture_header',
    'get_valley_recipe_plan': 'valley_product_recipe',
    'get_valley_mfg_order_detail': 'valley_manufacture_header',
    'get_valley_product_batches_multi': 'valley_current_products',

    'vf_mfg_order': 'valley_manufacture_header',
    'get_valley_mfg_order_view': 'valley_manufacture_header',

    'get_valley_invoice_lines': 'valley_sales_products',
    'save_valley_invoice': 'valley_sales_invoices',
    'approve_valley_invoice': 'valley_sales_invoices',
    'delete_valley_invoice': 'valley_sales_invoices',
    'get_valley_sales_list': 'valley_sales_invoices',
    'get_valley_invoice_full': 'valley_sales_invoices',

    'get_valley_returns_list': 'valley_sales_returns',
    'get_valley_invoice_for_return': 'valley_sales_returns',
    'save_valley_return': 'valley_sales_returns',
    'add_upload_file': 'valley_emp_deductions',

    // بيانات تجريبية
    'get_test_data': 'valley_test_data_log',
    'generate_test_data': 'valley_test_data_log',
    'remove_test_data': 'valley_test_data_log',

    // الانتاج — خطوط الإنتاج والأصول
    'get_valley_work_centers': 'valley_work_centers',
    'save_valley_work_center': 'valley_work_centers',
    'get_valley_asset_technicals': 'valley_product_technical',
    'save_valley_asset_technical': 'valley_product_technical',
