    function openStatusModal() {
      var body = '<form id="status-form">' +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف', required: true, options: ACTIVE_EMP_OPTIONS }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'status_type', label: 'نوع الحالة', type: 'select', required: true, options: EMP_STATUS_TYPES.map(function (t) { return { value: t, label: t }; }), placeholder: 'اختر الحالة' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'status_date', label: 'تاريخ الحالة', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
      '</form>';
      UIC.openModal('modal-status', { title: 'إضافة حالة موظف', body: body, onSave: 'saveStatus()' });
    }

    function saveStatus() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('status-form')) return false;
      var d = UIC.collectForm('status-form');
      if (!d.emp_id) { UIC.toast('الموظف مطلوب', 'error'); return false; }
      companyCall('add_emp_status', d).then(function (r) {
        if (r && r.status === 'success') { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); UIC.closeModal('modal-status'); fetchAll(); }
        else UIC.toast('تعذر الحفظ', 'error');
      }).catch(function (e) { UIC.toast('خطأ: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e), 'error'); });
      return true;
    }

    // ===================== 3) SHIFT ASSIGNMENT =====================
    function renderShift() {
      var headers = [
        { key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف' },
        { key: 'shift_id', label: 'الوردية' },
        { key: 'shift_start_date', label: 'تاريخ البداية' },
        { key: 'shift_end_date', label: 'تاريخ النهاية' },
        { key: 'notes', label: 'ملاحظات' },
        { key: 'user', label: 'المستخدم' }
      ];
      var rows = ASSIGNMENTS.map(function (r) {
        return {
          emp_id: esc(EMP_MAP[r.emp_id] || r.emp_id),
          shift_id: esc(SHIFT_MAP[r.shift_id] || r.shift_id),
          shift_start_date: esc(fmtDate(r.shift_start_date)),
          shift_end_date: esc(fmtDate(r.shift_end_date)),
          notes: esc(r.notes),
          user: esc(r.user)
        };
      });
      document.getElementById('vf-emp-tab').innerHTML =
        addBtn('openShiftModal()', '+ إضافة تعيين وردية') +
        UIC.dataTable('shift-table', { headers: headers, rows: rows, pageSize: 100, emptyText: 'لا توجد تعيينات ورديات' });
      UIC.initTableSort('shift-table');
    }

    function openShiftModal() {
      var body = '<form id="shift-form">' +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف', required: true, options: ACTIVE_EMP_OPTIONS }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'shift_id', label: 'الوردية', required: true, options: SHIFT_OPTIONS }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'shift_start_date', label: 'تاريخ بداية الوردية', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'shift_end_date', label: 'تاريخ نهاية الوردية', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'notes', label: 'ملاحظات', type: 'textarea', required: false }) +
      '</form>';
      UIC.openModal('modal-shift', { title: 'إضافة تعيين وردية', body: body, onSave: 'saveShift()' });
    }

    function saveShift() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('shift-form')) return false;
      var d = UIC.collectForm('shift-form');
      if (!d.emp_id) { UIC.toast('الموظف مطلوب', 'error'); return false; }
      if (!d.shift_id) { UIC.toast('الوردية مطلوبة', 'error'); return false; }
      companyCall('add_shift_assignment', d).then(function (r) {
        if (r && r.status === 'success') { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); UIC.closeModal('modal-shift'); fetchAll(); }
        else UIC.toast('تعذر الحفظ', 'error');
      }).catch(function (e) { UIC.toast('خطأ: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e), 'error'); });
      return true;
    }

    // ===================== 4) SALARY =====================
    function renderSalary() {
      var headers = [
        { key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف' },
        { key: 'name_ar', label: 'اسم الموظف' },
        { key: 'salary_date', label: 'تاريخ الراتب' },
        { key: 'main_salary', label: 'الراتب الأساسي', money: true },
        { key: 'allow', label: 'البدلات', money: true },
        { key: 'basic_salary', label: 'الراتب الأساسي (basic)', money: true },
        { key: 'insurance_salary', label: 'راتب التأمين', money: true },
        { key: 'insurance_allow', label: 'بدل التأمين', money: true },
        { key: 'user', label: 'المستخدم' }
      ];
      var rows = SALARIES.map(function (r) {
        return {
          emp_id: esc(EMP_MAP[r.emp_id] || r.emp_id),
          name_ar: esc(r.name_ar || EMP_MAP[r.emp_id] || ''),
          salary_date: esc(fmtDate(r.salary_date)),
          main_salary: Number(r.main_salary) || 0,
          allow: Number(r.allow) || 0,
          basic_salary: Number(r.basic_salary) || 0,
          insurance_salary: Number(r.insurance_salary) || 0,
          insurance_allow: Number(r.insurance_allow) || 0,
          user: esc(r.user)
        };
      });
      document.getElementById('vf-emp-tab').innerHTML =
        addBtn('openSalaryModal()', '+ إضافة راتب') +
        UIC.dataTable('salary-table', { headers: headers, rows: rows, pageSize: 100, emptyText: 'لا توجد رواتب' });
      UIC.initTableSort('salary-table');
    }

    function openSalaryModal() {
      var body = '<form id="salary-form">' +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف', required: true, options: ACTIVE_EMP_OPTIONS }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'salary_date', label: 'تاريخ الراتب', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'main_salary', label: 'الراتب الأساسي', type: 'number', required: true, min: 0, step: 0.01 }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'allow', label: 'البدلات', type: 'number', required: true, min: 0, step: 0.01 }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'basic_salary', label: 'الراتب الأساسي (basic)', type: 'number', required: true, min: 0, step: 0.01 }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'insurance_salary', label: 'راتب التأمين', type: 'number', required: true, min: 0, step: 0.01 }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'insurance_allow', label: 'بدل التأمين', type: 'number', required: true, min: 0, step: 0.01 }) +
      '</form>';
      UIC.openModal('modal-salary', { title: 'إضافة راتب موظف', body: body, onSave: 'saveSalary()' });
    }

    function saveSalary() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('salary-form')) return false;
      var d = UIC.collectForm('salary-form');
      if (!d.emp_id) { UIC.toast('الموظف مطلوب', 'error'); return false; }
      companyCall('add_employee_salary', d).then(function (r) {
        if (r && r.status === 'success') { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); UIC.closeModal('modal-salary'); fetchAll(); }
        else UIC.toast('تعذر الحفظ', 'error');
      }).catch(function (e) { UIC.toast('خطأ: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e), 'error'); });
      return true;
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
    var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>';
    var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
    var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
    var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
    var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }

    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
  </script>

  <script>
  (function () {
    /* Tab config: one authority page id per reference table; the active tab
       follows the page the user opened (CURRENT_ACTION). */
    var TABS = {
      vf_hr_settings_overtime:   { label: 'أنواع العمل الإضافي', get: 'get_overtime_roles_settings',  save: 'save_overtime_role',   toggle: 'toggle_overtime_role',   keyField: 'overtime_rule_unique_id' },
      vf_hr_settings_deduction:  { label: 'قواعد الخصومات',      get: 'get_deduction_roles_settings', save: 'save_deduction_role',  toggle: 'toggle_deduction_role',  keyField: 'rule_unique_id' },
      vf_hr_settings_vacations:  { label: 'أنواع الإجازات',      get: 'get_vacations_index_settings', save: 'save_vacation_index',  toggle: 'toggle_vacation_index',  keyField: 'id' },
      vf_hr_settings_shifts:     { label: 'الورديات',            get: 'get_shift_schedule_settings',  save: 'save_shift_schedule',  toggle: 'toggle_shift_schedule',  keyField: 'shift_unique_id' }
    };
    var TAB_ORDER = ['vf_hr_settings_overtime', 'vf_hr_settings_deduction', 'vf_hr_settings_vacations', 'vf_hr_settings_shifts'];
    var CURRENT_TAB = TABS[CURRENT_ACTION] ? CURRENT_ACTION : TAB_ORDER[0];
    var CACHE = {};

    function renderApp() {
      UIC.appShell('vf-root', {
        companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
        companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=vf_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
        companyLogoTitle: 'Valley Foods',
        breadcrumb: 'Valley Foods / شؤون الموظفين / إعدادات ' + TABS[CURRENT_TAB].label,
        contentId: 'vf-settings-content',
        menuGroups: (window.VALLEYFOODS_MENU || [])
      });
      renderTabs();
      loadTab();
    }

    function renderTabs() {
      var html = '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;">';
      TAB_ORDER.forEach(function (id) {
        var active = id === CURRENT_TAB;
        html += '<a class="btn ' + (active ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline') + '" style="text-decoration:none;" href="' +
          scriptUrl + '?action=' + id + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN) +
          '" onclick="event.preventDefault();window.location.href=this.getAttribute(\'href\');">' + esc(TABS[id].label) + '</a>';
      });
      html += '</div>';
      html += '<div class="vf-card"><div class="vf-card-header"><h3>' + esc(TABS[CURRENT_TAB].label) + '</h3>' +
        (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="SETTINGS_PAGE.openAdd()">+ إضافة</button>' : '') +
        '</div><div class="vf-card-body">' +
        '<div id="settings-warning"></div>' +
        '<div id="settings-table"><p class="vf-text-muted">جاري التحميل...</p></div>' +
        '</div></div>';
      document.getElementById('vf-settings-content').innerHTML = html;
    }

    function activePill(isActive) {
      return UIC.statusPill(isActive ? 'مفعل' : 'موقوف', isActive ? 'success' : 'neutral');
    }

    function rowButtons(tabId, row) {
      /* POLICY: add = page write access; edit/toggle of existing rows = super admin only
         (mirrors the server-side enforcement in save_/toggle_ handlers). */
      if (!IS_SUPER_ADMIN) return '';
      var keyField = TABS[tabId].keyField;
      var key = esc(row[keyField]);
      var isActive = !(row.is_active === false || String(row.is_active).toLowerCase() === 'false');
      return '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px;" onclick="SETTINGS_PAGE.openEdit(\'' + key + '\')">تعديل</button> ' +
        '<button class="btn ' + (isActive ? 'btn-outline' : 'btn-primary') + '" style="padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px;" onclick="SETTINGS_PAGE.toggle(\'' + key + '\')">' +
        (isActive ? 'إيقاف' : 'تفعيل') + '</button>';
    }

    function boolCell(v) {
      var b = v === true || String(v).toLowerCase() === 'true';
      return UIC.statusPill(b ? 'نعم' : 'لا', b ? 'success' : 'neutral');
    }

    function buildRows(tabId, rows) {
      if (tabId === 'vf_hr_settings_overtime') {
        return rows.map(function (r) {
          return [esc(r.overtime_type), r.overtime_rate, boolCell(r.money_related), boolCell(r.vacation_days), activePill(r.is_active), rowButtons(tabId, r)];
        });
      }
      if (tabId === 'vf_hr_settings_deduction') {
        return rows.map(function (r) {
          return [esc(r.deduction_name), esc(r.deduction_category), r.deduction_value || '-', r.deduction_days || '-', r.deduction_hours || '-', activePill(r.is_active), rowButtons(tabId, r)];
        });
      }
      if (tabId === 'vf_hr_settings_vacations') {
        return rows.map(function (r) {
          return [esc(r.id), esc(r.vacation_name_ar), esc(r.vacation_name_en || '-'), boolCell(r.require_allocation), activePill(r.is_active), rowButtons(tabId, r)];
        });
      }
      return rows.map(function (r) {
        return [esc(r.shift_name), esc(r.shift_type || '-'), esc(r.shift_start_time_display || ''), esc(r.shift_end_time_display || ''), activePill(r.is_active), rowButtons(tabId, r)];
      });
    }

    var TABLE_HEADERS = {
      vf_hr_settings_overtime:   ['الاسم', 'المعدل', 'نقدي؟', 'أيام إجازة؟', 'الحالة', ''],
      vf_hr_settings_deduction:  ['الاسم', 'التصنيف', 'القيمة', 'الأيام', 'الساعات', 'الحالة', ''],
      vf_hr_settings_vacations:  ['الكود', 'الاسم العربي', 'الاسم الإنجليزي', 'يتطلب تخصيص؟', 'الحالة', ''],
      vf_hr_settings_shifts:     ['الاسم', 'النوع', 'من', 'إلى', 'الحالة', '']
    };

    function renderTable() {
      var container = document.getElementById('settings-table');
      var warning = document.getElementById('settings-warning');
      if (!container) return;
      var res = CACHE[CURRENT_TAB] || {};
      if (warning) warning.innerHTML = res.alignment_warning
        ? '<div style="background:#fffbeb;border:1px solid #fde68a;color:#92400e;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:13px;">⚠️ ' + esc(res.alignment_warning) + '</div>'
        : '';
      var rows = buildRows(CURRENT_TAB, res.rows || []);
      container.innerHTML = UIC.dataTable('settings-table-id', { headers: TABLE_HEADERS[CURRENT_TAB], rows: rows });
    }

    function loadTab() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall(TABS[CURRENT_TAB].get)
        .then(function (res) {
          CACHE[CURRENT_TAB] = res || {};
          renderTable();
        })
        .catch(function (e) {
          UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ في تحميل البيانات', 'error');
          var c = document.getElementById('settings-table');
          if (c) c.innerHTML = '';
        })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    /* ---------- MODALS ---------- */
    function checkbox(key, label, checked) {
      return '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:10px 0;font-size:14px;">' +
        '<input type="checkbox" id="' + key + '"' + (checked ? ' checked' : '') + '> ' + label + '</label>';
    }
    function readCheckbox(id) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      return !!(el && el.checked);
    }

    function openAdd() {
      openModal(null);
    }

    function openEdit(key) {
      var rows = (CACHE[CURRENT_TAB] || {}).rows || [];
      var row = null;
      rows.forEach(function (r) { if (String(r[TABS[CURRENT_TAB].keyField]) === String(key)) row = r; });
      if (!row) { UIC.toast('لم يتم العثور على السجل', 'error'); return; }
      openModal(row);
    }

    function openModal(row) {
      var isEdit = !!row;
      var titles = {
        vf_hr_settings_overtime: 'نوع عمل إضافي',
        vf_hr_settings_deduction: 'قاعدة خصم',
        vf_hr_settings_vacations: 'نوع إجازة',
        vf_hr_settings_shifts: 'وردية'
      };
      var body = '';

      if (CURRENT_TAB === 'vf_hr_settings_overtime') {
        body += '<input type="hidden" id="f-key" value="' + esc(row ? row.overtime_rule_unique_id : '') + '">' +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-name', label: 'الاسم', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? row.overtime_type : '' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-rate', label: 'المعدل (مضاعف الساعة)', type: 'number', required: true, min: '0', step: '0.25', value: row ? row.overtime_rate : 1 }) +
          checkbox('f-money', 'مرتبط بمبلغ ثابت (يُدخل المبلغ يدوياً)', row && (row.money_related === true || String(row.money_related).toLowerCase() === 'true')) +
          checkbox('f-vacdays', 'يُحتسب كأيام إجازة بدلاً من ساعات', row && (row.vacation_days === true || String(row.vacation_days).toLowerCase() === 'true'));
      } else if (CURRENT_TAB === 'vf_hr_settings_deduction') {
        var cats = (CACHE[CURRENT_TAB] || {}).categories || [];
        var catOpts = cats.map(function (c) { return { value: c, label: c }; });
        body += '<input type="hidden" id="f-key" value="' + esc(row ? row.rule_unique_id : '') + '">' +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-name', label: 'الاسم', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? row.deduction_name : '' }) +
          UIC.combo({ key: 'f-category', label: 'التصنيف', required: true, options: catOpts, value: row ? row.deduction_category : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-value', label: 'قيمة الخصم الثابتة (للجزاءات)', type: 'number', min: '0', value: row ? (row.deduction_value || '') : '' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-days', label: 'معامل أيام الغياب', type: 'number', min: '0', value: row ? (row.deduction_days || '') : '' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-hours', label: 'عدد ساعات التأخير', type: 'number', min: '0', value: row ? (row.deduction_hours || '') : '' });
      } else if (CURRENT_TAB === 'vf_hr_settings_vacations') {
        body += UIC.field({
          key: 'f-id', label: 'الكود', type: 'text', required: true,
          value: row ? row.id : ((CACHE[CURRENT_TAB] || {}).suggested_next_id || ''),
          noCorrect: true
        }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-ar', label: 'الاسم العربي', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? row.vacation_name_ar : '' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-en', label: 'الاسم الإنجليزي', type: 'text', value: row ? (row.vacation_name_en || '') : '' }) +
          checkbox('f-alloc', 'يتطلب تخصيص رصيد قبل الاستخدام', row && (row.require_allocation === true || String(row.require_allocation).toLowerCase() === 'true')) +
          (isEdit ? '<input type="hidden" id="f-editing" value="1">' : '');
      } else {
        body += '<input type="hidden" id="f-key" value="' + esc(row ? row.shift_unique_id : '') + '">' +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-name', label: 'اسم الوردية', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? row.shift_name : '' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-type', label: 'النوع (اختياري)', type: 'text', value: row ? (row.shift_type || '') : '' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-start', label: 'من', type: 'time', required: true, value: row ? (row.shift_start_time_display || '') : '08:00' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-end', label: 'إلى', type: 'time', required: true, value: row ? (row.shift_end_time_display || '') : '16:00' });
      }

      UIC.openModal('hr-settings-modal', {
        title: (isEdit ? 'تعديل ' : 'إضافة ') + titles[CURRENT_TAB],
        body: '<form id="hr-settings-form">' + body + '</form>',
        onSave: 'SETTINGS_PAGE.save()'
      });
    }

    function collectPayload() {
      var p = {};
      var keyEl = document.getElementById('f-key');
      if (keyEl && keyEl.value) p[TABS[CURRENT_TAB].keyField] = keyEl.value;

      if (CURRENT_TAB === 'vf_hr_settings_overtime') {
        p.overtime_type = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim();
        p.overtime_rate = document.getElementById('f-rate').value;
        p.money_related = readCheckbox('f-money');
        p.vacation_days = readCheckbox('f-vacdays');
      } else if (CURRENT_TAB === 'vf_hr_settings_deduction') {
        p.deduction_name = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim();
        p.deduction_category = document.getElementById('f-category').value;
        p.deduction_value = document.getElementById('f-value').value;
        p.deduction_days = document.getElementById('f-days').value;
        p.deduction_hours = document.getElementById('f-hours').value;
      } else if (CURRENT_TAB === 'vf_hr_settings_vacations') {
        p.id = document.getElementById('f-id').value.trim();
        p.vacation_name_ar = document.getElementById('f-ar').value.trim();
        p.vacation_name_en = document.getElementById('f-en').value.trim();
        p.require_allocation = readCheckbox('f-alloc');
        var editing = document.getElementById('f-editing');
        p._editing = !!(editing && editing.value === '1');
      } else {
        p.shift_name = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim();
        p.shift_type = document.getElementById('f-type').value.trim();
        p.shift_start_time = document.getElementById('f-start').value;
        p.shift_end_time = document.getElementById('f-end').value;
      }
      return p;
    }

    function save() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('hr-settings-form')) return;
      var payload = collectPayload();
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall(TABS[CURRENT_TAB].save, payload)
        .then(function (r) {
          UIC.closeModal('hr-settings-modal');
          UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ بنجاح', 'success');
          loadTab();
        })
        .catch(function (e) {
          UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل الحفظ', 'error');
        })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function doToggle(key) {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall(TABS[CURRENT_TAB].toggle, { key: key })
        .then(function (r) {
          UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم التنفيذ', 'success');
          loadTab();
        })
        .catch(function (e) {
          UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل التنفيذ', 'error');
        })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    window.SETTINGS_PAGE = {
      openAdd: openAdd,
      openEdit: openEdit,
      save: save,
      toggle: function (key) {
        var rows = (CACHE[CURRENT_TAB] || {}).rows || [];
        var row = null;
        rows.forEach(function (r) { if (String(r[TABS[CURRENT_TAB].keyField]) === String(key)) row = r; });
        var willDeactivate = row && !(row.is_active === false || String(row.is_active).toLowerCase() === 'false');
        if (willDeactivate && !confirm('إيقاف هذا العنصر يخفيه من القوائم فقط ولا يحذفه — السجلات التاريخية المرتبطة به لن تتأثر. متابعة؟')) return;
        doToggle(key);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderApp);
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
    var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>';
    var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
    var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
    var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
    var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }
    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    function num0(v) { var n = Number(v); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
    function fmt3(v) { return Number(v || 0).toFixed(3); }
    function todayStr() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
    function fmtDate(v) {
      if (!v) return '-';
      var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
      var p = function (n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; };
      return p(d.getDate()) + '/' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + d.getFullYear();
    }

    function load() {
      showLoading('جاري تحميل أوامر التصنيع…');
      var watchdog = setTimeout(function () { hideLoading(); UIC.toast('انتهت مهلة التحميل — تحقق من الاتصال وأعد المحاولة', 'error'); }, 25000);
      var container = document.getElementById('mo-table');
      if (container) {
        UIC.PagedTable({
          container: container,
          headers: ['كود الأمر', 'المنتج المنتج', 'نوع العملية', 'الوردية', 'التاريخ',
                    { label: 'المتوقع', numeric: true }, { label: 'المصنع', numeric: true }, 'الحالة', ''],

          emptyText: 'لا توجد أوامر تصنيع',
          onRendered: function (tid) { try { UIC.initTableSort(tid); } catch (e) {} },
          fetcher: function (offset, limit) {

          onFirst: function (r) {
            RECIPE_OPTIONS = r.recipe_options || [];
            PRODUCT_OPTIONS = r.product_options || [];
            ENUMS = r.enums || {};
            try { clearTimeout(watchdog); hideLoading(); } catch (e) {}
          },
          mapRow: function (o) {
            var isLocked = o.mo_status === 'Locked';
            var isInProgress = o.mo_status === 'In Progress';
            var actions = '';
            /* open (view / edit in separate route) — always available */
            actions += '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.openDetail(\'' + esc(o.unique_id) + '\')">فتح</button> ';
            if (IS_SUPER_ADMIN || CAN_WRITE) {
              if (o.mo_status === 'Draft') {
                actions += '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.changeStatus(\'' + esc(o.unique_id) + '\',\'start\')">▶️ بدء</button> ';
              } else if (isInProgress && IS_SUPER_ADMIN) {
                actions += '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;color:#b45309;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.changeStatus(\'' + esc(o.unique_id) + '\',\'lock\')">🔒 قفل</button> ';
              } else if (isLocked && IS_SUPER_ADMIN) {
                actions += '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;color:#b45309;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.changeStatus(\'' + esc(o.unique_id) + '\',\'unlock\')">🔓 فتق القفل</button> ';
              }
            }
            if (IS_SUPER_ADMIN) {
              actions += '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;color:#dc2626;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.remove(\'' + esc(o.unique_id) + '\')">حذف</button>';
            }
            var statusLabel = isLocked ? 'مقفل' : (isInProgress ? 'قيد التنفيذ' : 'مسودة');
            return [
              '<b>' + esc(o.transaction_code || o.id) + '</b>',
              esc(prodLabel(o.produced_product)),
              esc(o.operation_type),
              esc(o.shift),
              fmtDate(o.manufacture_date),
              '<span class="num">' + fmt3(o.expected_qty) + '</span>',
              '<span class="num">' + fmt3(o.manufactured_qty) + '</span>',
              statusPill(statusLabel, isLocked ? 'success' : 'neutral'),
              actions
            ];
          }
        });
      } else { try { clearTimeout(watchdog); hideLoading(); } catch (e) {} }
    }

    function statusPill(s, c) { return UIC.statusPill(s, c); }

    function switchTab(paneId) {
      ['tab-main-extra', 'tab-cons', 'tab-workops', 'tab-byproducts', 'tab-outputs'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = (id === paneId) ? '' : 'none';

    function selList_(list) { return (list || []).map(function (v) { return { value: v, label: v }; }); }
    function getV_(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; }
    function checkboxField(key, label, checked) {
      return '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:22px;font-size:14px;">' +
        '<input type="checkbox" id="' + key + '"' + (checked ? ' checked' : '') + '> ' + label + '</label>';
    }

    /* ---------- OUTPUTS with footer child table ---------- */
    var MFG_OUTPUTS = [];
    var OUTPUT_FOOTERS = {};

    function addOutput(pre) {
      pre = pre || {};
      var idx = MFG_OUTPUTS.length;
      MFG_OUTPUTS.push({ product_id: pre.product_id != null ? String(pre.product_id) : '', qty: pre.qty != null ? pre.qty : '', uid: pre.unique_id || '' });
      OUTPUT_FOOTERS[idx] = (pre.footer_rows || []).map(function (f) {
        return { item: String(f.item || '').trim(), qty: f.qty != null ? f.qty : '', unique_id: f.unique_id || '' };
      });
      drawOutputs();
    }

    function removeOutput(i) {
      MFG_OUTPUTS.splice(i, 1);
      delete OUTPUT_FOOTERS[i];
      var newF = {};
      MFG_OUTPUTS.forEach(function (_, ni) { if (OUTPUT_FOOTERS[i + ni] !== undefined) newF[ni] = OUTPUT_FOOTERS[i + ni]; });
      OUTPUT_FOOTERS = newF;
      drawOutputs();
    }

    function drawOutputs() {
      var tb = document.getElementById('outputs-body');
      if (!tb) return;
      if (!MFG_OUTPUTS.length) { addOutput(null); return; }
      var html = '';
      MFG_OUTPUTS.forEach(function (o, i) {
        var footerRows = OUTPUT_FOOTERS[i] || [];
        var footerHtml = footerRows.map(function (f, fi) {
          return '<tr><td>' + UIC.combo({ key: 'ft-item-' + i + '-' + fi, options: PRODUCT_OPTIONS, value: f.item, placeholder: 'ابحث…' }) + '</td>' +
            '<td><input id="ft-qty-' + i + '-' + fi + '" class="input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="' + (f.qty || '') + '" style="max-width:100px;"></td>' +
            '<td><button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:2px 6px;color:#dc2626;font-size:10px;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.removeFooterRow(' + i + ',' + fi + ')">✕</button></td></tr>';
        }).join('');
        html += '<div style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px;overflow:hidden;">' +
          '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 120px 40px;gap:8px;padding:10px;background:#f0fdf4;align-items:center;">' +
            '<div>' + UIC.combo({ key: 'out-prod-' + i, options: PRODUCT_OPTIONS, value: o.product_id, placeholder: 'ابحث عن منتج…' }) + '</div>' +
            '<div><input id="out-qty-' + i + '" class="input" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="' + (o.qty || '') + '" placeholder="الكمية" oninput="MFG_PAGE.recalc()"></div>' +
            '<div><button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 8px;color:#dc2626;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.removeOutput(' + i + ')">✕</button></div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div style="padding:8px 10px;border-top:1px dashed #e5e7eb;background:#fafafa;">' +
            '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px;">' +
              '<span style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;">🧪 المواد المستهلكة لهذا المنتج</span>' +
              (CAN_WRITE ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:1px 6px;font-size:10px;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.addFooterRow(' + i + ')">+ صنف</button>' : '') +
            '</div>' +
            (footerRows.length ?
              '<table class="table" style="margin:0;font-size:12px;"><thead><tr><th>الصنف</th><th style="width:100px;">الكمية</th><th style="width:30px;"></th></tr></thead><tbody>' + footerHtml + '</tbody></table>' :
              '<div style="text-align:center;color:#94a3b8;font-size:11px;padding:4px;">لا توجد أصناف مسجلة</div>') +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      });
      tb.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function addFooterRow(outputIdx) {
      if (!OUTPUT_FOOTERS[outputIdx]) OUTPUT_FOOTERS[outputIdx] = [];
      OUTPUT_FOOTERS[outputIdx].push({ item: '', qty: '' });
      drawOutputs();
    }

    function removeFooterRow(outputIdx, footerIdx) {
      if (OUTPUT_FOOTERS[outputIdx]) OUTPUT_FOOTERS[outputIdx].splice(footerIdx, 1);
      drawOutputs();
    }

    /* ---------- RECIPE-DRIVEN CONSUMPTION ---------- */
    var CONSUMPTION_DRAFT = [];   /* [{item_pid, lot, batch_uid, qty}] */

    function onRecipeChange(skipAuto) {
      var recipeUid = getV_('f-recipe');
      var qty = num0(getV_('f-manufactured'));
      if (!recipeUid || qty <= 0) return;
      if (!skipAuto) {
        UI.showSpinner();
        companyCall('get_valley_recipe_consumption', { recipe_uid: recipeUid, qty: qty })
          .then(function (r) {
            CONSUMPTION_DRAFT = (r.materials || []).map(function (m) {
              return { item_pid: m.raw_material_id, raw_name: m.raw_material_name, required: m.required_qty };
            });
            renderConsumptionStrip();
          })
          .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ في جلب الوصفة', 'error'); })
          .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
      }
    }

    function onQtyChange() {
      var recipeUid = getV_('f-recipe');
      var qty = num0(getV_('f-manufactured'));
      if (!recipeUid || qty <= 0 || !CONSUMPTION_DRAFT.length) return;
      /* re-scale existing draft proportionally to the new quantity */
      companyCall('get_valley_recipe_consumption', { recipe_uid: recipeUid, qty: qty })
        .then(function (r) {
          var byPid = {};
          (r.materials || []).forEach(function (m) { byPid[m.raw_material_id] = m.required_qty; });
          CONSUMPTION_DRAFT.forEach(function (c) {
            if (byPid[c.item_pid] != null) c.required = byPid[c.item_pid];
          });
          renderConsumptionStrip();
        })
        .catch(function () {});
    }

    function renderConsumptionStrip() {
      var strip = document.getElementById('cons-strip');
      if (!strip) return;
      if (!CONSUMPTION_DRAFT.length) {
        strip.innerHTML = 'الوصفة لا تحتوي مواد خام.';
        return;
      }
      var html = '';
      CONSUMPTION_DRAFT.forEach(function (c, i) {
        html += '<div style="border-bottom:1px dashed #e5e7eb;padding:8px 0;">' +
          '<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px;">🧪 ' + esc(c.raw_name || c.item_pid) +
          ' — المطلوب: <span style="direction:ltr;display:inline-block;">' + Number(c.required).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + '</span>' +
          ' <span id="cons-sum-' + i + '" style="font-weight:800;"></span></div>' +
          '<div id="cons-batches-' + i + '">جاري تحميل الدفعات...</div>' +
        '</div>';
        loadBatchesForCons(i, c);
      });
    }

    function loadBatchesForCons(i, consItem) {
      companyCall('get_valley_product_batches', { product_id: consItem.item_pid, exclude_invoice_unique_id: '' })
        .then(function (r) {
          var holder = document.getElementById('cons-batches-' + i);
          if (!holder) return;
          var batches = (r.batches || []).filter(function (b) { return b.available > 0; });
          if (!batches.length) { holder.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#d97706;">لا توجد دفعات متاحة لهذه الخامة.</span>'; return; }
          var html = '<table class="table" style="margin:0;"><thead><tr><th>الدفعة</th><th>المتاح</th><th style="width:140px;">الكمية المستهلكة</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
          batches.forEach(function (b, bi) {
            html += '<tr><td><b>' + esc(b.lot) + '</b></td>' +
              '<td class="num">' + Number(b.available).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + '</td>' +
              '<td><input id="cons-q-' + i + '-' + bi + '" class="input" type="number" min="0" max="' + b.available + '" step="0.01" data-buid="' + esc(b.batch_uid) + '" data-pid="' + esc(consItem.item_pid) + '" data-lot="' + esc(b.lot) + '" value="" oninput="MFG_PAGE.recalcCons()" style="max-width:130px;direction:ltr;"></td></tr>';
          });
          html += '</tbody></table>';
          holder.innerHTML = html;
        })
        .catch(function () { holder.innerHTML = '<span style="color:red;">خطأ في تحميل الدفعات</span>'; });
    }

    function recalcCons() {
      CONSUMPTION_DRAFT.forEach(function (c, i) {
        var sumEl = document.getElementById('cons-sum-' + i);
        if (!sumEl) return;
        var s2 = 0;
        for (var j = 0; ; j++) {
          var qEl = document.getElementById('cons-q-' + i + '-' + j);
          if (!qEl) break;
          s2 += parseFloat(qEl.value) || 0;
        }
        var needed = Number(c.required) || 0;
        sumEl.textContent = '(' + Number(s2.toFixed(2)) + ' / ' + Number(needed.toFixed(2)) + ')';
        sumEl.style.color = Math.abs(s2 - needed) < 0.0001 ? '#059669' : '#dc2626';
      });
    }

    function collectConsumption() {
      var out = [];
      CONSUMPTION_DRAFT.forEach(function (_, i) {
        for (var j = 0; ; j++) {
          var qEl = document.getElementById('cons-q-' + i + '-' + j);
          if (!qEl) break;
          var q = parseFloat(qEl.value) || 0;
          if (q > 0) out.push({
            batch_uid: qEl.getAttribute('data-buid'),
            item_pid: qEl.getAttribute('data-pid'),
            lot: qEl.getAttribute('data-lot'),
            qty: q
          });
        }
      });
      return out;
    }

    function save() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('mfg-form')) return;
      var outputs = MFG_OUTPUTS.map(function (o, i) {
        var el = document.getElementById('out-prod-' + i);
        var qEl = document.getElementById('out-qty-' + i);
        var footers = (OUTPUT_FOOTERS[i] || []).map(function (f, fi) {
          var fItem = document.getElementById('ft-item-' + i + '-' + fi);
          var fQty = document.getElementById('ft-qty-' + i + '-' + fi);
          return { item: fItem ? fItem.value : '', qty: fQty ? fQty.value : '' };
        }).filter(function (f) { return f.item; });
        return { product_id: el ? el.value : '', qty: qEl ? qEl.value : '', footers: footers };
      }).filter(function (o) { return o.product_id && num0(o.qty) > 0; });
      if (!outputs.length) { UIC.toast('أضف منتج ناتج واحد على الأقل', 'error'); return; }

      var payload = {
        mo_uid: EDIT_MO_UID(),
        manufacture_date: getV_('f-date'),
        operation_type: getCombo_('f-op-type'),
        shift: getCombo_('f-shift'),
        produced_product_id: getCombo_('f-product'),
        expected_qty: getV_('f-expected'),
        manufactured_qty: getV_('f-manufactured'),
        actual_qty: getV_('f-actual'),
        recipe_id: getCombo_('f-recipe'),
        mo_status: getHid_('f-status'),
        outputs: outputs,
        consumption: collectConsumption()
      };
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('save_valley_mfg_order', payload)
        .then(function (r) {
          UIC.closeModal('mfg-modal');
          UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ بنجاح', 'success');
          load();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل الحفظ', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function EDIT_MO_UID() { var el = document.getElementById('f-mo-uid'); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; }
    function getCombo_(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; }
    function getHid_(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; }

    function openDetail(moUid) {
      window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=vf_mfg_order&mo=' + encodeURIComponent(moUid) + '&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN, '_blank');
    }

    function openNewPage() {
      window.open(scriptUrl + '?action=vf_mfg_order&new=1&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN, '_blank');
    }

    function changeStatus(moUid, kind) {
      if (kind === 'lock' && !confirm('قفل الأمر سيجعله غير قابل للتعديل إلا بصلاحية مدير النظام. متابعة؟')) return;
      if (kind === 'unlock' && !confirm('فتح القفل سيعيد الأمر إلى «قيد التنفيذ». متابعة؟')) return;
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('change_valley_mfg_status', { mo_uid: moUid, kind: kind })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم', 'success'); load(); })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function removeMo(moUid) {
      if (!confirm('سيتم حذف أمر التصنيع وبنوده واستهلاكاته نهائياً. متابعة؟')) return;
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('delete_valley_mfg_order', { mo_uid: moUid })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); load(); })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل الحذف', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function fmtNumP2(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); }

    /* ---------- BY-PRODUCTS (tab loader) ---------- */
    function loadByproductsTab(moUid) {
      var holder = document.getElementById('byproducts-body');
      if (!holder) return;
      companyCall('get_valley_mfg_byproducts', { mo_uid: moUid })
        .then(function (r) {
          window.__BP_OPTIONS = (r.product_options || []).map(function (o) { return { value: String(o.value), label: o.label }; });
          var rowsHtml = (r.byproducts || []).map(function (b) {
            var nm = '';
            window.__BP_OPTIONS.forEach(function (o) { if (String(o.value) === String(b.item)) nm = o.label; });
            return '<tr><td>' + esc(nm || b.item) + '</td><td class="num">' + Number(b.qty || 0).toLocaleString('en-US') + '</td><td>' + esc(b.transaction_code || '-') + '</td><td class="num">' + Number(b.total_cost || 0).toLocaleString('en-US') + '</td></tr>';
          }).join('');
          var form = CAN_WRITE ? '<form id="bp-form"><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:10px;align-items:flex-end;">' +
            UIC.combo({ key: 'bp-item', label: 'المنتج الثانوي', required: true, options: window.__BP_OPTIONS, placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
            UIC.field({ key: 'bp-qty', label: 'الكمية', type: 'number', required: true, min: '0.01', step: '0.01' }) +
            UIC.field({ key: 'bp-lot', label: 'كود الدفعة', type: 'text' }) +
            UIC.field({ key: 'bp-cost', label: 'التكلفة', type: 'number', min: '0', step: '0.01' }) +
            '</div><input type="hidden" id="bp-mo-uid" value="' + esc(moUid) + '"></form>' : '';
          holder.innerHTML = '<div style="overflow-x:auto;"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>المنتج</th><th>الكمية</th><th>الدفعة</th><th>التكلفة</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
            (rowsHtml || '<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center;color:#94a3b8;">لا يوجد منتجات ثانوية</td></tr>') +
            '</tbody></table></div>' + form;
        })
        .catch(function () { holder.innerHTML = '<p style="color:red;">خطأ في التحميل</p>'; });
    }

    function addByproduct() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('bp-form')) return;
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('add_valley_mfg_byproduct', { mo_uid: getHid_('bp-mo-uid'), item: getCombo_('bp-item'), qty: getVal_('bp-qty'), batch_code: getV_('bp-lot'), total_cost: getV_('bp-cost') })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تمت الإضافة', 'success'); loadByproductsTab(getHid_('bp-mo-uid')); })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    /* ---------- WORK OPS (tab loader) ---------- */
    var _workopTimers = {};

    function loadWorkOpsTab(moUid) {
      var holder = document.getElementById('workops-body');
      if (!holder) return;
      Object.keys(_workopTimers).forEach(function (k) { clearInterval(_workopTimers[k]); delete _workopTimers[k]; });
      companyCall('get_valley_mfg_workops', { mo_uid: moUid })
        .then(function (r) {
          window.__WC_OPTIONS = r.work_center_options || [];
          var rowsHtml = (r.workops || []).map(function (w) {
            var pill = UIC.statusPill(w.operation_status, w.operation_status === 'Done' ? 'success' : 'neutral');
            var buttons = '';
            if (CAN_WRITE && w.operation_status !== 'Done') {
              if (w.operation_status === 'Pending') {
                buttons = '<button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:10px;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.startWorkOp(\'' + esc(w.unique_id) + '\')">▶️ بدء</button>';
              } else if (w.operation_status === 'In Progress') {
                buttons = '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:10px;color:#d97706;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.pauseWorkOp(\'' + esc(w.unique_id) + '\')">⏸️ إيقاف مؤقت</button> ' +
                  '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:10px;color:#dc2626;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.stopWorkOp(\'' + esc(w.unique_id) + '\')">⏹️ إنهاء</button>';
              } else if (w.operation_status === 'Paused') {
                buttons = '<button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:10px;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.resumeWorkOp(\'' + esc(w.unique_id) + '\')">▶️ استئناف</button> ' +
                  '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:10px;color:#dc2626;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.stopWorkOp(\'' + esc(w.unique_id) + '\')">⏹️ إنهاء</button>';
              }
            }
            var timerCell = '';
            if (w.operation_status === 'In Progress' && w.start_time) {
              timerCell = '<span id="timer-' + esc(w.unique_id) + '" class="timer-live" data-start="' + esc(w.start_time) + '" data-pause="' + esc(w.last_pause_time || '') + '" data-pause-dur="' + num0(w.total_pause_duration) + '"></span>';
            } else if (w.operation_status === 'Paused') {
              timerCell = '<span style="color:#d97706;font-weight:700;">⏸ موقوف</span>';
            }
            var manualBtn = '';
            if (CAN_WRITE && w.operation_status !== 'Done') {
              manualBtn = '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:2px 6px;font-size:9px;" onclick="MFG_PAGE.toggleWorkOpManualEdit(\'' + esc(w.unique_id) + '\')">✏️</button>';
            }
            return '<tr id="wo-row-' + esc(w.unique_id) + '">' +
              '<td>' + Number(w.work_center_sequence || 0) + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + esc(wcLabel_(w.work_center_id)) + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + pill + '</td>' +
              '<td class="wo-start-cell" style="direction:ltr;font-size:11px;">' + esc(fmtDateTime_(w.start_time)) + ' ' + manualBtn + '</td>' +
              '<td class="wo-end-cell" style="direction:ltr;font-size:11px;">' + esc(fmtDateTime_(w.end_time)) + '</td>' +
              '<td class="num">' + timerCell + (w.actual_hours !== '' && w.actual_hours != null ? ' ' + esc(w.actual_hours) + 'h' : '') + '</td>' +
              '<td style="font-size:11px;">' + esc(w.notes || '-') + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + buttons + '</td>' +
              '</tr>';
          }).join('');
          var form = CAN_WRITE ? '<form id="workops-form"><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:10px;align-items:flex-end;background:#f8fafc;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;">' +
            UIC.combo({ key: 'wo-wc', label: 'مركز العمل', required: true, options: window.__WC_OPTIONS, placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
            UIC.field({ key: 'wo-notes', label: 'ملاحظات', type: 'text' }) +
            '</div><input type="hidden" id="wo-mo-uid" value="' + esc(moUid) + '"></form>' : '';
          holder.innerHTML = '<div style="overflow-x:auto;"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>مركز العمل</th><th>الحالة</th><th>البداية</th><th>النهاية</th><th>الساعات</th><th>ملاحظات</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
            (rowsHtml || '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;color:#94a3b8;">لا توجد عمليات تشغيل</td></tr>') +
            '</tbody></table></div>' + form;
          startAllTimers();
        })
        .catch(function () { holder.innerHTML = '<p style="color:red;">خطأ في التحميل</p>'; });
    }

    function startAllTimers() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.timer-live').forEach(function (el) {
        var uid = el.id.replace('timer-', '');
        var startStr = el.getAttribute('data-start');
        var pauseStr = el.getAttribute('data-pause');
        var pauseDur = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-pause-dur')) || 0;
        if (!startStr) return;
        function tick() {
          var now = new Date();
          var start = new Date(startStr);
          var elapsed = (now.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 3600000 - pauseDur;
          if (elapsed < 0) elapsed = 0;
          var h = Math.floor(elapsed);
          var m = Math.floor((elapsed - h) * 60);
          el.textContent = h + 'h ' + m + 'm';
        }
        tick();
        _workopTimers[uid] = setInterval(tick, 30000);
      });
    }

    function controlWorkOp_(workopUid, cmd) {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('control_valley_mfg_workop', { workop_uid: workopUid, command: cmd })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم', 'success'); loadWorkOpsTab(getHid_('wo-mo-uid')); })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }
    function startWorkOp(uid) { controlWorkOp_(uid, 'start'); }
    function pauseWorkOp(uid) { controlWorkOp_(uid, 'pause'); }
    function resumeWorkOp(uid) { controlWorkOp_(uid, 'resume'); }
    function stopWorkOp(uid) { if (!confirm('إنهاء العملية؟')) return; controlWorkOp_(uid, 'stop'); }

    function toggleWorkOpManualEdit(uid) {
      var row = document.getElementById('wo-row-' + uid);
      if (!row) return;
      var startCell = row.querySelector('.wo-start-cell');
      var endCell = row.querySelector('.wo-end-cell');
      if (!startCell || !endCell) return;
      if (startCell.querySelector('input')) {
        var sv = startCell.querySelector('input').value;
        var ev = endCell.querySelector('input').value;
        var payload = { workop_uid: uid, mo_uid: getHid_('wo-mo-uid'), operation_status: 'In Progress', start_time: sv, end_time: ev, actual_hours: '', notes: '' };
        UI.showSpinner();
        companyCall('save_valley_mfg_workop', payload)
          .then(function (r) { UIC.toast('تم الحفظ', 'success'); loadWorkOpsTab(getHid_('wo-mo-uid')); })
          .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل', 'error'); })
          .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
      } else {
        var origStart = startCell.textContent.trim();
        var origEnd = endCell.textContent.trim();
        startCell.innerHTML = '<input type="datetime-local" class="input" value="' + toLocalDT_(origStart) + '" style="font-size:11px;">';
        endCell.innerHTML = '<input type="datetime-local" class="input" value="' + toLocalDT_(origEnd) + '" style="font-size:11px;">';
      }
    }

    function toLocalDT_(display) {
      if (!display || display === '-') return '';
      var parts = display.match(/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})\s+(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
      if (!parts) return '';
      return parts[3] + '-' + parts[2] + '-' + parts[1] + 'T' + parts[4] + ':' + parts[5];
    }

    function saveWorkOpManual() { toggleWorkOpManualEdit(''); }

    function addWorkOp() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('workops-form')) return;
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('save_valley_mfg_workop', { mo_uid: getHid_('wo-mo-uid'), work_center_id: getCombo_('wo-wc'), operation_status: 'Pending', notes: getV_('wo-notes') })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); loadWorkOpsTab(getHid_('wo-mo-uid')); })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function wcLabel_(idRef) {
      var f = (window.__WC_OPTIONS || []).filter(function (o) { return String(o.value) === String(idRef); })[0];
      return f ? f.label : (idRef || '-');
    }
    function fmtDateTime_(v) {
      if (!v) return '-';
      var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
      var p = function (n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; };
      return p(d.getDate()) + '/' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + d.getFullYear() + ' ' + p(d.getHours()) + ':' + p(d.getMinutes());
    }

    function recalc() {
      var net = 0, taxV = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < MFG_OUTPUTS.length; i++) {
        var qEl = document.getElementById('out-qty-' + i);
        var pEl = document.getElementById('out-prod-' + i);
        if (!qEl || !pEl) continue;
        var qty = parseFloat(qEl.value) || 0;
        /* outputs don't have per-row price/tax in MO — just count */
      }
      /* placeholder: MO totals are computed server-side on save */
    }

    window.MFG_PAGE = {
      tabBtn: tabBtn,
      openDetail: openDetail, openNewPage: openNewPage, save: save,
      changeStatus: changeStatus, remove: removeMo,
      switchTab: function (paneId) {
        ['tab-main-extra', 'tab-cons', 'tab-workops', 'tab-byproducts', 'tab-outputs'].forEach(function (id) {
          var el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) el.style.display = (id === paneId) ? '' : 'none';
        });
      },
      addByproduct: addByproduct,
      addWorkOp: addWorkOp,
      startWorkOp: startWorkOp, pauseWorkOp: pauseWorkOp, resumeWorkOp: resumeWorkOp, stopWorkOp: stopWorkOp,
      toggleWorkOpManualEdit: toggleWorkOpManualEdit, saveWorkOpManual: saveWorkOpManual,
      addOutput: addOutput, removeOutput: removeOutput,
      addFooterRow: addFooterRow, removeFooterRow: removeFooterRow,
      onRecipeChange: onRecipeChange, onQtyChange: onQtyChange, onProductChange: function () {},
      recalc: recalc, recalcCons: recalcCons
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderApp);
  })();
  </script>
