<body>
  <div id="vf-root"></div>

  <script>
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
    var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>';
    var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
    var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
    var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
    var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }
    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
  </script>

  <script>
  (function () {
    var ROWS = [], ENUMS = {}, NEXT_ID = 1;

    function renderApp() {
      UIC.appShell('vf-root', {
        companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
        companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=vf_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
        companyLogoTitle: 'Valley Foods',
        breadcrumb: 'Valley Foods / الادارة المالية / العملاء والموردون',
        contentId: 'vf-parties-content',
        menuGroups: (window.VALLEYFOODS_MENU || [])
      });
      document.getElementById('vf-parties-content').innerHTML =
        '<div class="vf-card"><div class="vf-card-header"><h3>العملاء والموردون</h3>' +
          (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="PARTIES_PAGE.openAdd()">+ إضافة سجل</button>' : '') +
        '</div><div class="vf-card-body">' +
          '<div id="pt-table"><p class="vf-text-muted">جاري التحميل...</p></div>' +
        '</div></div>';
      load();
    }

    function load() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('get_valley_parties')
        .then(function (res) {
          ROWS = (res && res.rows) || [];
          ENUMS = (res && res.enums) || {};
          NEXT_ID = (res && res.next_id) || 1;
          renderTable();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ في تحميل البيانات', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function renderTable() {
      var container = document.getElementById('pt-table');
      if (!container) return;
      var rows = ROWS.map(function (r) {
        var level = r['المستوى الاساسي'] || ((r.name || '') + (r.name_en ? ' - ' + r.name_en : ''));
        return [
          '<b>' + esc(r.id) + '</b>',
          esc(r.name),
          esc(r.customer_direction),
          esc(r.type || '-'),
          esc(r.telephone || '-'),
          esc(r.country || '-'),
          esc(level),
          '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px;" onclick="PARTIES_PAGE.openStatement(\'' + esc(r.id) + '\')">📄 كشف حساب</button>'
        ];
      });
      container.innerHTML = UIC.dataTable('parties-table-id', {
        headers: ['الكود', 'الاسم', 'الاتجاه', 'نوع التعامل', 'التليفون', 'الدولة', 'المستوى الأساسي', ''],
        rows: rows, pageSize: 100
      });
    }

    /* ---------- MODAL ---------- */
    function openAdd() { openModal(null); }

    function openEdit(id) {
      var row = null;
      ROWS.forEach(function (r) { if (String(r.id) === String(id)) row = r; });
      if (!row) { UIC.toast('لم يتم العثور على السجل', 'error'); return; }
      openModal(row);
    }

    function openModal(row) {
      var isEdit = !!row;
      /* Grayed-out non-editable id: preview of the auto-assigned code (add)
         or the actual record id (edit). Server always decides the final id. */
      var idValue = row ? row.id : NEXT_ID;
      var body = '<form id="pt-form">' +
        '<div class="form-field">' +
          '<label class="form-label">الرقم (يُعتمد تلقائياً)</label>' +
          '<input id="f-id-display" class="input" type="text" readonly value="' + esc(idValue) + '" style="background:#f3f4f6;color:#6b7280;cursor:not-allowed;">' +
        '</div>' +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-name', label: 'الاسم', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? row.name : '', noCorrect: true }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-direction', label: 'الاتجاه', required: true, options: (ENUMS.customer_direction || []).map(function (v) { return { value: v, label: v }; }), value: row ? row.customer_direction : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-type', label: 'نوع التعامل', required: true, options: (ENUMS.type || []).map(function (v) { return { value: v, label: v }; }), value: row ? String(row.type || '') : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-reg', label: 'رقم السجل التجاري', type: 'number', required: true, min: '0', value: row ? (row.registration_number != null ? row.registration_number : '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-tax', label: 'الرقم الضريبي', type: 'number', required: true, min: '0', value: row ? (row.tax_id != null ? row.tax_id : '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-name-en', label: 'الاسم الإنجليزي', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? (row.name_en || '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-country', label: 'الدولة', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? (row.country || '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-region', label: 'المنطقة', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? (row.region || '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-phone', label: 'التليفون', type: 'tel', required: true, value: row ? (row.telephone || '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-address', label: 'العنوان', type: 'textarea', required: true, value: row ? (row.address || '') : '' }) +
      '</form>';

      UIC.openModal('party-modal', {
        title: isEdit ? 'تعديل سجل' : 'إضافة عميل / مورد',
        body: body,
        onSave: 'PARTIES_PAGE.save(' + (isEdit ? esc(row.id) : 'null') + ')'
      });
    }

    function save(editId) {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('pt-form')) return;
      var v = function (id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; };
      var payload = {
        id: editId != null ? editId : '',
        name: v('f-name'),
        customer_direction: v('f-direction'),
        type: v('f-type'),
        registration_number: v('f-reg'),
        tax_id: v('f-tax'),
        name_en: v('f-name-en'),
        country: v('f-country'),
        region: v('f-region'),
        telephone: v('f-phone'),
        address: v('f-address')
      };
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('save_valley_party', payload)
        .then(function (r) {
          UIC.closeModal('party-modal');
          UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ بنجاح', 'success');
          load();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل الحفظ', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    /* ===================== PARTY STATEMENT (كشف حساب) =====================
     * Financial semantics ported verbatim from the legacy Client Statement
     * Engine: debit = sales/payments, credit = purchases/collections/returns,
     * chronological running balance, opening-balance row on date filters, and
     * editable stock valuation deducted from the net balance. */
    var STMT = null;

    function finFmt(n) {
      n = Number(n) || 0;
      var abs = Math.abs(n).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      return n < 0 ? '(' + abs + ')' : abs;
    }
    function chip(label, value, extraStyle) {
      return '<div style="background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;min-width:120px;text-align:center;">' +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600;">' + label + '</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;direction:ltr;' + (extraStyle || '') + '">' + value + '</div></div>';
    }

    function openStatement(pid) {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('get_valley_party_statement', { id: pid })
        .then(function (res) {
          STMT = res;
          renderStatementModal();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ في تحميل الكشف', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function renderStatementModal() {
      var p = STMT.party;
      var body =
        '<div style="background:#f0fdf4;border:1px solid #a7f0ba;border-left:4px solid #16a34a;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">' +
          '<div><h3 style="margin:0;color:#166534;font-size:18px;">' + esc(p.name) + '</h3>' +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:6px;">العنوان: <b>' + esc(p.address || '-') + '</b> · الرقم الضريبي: <b>' + esc(p.tax_id || '-') + '</b> · الهاتف: <b>' + esc(p.phone || '-') + '</b></div></div>' +
          '<div style="text-align:left;color:#9ca3af;font-size:11px;">Valley Foods ERP<br>IFRS Compliant Ledger</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="st-filter" style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;">' +
          UIC.field({ key: 'st-from', label: 'من تاريخ', type: 'date' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'st-to', label: 'إلى تاريخ', type: 'date' }) +
          UIC.combo({ key: 'st-type', label: 'نوع الحركة', options: [
            { value: 'all', label: 'عرض كل المعاملات' },
            { value: 'sales', label: 'مبيعات صادرة' },
            { value: 'returns', label: 'مرتجعات مبيعات' },
            { value: 'purchases', label: 'مشتريات وتوريدات' },
            { value: 'collections', label: 'مقبوضات نقدية' },
            { value: 'payments', label: 'مدفوعات صادرة' }
          ], value: 'all' }) +
          '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="PARTIES_PAGE.applyFilter()">⚡ تنفيذ</button>' +
          '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="PARTIES_PAGE.printStatement()">🖨️ طباعة / PDF</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="st-kpis" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;"></div>' +
        '<div id="st-net" style="margin-bottom:14px;"></div>' +
        '<div id="st-ledger"></div>' +
        '<div id="st-stock"></div>' +
        '<span id="st-range-badge" style="display:none;"></span>';

      /* wide modal */
      UIC.openModal('party-statement-modal', { title: '📄 كشف حساب مالي تفصيلي', body: body, footer: false });
      var modal = document.getElementById('party-statement-modal');
      if (modal) {
        var box = modal.querySelector('.modal');
        if (box) box.style.maxWidth = '1150px';
      }
      applyFilter();
    }

    function applyFilter() {
      var fromV = document.getElementById('st-from').value;
      var toV = document.getElementById('st-to').value;
      var typeSel = document.getElementById('st-type').value;
      var fromMs = fromV ? new Date(fromV + 'T00:00:00').getTime() : null;
      var toMs = toV ? new Date(toV + 'T23:59:59').getTime() : null;

      var kSales = 0, kReturns = 0, kCollections = 0, kPayments = 0, kPurchases = 0;
      var opening = 0;
      var visible = [];
      var txs = STMT.transactions;

      txs.forEach(function (t) {
        var tMs = t.date_iso ? new Date(t.date_iso).getTime() : 0;
        var sign = (t.type === 'collections' || t.type === 'purchases' || t.type === 'returns') ? 1 : -1;
        if (fromMs !== null && tMs && tMs < fromMs) { opening += t.value * sign; return; }
        if (toMs !== null && tMs && tMs > toMs) return;
        if (typeSel !== 'all' && t.type !== typeSel) return;
        visible.push(t);
        if (t.type === 'sales') kSales += t.value;
        else if (t.type === 'returns') kReturns += t.value;
        else if (t.type === 'collections') kCollections += t.value;
        else if (t.type === 'payments') kPayments += t.value;
        else if (t.type === 'purchases') kPurchases += t.value;
      });

      document.getElementById('st-kpis').innerHTML =
        chip('رصيد أول المدة', finFmt(opening), 'color:#0284c7;') +
        chip('إجمالي المبيعات (مدين)', finFmt(kSales), 'color:#dc2626;') +
        chip('المرتجعات (دائن)', finFmt(kReturns), 'color:#2563eb;') +
        chip('التحصيلات (دائن)', finFmt(kCollections), 'color:#059669;') +
        chip('المدفوعات له (مدين)', finFmt(kPayments), 'color:#b45309;') +
        chip('المشتريات (دائن)', finFmt(kPurchases), 'color:#7c3aed;');

      var running = opening;
      var html = '<table class="table"><thead><tr>' +
        '<th>التاريخ</th><th>رقم المستند</th><th>البيان</th>' +
        '<th>مدين</th><th>دائن</th><th>الرصيد التراكمي</th></tr></thead><tbody>';

      if (fromV) {
        html += '<tr style="font-style:italic;background:#f1f5f9;"><td>' + esc(fromV) + '</td><td>-</td>' +
          '<td style="color:#0284c7;">الرصيد الافتتاحي المنقول</td><td>-</td><td>-</td>' +
          '<td class="num" data-num="' + opening + '">' + finFmt(opening) + '</td></tr>';
      }

      visible.forEach(function (t) {
        var sign = (t.type === 'collections' || t.type === 'purchases' || t.type === 'returns') ? 1 : -1;
        running += t.value * sign;
        var debit = (t.type === 'sales' || t.type === 'payments') ? finFmt(t.value) : '-';
        var credit = (t.type !== 'sales' && t.type !== 'payments') ? finFmt(t.value) : '-';
        var subHtml = (t.sub_rows || []).map(function (s) {
          var det = s.details ? '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;background:#eef2ff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block;">📝 ' + esc(s.details) + '</div>' : '';
          return '<tr style="background:#fafafa;"><td></td><td style="color:#9ca3af;">↳ ' + esc(s.doc_id) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right;"><b>' + esc(s.name) + '</b> ' + det +
            ' <span style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;">الكمية: <b>' + finFmt(s.qty) + '</b> | السعر: <b>' + finFmt(s.price) + '</b></span></td>' +
            '<td colspan="3"></td></tr>';
        }).join('');
        html += '<tr><td>' + esc(t.date_display) + '</td><td style="direction:ltr;">' + esc(t.doc_id) + '</td>' +
          '<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700;">' + esc(t.desc_ar) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="num" style="' + (debit !== '-' ? 'color:#dc2626;' : '') + '" data-num="' + (debit !== '-' ? t.value : '') + '">' + debit + '</td>' +
          '<td class="num" style="' + (credit !== '-' ? 'color:#059669;' : '') + '" data-num="' + (credit !== '-' ? t.value : '') + '">' + credit + '</td>' +
          '<td class="num" style="font-weight:800;background:#f8fafc;" data-num="' + running + '">' + finFmt(running) + '</td></tr>' + subHtml;
      });

      if (!visible.length && !fromV) html += '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;padding:30px;">لا توجد حركات مسجلة لهذا الحساب.</td></tr>';
      html += '</tbody></table>';
      document.getElementById('st-ledger').innerHTML = html;

      var dirBadge = running > 0 ? 'لصالح الشركة (مدين) 🔺' : (running < 0 ? 'لصالح العميل (دائن) 🔻' : 'متوازن 🤝');
      var dirColor = running > 0 ? '#16a34a' : (running < 0 ? '#dc2626' : '#6b7280');
      document.getElementById('st-net').innerHTML =
        '<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0e623b,#059669);border-radius:8px;padding:16px 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">' +
          '<div><div style="color:#d1fae5;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;">صافي رصيد الحساب الموحد</div>' +
          '<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:5px 14px;display:inline-block;margin-top:6px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:' + dirColor + ';">' + dirBadge + '</div></div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;direction:ltr;">' + finFmt(running) + '</div>' +
        '</div>';

      renderStockSection();
    }

    function stockTotal() {
      var total = 0;
      (STMT.stock_rows || []).forEach(function (_, i) {
        var el = document.getElementById('stock-price-' + i);
        var qty = STMT.stock_rows[i].qty;
        total += qty * (el ? (parseFloat(el.value) || 0) : STMT.stock_rows[i].latest_price);
      });
      return total;
    }

    function renderStockSection() {
      var container = document.getElementById('st-stock');
      var rows = STMT.stock_rows || [];
      if (!rows.length) { container.innerHTML = ''; return; }

      var rowsHtml = rows.map(function (r, i) {
        return '<tr><td style="text-align:right;">' + esc(r.name) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="num" data-num="' + r.qty + '">' + finFmt(r.qty) + '</td>' +
          '<td><input id="stock-price-' + i + '" class="input" type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value="' + Number(r.latest_price).toFixed(2) + '" oninput="PARTIES_PAGE.recalcStock()" style="max-width:140px;direction:ltr;"></td>' +
          '<td class="num" id="stock-line-' + i + '" style="font-weight:700;color:#059669;" data-num="' + (r.qty * r.latest_price) + '">' + finFmt(r.qty * r.latest_price) + '</td></tr>';
      }).join('');

      container.innerHTML =
        '<h3 style="color:#166534;margin:20px 0 8px;border-right:4px solid #16a34a;padding-right:10px;">📦 تقييم المخزون المتاح بالعنابر</h3>' +
        '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;margin:-4px 0 10px;">يمكن تعديل سعر التقييم لكل صنف — يُعاد احتساب الإجمالي وخصمه من الصافي تلقائياً.</p>' +
        '<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>الصنف</th><th>الكمية الحالية</th><th>سعر التقييم ✏️</th><th>إجمالي القيمة</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        rowsHtml + '</tbody></table>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#f0fdf4;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">' +
          '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="PARTIES_PAGE.resetStockPrices()">🔄 إعادة تعيين الأسعار</button>' +
          '<div><span style="font-weight:700;color:#166534;">إجمالي قيمة المخزون:</span> ' +
          '<span id="stock-total" style="font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:#059669;direction:ltr;">' + finFmt(stockTotal()) + '</span></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="adjusted-box" style="margin-top:10px;"></div>';

      updateAdjusted();
    }

    function recalcStock() {
      var total = stockTotal();
      var st = document.getElementById('stock-total');
      if (st) st.textContent = finFmt(total);
      (STMT.stock_rows || []).forEach(function (r, i) {
        var el = document.getElementById('stock-price-' + i);
        var line = document.getElementById('stock-line-' + i);
        if (line && el) { var v = r.qty * (parseFloat(el.value) || 0); line.textContent = finFmt(v); line.setAttribute('data-num', v); }
      });
      updateAdjusted();
    }

    function resetStockPrices() {
      (STMT.stock_rows || []).forEach(function (r, i) {
        var el = document.getElementById('stock-price-' + i);
        if (el) el.value = Number(r.latest_price).toFixed(2);
      });
      recalcStock();
    }

    function readChipNum(id) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return 0;
      /* net balance lives inside gradient div — read from its last child span */
      var spans = el.querySelectorAll('div[style*="font-size:26px"]');
      if (spans.length) return parseFloat((spans[spans.length - 1].textContent || '').replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
      return parseFloat(el.textContent.replace(/[(),]/g, '')) || 0;
    }

    function updateAdjusted() {
      var net = readNetBalance();
      var stock = stockTotal();
      var adjusted = net - stock;
      var badge = adjusted > 0 ? 'لصالح الشركة (مدين) 🔺' : (adjusted < 0 ? 'لصالح العميل (دائن) 🔻' : 'متوازن 🤝');
      var color = adjusted > 0 ? '#dc2626' : (adjusted < 0 ? '#0e623b' : '#6b7280');
      document.getElementById('adjusted-box').innerHTML =
        '<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffbeb,#fef3c7);border:2px solid #b45309;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">' +
          '<div><div style="color:#92400e;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;">⚖️ الرصيد المستحق بعد خصم المخزون</div>' +
          '<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 12px;display:inline-block;margin-top:5px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:' + color + ';">' + badge + '</div></div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:23px;font-weight:800;color:#b45309;direction:ltr;">' + finFmt(adjusted) + '</div>' +
        '</div>';
    }

    function readNetBalance() {
      var netBox = document.getElementById('st-net');
      if (!netBox) return 0;
      var m = netBox.innerHTML.match(/font-size:26px[^>]*>([-\d,.]+)</);
      if (!m) return 0;
      var neg = false;
      return parseFloat(m[1].replace(/,/g, '')) || 0;
    }

    function printStatement() {
      var ledger = document.getElementById('st-ledger');
      var p = STMT.party;
      var win = window.open('', '_blank');
      if (!win) { UIC.toast('يرجى السماح بالنوافذ المنبثقة', 'error'); return; }
      win.document.open();
      win.document.write(
        '<!DOCTYPE html><html dir="rtl" lang="ar"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>كشف حساب - ' + p.name + '</title>' +
        '<style>body{font-family:Segoe UI,Tahoma,sans-serif;margin:20px;color:#1f2937;}h2{text-align:center;color:#094d2c;border-bottom:3px solid #0e623b;padding-bottom:10px;}meta{}</style></head><body>' +
        '<h2>📊 كشف حساب مالي تفصيلي — ' + esc(p.name) + '</h2>' +
        '<p style="text-align:center;color:#555;">الرقم الضريبي: ' + esc(p.tax_id || '-') + ' · العنوان: ' + esc(p.address || '-') + ' · الهاتف: ' + esc(p.phone || '-') + '</p>' +
        (ledger ? ledger.outerHTML : '') +
        document.getElementById('st-kpis').outerHTML +
        document.getElementById('st-net').outerHTML +
        '</body></html>'
      );
      win.document.close();
      setTimeout(function () { win.focus(); win.print(); }, 500);
    }

    window.PARTIES_PAGE = { openAdd: openAdd, openEdit: openEdit, save: save, openStatement: openStatement, applyFilter: applyFilter, printStatement: printStatement, recalcStock: recalcStock, resetStockPrices: resetStockPrices };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderApp);
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
    var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>';
    var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
    var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
    var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }
    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
  </script>

  <script>
  (function () {
    var ROWS = [], ENUMS = {}, CATEGORY_OPTIONS = [], ACCOUNT_OPTIONS = [], PARTY_OPTIONS = [], NEXT_ID = 1;
    var BATCHES_BY_PRODUCT = {};

    function renderApp() {
      UIC.appShell('vf-root', {
        companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
        companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=vf_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
        companyLogoTitle: 'Valley Foods',
        breadcrumb: 'Valley Foods / الادارة المالية / المنتجات',
        contentId: 'vf-products-content',
        menuGroups: (window.VALLEYFOODS_MENU || [])
      });
      document.getElementById('vf-products-content').innerHTML =
        '<div class="vf-card"><div class="vf-card-header"><h3>المنتجات</h3>' +
          (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="PRODUCTS_PAGE.openAdd()">+ إضافة منتج</button>' : '') +
        '</div><div class="vf-card-body">' +
          '<div id="pf-warning"></div>' +
          '<div id="pf-table"><p class="vf-text-muted">جاري التحميل...</p></div>' +
        '</div></div>';
      load();
    }

    function load() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('get_valley_products')
        .then(function (res) {
          ROWS = (res && res.rows) || [];
          ENUMS = (res && res.enums) || {};
          CATEGORY_OPTIONS = (res && res.category_options) || [];
          ACCOUNT_OPTIONS = (res && res.account_options) || [];
          PARTY_OPTIONS = (res && res.party_options) || [];
          NEXT_ID = (res && res.next_id) || 1;
          BATCHES_BY_PRODUCT = (res && res.batches_by_product) || {};
          renderTable(res);
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ في تحميل البيانات', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function renderTable(res) {
      var container = document.getElementById('pf-table');
      if (!container) return;
      if (res && res.alignment_warning) {
        document.getElementById('pf-warning').innerHTML =
          '<div style="background:#fffbeb;border:1px solid #fde68a;color:#92400e;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:13px;">⚠️ ' + esc(res.alignment_warning) + '</div>';
      }
      var partyMap = {};
      PARTY_OPTIONS.forEach(function (o) { partyMap[String(o.value)] = o.label; });
      var catMap = {};
      CATEGORY_OPTIONS.forEach(function (o) { catMap[String(o.value)] = o.label; });
      var rows = ROWS.map(function (r) {
        var partyLabel = partyMap[String(r.client_id)] || r.client_id || '-';
        var hasStock = r.batch_count > 0;
        return [
          '<b data-pid="' + esc(r.id) + '">' + esc(r.id) + '</b>',
          esc(r.name_ar),
          esc(r.product_type),
          esc(r.name_en || '-'),
          esc(partyLabel),
          esc(r.unit || r.price_unit || '-'),
          esc(r.carton != null && r.carton !== '' ? r.carton : '-'),
          (r.sales_tax != null && r.sales_tax !== '' ? (Number(r.sales_tax) * 100) + '%' : '-'),
          esc(catMap[String(r.category)] || r.category || '-'),
          '<span class="num" data-num="' + (r.current_stock_qty || 0) + '">' + fmtNum(r.current_stock_qty) + '</span>',
          '<span class="num" style="font-weight:700;color:#0e623b;" data-num="' + (r.stock_value || 0) + '">' + fmtNum(r.stock_value, 2) + '</span>',
          (hasStock
            ? fmtNum(r.batch_count) + (r.aged_count ? ' <span style="color:#d97706;font-weight:700;">⚠' + r.aged_count + '</span>' : '')
            : '<span style="color:#94a3b8;">0</span>')
        ];
      });
      container.innerHTML = UIC.dataTable('products-table-id', {
        headers: ['الكود', 'الاسم', 'النوع', 'الاسم الإنجليزي', 'العميل/المورد', 'الوحدة', 'الكرتونة او التغليف', 'الضريبة', 'التصنيف',
                  { label: 'الرصيد الحالي', numeric: true }, { label: 'القيمة (ج.م)', numeric: true }, { label: 'الباتشات', numeric: true }],
        rows: rows,
        rowClick: function (rec, tr) {
          var el = tr.querySelector('[data-pid]');
          if (el) PRODUCTS_PAGE.openBatches(el.getAttribute('data-pid'));
        }
      });
    }

    /* ---------- MODAL ---------- */
    function openAdd() { openModal(null); }

    function openEdit(id) {
      var row = null;
      ROWS.forEach(function (r) { if (String(r.id) === String(id)) row = r; });
      if (!row) { UIC.toast('لم يتم العثور على المنتج', 'error'); return; }
      openModal(row);
    }

    function openModal(row) {
      var isEdit = !!row;
      /* Grayed-out non-editable id: preview of the auto-assigned code (add)
         or the actual record id (edit). Server always decides the final id. */
      var idValue = row ? row.id : NEXT_ID;
      /* UIC.field select expects an ARRAY of {value,label} — not HTML */
      var withEmpty = function (arr) {
        return [{ value: '', label: '—' }].concat(arr || []);
      };
      var TAX_OPTIONS = [
        { value: 0, label: '0%' },
        { value: 0.05, label: '5%' },
        { value: 0.10, label: '10%' },
        { value: 0.14, label: '14%' }
      ];
      /* ALL entry fields are mandatory (mirrors server validation). */
      var body = '<form id="pf-form">' +
        '<div class="form-field">' +
          '<label class="form-label">رقم المنتج (يُعتمد تلقائياً)</label>' +
          '<input id="f-id-display" class="input" type="text" readonly value="' + esc(idValue) + '" style="background:#f3f4f6;color:#6b7280;cursor:not-allowed;">' +
        '</div>' +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-name-ar', label: 'الاسم العربي', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? row.name_ar : '', noCorrect: true }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-type', label: 'نوع المنتج', required: true, options: (ENUMS.product_type || []).map(function (v) { return { value: v, label: v }; }), value: row ? row.product_type : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-name-en', label: 'الاسم الإنجليزي', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? (row.name_en || '') : '' }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-client', label: 'العميل / المورد', options: PARTY_OPTIONS, value: row ? String(row.client_id || '') : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-gpc', label: 'GPC', type: 'number', required: true, min: '0', value: row ? (row.GPC != null ? row.GPC : '') : '' }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-unit', label: 'الوحدة', required: true, options: (ENUMS.unit || []).map(function (v) { return { value: v, label: v }; }), value: row ? (row.unit || row.price_unit) : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-carton', label: 'الكرتونة او التغليف', type: 'number', required: true, min: '0', step: '0.01', value: row ? (row.carton != null ? row.carton : '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-alloc', label: 'نسبة تخصيص التكلفة %', type: 'number', required: true, min: '0', max: '100', step: '0.01', value: row ? (row.cost_allocation_percentage != null ? row.cost_allocation_percentage : '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-conc', label: 'التركيز', type: 'text', required: true, value: row ? (row.concentration || '') : '' }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-asset', label: 'كود الأصل', required: true, options: ACCOUNT_OPTIONS, value: row ? String(row.asset_code || '') : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-category', label: 'التصنيف', required: true, options: CATEGORY_OPTIONS, value: row ? String(row.category || '') : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-tax', label: 'نسبة ضريبة المبيعات %', required: true, options: TAX_OPTIONS, value: row != null && row.sales_tax !== '' && row.sales_tax != null ? Number(row.sales_tax) : 0, placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'f-quality', label: 'رقابة الجودة', required: true, options: withEmpty(ENUMS.quality_controlled), value: row ? String(row.quality_controlled || '') : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
      '</form>';

      UIC.openModal('product-modal', {
        title: (isEdit ? 'تعديل منتج: ' : 'إضافة منتج') ,
        body: body,
        onSave: 'PRODUCTS_PAGE.save(' + (isEdit ? esc(row.id) : 'null') + ')'
      });
    }

    function save(editId) {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('pf-form')) return;
      var v = function (id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; };
      var payload = {
        id: editId != null ? editId : '',
        name_ar: v('f-name-ar'),
        product_type: v('f-type'),
        name_en: v('f-name-en'),
        client_id: v('f-client'),
        GPC: v('f-gpc'),
        unit: v('f-unit'),
        carton: v('f-carton'),
        cost_allocation_percentage: v('f-alloc'),
        concentration: v('f-conc'),
        asset_code: v('f-asset'),
        category: v('f-category'),
        sales_tax: v('f-tax'),
        quality_controlled: v('f-quality')
      };
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('save_valley_product', payload)
        .then(function (r) {
          UIC.closeModal('product-modal');
          UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ بنجاح', 'success');
          load();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل الحفظ', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    window.PRODUCTS_PAGE = { openAdd: openAdd, openEdit: openEdit, save: save, openBatches: openBatches };

    /* ===================== STOCK SUMMARY + BATCH MODAL =====================
     * Data logic ported from the legacy stock report (server-side grouping,
     * chart-range exclusions, 90-day aging). */
    function fmtNum(n, dec) {
      return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: dec || 0, maximumFractionDigits: dec == null ? 2 : dec });
    }

    function openBatches(pid) {
      var row = null;
      ROWS.forEach(function (r) { if (String(r.id) === String(pid)) row = r; });
      var batches = BATCHES_BY_PRODUCT[String(pid)] || [];
      var qtySum = 0, valSum = 0, agedN = 0;
      batches.forEach(function (b) { qtySum += b.qty; valSum += b.value; if (b.aged) agedN++; });

      var inner = '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px;">' +
        chip('إجمالي الرصيد', fmtNum(qtySum)) +
        chip('القيمة (ج.م)', fmtNum(valSum, 2)) +
        chip('عدد الباتشات', fmtNum(batches.length)) +
        chip('متقادم ⚠', fmtNum(agedN)) +
      '</div>';

      if (!batches.length) {
        inner += '<p class="vf-text-muted">لا يوجد رصيد حالي لهذا المنتج.</p>';
      } else {
        inner += '<div style="overflow-x:auto;"><table class="table"><thead><tr>' +
          '<th>كود الحركة (الدفعة)</th><th>التاريخ</th><th>حساب التوجيه</th>' +
          '<th>الكمية</th><th>تكلفة الوحدة</th><th>القيمة (ج.م)</th>' +
        '</tr></thead><tbody>';
        batches.forEach(function (b) {
          inner += '<tr' + (b.aged ? ' style="background:#fffbeb;"' : '') + '>' +
            '<td><span style="background:#eef2f6;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;">' + esc(b.lot) + '</span></td>' +
            '<td style="font-family:monospace;">' + (b.aged ? '<span style="color:#d97706;" title="باتش متقادم (>90 يوم)">⚠ </span>' : '') + esc(b.date_display) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="text-align:right;font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;">' + esc(b.chart_name) + '</td>' +
            '<td class="num" data-num="' + b.qty + '">' + fmtNum(b.qty) + '</td>' +
            '<td class="num" data-num="' + b.cost + '">' + fmtNum(b.cost, 2) + '</td>' +
            '<td class="num" data-num="' + b.value + '">' + fmtNum(b.value, 2) + '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
        });
        inner += '</tbody></table></div>';
      }

      UIC.openModal('product-batches-modal', {
        title: 'الباتشات — ' + ((row && row.name_ar) || '') + ' (' + pid + ')',
        body: inner,
        footer: false
      });
    }

    function chip(label, value) {
      return '<div style="background:#f0fdf4;border:1px solid #a7f0ba;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px;min-width:130px;text-align:center;">' +
        '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#166534;font-weight:700;">' + label + '</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#14532d;">' + value + '</div></div>';
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderApp);
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  function renderHeadersTable() {
    var content = document.getElementById('vf-purchasing-content');
    __headers.sort(function (a, b) { return Number(b.id) - Number(a.id); });
    var supMap = {};
    (__options.supplier_options || []).forEach(function (o) { supMap[String(o.value)] = o.label; });
    var rows = __headers.map(function (h) {
      var opts = '<option value="">إجراءات...</option>';
      opts += '<option value="print">طباعة</option>';
      if (String(h.approval_status) !== 'Approved') {
        opts += '<option value="approve">اعتماد</option>';
        if (CAN_WRITE) opts += '<option value="edit">تعديل</option><option value="delete">حذف</option>';
        else opts += '<option value="view">عرض</option>';
      } else {
        opts += '<option value="view">عرض</option>';
      }
      if (CAN_WRITE) opts += '<option value="quality">اعتماد الجودة</option>';
      var actions = '<select class="input" style="padding:6px 8px;width:140px;" onchange="doAction(\'' + esc(String(h.Code)) + '\', this.value); this.value=\'\';">' + opts + '</select>';
      return {
        Code: h.Code || '-',
        supplier_name: supMap[String(h['Supplier Name'])] || h['Supplier Name'] || '-',
        receipt_date: h['Reciept Date'] ? String(h['Reciept Date']).slice(0, 10) : '-',
        items: h.Items || '-',
        total_costs: FMT.number(h['Total costs']),
        approval_status: h.approval_status || '-',
        quality_status: h.quality_approval_status || '—',
        actions: actions
      };
    });
    content.innerHTML = '<div class="vf-card"><div class="vf-card-header"><h3>المشتريات</h3>' +
      (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openForm(\'\', false)">+ إضافة عملية شراء</button>' : '') +
      '</div><div class="vf-card-body">' +
      UIC.dataTable('purchasing-table', {
        title: 'عمليات الشراء',
        searchable: true,
        headers: [
          { key: 'Code', label: 'الكود' },
          { key: 'supplier_name', label: 'المورد' },
          { key: 'receipt_date', label: 'تاريخ الاستلام' },
          { key: 'items', label: 'الأصناف' },
          { key: 'total_costs', label: 'إجمالي التكاليف', numeric: true },
          { key: 'approval_status', label: 'الحالة' },
          { key: 'quality_status', label: 'حالة الجودة' },
          { key: 'actions', label: 'إجراءات' }
        ],
        rows: rows,
        emptyText: 'لا توجد عمليات شراء'
      }) + '</div></div>';
    UIC.initTableSort('purchasing-table');
  }

    function openForm(code, viewOnly) {
      __editingCode = code || '';
      __viewOnly = !!viewOnly;
      var record = null;
      if (code) {
        record = __headers.find(function (h) { return String(h.Code) === String(code); }) || null;
      }
      renderForm(record);
    }

    function headerSections() {
      return [
        { title: 'البيانات الأساسية', open: true, fields: HEADER_FIELDS.slice(0, 10) },
        { title: 'التكاليف والمصاريف', fields: HEADER_FIELDS.slice(10, 22) },
        { title: 'الضرائب وأخرى', fields: HEADER_FIELDS.slice(22) }
      ];
    }

    function fieldValue(s, record) {
      var v = record ? record[s.col] : null;
      if (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '') return v;
      if (s.type === 'date' && s.default === 'today') return formatDate(new Date());
      if (s.default !== undefined && s.default !== null) return s.default;
      return s.type === 'number' ? 0 : '';
    }

    function renderField(s, record) {
      var opts = s.options;
      if (opts === '__supplier__') opts = __options.supplier_options || [];
      else if (opts === '__currency__') opts = __options.currency_options || [];
      var v = fieldValue(s, record);
      if (s.type === 'select') {
        return UIC.field({ key: s.key, label: s.label, type: 'select', options: opts, value: v });
      }
      if (s.type === 'date') {
        return UIC.field({ key: s.key, label: s.label, type: 'date', value: v, required: !!s.required });
      }
      if (s.key === 'value' && (!v || Number(v) === 0)) v = '';
      return UIC.field({ key: s.key, label: s.label, type: s.type, value: v, required: !!s.required, min: s.type === 'number' ? 0 : undefined, step: s.type === 'number' ? 'any' : undefined });
    }

    function renderForm(record) {
      var content = document.getElementById('vf-purchasing-content');
      __canEdit = !__viewOnly && CAN_WRITE;

      var sectionsHtml = headerSections().map(function (sec) {
        var grid = '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:0 16px;">' +
          sec.fields.map(function (s) { return renderField(s, record); }).join('') + '</div>';
        return '<details' + (sec.open ? ' open' : '') + ' style="margin-bottom:12px;border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--bg-surface);">' +
          '<summary style="font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:12px;">' + sec.title + '</summary>' + grid + '</details>';
      }).join('');

      content.innerHTML =
        '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
        '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="showList()">← عودة</button>' +
        '<h2 style="margin:0;">' + (record ? 'تعديل عملية شراء' : 'إضافة عملية شراء') + '</h2></div>' +
        '<form id="purchasing-form">' +
        '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;padding:16px;background:var(--bg-surface);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">' +
        '<div>قيمة بناءً على الفاتورة: <strong id="value_based_on_invoice_display">0</strong></div>' +
        '<div>إجمالي التكاليف: <strong id="total_costs_display">0</strong></div>' +
        '<div>مجموع تكاليف الأصناف: <strong id="lines_total_display">0</strong></div>' +
        '<div>قيمة البيع: <strong id="sales_value_display">0</strong></div>' +
        '<div>نوع الضريبة: <strong id="tax_type_display">-</strong></div>' +
        '<div>ضريبة المبيعات: <strong id="sales_tax_display">0</strong></div>' +
        '<div>الشهر: <strong id="month_display">-</strong></div>' +
        '<div>السنة: <strong id="year_display">-</strong></div>' +
        '<div id="reconcile_warning" style="flex-basis:100%;color:var(--danger);font-weight:700;display:none;">⚠ مجموع تكاليف الأصناف لا يساوي إجمالي التكاليف</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        sectionsHtml +
        '</form>' +
        '<h3 style="margin-top:20px;">الأصناف</h3>' +
        '<div style="overflow-x:auto;">' +
        '<table class="table" style="min-width:900px;"><thead><tr>' +
        '<th>المنتج</th><th>الكمية</th><th>سعر الوحدة</th><th>تكاليف أخرى</th><th>سعر البيع</th><th>نوع الحركة</th><th>الإجمالي</th>' + (__canEdit ? '<th></th>' : '') +
        '</tr></thead><tbody id="lines-tbody"></tbody></table>' +
        '</div>' +
        (__canEdit ? '<div style="margin:12px 0;"><button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="addLine()">+ إضافة صنف</button></div>' : '') +
        '<div style="margin:16px 0;">' + (__canEdit ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="savePurchasing()">حفظ</button> ' : '') +
        '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="showList()">إلغاء</button></div>';

      var curEl = document.getElementById('currency');
      if (curEl) curEl.addEventListener('change', onCurrencyChange);

      attachCalcListeners();

      __lines = [];
      if (record) {
        companyCall('get_valley_purchasing_lines', { code: record.Code })
          .then(function (r) {
            __lines = (r.lines || []).map(function (l) {
              return {
                product: l.product, qty: l.qty, unit_price: l.unit_price, other_cost: l.other_cost,
                sales_value: l.sales_value, movement_type: l.movement_type, total_cost: l.total_cost,
                product_category: l.product_category, vendor: l.vendor, lot_identification: l.lot_identification,
                receipt_date: l.receipt_date, invoice_date: l.invoice_date, currency: l.currency,
                exchange_rate: l.exchange_rate, unit_cost: l.unit_cost, sales_qty: l.sales_qty,
                sales_value_amount: l.sales_value_amount
              };
            });
            renderLines();
          })
          .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
      } else {
        renderLines();
      }
    }

    function attachCalcListeners() {
      ['value', 'exchange_rate', 'type', 'tax_type', 'receipt_date', 'administrative_expenses', 'customs_expenses',
        'unloading_expenses', 'bank_commission', 'customs_clearance', 'additional_fees', 'clearance_expenses',
        'other_expenses', 'internal_cost_adjustment'].forEach(function (k) {
        var el = document.getElementById(k);
        if (el) { el.addEventListener('input', recalc); el.addEventListener('change', recalc); }
      });
    }

    function renderLines() {
      var lines = __lines || [];
      var opts = __options || {};
      var html = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        var l = lines[i];
        var avail = availableProducts(i);
        html += '<tr>' +
          '<td><select id="product_' + i + '" class="input" onchange="updateLineSelect(' + i + ', \'product\', this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">اختر...</option>' +
          avail.map(function (p) {
            return '<option value="' + esc(p.value) + '"' + (String(p.value) === String(l.product) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(p.label) + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
          '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.qty != null ? l.qty : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'qty\', this.value)"></td>' +
          '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.unit_price != null ? l.unit_price : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'unit_price\', this.value)"></td>' +
          '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.other_cost != null ? l.other_cost : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'other_cost\', this.value)"></td>' +
          '<td><input class="input" type="number" min="0" step="any" value="' + (l.sales_value != null ? l.sales_value : '') + '" oninput="updateLineInput(' + i + ', \'sales_value\', this.value)"></td>' +
          '<td><select id="movement_type_' + i + '" class="input" onchange="updateLineSelect(' + i + ', \'movement_type\', this.value)">' +
          '<option value="">اختر...</option>' +
          (opts.movement_type_options || []).map(function (o) {
            return '<option value="' + esc(o.fifth) + '"' + (String(o.fifth) === String(l.movement_type) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(o.code) + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
          '</select></td>' +
          '<td id="total_cost_' + i + '"></td>' +
          (__canEdit ? '<td><button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:4px 10px;" onclick="removeLine(' + i + ')">حذف</button></td>' : '') +
          '</tr>';
      }
      var tbody = document.getElementById('lines-tbody');
      if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = html;
      recalc();
    }

    function availableProducts(excludeIndex) {
      var chosen = {};
      (__lines || []).forEach(function (l, i) {
        if (i !== excludeIndex && l.product) chosen[String(l.product)] = true;
      });
      return (__options.product_options || []).filter(function (p) { return !chosen[String(p.value)]; });
    }

    function addLine() {
      __lines.push({ product: '', qty: 0, unit_price: 0, other_cost: 0, sales_value: 0, movement_type: '' });
      renderLines();
    }

    function removeLine(i) {
      __lines.splice(i, 1);
      renderLines();
    }

    function updateLineInput(i, key, value) {
      __lines[i][key] = value;
      recalc();
    }

    function updateLineSelect(i, key, value) {
      __lines[i][key] = value;
      renderLines();
    }

    function computeTotals() {
      var rate = num(getVal('exchange_rate'));
      var lineSum = 0;
      (__lines || []).forEach(function (l) {
        var tc = num(l.qty) * num(l.unit_price) * rate + num(l.other_cost);
        l.total_cost = tc;
        lineSum += tc;
      });
      var value = num(getVal('value'));
      var vbi = value * rate;
      var expenses = num(getVal('administrative_expenses')) + num(getVal('customs_expenses')) +
        num(getVal('unloading_expenses')) + num(getVal('bank_commission')) + num(getVal('customs_clearance')) +
        num(getVal('additional_fees')) + num(getVal('clearance_expenses')) + num(getVal('other_expenses'));
      var type = getVal('type');
      var totalCosts = vbi + expenses + (type === 'بيع' ? 0 : num(getVal('internal_cost_adjustment')) + num(getVal('purchase_tax')));
      var mismatch = Math.abs(lineSum - totalCosts) > 0.01;
      var salesValue = type === 'بيع' ? Math.round((totalCosts * 103 / 100) / 100) * 100 : 0;
      var purchaseTax = num(getVal('purchase_tax'));
      var denom = num(getVal('importation_reprice')) + num(getVal('customs_expenses'));
      var taxType = denom > 0 ? (purchaseTax / denom >= 0.08 ? 0.14 : purchaseTax / denom) : '';
      var salesTax = (taxType === '' || num(taxType) > 0.06) ? salesValue * 14 / 100 : 0;
      var d = new Date(getVal('receipt_date'));
      var month = (!isNaN(d.getTime())) ? d.getMonth() + 1 : '';
      var year = (!isNaN(d.getTime())) ? d.getFullYear() : '';
      return { valueBasedOnInvoice: vbi, totalCosts: totalCosts, linesTotal: lineSum, salesValue: salesValue, taxType: taxType, salesTax: salesTax, month: month, year: year, mismatch: mismatch };
    }

    function recalc() {
      var t = computeTotals();
      setText('lines_total_display', FMT.number(t.linesTotal));
      setText('value_based_on_invoice_display', FMT.number(t.valueBasedOnInvoice));
      setText('total_costs_display', FMT.number(t.totalCosts));
      var lcEl = document.getElementById('lines_total_display');
      var tcEl = document.getElementById('total_costs_display');
      var warnEl = document.getElementById('reconcile_warning');
      if (lcEl) lcEl.style.color = t.mismatch ? 'var(--danger)' : '';
      if (tcEl) tcEl.style.color = t.mismatch ? 'var(--danger)' : '';
      if (warnEl) warnEl.style.display = t.mismatch ? '' : 'none';
      setText('sales_value_display', FMT.number(t.salesValue));
      setText('tax_type_display', t.taxType === '' ? '-' : t.taxType);
      setText('sales_tax_display', FMT.number(t.salesTax));
      setText('month_display', t.month === '' ? '-' : t.month);
      setText('year_display', t.year === '' ? '-' : t.year);
      var lines = __lines || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        setText('total_cost_' + i, FMT.number(lines[i].total_cost));
      }
    }

    function onCurrencyChange() {
      var sel = document.getElementById('currency');
      if (!sel) return;
      var cur = sel.value;
      var opts = __options.currency_options || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
        if (String(opts[i].value) === String(cur)) {
          var rateEl = document.getElementById('exchange_rate');
          if (rateEl && opts[i].rate !== '' && opts[i].rate !== undefined && opts[i].rate !== null) rateEl.value = opts[i].rate;
          recalc();
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    function savePurchasing() {
      var form = UIC.collectForm('purchasing-form');
      if (!UIC.validateForm('purchasing-form')) return;
      var header = {};
      HEADER_FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
        var val = form[f.key];
        header[f.col] = (val === undefined || val === null) ? '' : val;
      });
      if (String(header['Code']).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('الكود (Code) مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
      if (String(header['Value']).trim() === '') { UIC.toast('قيمة الفاتورة (Value) مطلوبة', 'error'); return; }

      var t = computeTotals();
      header['Value Based on Invoice'] = t.valueBasedOnInvoice;
      header['Total costs'] = t.totalCosts;
      header['Sales Value'] = t.salesValue;
      header['Tax type'] = t.taxType;
      header['sales tax amount'] = t.salesTax;
      header['month'] = t.month;
      header['Year'] = t.year;

      var payload = { header: header, originalCode: __editingCode, lines: __lines || [] };
      UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
      companyCall('save_valley_purchasing_costing', payload)
        .then(function (r) {
          UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
          showList();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
    }

    function doAction(code, action) {
      if (action === 'approve') approvePurchasing(code);
      else if (action === 'edit') openForm(code, false);
      else if (action === 'view') openForm(code, true);
      else if (action === 'delete') deletePurchasing(code);
      else if (action === 'quality') qualityApprovePurchasing(code);
      else if (action === 'print') openPrint(code);
    }

    function qualityApprovePurchasing(code) {
      UI.showSpinner('جاري اعتماد الجودة...');
      companyCall('quality_approve_valley_purchasing_costing', { code: code })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم اعتماد الجودة', 'success'); showList(); })
        .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
    }

    function openPrint(code) {
      var rec = __headers.find(function (h) { return String(h.Code) === String(code); }) || null;
      if (!rec) { UIC.toast('العملية غير موجودة', 'error'); return; }
      UI.showSpinner('جاري تجهيز الطباعة...');
      companyCall('get_valley_purchasing_lines', { code: code })
        .then(function (r) {
          var lines = (r && r.lines) || [];
          var supMap = {}; (__options.supplier_options || []).forEach(function (o) { supMap[String(o.value)] = o.label; });
          var prodMap = {}; (__options.product_options || []).forEach(function (o) { prodMap[String(o.value)] = o.label; });
          var w = window.open('', '_blank');
          if (!w) { UIC.toast('تم حظر النافذة المنبثقة', 'error'); return; }
          w.document.open();
          w.document.write(buildPrintHtml(rec, lines, supMap, prodMap));
          w.document.close();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function buildPrintHtml(rec, lines, supMap, prodMap) {
      var supName = supMap[String(rec['Supplier Name'])] || rec['Supplier Name'] || '-';
      var finStatus = rec.approval_status || '-';
      var qStatus = rec.quality_approval_status || '-';
      var qBy = rec.quality_approval || '';
      var qTime = rec.quality_approval_time ? String(rec.quality_approval_time).slice(0, 19) : '';
      var head = '<tr><th>الكود</th><td>' + esc(rec.Code) + '</td>' +
        '<th>المورد</th><td>' + esc(supName) + '</td></tr>' +
        '<tr><th>تاريخ الاستلام</th><td>' + esc(rec['Reciept Date'] ? String(rec['Reciept Date']).slice(0, 10) : '-') + '</td>' +
        '<th>النوع</th><td>' + esc(rec.Type || '-') + '</td></tr>' +
        '<tr><th>العملة</th><td>' + esc(rec.Currency || '-') + '</td>' +
        '<th>القيمة (Value)</th><td>' + FMT.number(rec.Value) + '</td></tr>' +
        '<tr><th>إجمالي التكاليف</th><td>' + FMT.number(rec['Total costs']) + '</td>' +
        '<th>الأصناف</th><td>' + esc(rec.Items || '-') + '</td></tr>' +
        '<tr><th>حالة الاعتماد المالي</th><td>' + esc(finStatus) + '</td>' +
        '<th>حالة اعتماد الجودة</th><td>' + esc(qStatus) + (qBy ? ' (' + esc(qBy) + (qTime ? ' — ' + esc(qTime) : '') + ')' : '') + '</td></tr>';
      var lrows = (lines || []).map(function (l) {
        return '<tr>' +
          '<td>' + esc(prodMap[String(l.product)] || l.product || '-') + '</td>' +
          '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(l.qty) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(l.unit_price) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(l.other_cost) + '</td>' +
          '<td class="num">' + FMT.number(l.total_cost) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + esc(l.movement_type || '-') + '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('');
      if (!lrows) lrows = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;padding:12px;">لا توجد أصناف</td></tr>';
      return '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ar" dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8">' +
        '<title>طباعة عملية شراء — ' + esc(String(rec.Code)) + '</title>' +
        '<style>body{font-family:Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;padding:24px;color:#111;}' +
        'h2{margin:0 0 12px;}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin-bottom:18px;}' +
        'th,td{border:1px solid #999;padding:6px 10px;text-align:right;}' +
        'th{background:#f0f0f0;white-space:nowrap;}td.num{text-align:left;direction:ltr;}' +
        '.btn{margin-bottom:16px;padding:8px 18px;background:#1976d2;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;}' +
        '@media print{.no-print{display:none;}}</style></head><body>' +
        '<button class="btn no-print" onclick="window.print()">طباعة هذه الصفحة</button>' +
        '<h2>تفاصيل عملية الشراء — ' + esc(String(rec.Code)) + '</h2>' +
        '<table>' + head + '</table>' +
        '<h3>الأصناف</h3>' +
        '<table><thead><tr><th>المنتج</th><th>الكمية</th><th>سعر الوحدة</th><th>تكاليف أخرى</th><th>الإجمالي</th><th>نوع الحركة</th></tr></thead>' +
        '<tbody>' + lrows + '</tbody></table>' +
        '</body></html>';
    }

    function approvePurchasing(code) {
      UI.showSpinner('جاري الاعتماد...');
      companyCall('approve_valley_purchasing_costing', { code: code })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الاعتماد', 'success'); showList(); })
        .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
    }

    function deletePurchasing(code) {
      if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذه العملية؟')) return;
      UI.showSpinner('جاري الحذف...');
      companyCall('delete_valley_purchasing_costing', { code: code })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); showList(); })
        .catch(function (e) { UI.hideSpinner(); UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); });
    }

    function showList() {
      renderList();
    }

    function showError(e) {
      var content = document.getElementById('vf-purchasing-content');
      if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span>' + esc((e && e.message) || 'خطأ') + '</span></div>';
    }

    function formatDate(v) {
      if (!v) return '';
      var d = new Date(v);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);
      return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }

    function logout() {
      API.clearSession();
      window.location.href = scriptUrl + '?action=login';
    }

    load();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

 * for the dashboard double-gate.
 */
