  <script>
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
    var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>';
    var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
    var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
    var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
    var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }
    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    function num0(v) { var n = Number(v); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
    function todayStr() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
    function fmtDate(v) {
      if (!v) return '-';
      var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
      var p = function (n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; };
      return p(d.getDate()) + '/' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + d.getFullYear();
    }
  </script>

  <script>
  (function () {
    var INVOICES = [], PARTIES = [], PRODUCTS = [], ENUMS = {};

    function renderApp() {
      UIC.appShell('vf-root', {
        companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
        companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=vf_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
        companyLogoTitle: 'Valley Foods',
        breadcrumb: 'Valley Foods / الادارة المالية / المبيعات',
        contentId: 'vf-sales-content',
        menuGroups: (window.VALLEYFOODS_MENU || [])
      });
      document.getElementById('vf-sales-content').innerHTML =
        '<div class="vf-card"><div class="vf-card-header"><h3>فواتير المبيعات</h3>' +
          (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="SALES_PAGE.openAdd()">+ إضافة فاتورة</button>' : '') +
        '</div><div class="vf-card-body">' +
          '<div id="sales-table"><p class="vf-text-muted">جاري التحميل...</p></div>' +
        '</div></div>';
      load();
    }

    function load() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      var container = document.getElementById('sales-table');
      if (container) {
        UIC.PagedTable({
          container: container,
          headers: ['رقم الفاتورة', 'العميل', 'التاريخ',
            { label: 'الصافي', numeric: true }, { label: 'الضريبة', numeric: true }, { label: 'الإجمالي', numeric: true },
            'الاعتماد', ''],
          pageSize: 100,
          emptyText: 'لا توجد فواتير',
          onRendered: function (tid) { try { UIC.initTableSort(tid); } catch (e) {} },
          fetcher: function (offset, limit) {
            return companyCall('get_valley_sales_page', { offset: offset, limit: limit });
          },
          onFirst: function (r) {
            PARTIES = r.parties || [];
            PRODUCTS = r.products || [];
            ENUMS = r.enums || {};
          },
          mapRow: function (inv) {
            var isApproved = inv.approval_status === 'Approved';
            var actions = '';
            if (IS_SUPER_ADMIN) {
              /* S2: revert-first — approved invoices are immutable */
              actions = '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;" onclick="SALES_PAGE.approve(\'' + esc(inv.invoice_unique_id) + '\')">' + (isApproved ? 'إرجاع لقيد الانتظار' : 'اعتماد') + '</button>' +
                (isApproved ? '' :
                  ' <button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;" onclick="SALES_PAGE.openEdit(\'' + esc(inv.invoice_unique_id) + '\')">تعديل</button>' +
                  ' <button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;color:#dc2626;" onclick="SALES_PAGE.remove(\'' + esc(inv.invoice_unique_id) + '\')">حذف</button>');
            }
            return [
              '<b>' + esc(inv['رقم الفاتورة'] || '-') + '</b>',
              esc(partyLabel(inv['اسم العميل'])),
              fmtDate(inv['تاريخ الفاتورة']),
              '<span class="num" data-num="' + num0(inv['المبلغ الصافي']) + '">' + num0(inv['المبلغ الصافي']).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) + '</span>',
              '<span class="num" data-num="' + num0(inv['قيمة الضريبة']) + '">' + num0(inv['قيمة الضريبة']).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) + '</span>',
              '<span class="num" style="font-weight:700;color:#0e623b;" data-num="' + num0(inv['إجمالي']) + '">' + num0(inv['إجمالي']).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) + '</span>',
              UIC.statusPill(isApproved ? 'معتمد' : 'قيد الانتظار', isApproved ? 'success' : 'neutral'),
              actions
            ];
          }
        });
      }
      UI.hideSpinner();
    }

    function partyLabel(idRef) {
      var f = PARTIES.filter(function (o) { return String(o.value) === String(idRef); })[0];
      return f ? f.label : (idRef || '-');
    }

    /* ---------- ODOO-STYLE ENTRY MODAL ---------- */
    var DRAFT_LINES = [];
    var EDIT_UID = '';

    function openAdd() { DRAFT_LINES = []; openInvoiceModal(null); }

    function openEdit(uid) {
      UI.showSpinner();
      Promise.all([
        companyCall('get_valley_sales_bootstrap'),
        companyCall('get_valley_invoice_full', { invoice_unique_id: uid })
      ])
        .then(function (res) {
          PARTIES = res[0].parties || [];
          PRODUCTS = res[0].products || [];
          ENUMS = res[0].enums || {};
          var inv = res[1].invoice;
          DRAFT_LINES = res[1].lines.map(function (l) {
            return {
              unique_id: l.unique_id,
              product_id: String(l.product_id),
              details: l.product_details || '',
              tax: Number(l.product_tax || 0),
              qty: Number(l.product_qty || 0),
              price: Number(l.product_price || 0)
            };
          });
          openInvoiceModal(inv);
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ في تحميل الفاتورة', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function partyFieldHtml(selected) {
      return UIC.combo({ key: 'f-party', label: 'العميل', required: true, options: PARTIES, value: selected ? String(selected['اسم العميل'] || '') : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' });
    }
    function comboEnum(key, label, list, selected) {
      return UIC.combo({ key: key, label: label, required: true, options: (list || []).map(function (o) { return { value: o.value, label: o.label }; }), value: selected != null ? selected : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' });
    }

    function lineRowHtml(i, ln) {
      ln = ln || { product_id: '', details: '', tax: 0, qty: '', price: '', allocations: [] };
      var prodOpts = PRODUCTS.map(function (p) { return { value: String(p.value), label: p.label }; });
      var rowTotal = num0(ln.qty) * num0(ln.price) * (1 + num0(ln.tax));
      return '<tr id="line-' + i + '" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
        '<td>' + UIC.combo({ key: 'ln-prod-' + i, label: '', required: true, options: prodOpts, value: ln.product_id ? String(ln.product_id) : '', placeholder: 'ابحث عن منتج…' }) + '</td>' +
        '<td><input id="ln-details-' + i + '" class="input" type="text" value="' + esc(ln.details) + '" placeholder="اختياري"></td>' +
        '<td><input id="ln-qty-' + i + '" class="input" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" value="' + (ln.qty || '') + '" oninput="SALES_PAGE.recalc()"></td>' +
        '<td><input id="ln-price-' + i + '" class="input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="' + (ln.price !== '' ? ln.price : '') + '" oninput="SALES_PAGE.recalc()"></td>' +
        '<td>' + UIC.combo({ key: 'ln-tax-' + i, label: '', required: true, options: (ENUMS.line_tax || []).map(function (t) { return { value: t, label: (t * 100) + '%' }; }), value: String(ln.tax), placeholder: '%' }) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num" style="font-weight:700;direction:ltr;" id="ln-total-' + i + '">' + rowTotal.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) + '</td>' +
        '<td><button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;color:#dc2626;" onclick="SALES_PAGE.removeLine(' + i + ')">✕</button></td>' +
      '</tr>' +
      /* P2: batch-allocation strip (hidden until product chosen) */
      '<tr id="alloc-row-' + i + '" style="display:none;"><td colspan="7" style="background:#f8fafc;padding:8px 14px;">' +
        '<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#166534;margin-bottom:6px;">📦 تخصيص الدفعات <span class="num" style="color:#94a3b8;font-weight:400;">(يجب أن يساوي الكمية)</span> — <span id="alloc-sum-' + i + '">0</span> / <span id="alloc-need-' + i + '">' + (ln.qty || 0) + '</span></div>' +
        '<div id="alloc-strip-' + i + '" style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:12px;">اختر المنتج أولاً لعرض الدفعات المتاحة…</div>' +
      '</td></tr>';
    }

    function openInvoiceModal(inv) {
      var isEdit = !!inv;
      EDIT_UID = isEdit ? String(inv.invoice_unique_id) : '';
      /* Party auto-fill strip: tax id / address / phone from the party record */
      var autofill =
        '<div class="form-field"><label class="form-label">بيانات العميل (تُجلب تلقائياً)</label>' +
        '<div id="party-chips" class="input" readonly style="background:#f3f4f6;color:#6b7280;min-height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;">—</div></div>';
      var body = '<form id="sales-form">' +
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px;">' +
          partyFieldHtml(inv) + autofill +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-date', label: 'تاريخ الفاتورة', type: 'date', required: true, value: inv ? fmtDate(inv['تاريخ الفاتورة']).split('/').reverse().join('-') : todayStr() }) +
          checkboxField('f-tax-system', 'خاضع للنظام الضريبي', inv ? String(inv.tax_system).toLowerCase() === 'true' : true) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px;">' +
          comboEnum('f-class-tax', 'نوع الضريبة', ENUMS.class_tax, inv ? Number(inv['نوع الضريبة (سلع عامة 1/سلع جدول 2)']) : null) +
          comboEnum('f-class-schedule', 'نوع سلع الجدول', ENUMS.class_schedule, inv ? Number(inv['نوع سلع الجدول (لايوجد 0/جدول أولا 1/جدول ثانيا 2)']) : null) +
          comboEnum('f-class-statement', 'نوع البيان', ENUMS.class_statement, inv ? Number(inv['نوع البيان (سلعة 3/خدمة 4/تسويات 5)']) : null) +
          comboEnum('f-class-goods', 'نوع السلعة', ENUMS.class_goods, inv ? Number(inv['نوع السلعة (محلي 1/صادرات 2/آلات ومعدات 5/أجزاء آلات 6/إعفاءات 7)']) : null) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">' +
            '<b style="color:#166534;">بنود الفاتورة</b>' +
            '<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" onclick="SALES_PAGE.addLine()">+ إضافة بند</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div style="overflow-x:auto;"><table class="table" id="lines-table">' +
            '<thead><tr><th style="min-width:220px;">المنتج</th><th>تفاصيل</th><th>الكمية</th><th>السعر</th><th>الضريبة</th><th>الإجمالي</th><th></th></tr></thead>' +
            '<tbody id="lines-body"></tbody>' +
          '</table></div>' +
          '<div id="lines-footer" style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:16px;padding:10px;background:#f0fdf4;border-radius:8px;margin-top:8px;font-weight:800;"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</form>';

      /* wide modal */
      UIC.openModal('sales-modal', {
        title: isEdit ? 'تعديل فاتورة: ' + (inv['رقم الفاتورة'] || '') : 'فاتورة مبيعات جديدة — الرقم يُعتمد تلقائياً',
        body: body,
        footer: false
      });

      var modal = document.getElementById('sales-modal');
      if (modal) { var box = modal.querySelector('.modal'); if (box) box.style.maxWidth = '1200px'; }

      /* footer action bar inside modal */
      var foot = document.createElement('div');
      foot.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;';
      foot.innerHTML =
        '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="UIC.closeModal(\'sales-modal\')">إلغاء</button>' +
        (isEdit ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="SALES_PAGE.save()">💾 حفظ التعديلات</button>'
                : '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="SALES_PAGE.save()">💾 إنشاء الفاتورة</button>');
      modal.querySelector('.modal').appendChild(foot);

      drawLines();
      attachPartyAutoFill(inv);
      SALES_PAGE.recalc();
    }

    function attachPartyAutoFill(inv) {
      var combo = document.getElementById('f-party');
      var chips = document.getElementById('party-chips');
      if (!combo || !chips) return;
      var update = function () {
        var val = getComboVal('f-party');
        var p = PARTIES.filter(function (o) { return String(o.value) === String(val); })[0];
        if (!p) { chips.textContent = '—'; return; }
        chips.innerHTML = 'الرقم الضريبي: <b>' + esc(p.tax_id || '-') + '</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; العنوان: <b>' + esc(p.address || '-') + '</b> &nbsp;·&nbsp; الهاتف: <b>' + esc(p.phone || '-') + '</b>';
      };
      if (inv) update(); /* pre-fill for edit */
      document.getElementById('f-party_display').addEventListener('input', update);
    }

    function checkboxField(key, label, checked) {
      return '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:22px;font-size:14px;">' +
        '<input type="checkbox" id="' + key + '"' + (checked ? ' checked' : '') + '> ' + label + '</label>';
    }

    function drawLines() {
      var tb = document.getElementById('lines-body');
      if (!tb) return;
      tb.innerHTML = DRAFT_LINES.map(function (_, i) { return lineRowHtml(i, DRAFT_LINES[i]); }).join('') ||
        '<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center;color:#94a3b8;">لا توجد بنود — اضغط «+ إضافة بند»</td></tr>';
      /* re-fetch batches for every line that already has a product */
      for (var i = 0; i < DRAFT_LINES.length; i++) {
        var pc = document.getElementById('ln-prod-' + i);
        if (pc) pc.addEventListener('change', function () {
          var idx = parseInt(this.id.split('-').pop(), 10);
          onProductChange(idx);
        });
        if (DRAFT_LINES[i].product_id) loadBatches(i, DRAFT_LINES[i].product_id, DRAFT_LINES[i].allocations);
      }
      recalc();
    }

    function collectLines() {
      var out = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < DRAFT_LINES.length; i++) {
        var pidEl = document.getElementById('ln-prod-' + i);
        var qtyEl = document.getElementById('ln-qty-' + i);
        if (!pidEl || !qtyEl) continue;
        out.push({
          unique_id: DRAFT_LINES[i].unique_id || '',
          product_id: pidEl.value || '',
          details: (document.getElementById('ln-details-' + i) || {}).value || '',
          qty: qtyEl.value,
          price: (document.getElementById('ln-price-' + i) || {}).value || '',
          tax: getComboVal('ln-tax-' + i),
          allocations: collectAllocations(i)
        });
      }
      return out;
    }

    function getComboVal(key) {
      var el = document.getElementById(key);
      return el ? el.value : '';
    }

    function recalc() {
      var net = 0, taxV = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < DRAFT_LINES.length; i++) {
        var qty = num0((document.getElementById('ln-qty-' + i) || {}).value);
        var price = num0((document.getElementById('ln-price-' + i) || {}).value);
        var tax = num0(getComboVal('ln-tax-' + i));
        var lineNet = qty * price;
        var lt = lineNet * tax;
        net += lineNet; taxV += lt;
        var cell = document.getElementById('ln-total-' + i);
        if (cell) cell.textContent = (lineNet + lt).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
      }
      for (var a = 0; a < DRAFT_LINES.length; a++) {
        var sumEl = document.getElementById('alloc-sum-' + a);
        if (!sumEl) continue;
        var s2 = 0;
        for (var j2 = 0; ; j2++) {
          var qEl = document.getElementById('alloc-q-' + a + '-' + j2);
          if (!qEl) break;
          s2 += parseFloat(qEl.value) || 0;
        }
        sumEl.textContent = fmtNum2(s2);
        sumEl.style.color = (Math.abs(s2 - num0((document.getElementById('ln-qty-' + a)||{}).value)) > 0.0001 && s2 >= 0) ? '#dc2626' : '#059669';
      }
      var total = net + taxV;
      document.getElementById('lines-footer').innerHTML =
        '<span>الصافي: <span style="direction:ltr;">' + net.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) + '</span></span>' +
        '<span>الضريبة: <span style="direction:ltr;">' + taxV.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) + '</span></span>' +
        '<span style="color:#166534;">الإجمالي: <span style="direction:ltr;font-size:17px;">' + total.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) + ' ج.م</span></span>';
    }

    function addLine() {
      DRAFT_LINES.push({ product_id: '', details: '', tax: 0, qty: '', price: '' });
      drawLines();
    }

    function removeLine(i) {
      DRAFT_LINES.splice(i, 1);
      drawLines();
    }

    function getVal_(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; }
    function readCheckbox(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return !!(el && el.checked); }

    function save() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('sales-form')) return;
      var lines = collectLines();
      var payload = {
        invoice_unique_id: EDIT_UID || '',
        party: getComboVal('f-party'),
        date: getVal_('f-date'),
        tax_system: readCheckbox('f-tax-system'),
        class_tax: getComboVal('f-class-tax'),
        class_schedule: getComboVal('f-class-schedule'),
        class_statement: getComboVal('f-class-statement'),
        class_goods: getComboVal('f-class-goods'),
        lines: lines
      };
      if (!payload.party) { UIC.toast('اختر العميل', 'error'); return; }
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('save_valley_invoice', payload)
        .then(function (r) {
          UIC.closeModal('sales-modal');
          UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
          load();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل الحفظ', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function approve(uid) {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('approve_valley_invoice', { invoice_unique_id: uid })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم', 'success'); load(); })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function removeInv(uid) {
      if (!confirm('سيتم حذف الفاتورة وجميع بنودها نهائياً. متابعة؟')) return;
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('delete_valley_invoice', { invoice_unique_id: uid })
        .then(function (r) { UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحذف', 'success'); load(); })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل الحذف', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    /* ---------- P2: BATCH ALLOCATION ---------- */
    var BATCH_CACHE = {};   /* key: pid|exclude → batches array */

    function onProductChange(i) {
      var el = document.getElementById('ln-prod-' + i);
      var pid = el ? el.value : '';
      DRAFT_LINES[i].product_id = pid;
      DRAFT_LINES[i].allocations = [];
      if (!pid) {
        document.getElementById('alloc-row-' + i).style.display = 'none';
        recalc();
        return;
      }
      loadBatches(i, pid, null);
    }

    function loadBatches(i, pid, prefill) {
      var strip = document.getElementById('alloc-strip-' + i);
      var rowEl = document.getElementById('alloc-row-' + i);
      if (!strip || !rowEl) return;
      rowEl.style.display = '';
      var key = pid + '|' + (EDIT_UID || '');
      strip.innerHTML = 'جاري تحميل الدفعات...';
      var build = function () {
        renderAllocStrip(i, pid, prefill || []);
      };
      if (BATCH_CACHE[key]) { setTimeout(build, 0); }
      else {
        companyCall('get_valley_product_batches', { product_id: pid, exclude_invoice_unique_id: EDIT_UID })
          .then(function (r) {
            BATCH_CACHE[key] = r.batches || [];
            build();
          })
          .catch(function (e) { strip.innerHTML = '<span style="color:red;">' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</span>'; });
      }
    }

    function renderAllocStrip(i, pid, prefill) {
      var key = pid + '|' + (EDIT_UID || '');
      var batches = BATCH_CACHE[key] || [];
      var strip = document.getElementById('alloc-strip-' + i);
      if (!strip) return;
      if (!batches.length) {
        strip.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#d97706;">لا توجد دفعات متاحة لهذا المنتج.</span>';
        return;
      }
      var alloc = {};
      (prefill || []).forEach(function (a) { alloc[a.batch_uid] = a.qty; });
      DRAFT_LINES[i].allocations = (prefill || []).map(function (a) { return { batch_uid: a.batch_uid, lot: a.lot || '', qty: Number(a.qty || 0) }; });

      var html = '<table class="table" style="margin:0;"><thead><tr><th>الدفعة</th><th>المتاح</th><th style="width:140px;">الكمية من الدفعة</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
      batches.forEach(function (b, bi) {
        var preQ = alloc[b.batch_uid] || 0;
        html += '<tr>' +
          '<td><b>' + esc(b.lot) + '</b> <span style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:11px;">(' + esc(b.unit || '-') + ')</span></td>' +
          '<td class="num" data-num="' + b.available + '">' + fmtNum2(b.available) + '</td>' +
          '<td><input id="alloc-q-' + i + '-' + bi + '" class="input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" max="' + b.available + '" value="' + (preQ || '') + '" data-buid="' + esc(b.batch_uid) + '" data-lot="' + esc(b.lot) + '" oninput="SALES_PAGE.recalc()" style="max-width:130px;direction:ltr;"></td>' +
        '</tr>';
      });
      html += '</tbody></table>';
      strip.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function collectAllocations(i) {
      var out = [];
      for (var j = 0; ; j++) {
        var el = document.getElementById('alloc-q-' + i + '-' + j);
        if (!el) break;
        var q = parseFloat(el.value) || 0;
        if (q > 0) out.push({ batch_uid: el.getAttribute('data-buid'), lot: el.getAttribute('data-lot') || '', qty: q });
      }
      return out;
    }

    function fmtNum2(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); }

    window.SALES_PAGE = {
      openAdd: openAdd, openEdit: openEdit, save: save, approve: approve, remove: removeInv,
      addLine: addLine, removeLine: removeLine, recalc: recalc
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderApp);
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<body>
  <div id="vf-root"></div>

  <script>
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }
    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    function todayStr() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
    function finFmt(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); }
  </script>

  <script>
  (function () {
    function renderApp() {
      UIC.appShell('vf-root', {
        companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
        companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=vf_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
        companyLogoTitle: 'Valley Foods',
        breadcrumb: 'Valley Foods / الادارة المالية / مرتجعات المبيعات',
        contentId: 'vf-returns-content',
        menuGroups: (window.VALLEYFOODS_MENU || [])
      });
      document.getElementById('vf-returns-content').innerHTML =
        '<div class="vf-card"><div class="vf-card-header"><h3>مرتجعات المبيعات</h3>' +
          (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="RETURNS_PAGE.openAdd()">+ إضافة مرتجع</button>' : '') +
        '</div><div class="vf-card-body">' +
          '<div id="ret-table"><p class="vf-text-muted">جاري التحميل...</p></div>' +
        '</div></div>';
      load();
    }

    function load() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      var container = document.getElementById('ret-table');
      if (container) {
        UIC.PagedTable({
          container: container,
          headers: ['رقم المرتجع', 'الفاتورة', 'العميل', 'التاريخ', 'عدد البنود', { label: 'قيمة المرتجع', numeric: true }],
          pageSize: 100,
          searchable: false,
          onRendered: function (tid) { try { UIC.initTableSort(tid); } catch (e) {} },
          fetcher: function (offset, limit) {
            return companyCall('get_valley_returns_list', { offset: offset, limit: limit });
          },
          mapRow: function (g) {
            return [
              '<b>' + esc(g.id) + '</b>',
              esc(g.invoice_number),
              esc(g.client_label),
              esc(g.date_display),
              g.lines,
              '<span class="num" style="font-weight:700;color:#dc2626;" data-num="' + g.total_value + '">' + finFmt(g.total_value) + '</span>'
            ];
          }
        });
      }
      UI.hideSpinner();
    }

    /* ---------- ADD RETURN MODAL ---------- */
    function openAdd() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('get_valley_sales_list')
        .then(function (r) {
          var invs = (r.invoices || []).map(function (inv) {
            return { value: String(inv.invoice_unique_id), label: String(inv['رقم الفاتورة'] || '-') };
          });
          /* party labels need the parties list — fetch via bootstrap-lite */
          return companyCall('get_valley_sales_bootstrap').then(function (bs) {
            var pmap = {};
            (bs.parties || []).forEach(function (p) { pmap[String(p.value)] = p.label; });
            invs.forEach(function (o, i2) {
              var cid = (r.invoices || [])[i2] ? String(r.invoices[i2]['اسم العميل'] || '') : '';
              o.label = (r.invoices[i2]['رقم الفاتورة'] || '') + ' — ' + (pmap[cid] || cid);
            });
            renderReturnModal(invs);
          });
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    var PARTY_LABELS = {};

    function renderReturnModal(invoiceOptions) {
      var body =
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px;">' +
          UIC.combo({ key: 'ret-invoice', label: 'الفاتورة', required: true, options: invoiceOptions, value: '', placeholder: 'ابحث برقم الفاتورة…' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'ret-date', label: 'تاريخ المرتجع', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div id="ret-lines-wrap"><p class="vf-text-muted">اختر الفاتورة لعرض بنودها القابلة للإرجاع.</p></div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:16px;padding:10px;background:#fef2f2;border-radius:8px;margin-top:10px;font-weight:800;">' +
          '<span>إجمالي قيمة المرتجع:</span>' +
          '<span id="ret-total" style="color:#dc2626;direction:ltr;">0.00</span>' +
        '</div>';

      UIC.openModal('return-modal', { title: 'إضافة مرتجع مبيعات', body: body, footer: false });
      var modal = document.getElementById('return-modal');
      if (modal) { var box = modal.querySelector('.modal'); if (box) box.style.maxWidth = '1000px'; }

      /* footer buttons */
      var foot = document.createElement('div');
      foot.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;';
      foot.innerHTML =
        '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="UIC.closeModal(\'return-modal\')">إلغاء</button>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="RETURNS_PAGE.save()">💾 حفظ المرتجع</button>';
      modal.querySelector('.modal').appendChild(foot);

      var invCombo = document.getElementById('ret-invoice_display');
      var invHidden = document.getElementById('ret-invoice');
      if (invCombo) {
        invCombo.addEventListener('input', function () { if (!invCombo.value) resetLines(); });
        /* fire on selection: combo sets hidden value on pick */
        invHidden.addEventListener('change', loadInvoiceLines);
      }
    }

    function resetLines() {
      var w = document.getElementById('ret-lines-wrap');
      if (w) w.innerHTML = '<p class="vf-text-muted">اختر الفاتورة لعرض بنودها القابلة للإرجاع.</p>';
    }

    function loadInvoiceLines() {
      var uid = getHid_('ret-invoice');
      if (!uid) { resetLines(); return; }
      var w = document.getElementById('ret-lines-wrap');
      if (w) w.innerHTML = '<p class="vf-text-muted">جاري التحميل...</p>';
      companyCall('get_valley_invoice_for_return', { invoice_unique_id: uid })
        .then(function (res) {
          STMT_LINES = res.lines || [];
          var inv = res.invoice || {};
          var rowsHtml = STMT_LINES.map(function (l, i) {
            var disabled = l.returnable <= 0;
            return '<tr' + (disabled ? ' style="color:#94a3b8;"' : '') + '>' +
              '<td><b>' + esc(l.product_name) + '</b>' + (l.details ? '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;">' + esc(l.details) + '</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
              '<td class="num" data-num="' + l.price + '">' + finFmt(l.price) + '</td>' +
              '<td class="num">' + fmtNumP(l.sold_qty) + '</td>' +
              '<td class="num">' + fmtNumP(l.returned_qty) + '</td>' +
              '<td><input id="ret-qty-' + i + '" class="input" type="number" min="0" max="' + l.returnable + '" step="0.01" value="" data-line="' + esc(l.line_uid) + '" data-max="' + l.returnable + '" data-price="' + l.price + '"' + (disabled ? ' disabled' : '') + ' oninput="RETURNS_PAGE.recalc()" style="max-width:120px;direction:ltr;"></td>' +
              '<td class="num" style="font-weight:700;color:#dc2626;" data-num="' + (disabled ? '' : '') + '" id="ret-val-' + i + '">0.00</td>' +
            '</tr>';
          }).join('');
          w.innerHTML =
            '<div style="background:#f0fdf4;border-left:4px solid #16a34a;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:13px;">' +
              'فاتورة <b>' + esc((res.invoice || {}).number || '-') + '</b> — العميل: <b>' + esc((res.invoice || {}).client_name || '-') + '</b> · تاريخها: <b>' + esc((res.invoice || {}).date_display || '-') + '</b>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>المنتج</th><th>سعر البيع الأصلي</th><th>المبيع</th><th>مرتجع سابقاً</th><th style="width:130px;">كمية المرتجع</th><th>القيمة</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
            rowsHtml + '</tbody></table>';
        })
        .catch(function (e) { w.innerHTML = '<p style="color:red;">' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ') + '</p>'; });
    }

    var STMT_LINES = [];

    function fmtNumP(n) { return Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); }
    function getHid_(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; }

    function save() {
      var invUid = getHid_('ret-invoice');
      var date = getDt_('ret-date');
      if (!invUid) { UIC.toast('اختر الفاتورة أولاً', 'error'); return; }
      if (!date) { UIC.toast('اختر تاريخ المرتجع', 'error'); return; }
      var items = [];
      var anyQty = false;
      for (var i = 0; ; i++) {
        var qEl = document.getElementById('ret-qty-' + i);
        if (!qEl) break;
        var q = parseFloat(qEl.value) || 0;
        if (q > 0) {
          anyQty = true;
          items.push({ line_uid: qEl.getAttribute('data-line'), qty: q });
        }
      }
      if (!anyQty) { UIC.toast('أدخل كمية مرتجعة لبند واحد على الأقل', 'error'); return; }
      if (!confirm('سيتم تسجيل المرتجع وخصم قيمته من فاتورة رقم ' + invUid.slice(0, 8) + '… متابعة؟')) return;
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('save_valley_return', { invoice_unique_id: invUid, date: date, items: items })
        .then(function (r) {
          UIC.closeModal('return-modal');
          UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم تسجيل المرتجع', 'success');
          load();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل حفظ المرتجع', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function recalc() {
      var total = 0;
      for (var i = 0; ; i++) {
        var qEl = document.getElementById('ret-qty-' + i);
        if (!qEl) break;
        var max = parseFloat(qEl.getAttribute('data-max')) || 0;
        var price = parseFloat(qEl.getAttribute('data-price')) || 0;
        var q = parseFloat(qEl.value) || 0;
        if (q > max) { qEl.value = max; q = max; }
        var val = q * price;
        total += val;
        var cell = document.getElementById('ret-val-' + i);
        if (cell) cell.textContent = finFmt(val);
      }
      var t = document.getElementById('ret-total');
      if (t) t.textContent = finFmt(total);
    }

    function getDt_(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; }
    window.RETURNS_PAGE = {
      openAdd: openAdd,
      save: save,
      recalc: recalc
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderApp);
  })();
  </script>

    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
  </script>

<body>
  <h2>اختبار النظام — بيانات تجريبية</h2>
  <p>اضغط <b>إنشاء</b> لإدخال سجلات تجريبية في كل صفحة، ثم تحقق من ظهورها. اضغط <b>حذف</b> لإزالة كل ما تم إضافته.</p>

  <div class="btn-group">
    <button class="btn btn-green" id="btnGenerate" onclick="doGenerate()">إنشاء بيانات تجريبية</button>
    <button class="btn btn-red" id="btnRemove" onclick="doRemove()">حذف كل البيانات التجريبية</button>
  </div>

  <div id="statusBox" class="status">
    <h3 id="statusTitle"></h3>
    <div id="statusContent"></div>

  <script>
    function doGenerate() {
      var btn = document.getElementById('btnGenerate');
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'جارٍ الإنشاء...';
      var box = document.getElementById('statusBox');
      var title = document.getElementById('statusTitle');
      var content = document.getElementById('statusContent');
      box.className = 'status show';
      title.textContent = 'جارٍ الإنشاء...';
      content.innerHTML = '';

      companyCall('generate_test_data').then(function (r) {
        title.textContent = r.ok ? 'تم الإنشاء بنجاح' : 'خطأ في الإنشاء';
        title.className = r.ok ? 'ok' : 'err';
        if (r.ok && r.results) {
          var html = '<ul>';
          r.results.forEach(function (item) {
            var cls = item.ok ? 'ok' : 'err';
            var icon = item.ok ? '&#10003;' : '&#10007;';
            html += '<li class="' + cls + '">' + icon + ' ' + esc(item.page) + ' — ' + esc(item.message) + '</li>';
          });
          html += '</ul>';
          content.innerHTML = html;
        }
        if (r.errors && r.errors.length) {
          r.errors.forEach(function (e) {
            content.innerHTML += '<p class="err">' + esc(e) + '</p>';
          });
        }
      }).catch(function (e) {
        title.textContent = 'خطأ: ' + esc(e && e.message || e);
        title.className = 'err';
      }).finally(function () {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'إنشاء بيانات تجريبية';
      });
    }

    function doRemove() {
      var btn = document.getElementById('btnRemove');
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'جارٍ الحذف...';
      var box = document.getElementById('statusBox');
      var title = document.getElementById('statusTitle');
      var content = document.getElementById('statusContent');
      box.className = 'status show';
      title.textContent = 'جارٍ الحذف...';
      content.innerHTML = '';

      companyCall('remove_test_data').then(function (r) {
        title.textContent = r.ok ? 'تم الحذف بنجاح' : 'خطأ في الحذف';
        title.className = r.ok ? 'ok' : 'err';
        if (r.ok && r.results) {
          var html = '<ul>';
          r.results.forEach(function (item) {
            var cls = item.ok ? 'ok' : 'err';
            var icon = item.ok ? '&#10003;' : '&#10007;';
            html += '<li class="' + cls + '">' + icon + ' ' + esc(item.sheet) + ' — حُذف ' + esc(String(item.deleted)) + ' سجل(ات)</li>';
          });
          html += '</ul>';
          content.innerHTML = html;
        }
        if (r.errors && r.errors.length) {
          r.errors.forEach(function (e) {
            content.innerHTML += '<p class="err">' + esc(e) + '</p>';
          });
        }
      }).catch(function (e) {
        title.textContent = 'خطأ: ' + esc(e && e.message || e);
        title.className = 'err';
      }).finally(function () {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'حذف كل البيانات التجريبية';
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      doRemove();
    });
  </script>
</body>

  <div id="vf-root" dir="rtl"></div>

  <script>
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
    var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>';
    var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
    var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
    var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
    var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }

    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    function todayStr() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
    function fmtDate(v) {
      if (!v) return '';
      var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
      var pad = function (n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; };
      return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
    }

    var ROWS = [];
    var EMP_OPTIONS = [];
    var VAC_INDEX_OPTIONS = [];
    var VAC_INDEX_MAP = {};

    function load() {
      UIC.appShell('vf-root', {
        companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
        companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=vf_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
        companyLogoTitle: 'Valley Foods',
        breadcrumb: 'Valley Foods / شؤون الموظفين / تخصيص الإجازات',
        contentId: 'vf-vacalloc-content',
        menuGroups: (window.VALLEYFOODS_MENU || [])
      });
      fetchData();
    }

    function fetchData() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('get_vacation_alloc_data').then(function (res) {
        ROWS = res.rows || [];
        EMP_OPTIONS = res.employee_options || [];
        VAC_INDEX_OPTIONS = res.vacation_index_options || [];
        VAC_INDEX_MAP = {};
        VAC_INDEX_OPTIONS.forEach(function (o) { VAC_INDEX_MAP[String(o.value)] = o.label; });
        render();
      }).catch(function (e) {
        UIC.toast('خطأ: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e), 'error');
      }).finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function render() {
      var addBtn = CAN_WRITE
        ? '<div style="text-align:left;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ إضافة تخصيص إجازة</button></div>'
        : '';
      var headers = [
        { key: 'emp_id', label: 'الكود' },
        { key: 'employee_name', label: 'الاسم' },
        { key: 'vacation_type', label: 'نوع الإجازة' },
        { key: 'vacation_alloc_start_Date', label: 'من' },
        { key: 'vacation_alloc_end_Date', label: 'إلى' },
        { key: 'number_of_days', label: 'الأيام' },
        { key: 'used_days', label: 'المستخدم' },
        { key: 'remaining', label: 'متبقي' }
      ];
      var rows = ROWS.map(function (r) {
        var total = Number(r.number_of_days) || 0;
        var used = Number(r.used_days) || 0;
        var vacName = VAC_INDEX_MAP[String(r.vacation_type)] || r.vacation_type || '';
        return {
          emp_id: esc(r.emp_id),
          employee_name: esc(r.employee_name),
          vacation_type: esc(vacName),
          vacation_alloc_start_Date: esc(fmtDate(r.vacation_alloc_start_Date)),
          vacation_alloc_end_Date: esc(fmtDate(r.vacation_alloc_end_Date)),
          number_of_days: total,
          used_days: used,
          remaining: total - used
        };
      });
      document.getElementById('vf-vacalloc-content').innerHTML =
        addBtn +
        UIC.dataTable('vacalloc-table', { headers: headers, rows: rows, emptyText: 'لا توجد تخصيصات إجازات' });
      UIC.initTableSort('vacalloc-table');
    }

    function openAddModal() {
      var body = '<form id="vacalloc-form">' +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف', required: true, options: EMP_OPTIONS }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'vacation_type', label: 'نوع الإجازة', required: true, options: VAC_INDEX_OPTIONS, placeholder: 'اختر نوع الإجازة...' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'vacation_alloc_start_Date', label: 'من', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'vacation_alloc_end_Date', label: 'إلى', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'number_of_days', label: 'عدد الأيام', type: 'number', required: true, min: '1', step: '1', value: '0' }) +
      '</form>';
      UIC.openModal('modal-vacalloc', { title: 'إضافة تخصيص إجازة', body: body, onSave: 'saveAlloc()' });
    }

    function saveAlloc() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('vacalloc-form')) return false;
      var d = UIC.collectForm('vacalloc-form');
      if (!d.emp_id) { UIC.toast('الموظف مطلوب', 'error'); return false; }
      if (!d.vacation_type) { UIC.toast('نوع الإجازة مطلوب', 'error'); return false; }
      if (!d.vacation_alloc_start_Date) { UIC.toast('تاريخ البداية مطلوب', 'error'); return false; }
      if (!d.vacation_alloc_end_Date) { UIC.toast('تاريخ النهاية مطلوب', 'error'); return false; }
      if (!d.number_of_days || Number(d.number_of_days) <= 0) { UIC.toast('عدد الأيام يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر', 'error'); return false; }
      companyCall('add_vacation_alloc', d).then(function (r) {
        if (r && r.status === 'success') { UIC.toast(r.message || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); UIC.closeModal('modal-vacalloc'); fetchData(); }
        else UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تعذر الحفظ', 'error');
      }).catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) ? e.message : 'خطأ', 'error'); });
      return true;
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', load);
  </script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>

  <script>
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
    var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>';
    var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
    var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
    var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
    var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }

    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    function todayStr() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
    function fmtDate(v) {
      if (!v) return '';
      var d = (v instanceof Date) ? v : new Date(v);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v);
      var pad = function (n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; };
      return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
    }

    var ROWS = [], EMP_OPTIONS = [], VAC_INDEX_OPTIONS = [], ALLOC_MAP = {};
    var VAC_INDEX_MAP = {}, REQUIRE_ALLOC_MAP = {};

    function load() {
      UIC.appShell('vf-root', {
        companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
        companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=vf_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
        companyLogoTitle: 'Valley Foods',
        breadcrumb: 'Valley Foods / شؤون الموظفين / الإجازات',
        contentId: 'vf-vac-content',
        menuGroups: (window.VALLEYFOODS_MENU || [])
      });
      fetchData();
    }

    function fetchData() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('get_vacations_data')
        .then(function (r) {
          ROWS = r.rows || [];
          EMP_OPTIONS = r.employee_options || [];
          VAC_INDEX_OPTIONS = r.vacation_index_options || [];
          ALLOC_MAP = r.allocation_options_map || {};
          VAC_INDEX_MAP = {};
          REQUIRE_ALLOC_MAP = {};
          VAC_INDEX_OPTIONS.forEach(function (o) {
            VAC_INDEX_MAP[String(o.value)] = o.label;
            REQUIRE_ALLOC_MAP[String(o.value)] = o.require_allocation === true || o.require_allocation === 'true';
          });
          render();
        })
        .catch(function (e) {
          UIC.toast((e && e.message) ? e.message : 'خطأ في تحميل البيانات', 'error');
        })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function render() {
      var body = document.getElementById('vf-vac-content');
      if (!body) return;
      var html = (CAN_WRITE
        ? '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:12px;"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddModal()">+ إضافة إجازة</button></div>'
        : '');
      if (!ROWS.length) {
        html += '<div class="empty-state"><span>لا توجد إجازات</span></div>';
        body.innerHTML = html;
        return;
      }
      html += '<table class="table" style="font-size:13px;">';
      html += '<thead><tr><th>الكود</th><th>النوع</th><th>التخصيص</th><th>من</th><th>إلى</th><th>الأيام</th><th>نصف يوم</th><th>السبب</th><th>المرفق</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
      ROWS.forEach(function (r) {
        var vacName = VAC_INDEX_MAP[String(r.vacation_type)] || r.vacation_type_name || r.vacation_type || '';
        var halfDay = (r.vacation_half_day == 0.5 || r.vacation_half_day === '0.5' || r.vacation_half_day === true) ? 'نعم' : 'لا';
        var attachCell = r.attachment
          ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 8px;font-size:11px;" onclick="downloadAttach(\'' + esc(r.attachment) + '\')">تحميل</button>'
          : '—';
        html += '<tr>'
          + '<td>' + esc(r.emp_id) + '</td>'
          + '<td>' + esc(vacName) + '</td>'
          + '<td>' + esc(r.allocation_id || '—') + '</td>'
          + '<td>' + fmtDate(r.start_date) + '</td>'
          + '<td>' + fmtDate(r.end_date) + '</td>'
          + '<td>' + (r.duration_days != null ? r.duration_days : '') + '</td>'
          + '<td>' + halfDay + '</td>'
          + '<td>' + esc(r.vacation_reason || '—') + '</td>'
          + '<td>' + attachCell + '</td>'
          + '</tr>';
      });
      html += '</tbody></table>';
      body.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function downloadAttach(ref) {
      if (!ref) return;
      window.open(scriptUrl + '?download=doc_file&company=9940659bd83035d7&ref=' +
        encodeURIComponent(ref) + '&sessionToken=' + encodeURIComponent(SESSION_TOKEN), '_blank');
    }

    function openAddModal() {
      var body =
        '<form id="vf-vac-form">' +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'emp_id', label: 'الموظف', required: true,
          options: EMP_OPTIONS, placeholder: 'اختر الموظف...' }) +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'vacation_type', label: 'نوع الإجازة', required: true,
          options: VAC_INDEX_OPTIONS, placeholder: 'اختر النوع...' }) +
        '<div id="alloc-wrapper" style="display:none;">' +
        UIC.combo({ key: 'allocation_id', label: 'التخصيص', required: false,
          options: [], placeholder: 'اختر التخصيص...' }) +
        '</div>' +
        UIC.field({ key: 'vacation_half_day', label: 'نصف يوم', type: 'checkbox' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'start_date', label: 'من تاريخ', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'end_date', label: 'إلى تاريخ', type: 'date', required: true, value: todayStr() }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'duration_days', label: 'عدد الأيام (محسوب)', type: 'number', value: '1' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'duration_days_other', label: 'أيام أخرى', type: 'number', value: '0' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'amount_other', label: 'مبلغ إضافي', type: 'number', value: '0' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'vacation_reason', label: 'سبب الإجازة', type: 'textarea', required: true }) +
        UIC.fileField({ key: 'attachment', label: 'المرفق', accept: '.pdf,.doc,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg' }) +
        '</form>';
      UIC.openModal('vf-vac-modal', {
        title: 'إضافة إجازة',
        body: body,
        onSave: 'saveVacation()'
      });
      setTimeout(function () {
        var empSel = document.getElementById('emp_id');
        var vacSel = document.getElementById('vacation_type');
        var startEl = document.getElementById('start_date');
        var endEl = document.getElementById('end_date');
        var halfChk = document.getElementById('vacation_half_day');
        var durEl = document.getElementById('duration_days');
        if (durEl) durEl.disabled = true;

        function updateAllocVisibility() {
          var empId = empSel ? empSel.value : '';
          var vacId = vacSel ? vacSel.value : '';
          var needAlloc = !!REQUIRE_ALLOC_MAP[String(vacId)];
          var wrap = document.getElementById('alloc-wrapper');
          if (!wrap) return;
          if (needAlloc) {
            var allocs = (ALLOC_MAP[String(empId)] || []).filter(function (a) {
              return String(a.vacation_type) === String(vacId);
            });
            var opts = allocs.map(function (a) { return { value: a.value, label: a.label }; });
            if (opts.length === 0) opts = [{ value: '', label: 'لا توجد تخصيصات متاحة' }];
            wrap.innerHTML = UIC.combo({ key: 'allocation_id', label: 'التخصيص', required: true, options: opts, placeholder: '...' });
            wrap.style.display = '';
          } else {
            wrap.style.display = 'none';
          }
        }

        function calcDuration() {
          if (halfChk && halfChk.checked) {
            if (durEl) durEl.value = '0.5';
            return;
          }
          if (!startEl || !endEl || !durEl) return;
          var s = new Date(startEl.value);
          var e = new Date(endEl.value);
          if (isNaN(s.getTime()) || isNaN(e.getTime())) return;
          var diff = Math.round((e.getTime() - s.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
          if (diff < 0) diff = 0;
          durEl.value = String(diff);
        }

        if (empSel) empSel.onchange = function () { updateAllocVisibility(); };
        if (vacSel) vacSel.onchange = function () { updateAllocVisibility(); calcDuration(); };
        if (startEl) startEl.onchange = calcDuration;
        if (endEl) endEl.onchange = calcDuration;
        if (halfChk) halfChk.onchange = calcDuration;
      }, 200);
    }

    window.saveVacation = function () {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('vf-vac-form')) return;
      var d = UIC.collectForm('vf-vac-form');
      if (!d.emp_id) { UIC.toast('الموظف مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
      if (!d.vacation_type) { UIC.toast('نوع الإجازة مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
      if (!d.start_date) { UIC.toast('تاريخ البداية مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
      if (!d.end_date) { UIC.toast('تاريخ النهاية مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
      if (!d.vacation_reason || !d.vacation_reason.trim()) { UIC.toast('سبب الإجازة مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
      d.vacation_half_day = !!d.vacation_half_day;
      d.duration_days = parseFloat(d.duration_days) || 0;

      var wrap = document.getElementById('alloc-wrapper');
      var needAlloc = wrap && wrap.style.display !== 'none';
      if (needAlloc && !d.allocation_id) { UIC.toast('التخصيص مطلوب', 'error'); return; }
      if (!needAlloc) d.allocation_id = '';

      UI.showSpinner('جاري الحفظ...');
      var formEl = document.getElementById('vf-vac-form');
      var fileInput = formEl ? formEl.querySelector('input[type="file"]') : null;
      var filePromise = (fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0])
        ? new Promise(function (resolve) {
            var reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onerror = function () { resolve(''); };
            reader.onload = function () {
              var b64 = String(reader.result || '').split(',')[1] || '';
              companyCall('add_upload_file', { sheet: 'valley_employee_vacations', filename: fileInput.files[0].name, base64: b64 })
                .then(function (res) { resolve(res && res.reference ? res.reference : ''); })
                .catch(function () { resolve(''); });
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(fileInput.files[0]);
          })
        : Promise.resolve('');
      filePromise.then(function (ref) {
        if (ref) d.attachment = ref;
        return companyCall('add_vacation', d);
      }).then(function (r) {
        UIC.closeModal('vf-vac-modal');
        UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success');
        fetchData();
      }).catch(function (e) {
        UIC.toast((e && e.message) ? e.message : 'خطأ في حفظ الإجازة', 'error');
      }).finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', load);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <title>Valley Foods — أصول خطوط الإنتاج</title>
  <?!= include('CSS_Tokens'); ?>
  <?!= include('UI_Components'); ?>
  <?!= include('Client_Helpers'); ?>
  <?!= include('Company_ValleyFoods_Nav'); ?>
  <?!= getCompanyThemeCSS_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="vf-root"></div>

  <script>
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var SESSION_TOKEN = params.get('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() || {}).token || '';
    var scriptUrl = window.scriptUrl || '/';
    var IS_SUPER_ADMIN = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;
    var COMPANY_LOGO_URL = '<?!= getCompanyLogoUrl_('9940659bd83035d7') ?>';
    var COMPANY_PAGES = <?!= companyPages ?>;
    var CURRENT_ACTION = '<?!= currentAction ?>';
    var USER_PAGES = <?!= user && user.isSuperAdmin ? 'null' : JSON.stringify((user && user.authorizedPages) || {}) ?>;
    var CAN_WRITE = IS_SUPER_ADMIN || !!(USER_PAGES && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION] && USER_PAGES[CURRENT_ACTION].indexOf('write') !== -1);

    function companyCall(moduleAction, data) {
      return API.call('company_action', {
        target_system: '9940659bd83035d7',
        module_action: moduleAction,
        data: data || {}
      }, SESSION_TOKEN);
    }
    function esc(v) {
      var s = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : String(v);
      if (typeof FMT !== 'undefined' && FMT.escape) return FMT.escape(s);
      return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }
    function num0(v) { var n = Number(v); return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n; }
  </script>

  <script>
  (function () {
    var RECORDS = [], WC_OPTIONS = [], ASSET_OPTIONS = [];

    function renderApp() {
      UIC.appShell('vf-root', {
        companyLogoUrl: COMPANY_LOGO_URL,
        companyLogoHref: scriptUrl + '?action=vf_dashboard&sessionToken=' + SESSION_TOKEN,
        companyLogoTitle: 'Valley Foods',
        breadcrumb: 'Valley Foods / الانتاج / أصول خطوط الإنتاج',
        contentId: 'vf-wca-content',
        menuGroups: (window.VALLEYFOODS_MENU || [])
      });
      document.getElementById('vf-wca-content').innerHTML =
        '<div class="vf-card"><div class="vf-card-header"><h3>أصول خطوط الإنتاج (Work Center Assets)</h3>' +
          (CAN_WRITE ? '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="WCA_PAGE.openAdd()">+ إضافة أصل</button>' : '') +
        '</div><div class="vf-card-body">' +
          '<div id="wca-table"><p class="vf-text-muted">جاري التحميل...</p></div>' +
        '</div></div>';
      load();
    }

    function load() {
      UI.showSpinner();
      Promise.all([
        companyCall('get_valley_work_center_assets'),
        companyCall('get_valley_asset_technicals')
      ])
        .then(function (res) {
          RECORDS = res[0].records || [];
          WC_OPTIONS = res[0].work_center_options || [];
          ASSET_OPTIONS = (res[1].records || []).map(function (r) { return { value: r.unique_id, label: r.asset_name || ('#' + r.id) }; });
          renderTable();
        })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'خطأ', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    function wcLabel(idRef) {
      var f = WC_OPTIONS.filter(function (o) { return String(o.value) === String(idRef); })[0];
      return f ? f.label : (idRef || '-');
    }
    function assetLabel(idRef) {
      var f = ASSET_OPTIONS.filter(function (o) { return String(o.value) === String(idRef); })[0];
      return f ? f.label : (idRef || '-');
    }

    function renderTable() {
      var c = document.getElementById('wca-table');
      if (!c) return;
      var rows = RECORDS.map(function (r) {
        var active = !(r.is_active === false || String(r.is_active).toLowerCase() === 'false');
        var actions = IS_SUPER_ADMIN ? '<button class="btn btn-outline" style="padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;" onclick="WCA_PAGE.openEdit(\'' + esc(r.unique_id) + '\')">تعديل</button>' : '';
        return [esc(r.code || r.id), wcLabel(r.valley_work_centers_id), assetLabel(r.valley_asset_technical), esc(r.description || '-'), num0(r.capacity_per_hour_kg), UIC.statusPill(active ? 'مفعل' : 'متوقف', active ? 'success' : 'neutral'), actions];
      });
      c.innerHTML = UIC.dataTable('wca-tbl', {
        headers: ['الكود', 'خط الإنتاج', 'الأصل / الماكينة', 'الوصف', 'السعة (كغ/ساعة)', 'الحالة', ''],
        rows: rows, emptyText: 'لا توجد أصول مسجلة'
      });
      UIC.initTableSort('wca-tbl');
    }

    function openAdd() { openModal(null); }
    function openEdit(uid) {
      var row = null;
      RECORDS.forEach(function (r) { if (String(r.unique_id) === uid) row = r; });
      openModal(row);
    }

    function openModal(row) {
      var isEdit = !!row;
      var body = '<form id="wca-form">' +
        '<input type="hidden" id="f-uid" value="' + esc(row ? row.unique_id : '') + '">' +
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px;">' +
          UIC.combo({ key: 'f-wc', label: 'خط الإنتاج', required: true, options: WC_OPTIONS, value: row ? String(row.valley_work_centers_id || '') : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
          UIC.combo({ key: 'f-asset', label: 'الأصل / الماكينة', required: true, options: ASSET_OPTIONS, value: row ? String(row.valley_asset_technical || '') : '', placeholder: 'اكتب للبحث…' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-code', label: 'الكود / السيريال', type: 'text', value: row ? (row.code || '') : '' }) +
          UIC.field({ key: 'f-capacity', label: 'السعة (كغ/ساعة)', type: 'number', min: '0', step: '0.01', value: row ? num0(row.capacity_per_hour_kg) : 0 }) +
        '</div>' +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-desc', label: 'دور الماكينة في خط الإنتاج', type: 'textarea', value: row ? (row.description || '') : '' }) +
        UIC.field({ key: 'f-notes', label: 'ملاحظات', type: 'textarea', value: row ? (row.notes || '') : '' }) +
        '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;">' +
          '<input type="checkbox" id="f-active"' + (!row || !(row.is_active === false || String(row.is_active).toLowerCase() === 'false') ? ' checked' : '') + '> مفعل</label>' +
      '</form>';
      UIC.openModal('wca-modal', { title: isEdit ? 'تعديل الأصل' : 'إضافة أصل جديد', body: body });
      var m = document.getElementById('wca-modal');
      if (m) { var b = m.querySelector('.modal'); if (b) b.style.maxWidth = '700px'; }
      var foot = document.createElement('div');
      foot.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;';
      foot.innerHTML = '<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="UIC.closeModal(\'wca-modal\')">إلغاء</button>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="WCA_PAGE.save()">💾 حفظ</button>';
      m.querySelector('.modal').appendChild(foot);
    }

    function getCombo(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; }
    function getV(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; }

    function save() {
      if (!UIC.validateForm('wca-form')) return;
      var payload = {
        unique_id: getV('f-uid'),
        valley_work_centers_id: getCombo('f-wc'),
        valley_asset_technical: getCombo('f-asset'),
        code: getV('f-code'),
        capacity_per_hour_kg: getV('f-capacity'),
        description: getV('f-desc'),
        notes: getV('f-notes'),
        is_active: (document.getElementById('f-active') || {}).checked
      };
      UI.showSpinner();
      companyCall('save_valley_work_center_asset', payload)
        .then(function (r) { UIC.closeModal('wca-modal'); UIC.toast((r && r.message) || 'تم الحفظ', 'success'); load(); })
        .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast((e && e.message) || 'فشل', 'error'); })
        .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
    }

    window.WCA_PAGE = { openAdd: openAdd, openEdit: openEdit, save: save };
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderApp);
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="goBack()">رجوع</button>
  </header>

  <div id="list" class="stack"></div>
  <div id="empty" class="empty-state" style="display:none;">لا يوجد سجل تعديلات لهذا السجل.</div>
</div>

<script>
  var TOKEN = getQueryParam('sessionToken') || (API.getSession() && API.getSession().token) || '';
  var SHEET = getQueryParam('sheet') || '';
  var RECORD = getQueryParam('record') || '';
  if (TOKEN) API.setSession({ token: TOKEN, user: (API.getSession() && API.getSession().user) || null });

  function goBack() { window.close && window.close(); history.back && history.back(); }

  function init() {
    if (!SHEET || !RECORD) { UIC.toast('بيانات غير مكتملة', 'error'); return; }
    document.getElementById('subtitle').textContent = 'الجدول: ' + SHEET + ' • السجل رقم: ' + RECORD;
    UI.showSpinner('جاري التحميل...');
    API.call('get_record_history', { sheet_name: SHEET, record_id: RECORD }, TOKEN)
      .then(function (r) {
        var rows = (r && r.history) || [];
        var box = document.getElementById('list');
        box.innerHTML = '';
        if (!rows.length) { document.getElementById('empty').style.display = 'block'; return; }
        rows.forEach(function (c) {
          var item = document.createElement('div');
          item.className = 'hist';
          var actionLabel = { 'create': 'إنشاء', 'update': 'تعديل', 'approve': 'اعتماد', 'delete': 'حذف' }[c.action] || c.action;
          var changed = c.column_name ? ('<div class="hist-field"><b>' + FMT.escape(c.column_name) + '</b></div>' +
              '<div class="hist-vals"><span class="old">' + FMT.escape(c.old_value) + '</span> → <span class="new">' + FMT.escape(c.new_value) + '</span></div>')
            : (c.note ? '<div class="hist-note">' + FMT.escape(c.note) + '</div>' : '');
          item.innerHTML =
            '<div class="hist-head">' +
              '<span class="hist-action action-' + FMT.escape(c.action) + '">' + actionLabel + '</span>' +
              '<span class="hist-user">' + FMT.escape(c.changed_by) + '</span>' +
              '<span class="hist-time">' + FMT.datetime(c.changed_at) + '</span>' +
            '</div>' + changed;
          box.appendChild(item);
        });
      })
      .catch(function (e) { UIC.toast(e.message || 'تعذر التحميل', 'error'); })
      .finally(function () { UI.hideSpinner(); });
  }

  function getQueryParam(name) {
    var m = new RegExp('[?&]' + name + '=([^&]*)').exec(window.location.search);
    return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
  }

  init();
</script>

<script>

window.UIC = window.UIC || {};

UIC.SYSTEM_LOGO_URL = 'https://drive.google.com/thumbnail?id=1Ug1T9j5vQBeBA_5w52ufDO07IsefW6QH&sz=w200';

UIC.button = function (opts) {
  const o = opts || {};
  const type = o.type || 'primary';
  const cls = 'btn btn-' + type + (o.icon && !o.text ? ' btn-icon-only' : '');
  const icon = o.icon ? '<span class="btn-icon">' + o.icon + '</span>' : '';
  const attrs = o.onClick ? ' onclick="' + o.onClick + '"' : '';
  const disabled = o.disabled ? ' disabled' : '';
  return '<button class="' + cls + '"' + attrs + disabled + ' title="' + (o.tooltip || '') + '">' + icon + '<span>' + (o.text || '') + '</span></button>';
};

UIC.statusPill = function (label, tone) {
  const t = tone || 'neutral';
  return '<span class="pill pill-' + t + '">' + (label || '') + '</span>';
};

UIC.pageAuthorized_ = function (action) {
  const up = window.USER_PAGES;
  if (!up) return true;
  return !!(up[action] && up[action].length);
};

/* Navigation helpers — never depend on fragile globals; fall back to the
 * current page URL so links (logo, nav, dropdowns) always work. */
UIC.baseUrl = function () {
  if (window.scriptUrl) return window.scriptUrl;
  try { if (window.top && window.top !== window) return window.top.location.origin + window.top.location.pathname; } catch (e) {}
  return window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;
};
UIC.token = function () {
  try { return window.SESSION_TOKEN || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('sessionToken') || ''; }
  catch (e) { return ''; }
};

/* Navigate to an in-app URL. Prefers TOP-frame navigation so the address bar
 * reflects ?action=… (back/forward + deep-links work); falls back to iframe
 * navigation if the sandbox blocks top-navigation. `ev` = click event. */
UIC.navTo = function (ev, href) {
  try { if (ev && ev.preventDefault) ev.preventDefault(); } catch (e) {}
  if (!href) return;
  try { UIC.showPageLoading('جاري التحميل...'); } catch (e) {}
  try { if (window.top && window.top !== window) { window.top.location.href = href; return; } } catch (e) {}
  window.location.href = href;
};

/* ── Full-screen page-loading overlay (seamless navigation) ───────────────── */
UIC.ensurePageLoading = function () {
  if (document.getElementById('page-loading')) return;
  var st = document.createElement('style');
  st.textContent = '#page-loading{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);direction:rtl;}' +
    '#page-loading.show{display:flex;}' +
    '#page-loading .pl-card{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:18px 26px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.15);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;}' +
    '#page-loading .pl-spin{width:34px;height:34px;border:4px solid #eee;border-top-color:#4a90d9;border-radius:50%;animation:plspin .8s linear infinite;}' +
    '@keyframes plspin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}' +
    '#page-loading .pl-msg{font-family:inherit;color:#444;font-size:14px;}';
  document.head.appendChild(st);
  var d = document.createElement('div');
  d.id = 'page-loading';
  d.innerHTML = '<div class="pl-card"><div class="pl-spin"></div><div class="pl-msg">جاري التحميل...</div></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(d);
};
UIC.showPageLoading = function (msg) {
  try {
    UIC.ensurePageLoading();
    var d = document.getElementById('page-loading');
    if (msg) { var m = d.querySelector('.pl-msg'); if (m) m.textContent = msg; }
    d.classList.add('show');
  } catch (e) {}
};
UIC.hidePageLoading = function () {
  try { var d = document.getElementById('page-loading'); if (d) d.classList.remove('show'); } catch (e) {}
};
UIC.withPageLoading = function (promise, msg) {
  UIC.showPageLoading(msg || 'جاري التحميل...');
  return Promise.resolve(promise).then(function (r) { UIC.hidePageLoading(); return r; }, function (e) { UIC.hidePageLoading(); throw e; });
};
